    1: `timescale 1ns / 100ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : arq_rx_reorder_ddr4_wrapper
    7: Description  : Selective Repeat ARQ Receiver Reorder Buffer (Data Plane).
    8:                
    9:                SDA OISL TABLE 2-11 & SDA OCT COMPLIANCE:
   10:                - Implements the Selective Repeat ARQ receiver sliding window
   11:                  and in-order delivery buffer (inspired by SDA OCT) while 
   12:                  strictly adhering to SDA OISL Table 2-11 parameters:
   13:                  * ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG        = 8'd255 (8-bit register: 1..255)
   14:                  * ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT       = 16     (Table 2-11 'times 16' step,
   15:                                                     configurable to 32 or 64)
   16:                  * ARQ_HOLDOFF_MAX_FRAMES = 4080   (255 x 16 frames = 10.174 ms)
   17:                  * ARQ_MAX_RETX           = 3'd5   (Max retransmission retries)
   18:                
   19:                KEY HARDWARE OPERATIONS:
   20:                1. Stores incoming verified 1908-Byte (477-word) DATA frames 
   21:                   into a circular Block RAM indexed by rx_txfn_in[3:0].
   22:                2. Maintains the receiver sequence counter 'expected_txfn'.
   23:                3. If an out-of-order frame arrives (e.g., TXFN=3 arrives while 
   24:                   TXFN=2 failed CRC-32 and is awaiting retransmission), buffers 
   25:                   TXFN=3 in slot 3 and holds egress until TXFN=2 arrives.
   26:                4. Once TXFN=2 is received, drains TXFN=2 (1908 Bytes) followed 
   27:                   immediately by TXFN=3 (1908 Bytes) in strict sequence order 
   28:                   to ethernet_frame_reassembly.v.
   29: ===========================================================================
   30: */
   31: 
   32: module arq_rx_reorder_ddr4_wrapper #(
   33:     parameter [7:0] ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG  = 8'd255, // SDA OISL Table 2-11 (1..255)
   34:     parameter       ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT = 16,     // Table 2-11: 16 (or 32 / 64 for extended range)
   35:     parameter [2:0] ARQ_MAX_RETX     = 3'd5,   // Table 2-11: Default 5 retries (range 0..7)
   36:     parameter       NUM_SLOTS        = 16      // Active circular window slots in BRAM
   37: )(
   38:     input  wire        clk,                    // 312.5 MHz Clock
   39:     input  wire        rst_n,                  // Active-low reset
   40: 
   41:     // Verified 1908-Byte (477-word) DATA Frame Input from frame_demultiplexer
   42:     input  wire [31:0] s_axis_data_tdata,
   43:     input  wire        s_axis_data_tvalid,
   44:     input  wire        s_axis_data_tlast,
   45:     input  wire [15:0] rx_txfn_in,
   46: 
   47:     // Non-Data (IDLE / MGMT) sequence advancement from arq_rx_controller
   48:     input  wire        non_data_seq_adv,
   49:     input  wire [15:0] non_data_txfn,
   50: 
   51:     // In-Order 1908-Byte (477-word) DATA Stream Output to ethernet_frame_reassembly
   52:     output reg  [31:0] m_axis_ord_tdata,
   53:     output reg         m_axis_ord_tvalid,
   54:     output reg         m_axis_ord_tlast,
   55:     input  wire        m_axis_ord_tready,
   56: 
   57:     // Diagnostic & Table 2-11 Status Outputs
   58:     output reg  [15:0] expected_txfn,
   59:     output wire [15:0] arq_holdoff_frames_out, // Displays 4080 (for 255 x 16)
   60:     output reg  [15:0] in_order_drained_cnt,
   61:     output reg  [15:0] out_of_order_buffered_cnt
   62: );
   63: 
   64:     // =======================================================
   65:     // 1. SDA OISL TABLE 2-11 PARAMETER CALCULATION
   66:     // =======================================================
   67:     localparam [15:0] HOLDOFF_FRAMES_CALC = ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG * ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT;
   68:     assign arq_holdoff_frames_out = HOLDOFF_FRAMES_CALC;
   69: 
   70:     // =======================================================
   71:     // 2. DUAL-PORT BLOCK RAM STORAGE (16 Slots x 512 Words = 8192 Words)
   72:     // =======================================================
   73:     (* ram_style = "block" *) reg [31:0] reorder_ram [0:8191];
   74: 
   75:     reg [15:0] slot_valid;
   76:     reg [15:0] slot_txfn [0:15];
   77:     reg        sync_initialized;
   78: 
   79:     // Write Address Generation
   80:     reg  [8:0]  wr_word_cnt;
   81:     wire [3:0]  wr_slot    = rx_txfn_in[3:0];
   82:     wire [12:0] bram_waddr = {wr_slot, wr_word_cnt};
   83: 
   84:     // Read Address Generation
   85:     reg         draining_slot;
   86:     reg  [8:0]  rd_word_cnt;
   87:     wire [3:0]  rd_slot    = expected_txfn[3:0];
   88:     wire [12:0] bram_raddr = {rd_slot, rd_word_cnt};
   89:     reg  [31:0] bram_dout;
   90: 
   91:     // Purely Synchronous Block RAM Read & Write (Required for Vivado BRAM inference)
   92:     always @(posedge clk) begin
   93:         if (s_axis_data_tvalid) begin
   94:             reorder_ram[bram_waddr] <= s_axis_data_tdata;
   95:         end
   96:         bram_dout <= reorder_ram[bram_raddr];
   97:     end
   98: 
   99:     // =======================================================
  100:     // 3. SELECTIVE REPEAT SLIDING-WINDOW CONTROL FSM
  101:     // =======================================================
  102:     reg drain_d1;
  103:     reg last_d1;
  104:     integer i;
  105: 
  106:     wire current_expected_ready = sync_initialized &&
  107:                                   slot_valid[rd_slot] &&
  108:                                   (slot_txfn[rd_slot] == expected_txfn);
  109: 
  110:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  111:         if (!rst_n) begin
  112:             slot_valid                <= 16'd0;
  113:             for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1) begin
  114:                 slot_txfn[i]          <= 16'd0;
  115:             end
  116:             sync_initialized          <= 1'b0;
  117:             expected_txfn             <= 16'd1;
  118:             wr_word_cnt               <= 9'd0;
  119:             draining_slot             <= 1'b0;
  120:             rd_word_cnt               <= 9'd0;
  121:             drain_d1                  <= 1'b0;
  122:             last_d1                   <= 1'b0;
  123:             m_axis_ord_tvalid         <= 1'b0;
  124:             m_axis_ord_tlast          <= 1'b0;
  125:             m_axis_ord_tdata          <= 32'd0;
  126:             in_order_drained_cnt      <= 16'd0;
  127:             out_of_order_buffered_cnt <= 16'd0;
  128:         end else begin
  129:             // A. Initial Sequence Lock & Non-Data (IDLE/MGMT) Pointer Advancement
  130:             if (!sync_initialized) begin
  131:                 if (s_axis_data_tvalid && (wr_word_cnt == 9'd0)) begin
  132:                     sync_initialized <= 1'b1;
  133:                     if (rx_txfn_in == 16'd0)
  134:                         expected_txfn <= 16'd0;
  135:                     else
  136:                         expected_txfn <= 16'd1;
  137:                 end else if (non_data_seq_adv) begin
  138:                     sync_initialized <= 1'b1;
  139:                     expected_txfn    <= non_data_txfn + 16'd1;
  140:                 end
  141:             end else if (non_data_seq_adv && (non_data_txfn == expected_txfn) && !draining_slot) begin
  142:                 expected_txfn <= expected_txfn + 16'd1;
  143:             end
  144: 
  145:             // B. Write Incoming 477-Word (1908-Byte) Verified DATA Frame into Slot
  146:             if (s_axis_data_tvalid) begin
  147:                 if (s_axis_data_tlast || (wr_word_cnt == 9'd476)) begin
  148:                     wr_word_cnt         <= 9'd0;
  149:                     slot_valid[wr_slot] <= 1'b1;
  150:                     slot_txfn[wr_slot]  <= rx_txfn_in;
  151: 
  152:                     if (rx_txfn_in != expected_txfn) begin
  153:                         out_of_order_buffered_cnt <= out_of_order_buffered_cnt + 16'd1;
  154:                     end
  155:                 end else begin
  156:                     wr_word_cnt <= wr_word_cnt + 9'd1;
  157:                 end
  158:             end else begin
  159:                 wr_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
  160:             end
  161: 
  162:             // C. In-Order Read FSM: Drains Slot [expected_txfn] Only When Ready
  163:             if (!draining_slot) begin
  164:                 drain_d1 <= 1'b0;
  165:                 last_d1  <= 1'b0;
  166:                 if (current_expected_ready && m_axis_ord_tready) begin
  167:                     draining_slot <= 1'b1;
  168:                     rd_word_cnt   <= 9'd0;
  169:                 end
  170:             end else begin
  171:                 if (m_axis_ord_tready) begin
  172:                     drain_d1 <= 1'b1;
  173:                     last_d1  <= (rd_word_cnt == 9'd476);
  174: 
  175:                     if (rd_word_cnt == 9'd476) begin
  176:                         draining_slot        <= 1'b0;
  177:                         rd_word_cnt          <= 9'd0;
  178:                         slot_valid[rd_slot]  <= 1'b0;
  179:                         expected_txfn        <= expected_txfn + 16'd1;
  180:                         in_order_drained_cnt <= in_order_drained_cnt + 16'd1;
  181:                     end else begin
  182:                         rd_word_cnt <= rd_word_cnt + 9'd1;
  183:                     end
  184:                 end
  185:             end
  186: 
  187:             // D. 1-Cycle BRAM Read Output Registration
  188:             if (m_axis_ord_tready) begin
  189:                 m_axis_ord_tvalid <= drain_d1;
  190:                 m_axis_ord_tlast  <= drain_d1 && last_d1;
  191:                 m_axis_ord_tdata  <= drain_d1 ? bram_dout : 32'd0;
  192:             end
  193:         end
  194:     end
  195: 
  196: endmodule
sources_1/new/arq_tx_controller.v — 267 baris

Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : arq_tx_controller
    7: Description  : Selective Repeat ARQ Transmit Controller with Autonomous 
    8:                Holdoff Tracking.
    9:                
   10:                SDA OISL TABLE 2-11 PARAMETERS:
   11:                - ARQ_MAX_RETX           = 3'd5   (Max retries before drop: 0..7)
   12:                - ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG        = 8'd255 (8-bit register setting: 1..255)
   13:                - ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT       = 16     (Table 2-11 'times 16' step;
   14:                                                   configurable to 32 or 64)
   15:                - ARQ_HOLDOFF_MAX_FRAMES = 4080   (255 x 16 frames = 10.174 ms)
   16:                - SIM_SCALE_ENABLE       = 1      (Uses HOLDOFF_TICKS for fast 
   17:                                                   simulation; set 0 for full 
   18:                                                   4080-frame hardware timer)
   19: 
   20: Revision History:
   21:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Selective Repeat ARQ TX controller with holdoff tracker.
   22:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:26 KST) : [Target B5.4 - SDA OISL Page 25-26, Sec. 2.6.3.3.2, 2.6.3.3.3 & Table 2-11]
   23:     1. Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps for project-wide consistency.
   24:     2. Aligned 'track_timer' decrement step with Table 2-11 frame units: when 
   25:        SIM_SCALE_ENABLE == 0 (Hardware Mode), track_timer decrements once per 
   26:        transmitted frame (on tx_trigger_gen) so that ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG * ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT 
   27:        (e.g., 255 * 16 = 4080 frames or project-specific extension 255 * 64 = 16,320 frames) 
   28:        measures exact FSO frames (2.4936 us/frame). When SIM_SCALE_ENABLE == 1, 
   29:        retains cycle-tick scaling for fast testbench verification.
   30:     3. Enabled ARQ disabling when ARQ_MAX_RETX == 3'd0 per Section 2.6.3.3.3 
   31:        ("ARQ shall be disabled by setting the number of re-transmission attempts to zero").
   32: ===========================================================================
   33: */
   34: 
   35: module arq_tx_controller #(
   36:     parameter [2:0]  ARQ_MAX_RETX     = 3'd5,     // SDA OISL Table 2-11 (Default = 5; 0 = ARQ Disabled)
   37:     parameter [7:0]  ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG  = 8'd255,   // SDA OISL Table 2-11 (1..255)
   38:     parameter        ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT = 16,       // Table 2-11: 'times 16' (or 64 for 16,320-frame 5000 km extension)
   39:     parameter        SIM_SCALE_ENABLE = 1,        // 1 = Fast Sim Timer, 0 = Full Frame-Based Timer
   40:     parameter [15:0] HOLDOFF_TICKS    = 16'd500,  // Scaled ticks when SIM_SCALE_ENABLE = 1
   41:     parameter        TRACKER_DEPTH    = 4
   42: )(
   43:     input  wire        clk,
   44:     input  wire        rst_n,
   45: 
   46:     // Traffic Monitors
   47:     input  wire        fso_data_valid,
   48:     input  wire        mgmt_tick_1hz,
   49:     input  wire        header_gen_busy,
   50: 
   51:     // ARQ RX Feedback (From arq_rx_controller)
   52:     input  wire [15:0] rx_rxfn_in,
   53:     input  wire        rx_ack_in,
   54:     input  wire        rx_ack_valid_in,
   55: 
   56:     // Commands to Header Generator
   57:     output reg  [15:0] tx_txfn_out,
   58:     output reg  [1:0]  tx_frame_type,
   59:     output reg         tx_trigger_gen,
   60: 
   61:     // Commands to Payload MUX & Segmenter
   62:     output reg  [1:0]  payload_mux_sel,
   63:     output reg         tx_stall_mac,
   64: 
   65:     // Commands to AXI4 DDR4 Wrapper
   66:     output reg         ddr4_write_req,
   67:     output reg         ddr4_read_req,
   68:     output reg         ddr4_delete_req,
   69:     output reg  [15:0] ddr4_addr
   70: );
   71: 
   72:     // Table 2-11 Holdoff Frame Calculation: 255 x 16 = 4080 frames (or 255 x 64 = 16,320 frames)
   73:     localparam [15:0] TABLE_2_11_HOLDOFF_FRAMES = ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG * ARQ_HOLDOFF_MULT;
   74:     wire [15:0] active_holdoff_limit = (SIM_SCALE_ENABLE == 1) ? HOLDOFF_TICKS : TABLE_2_11_HOLDOFF_FRAMES;
   75:     wire        arq_enabled          = (ARQ_MAX_RETX != 3'd0) && (ARQ_HOLDOFF_CFG != 8'd0);
   76:     wire        timer_step_en        = (SIM_SCALE_ENABLE == 1) ? 1'b1 : tx_trigger_gen;
   77: 
   78:     // FSM States
   79:     localparam S_IDLE       = 3'd0;
   80:     localparam S_EVALUATE   = 3'd1;
   81:     localparam S_EXEC_RETX  = 3'd2;
   82:     localparam S_EXEC_MGMT  = 3'd3;
   83:     localparam S_EXEC_DATA  = 3'd4;
   84:     localparam S_EXEC_IDLE  = 3'd5;
   85:     localparam S_WAIT_FRAME = 3'd6;
   86: 
   87:     reg [2:0]  state;
   88:     reg [15:0] txfn_counter;
   89:     reg        mgmt_pending;
   90: 
   91:     // Pending Acknowledgment Table (Selective Repeat Tracker)
   92:     reg        track_valid [0:TRACKER_DEPTH-1];
   93:     reg [15:0] track_txfn  [0:TRACKER_DEPTH-1];
   94:     reg [15:0] track_timer [0:TRACKER_DEPTH-1];
   95:     reg [2:0]  track_retx  [0:TRACKER_DEPTH-1];
   96: 
   97:     integer i;
   98:     reg        slot_allocated;
   99:     reg        timeout_pending;
  100:     reg [15:0] timeout_target_fn;
  101:     reg [31:0] target_index;
  102: 
  103:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  104:         if (!rst_n) begin
  105:             for (i = 0; i < TRACKER_DEPTH; i = i + 1) begin
  106:                 track_valid[i] <= 1'b0;
  107:                 track_txfn[i]  <= 16'd0;
  108:                 track_timer[i] <= 16'd0;
  109:                 track_retx[i]  <= 3'd0;
  110:             end
  111:             slot_allocated    <= 1'b0;
  112:             timeout_pending   <= 1'b0;
  113:             timeout_target_fn <= 16'd0;
  114:             target_index      <= 32'd0;
  115:             ddr4_delete_req   <= 1'b0;
  116:         end else begin
  117:             ddr4_delete_req <= 1'b0;
  118:             timeout_pending <= 1'b0;
  119: 
  120:             // 1. Process Incoming Selective Repeat Feedback (ACK / NAK)
  121:             if (arq_enabled && rx_ack_valid_in) begin
  122:                 for (i = 0; i < TRACKER_DEPTH; i = i + 1) begin
  123:                     if (track_valid[i] && (track_txfn[i] == rx_rxfn_in)) begin
  124:                         if (rx_ack_in == 1'b1) begin
  125:                             // ACK received: release tracker slot & delete from DDR4
  126:                             track_valid[i]  <= 1'b0;
  127:                             ddr4_delete_req <= 1'b1;
  128:                         end else begin
  129:                             // NAK received: expire timer immediately to trigger S_EXEC_RETX
  130:                             track_timer[i]  <= 16'd0;
  131:                         end
  132:                     end
  133:                 end
  134:             end
  135: 
  136:             // 2. Decrement Timers & Detect Holdoff Timeouts / ARQ_MAX_RETX = 5
  137:             for (i = 0; i < TRACKER_DEPTH; i = i + 1) begin
  138:                 if (track_valid[i]) begin
  139:                     if (track_timer[i] > 16'd0) begin
  140:                         if (timer_step_en)
  141:                             track_timer[i] <= track_timer[i] - 16'd1;
  142:                     end else if (!timeout_pending) begin
  143:                         if (track_retx[i] >= ARQ_MAX_RETX) begin
  144:                             track_valid[i]  <= 1'b0;
  145:                             ddr4_delete_req <= 1'b1;
  146:                         end else begin
  147:                             timeout_pending   <= 1'b1;
  148:                             timeout_target_fn <= track_txfn[i];
  149:                             target_index      <= i;
  150:                         end
  151:                     end
  152:                 end
  153:             end
  154: 
  155:             // 3. Allocate Tracker Slot on New DATA Transmission
  156:             if (arq_enabled && state == S_EXEC_DATA && tx_trigger_gen) begin
  157:                 slot_allocated = 1'b0;
  158:                 for (i = 0; i < TRACKER_DEPTH; i = i + 1) begin
  159:                     if (!track_valid[i] && !slot_allocated) begin
  160:                         track_valid[i] <= 1'b1;
  161:                         track_txfn[i]  <= txfn_counter;
  162:                         track_timer[i] <= active_holdoff_limit;
  163:                         track_retx[i]  <= 3'd0;
  164:                         slot_allocated = 1'b1;
  165:                     end
  166:                 end
  167:             end
  168: 
  169:             // 4. Reload Holdoff Timer & Increment Retry Count (TX_NUM) on Retransmission
  170:             if (state == S_EXEC_RETX && tx_trigger_gen) begin
  171:                 track_timer[target_index[1:0]] <= active_holdoff_limit;
  172:                 track_retx[target_index[1:0]]  <= track_retx[target_index[1:0]] + 3'd1;
  173:             end
  174:         end
  175:     end
  176: 
  177:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  178:         if (!rst_n) begin
  179:             mgmt_pending <= 1'b0;
  180:         end else begin
  181:             if (mgmt_tick_1hz) mgmt_pending <= 1'b1;
  182:             else if (state == S_EXEC_MGMT) mgmt_pending <= 1'b0;
  183:         end
  184:     end
  185: 
  186:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  187:         if (!rst_n) begin
  188:             state           <= S_IDLE;
  189:             txfn_counter    <= 16'd0;
  190:             tx_txfn_out     <= 16'd0;
  191:             tx_frame_type   <= 2'b00;
  192:             tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b0;
  193:             payload_mux_sel <= 2'b00;
  194:             tx_stall_mac    <= 1'b0;
  195:             ddr4_write_req  <= 1'b0;
  196:             ddr4_read_req   <= 1'b0;
  197:             ddr4_addr       <= 16'd0;
  198:         end else begin
  199:             tx_trigger_gen <= 1'b0;
  200:             ddr4_write_req <= 1'b0;
  201:             ddr4_read_req  <= 1'b0;
  202: 
  203:             case (state)
  204:                 S_IDLE: begin
  205:                     tx_stall_mac <= 1'b0;
  206:                     if (!header_gen_busy) state <= S_EVALUATE;
  207:                 end
  208: 
  209:                 S_EVALUATE: begin
  210:                     if (arq_enabled && timeout_pending) state <= S_EXEC_RETX; // Priority 1: ARQ Retransmission
  211:                     else if (mgmt_pending)              state <= S_EXEC_MGMT; // Priority 2: 1Hz Management Frame
  212:                     else if (fso_data_valid)            state <= S_EXEC_DATA; // Priority 3: New Ethernet Data
  213:                     else                                state <= S_EXEC_IDLE; // Priority 4: PRBS Idle Frame
  214:                 end
  215: 
  216:                 S_EXEC_RETX: begin
  217:                     tx_stall_mac    <= 1'b1;
  218:                     tx_txfn_out     <= timeout_target_fn;
  219:                     tx_frame_type   <= 2'b01;
  220:                     payload_mux_sel <= 2'b11;
  221:                     ddr4_addr       <= timeout_target_fn;
  222:                     ddr4_read_req   <= 1'b1;
  223:                     tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b1;
  224:                     state           <= S_WAIT_FRAME;
  225:                 end
  226: 
  227:                 S_EXEC_MGMT: begin
  228:                     tx_txfn_out     <= txfn_counter;
  229:                     tx_frame_type   <= 2'b10;
  230:                     payload_mux_sel <= 2'b10;
  231:                     tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b1;
  232:                     state           <= S_WAIT_FRAME;
  233:                 end
  234: 
  235:                 S_EXEC_DATA: begin
  236:                     tx_txfn_out     <= txfn_counter;
  237:                     tx_frame_type   <= 2'b01;
  238:                     payload_mux_sel <= 2'b01;
  239:                     ddr4_addr       <= txfn_counter;
  240:                     ddr4_write_req  <= 1'b1;
  241:                     tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b1;
  242:                     state           <= S_WAIT_FRAME;
  243:                 end
  244: 
  245:                 S_EXEC_IDLE: begin
  246:                     tx_txfn_out     <= txfn_counter;
  247:                     tx_frame_type   <= 2'b00;
  248:                     payload_mux_sel <= 2'b00;
  249:                     tx_trigger_gen  <= 1'b1;
  250:                     state           <= S_WAIT_FRAME;
  251:                 end
  252: 
  253:                 S_WAIT_FRAME: begin
  254:                     if (header_gen_busy) begin
  255:                         // Wait until current frame completes
  256:                     end else if (!tx_trigger_gen) begin
  257:                         if (payload_mux_sel != 2'b11) txfn_counter <= txfn_counter + 16'd1;
  258:                         state <= S_IDLE;
  259:                     end
  260:                 end
  261: 
  262:                 default: state <= S_IDLE;
  263:             endcase
  264:         end
  265:     end
  266: 
  267: endmodule

   23: module autorun(
   24:     input       clk,
   25:     input       rst_n,
   26:     output      flag
   27: );
   28: 
   29: parameter   max     = 1119;     // 1332 or 1525 or 1119 sim
   30: (*mark_debug = "true" *)reg     [15:0]  count   = 16'd0;
   31: 
   32: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   33: begin
   34:     if (~rst_n)
   35:         count   <= 16'd0;
   36:     else if (count < max)
   37:         count   <= count + 1'b1;
   38:     else
   39:         count   <= 16'd0;
   40: end
   41: 
   42: assign  flag    = (count == 0);

    4: // Engineer:

    7: // Design Name: 
    8: // Module Name: eth_framer
    9: // Project Name:

   22: 
   23: module assembler(
   24:     input               clk,
   25:     input               rst_n,
   26:     input               en_head,
   27:     input               en_load,
   28:     input   [7:0]       header_in,
   29:     input   [31:0]      payload_in,
   30:     output              flag,
   31:     output  [31:0]      data_out
   32: );
   33: 
   34: parameter   max         = 483;
   35: parameter   thres       = 240;
   36: reg     [15:0]  count   = 16'd0;
   37: 
   38: parameter   IDLE        = 4'b0001;
   39: parameter   CHECK       = 4'b0010;
   40: parameter   ACTIVE      = 4'b0100;
   41: parameter   END         = 4'b1000;
   42: 
   43: reg     [3:0]   state;
   44: reg     [3:0]   next_state;
   45: 
   46: reg     [111:0]     head_d0;
   47: reg     [111:0]     head_d1;
   48: 
   49: reg     [31:0]      load_d0;
   50: reg     [31:0]      head_out;
   51: 
   52: reg     [13:0]      len_payload     = 14'd0;
   53: reg     [13:0]      len_packet      = 14'd0;
   54: 
   55: wire    wr_en;
   56: wire    rd_en;
   57: wire    [63:0]      fifo_out;
   58: reg     [31:0]      eth_packet;
   59: 
   60: reg     [63:0]      roll_out;
   61: reg     [31:0]      load_out;
   62: 
   63: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   64: begin
   65:     if (~rst_n)
   66:         state   <= IDLE;
   67:     else
   68:         state   <= next_state;
   69: end
   70: 
   71: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   72: begin
   73:     if (~rst_n)
   74:         count   <= 16'd0;
   75:     else if (state == ACTIVE )
   76:         count   <= count + 1'b1;
   77:     else
   78:         count   <= 16'd0;
   79: end
   80: 
   81: always @(*)
   82: begin
   83:     case(state)
   84:         IDLE:           begin
   85:                             if (en_load)
   86:                                 next_state  <= CHECK;
   87:                             else
   88:                                 next_state  <= IDLE;
   89:                         end
   90:         CHECK:          begin
   91:                             if (load_d0[31:24] == 8'hab)
   92:                                 next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   93:                             else
   94:                                 next_state  <= END;
   95:                         end
   96:         ACTIVE:         begin
   97:                             if (count < max)
   98:                                 next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   99:                             else
  100:                                 next_state  <= END;
  101:                         end
  102:         END:            next_state  <= IDLE;
  103:         default:        next_state  <= IDLE;
  104:     endcase
  105: end
  106: 
  107: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  108: begin
  109:     if (~rst_n)
  110:         load_d0     <= 32'b0;
  111:     else
  112:         load_d0     <= payload_in;
  113: end
  114: 
  115: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  116: begin
  117:     if (~rst_n)
  118:         len_payload     <= 14'd0;
  119:     else if (state == CHECK)
  120:         len_payload     <= load_d0[13:0];
  121: end
  122: 
  123: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  124: begin
  125:     if (~rst_n)
  126:         head_d0     <= 112'b0;
  127:     else if (count > 6)
  128:         head_d0     <= {head_d0[103:0], header_in};
  129: end
  130: 
  131: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  132: begin
  133:     if (~rst_n)
  134:         head_d1     <= 112'b0;
  135:     else if (count == 21)
  136:         head_d1     <= head_d0;
  137: end
  138: 
  139: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  140: begin
  141:     if (~rst_n)
  142:         eth_packet      <= 32'b0;
  143:     else if (rd_en)
  144:         begin
  145:             if (count > thres + 1 && count < max - 1)
  146:                 begin
  147:                     len_packet      <= len_packet - 14'd4;
  148:                     if (fifo_out[63:48] == 16'hcdef)
  149:                         begin
  150:                             if (fifo_out[45:32] == len_packet)
  151:                                 eth_packet      <= fifo_out[31:0];
  152:                             else
  153:                                 eth_packet      <= 32'b0;
  154:                         end
  155:                     else
  156:                         eth_packet      <= 32'b0;
  157:                 end
  158:             else if (count == thres + 1)
  159:                 len_packet      <= len_payload - 14'd4;
  160:         end
  161: end
  162: 
  163: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  164: begin
  165:     if (~rst_n)
  166:         roll_out    <= 64'b0;
  167:     else
  168:         roll_out    <= {roll_out[31:0], eth_packet};
  169: end
  170: 
  171: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  172: begin
  173:     if (~rst_n)
  174:         load_out    <= 32'b0;
  175:     else
  176:         load_out    <= roll_out[47:16];
  177: end
  178: 
  179: assign  wr_en   = (state == ACTIVE && count < max - 5);
  180: assign  rd_en   = (count > thres && count < max);
  181: 
  182: assign  flag        = (state == ACTIVE && count > 242);
  183: assign  data_out    = (flag) ? head_out : 32'b0;
  184: 
  185: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  186: begin
  187:     if (~rst_n)
  188:         head_out    <= 32'b0;
  189:     else if (count > 241 && count < 246)
  190:         begin
  191:             case (count)
  192:                 16'd242:    head_out    <= head_d1[111:80];
  193:                 16'd243:    head_out    <= head_d1[79:48];
  194:                 16'd244:    head_out    <= head_d1[47:16];
  195:                 16'd245:    head_out    <= {head_d1[15:0], load_out[15:0]};
  196:                 default:    head_out    <= 32'b0;
  197:             endcase
  198:         end
  199:     else if (count > 245)
  200:         head_out    <= load_out;
  201:     else
  202:         head_out    <= 32'b0;
  203: end
  204: 
  205: serdes_assembler serdes_inst (
  206:     .srst           (1'b0)
  207:     ,.clk           (clk)
  208:     ,.wr_en         (wr_en)
  209:     ,.din           (load_d0)
  210:     ,.rd_en         (rd_en)
  211:     ,.dout          (fifo_out)
  212: );

   20: module core_rx(
   21:     input               clk,
   22:     input               rst_n,
   23:     input               en,
   24:     input   [127:0]     data_in,      // 128-bit from rx_gth_logic (CDC 3)
   25:     output              header_dv,    // 16 cycles @ 8-bit (16-Byte Decoded Header)
   26:     output  [7:0]       header,
   27:     output              payload_dv,   // 239 cycles @ 64-bit (1912-Byte Decoded Payload)
   28:     output  [63:0]      payload,
   29:     output              link_locked   // Optical Preamble 72-bit lock status
   30: );
   31: 
   32:     // 1. Demux Preamble & LPC Wires
   33:     wire [71:0] preamble_extracted;
   34:     wire        preamble_valid;
   35:     wire [95:0] lpc_data_raw;
   36:     wire        lpc_valid_raw;

   39:     wire        lpc_dv;
   40:     wire [63:0] lpc;
   41: 
   42:     // 3. Descrambler -> FEC_Demux Wires
   43:     wire        descrambler_dv;
   44:     wire [63:0] descrambled_data;
   45: 
   46:     // 4. FEC_Demux -> RS Decoders Wires
   47:     wire        rs_head_dv;
   48:     wire [7:0]  rs_head;
   49:     wire        rs_load_dv;
   50:     wire [63:0] rs_load;
   51: 
   52:     // --- 1. INSTANSIASI DEMULTIPLEXER 128-BIT ---
   53:     demux_preamble_128 demux_inst (
   54:         .clk                (clk),
   55:         .rst_n              (rst_n),
   56:         .cdc_data_in        (data_in),
   57:         .cdc_valid_in       (en),
   58:         .preamble_extracted (preamble_extracted),
   59:         .preamble_valid     (preamble_valid),
   60:         .lpc_data_out       (lpc_data_raw),
   61:         .lpc_valid_out      (lpc_valid_raw)
   62:     );
   63: 
   64:     // --- 2. INSTANSIASI PREAMBLE SDA DECODER ---
   65:     preamble_sda_decoder preamble_sda_decoder_inst (
   66:         .clk                (clk),
   67:         .rst_n              (rst_n),
   68:         .preamble_in        (preamble_extracted),
   69:         .preamble_valid_in  (preamble_valid),
   70:         .link_locked_out    (link_locked)
   71:     );
   72: 
   73:     // --- 3. INSTANSIASI LPC(24,16) DECODER TOP (96-bit -> 64-bit) ---
   74:     lpc_dec_top lpc_dec_top_inst (
   75:         .clk                (clk),
   76:         .rst_n              (rst_n),
   77:         .en                 (lpc_valid_raw),
   78:         .data_in            (lpc_data_raw),
   79:         .flag               (lpc_dv),
   80:         .data_out           (lpc)
   81:     );
   82: 
   83:     // --- 4. INSTANSIASI PRBS DESCRAMBLER (64-bit, 259 Siklus) ---
   84:     descrambler descrambler_inst (
   85:         .clk                (clk),
   86:         .rst_n              (rst_n),
   87:         .en                 (lpc_dv),
   88:         .data_in            (lpc),
   89:         .flag               (descrambler_dv),
   90:         .data_out           (descrambled_data)
   91:     );
   92: 
   93:     // --- 5. INSTANSIASI FEC_DEMUX (259x64b -> 32x8b Hdr + 255x64b Pld) ---
   94:     FEC_Demux fec_demux_inst (
   95:         .clk                (clk),
   96:         .rst_n              (rst_n),
   97:         .en                 (descrambler_dv),
   98:         .data_in            (descrambled_data),
   99:         .header_dv          (rs_head_dv),
  100:         .header             (rs_head),
  101:         .payload_dv         (rs_load_dv),
  102:         .payload            (rs_load)
  103:     );
  104: 
  105:     // --- 6. INSTANSIASI RS(32,16) HEADER DECODER ---
  106:     rs_decoder #(33) rs_decoder_inst (
  107:         .clk                (clk),
  108:         .rst_n              (rst_n),
  109:         .en                 (rs_head_dv),
  110:         .data_in            (rs_head),
  111:         .flag               (header_dv),
  112:         .data_out           (header)
  113:     );
  114: 
  115:     // --- 7. INSTANSIASI 8xRS(255,239) PAYLOAD DECODER ---
  116:     rs_decoder_64 rs_decoder_64_inst (

Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University / ETRI Daejeon
    5: Engineers    : Irzal Zaini & Williamsyah Baginda Miraj
    6: Module Name  : lpc_dec
    7: Description  : 24-bit to 16-bit Line Product Code (LPC) Sub-Decoder.
    8:                Performs 2D horizontal (H[0:3]) and vertical (V[0:3]) parity 
    9:                syndrome checking to correct single-bit errors in the 16-bit 
   10:                encoded data matrix (E[0:15]) and reverses the differential 
   11:                encoding to recover the 16-bit descrambled word (U[0:15]).
   12: 
   13: Revision History:
   14:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 2D syndrome single-bit error corrector & differential decoder.
   15:   - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 05:45 KST) : Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps and added 
   16:     corrected_bit_stb tracker for lpc_dec_top.v.
   17:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:09 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 6 - SDA OISL Page 40-41, Sec. 2.6.3.6.8]
   18:     Added matching Active Disparity Management state tracker (running_disparity).
   19:   - Rev 2.2 (2026-10-28 14:55 KST) : [Clean-Path, All 24-Bit Error Positions & Monitor Fix]
   20:     1. Fixed clean-path false inversion by setting ACTIVE_DISP_INV_EN = 0 default and
   21:        restricting word_is_inverted strictly to exact inverted zero-error syndrome
   22:        (Hr == 4'b1000 && Vr == 4'b1000).
   23:     2. Added exact single-row & single-column weight gating (h_wt == 1 && v_wt == 1)
   24:        plus E[0] all-syndrome detection (is_e0_err = (&H) & (&V)) so single-bit errors
   25:        across ALL 24 codeword bit positions (bits 23..8 data E[0..15] and bits 7..0
   26:        parity P[7..0]) are 100% corrected with zero false triggers.
   27:     3. Added internal monitor alias wires (E_rx, P_rx, P_calc, SH, SV) for full backward
   28:        compatibility with legacy lpc_dec_top.v monitors.
   29: ===========================================================================
   30: */
   31: 
   32: module lpc_dec #(
   33:     parameter ACTIVE_DISP_INV_EN = 0
   34: )(
   35:     input  wire        clk,
   36:     input  wire        rst_n,
   37:     input  wire        en,
   38:     input  wire [23:0] data_in,
   39:     output wire        flag,
   40:     output wire [15:0] data_out
   41: );
   42: 
   43:     reg         en_d0;
   44:     reg  [23:0] temp;
   45: 
   46:     reg  signed [11:0] running_disparity;
   47:     function [4:0] count_ones_24(input [23:0] w);
   48:         integer idx;
   49:         reg [4:0] sum;
   50:         begin
   51:             sum = 5'd0;
   52:             for (idx = 0; idx < 24; idx = idx + 1) begin
   53:                 sum = sum + w[idx];
   54:             end
   55:             count_ones_24 = sum;
   56:         end
   57:     endfunction
   58: 
   59:     wire [0:15] U;
   60:     wire [0:15] M;
   61:     wire [0:15] E;
   62:     wire [0:3]  H;
   63:     wire [0:3]  V;
   64:     wire [7:0]  P;
   65:     wire [0:15] S;
   66: 
   67:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   68:         if (~rst_n)
   69:             en_d0 <= 1'b0;
   70:         else
   71:             en_d0 <= en;
   72:     end
   73: 
   74:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   75:         if (~rst_n)
   76:             temp <= 24'b0;
   77:         else
   78:             temp <= data_in;
   79:     end
   80: 
   81:     // Raw syndromes on incoming 'temp'
   82:     wire [0:15] Er = temp[23:8];
   83:     wire [7:0]  Pr = temp[7:0];
   84:     wire [0:3]  Hr, Vr;
   85: 
   86:     assign Hr[0] = Er[0]  ^ Er[1]  ^ Er[2]  ^ Er[3]  ^ (~Pr[7]);
   87:     assign Hr[1] = Er[4]  ^ Er[5]  ^ Er[6]  ^ Er[7]  ^ (~Pr[6]) ^ Er[0];
   88:     assign Hr[2] = Er[8]  ^ Er[9]  ^ Er[10] ^ Er[11] ^ (~Pr[5]) ^ Er[0];
   89:     assign Hr[3] = Er[12] ^ Er[13] ^ Er[14] ^ Er[15] ^ (~Pr[4]) ^ Er[0];
   90: 
   91:     assign Vr[0] = Er[0] ^ Er[4] ^ Er[8]  ^ Er[12] ^ Pr[3];
   92:     assign Vr[1] = Er[1] ^ Er[5] ^ Er[9]  ^ Er[13] ^ Pr[2] ^ Er[0];
   93:     assign Vr[2] = Er[2] ^ Er[6] ^ Er[10] ^ Er[14] ^ Pr[1] ^ Er[0];
   94:     assign Vr[3] = Er[3] ^ Er[7] ^ Er[11] ^ Er[15] ^ Pr[0] ^ Er[0];
   95: 
   96:     // Note: In a non-inverted codeword with 0 or 1 bit error, (Hr==4'b1000 && Vr==4'b1000)
   97:     // never occurs because E[0] flips all 8 syndromes (Hr==4'b1111 && Vr==4'b1111).
   98:     wire word_is_inverted   = ACTIVE_DISP_INV_EN && (Hr == 4'b1000) && (Vr == 4'b1000);
   99:     wire [23:0] aligned_temp = word_is_inverted ? ~temp : temp;
  100: 
  101:     wire [4:0]        rx_ones_cnt  = count_ones_24(temp);
  102:     wire signed [6:0] rx_disparity = $signed({1'b0, rx_ones_cnt, 1'b0}) - 7'sd24;
  103: 
  104:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  105:         if (~rst_n)
  106:             running_disparity <= 12'sd0;
  107:         else if (en_d0)
  108:             running_disparity <= running_disparity + {{5{rx_disparity[6]}}, rx_disparity};
  109:         else
  110:             running_disparity <= 12'sd0;
  111:     end
  112: 
  113:     assign E = {aligned_temp[23], aligned_temp[22], aligned_temp[21], aligned_temp[20],
  114:                 aligned_temp[19], aligned_temp[18], aligned_temp[17], aligned_temp[16],
  115:                 aligned_temp[15], aligned_temp[14], aligned_temp[13], aligned_temp[12],
  116:                 aligned_temp[11], aligned_temp[10], aligned_temp[9],  aligned_temp[8]};
  117: 
  118:     assign P = aligned_temp[7:0];
  119: 
  120:     // Horizontal & Vertical Syndrome Equations
  121:     assign H[0] = E[0]  ^ E[1]  ^ E[2]  ^ E[3]  ^ (~P[7]);
  122:     assign H[1] = E[4]  ^ E[5]  ^ E[6]  ^ E[7]  ^ (~P[6]) ^ E[0];
  123:     assign H[2] = E[8]  ^ E[9]  ^ E[10] ^ E[11] ^ (~P[5]) ^ E[0];
  124:     assign H[3] = E[12] ^ E[13] ^ E[14] ^ E[15] ^ (~P[4]) ^ E[0];
  125: 
  126:     assign V[0] = E[0] ^ E[4] ^ E[8]  ^ E[12] ^ P[3];
  127:     assign V[1] = E[1] ^ E[5] ^ E[9]  ^ E[13] ^ P[2] ^ E[0];
  128:     assign V[2] = E[2] ^ E[6] ^ E[10] ^ E[14] ^ P[1] ^ E[0];
  129:     assign V[3] = E[3] ^ E[7] ^ E[11] ^ E[15] ^ P[0] ^ E[0];
  130: 
  131:     // Exact 2D Cross-Point Error Localization for All 24 Bit Positions:
  132:     // - E[0] error (bit 23) flips all 8 syndromes: H == 4'b1111 && V == 4'b1111 (is_e0_err)
  133:     // - E[1..15] error (bits 22..8) flips exactly 1 H row (h_wt == 1) and 1 V col (v_wt == 1)
  134:     // - P[7..0] error (bits 7..0) flips only 1 H or 1 V (h_wt == 0 or v_wt == 0), leaving E untouched
  135:     wire [2:0] h_wt       = H[0] + H[1] + H[2] + H[3];
  136:     wire [2:0] v_wt       = V[0] + V[1] + V[2] + V[3];
  137:     wire       is_e0_err  = (&H) & (&V);
  138:     wire       is_1b_data = (h_wt == 3'd1) && (v_wt == 3'd1);
  139: 
  140:     assign S[0]  = is_e0_err;
  141:     assign S[1]  = is_1b_data & H[0] & V[1];
  142:     assign S[2]  = is_1b_data & H[0] & V[2];
  143:     assign S[3]  = is_1b_data & H[0] & V[3];
  144:     assign S[4]  = is_1b_data & H[1] & V[0];
  145:     assign S[5]  = is_1b_data & H[1] & V[1];
  146:     assign S[6]  = is_1b_data & H[1] & V[2];
  147:     assign S[7]  = is_1b_data & H[1] & V[3];
  148:     assign S[8]  = is_1b_data & H[2] & V[0];
  149:     assign S[9]  = is_1b_data & H[2] & V[1];
  150:     assign S[10] = is_1b_data & H[2] & V[2];
  151:     assign S[11] = is_1b_data & H[2] & V[3];
  152:     assign S[12] = is_1b_data & H[3] & V[0];
  153:     assign S[13] = is_1b_data & H[3] & V[1];
  154:     assign S[14] = is_1b_data & H[3] & V[2];
  155:     assign S[15] = is_1b_data & H[3] & V[3];
  156: 
  157:     // Single-Bit Error Correction
  158:     assign M[0]  = E[0]  ^ S[0];
  159:     assign M[1]  = E[1]  ^ S[1];
  160:     assign M[2]  = E[2]  ^ S[2];
  161:     assign M[3]  = E[3]  ^ S[3];
  162:     assign M[4]  = E[4]  ^ S[4];
  163:     assign M[5]  = E[5]  ^ S[5];
  164:     assign M[6]  = E[6]  ^ S[6];
  165:     assign M[7]  = E[7]  ^ S[7];
  166:     assign M[8]  = E[8]  ^ S[8];
  167:     assign M[9]  = E[9]  ^ S[9];
  168:     assign M[10] = E[10] ^ S[10];
  169:     assign M[11] = E[11] ^ S[11];
  170:     assign M[12] = E[12] ^ S[12];
  171:     assign M[13] = E[13] ^ S[13];
  172:     assign M[14] = E[14] ^ S[14];
  173:     assign M[15] = E[15] ^ S[15];
  174: 
  175:     // Differential Decoding (Inverse of Figure 2-13)
  176:     assign U[0]  = M[0];
  177:     assign U[1]  = M[1]  ^ M[0];
  178:     assign U[2]  = M[2]  ^ M[1];
  179:     assign U[3]  = M[3]  ^ M[2];
  180:     assign U[4]  = M[4]  ^ M[3];
  181:     assign U[5]  = M[5]  ^ M[4];
  182:     assign U[6]  = M[6]  ^ M[5];
  183:     assign U[7]  = M[7]  ^ M[6];
  184:     assign U[8]  = M[8];
  185:     assign U[9]  = M[9]  ^ M[8];
  186:     assign U[10] = M[10] ^ M[9];
  187:     assign U[11] = M[11] ^ M[10];
  188:     assign U[12] = M[12] ^ M[11];
  189:     assign U[13] = M[13] ^ M[12];
  190:     assign U[14] = M[14] ^ M[13];
  191:     assign U[15] = M[15] ^ M[14];
  192: 
  193:     wire corrected_bit_stb = en_d0 && ((|S) || ((h_wt + v_wt) == 3'd1));
  194: 
  195:     // [Rev 2.2] Monitor Alias Wires for lpc_dec_top.v Compatibility
  196:     wire [15:0] E_rx   = {E[0], E[1], E[2], E[3], E[4], E[5], E[6], E[7],
  197:                           E[8], E[9], E[10], E[11], E[12], E[13], E[14], E[15]};
  198:     wire [7:0]  P_rx   = P;
  199:     wire [7:0]  P_calc = {~(E[0]^E[1]^E[2]^E[3]), ~(E[0]^E[4]^E[5]^E[6]^E[7]),
  200:                           ~(E[0]^E[8]^E[9]^E[10]^E[11]), ~(E[0]^E[12]^E[13]^E[14]^E[15]),
  201:                           (E[0]^E[4]^E[8]^E[12]), (E[0]^E[1]^E[5]^E[9]^E[13]),
  202:                           (E[0]^E[2]^E[6]^E[10]^E[14]), (E[0]^E[3]^E[7]^E[11]^E[15])};
  203:     wire [3:0]  SH     = {H[0], H[1], H[2], H[3]};
  204:     wire [3:0]  SV     = {V[0], V[1], V[2], V[3]};
  205: 
  206:     assign flag     = en_d0;
  207:     assign data_out = (flag) ? {U[0], U[1], U[2],  U[3],  U[4],  U[5],  U[6],  U[7],
  208:                                 U[8], U[9], U[10], U[11], U[12], U[13], U[14], U[15]} : 16'b0;
  209: 
  210: endmodule

    8:                Instantiates 4 parallel 24-to-16 bit LPC decoders (lpc_dec_3 .. 
    9:                lpc_dec_0) and tracks cumulative corrected single-bit errors 
   10:                (total_corrected_bits) for testbench telemetry.
   11: 
   12: Revision History:
   13:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 4-lane parallel LPC(24,16) decoder wrapper.
   14:   - Rev 2.2 (2026-10-28 14:55 KST) : Defined 'total_corrected_bits' telemetry
   15:     counter and synchronized internal monitor wires with lpc_dec.v Rev 2.2.
   16: ===========================================================================
   17: */
   18: 
   19: module lpc_dec_top (
   20:     input  wire        clk,
   21:     input  wire        rst_n,
   22:     input  wire        en,
   23:     input  wire [95:0] data_in,
   24:     output wire        flag,
   25:     output wire [63:0] data_out
   26: );
   27: 
   28:     wire [3:0] f;
   29:     assign flag = &f;
   30:

   32:         .clk      (clk),
   33:         .rst_n    (rst_n),
   34:         .en       (en),
   35:         .data_in  (data_in[95:72]),
   36:         .flag     (f[3]),
   37:         .data_out (data_out[63:48])
   38:     );
   39: 
   40:     lpc_dec lpc_dec_2 (
   41:         .clk      (clk),
   42:         .rst_n    (rst_n),
   43:         .en       (en),
   44:         .data_in  (data_in[71:48]),
   45:         .flag     (f[2]),
   46:         .data_out (data_out[47:32])
   47:     );
   48: 
   49:     lpc_dec lpc_dec_1 (
   50:         .clk      (clk),
   51:         .rst_n    (rst_n),
   52:         .en       (en),
   53:         .data_in  (data_in[47:24]),
   54:         .flag     (f[1]),
   55:         .data_out (data_out[31:16])
   56:     );
   57: 
   58:     lpc_dec lpc_dec_0 (

   62:         .data_in  (data_in[23:0]),

   64:         .data_out (data_out[15:0])
   65:     );
   66: 
   67:     // Cumulative Single-Bit Error Repair Counter for Testbench Telemetry
   68:     reg [15:0] total_corrected_bits;
   69:     wire [2:0] cycle_repaired_cnt = lpc_dec_3.corrected_bit_stb +
   70:                                     lpc_dec_2.corrected_bit_stb +
   71:                                     lpc_dec_1.corrected_bit_stb +
   72:                                     lpc_dec_0.corrected_bit_stb;
   73:

    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University / ETRI Daejeon
    5: Engineers    : Irzal Zaini & Williamsyah Baginda Miraj
    6: Module Name  : rs_decoder_64
    7: Description  : 64-bit Parallel Reed-Solomon Payload Decoder.
    8:                Instantiates 8 parallel RS(255,239) decoder engines to 
    9:                process 255 incoming 64-bit words (2040 Bytes) and output 
   10:                239 corrected 64-bit payload words (1912 Bytes).
   11: 
   12:                Revision History:
   13:                - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 8-lane parallel RS(255,239) payload decoder.
   14:                - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 06:20 KST) : Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps,
   15:                  clocked rs_sim_q writer on negedge clk, and maintained 
   16:                  continuous 4-frame unpacking (7648 bytes across exact 
   17:                  2493.600 ns frame windows) so rs_frame_id counts 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4.
   18: ===========================================================================
   19: */
   20: 
   21: module rs_decoder_64 (
   22:     input  wire        clk,
   23:     input  wire        rst_n,
   24:     input  wire        en,
   25:     input  wire [63:0] data_in,
   26:     output wire        flag,
   27:     output wire [63:0] data_out
   28: );
   29: 
   30:     rs_decoder #(256) rs_decoder_7 (
   31:         .clk      (clk),
   32:         .rst_n    (rst_n),
   33:         .en       (en),
   34:         .data_in  (data_in[63:56]),
   35:         .flag     (flag),
   36:         .data_out (data_out[63:56])
   37:     );
   38: 
   39:     rs_decoder #(256) rs_decoder_6 (
   40:         .clk      (clk),
   41:         .rst_n    (rst_n),
   42:         .en       (en),
   43:         .data_in  (data_in[55:48]),
   44:         .flag     (),
   45:         .data_out (data_out[55:48])
   46:     );
   47: 
   48:     rs_decoder #(256) rs_decoder_5 (
   49:         .clk      (clk),
   50:         .rst_n    (rst_n),
   51:         .en       (en),
   52:         .data_in  (data_in[47:40]),
   53:         .flag     (),
   54:         .data_out (data_out[47:40])
   55:     );
   56: 
   57:     rs_decoder #(256) rs_decoder_4 (
   58:         .clk      (clk),

  102:     // =====================================================================
  103:     // SIMULATION TRACKERS: 1..1912 BYTE UNPACKER & FSO HEADER/CRC32 EXTRACTOR

  105:     // synthesis translate_off
  106:     wire [8:0]  pld_out_word_cnt = rs_decoder_7.out_byte_cnt; // 1..239 Words (64-bit)
  107:     wire [11:0] total_repaired_pld_bytes = 
  108:                 rs_decoder_7.repaired_symbol_cnt + rs_decoder_6.repaired_symbol_cnt +
  109:                 rs_decoder_5.repaired_symbol_cnt + rs_decoder_4.repaired_symbol_cnt +
  110:                 rs_decoder_3.repaired_symbol_cnt + rs_decoder_2.repaired_symbol_cnt +
  111:                 rs_decoder_1.repaired_symbol_cnt + rs_decoder_0.repaired_symbol_cnt;
  112: 
  113:     reg [31:0] fso_payload_header; // Captures 0xAB00_076C from Word 1 [63:32]
  114:     reg [31:0] fso_packet_header;  // Captures 0xCDEF_07D0 from Word 1 [31:0]
  115:     reg [31:0] fso_crc32_out;      // Captures 32-bit FSO CRC-32 from Word 239 [31:0]
  116: 
  117:     reg [7:0]  rs_sim_q [0:16383];
  118:     integer    rs_wr_ptr;
  119:     integer    rs_rd_ptr;
  120:     reg        rs_unpack_active;
  121: 
  122:     reg [7:0]  pld_byte_stream;
  123:     reg [11:0] pld_byte_cnt;       // Counts strictly 1 to 1912 per frame
  124:     reg [31:0] rs_frame_id;        // Active Frame ID (1, 2, 3, 4)
  125:     reg [15:0] pld_total_bytes;    // Counts 1 to 7648 (4 x 1912 Bytes)
  126: 
  127:     initial begin
  128:         fso_payload_header = 32'd0;
  129:         fso_packet_header  = 32'd0;
  130:         fso_crc32_out      = 32'd0;
  131:         rs_wr_ptr          = 0;
  132:         rs_rd_ptr          = 0;
  133:         rs_unpack_active   = 1'b0;
  134:         pld_byte_stream    = 8'd0;
  135:         pld_byte_cnt       = 12'd0;
  136:         rs_frame_id        = 32'd0;
  137:         pld_total_bytes    = 16'd0;
  138:     end
  139: 
  140:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  141:         if (~rst_n) begin
  142:             fso_payload_header <= 32'd0;
  143:             fso_packet_header  <= 32'd0;
  144:             fso_crc32_out      <= 32'd0;
  145:         end else if (flag) begin
  146:             if (pld_out_word_cnt == 9'd1) begin
  147:                 fso_payload_header <= data_out[63:32];
  148:                 fso_packet_header  <= data_out[31:0];
  149:             end
  150:             if (pld_out_word_cnt == 9'd239) begin
  151:                 fso_crc32_out <= data_out[31:0];
  152:             end
  153:         end
  154:     end
  155: 
  156:     // THREAD B: Negedge Queue Writer (2.5 ns before posedge clk)
  157:     always @(negedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  158:         if (~rst_n) begin
  159:             rs_wr_ptr = 0;
  160:         end else if (flag) begin
  161:             rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 0] = data_out[63:56];
  162:             rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 1] = data_out[55:48];
  163:             rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 2] = data_out[47:40];
  164:             rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 3] = data_out[39:32];
  165:             rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 4] = data_out[31:24];
  166:             rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 5] = data_out[23:16];
  167:             rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 6] = data_out[15:8];
  168:             rs_sim_q[rs_wr_ptr + 7] = data_out[7:0];
  169:             rs_wr_ptr               = rs_wr_ptr + 8;
  170:         end
  171:     end
  172: 
  173:     // THREAD C: Continuous 4-Frame Unpacker (1912 Bytes per 2493.600 ns frame window)
  174:     real next_rs_edge_ns;
  175:     always @(posedge clk) begin
  176:         if (rst_n && (rs_decoder_7.rd_state == 3'b010) && (rs_decoder_7.con_rd == 16'd1) && !rs_unpack_active) begin
  177:             rs_unpack_active = 1'b1;
  178:             @(posedge clk); // Align to rising edge of flag Word 1 (con_rd == 2)
  179:             #0.001;
  180:             next_rs_edge_ns  = $realtime;
  181:             while (pld_total_bytes < 16'd7648) begin
  182:                 if (rs_rd_ptr == 0)
  183:                     pld_byte_stream = data_out[63:56];
  184:                 else
  185:                     pld_byte_stream = rs_sim_q[rs_rd_ptr];
  186: 
  187:                 rs_rd_ptr       = rs_rd_ptr + 1;
  188:                 pld_total_bytes = pld_total_bytes + 16'd1;
  189: 
  190:                 if (rs_frame_id == 32'd0) begin
  191:                     rs_frame_id  = 32'd1;
  192:                     pld_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  193:                 end else if (pld_byte_cnt == 12'd1912) begin
  194:                     rs_frame_id  = rs_frame_id + 32'd1;
  195:                     pld_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  196:                 end else begin
  197:                     pld_byte_cnt = pld_byte_cnt + 12'd1;
  198:                 end
  199: 
  200:                 next_rs_edge_ns = next_rs_edge_ns + (2493.6 / 1912.0);
  201:                 #((next_rs_edge_ns - $realtime) > 0.0 ? (next_rs_edge_ns - $realtime) : 0.001);
  202:             end
  203:             pld_byte_stream  = 8'd0;
  204:             pld_byte_cnt     = 12'd0;
  205:             rs_frame_id      = 32'd0;
  206:             rs_unpack_active = 1'b0;
  207:         end
  208:     end
  209:     // synthesis translate_on

  211: endmodule

    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : rx_gth_logic
    7: Description  : Clock Domain Crossing 3 (CDC 3) Module.
    8:                Transfers the continuous 32-bit FSO frame stream from the 
    9:                312.5 MHz GTH RX domain to the 128-bit 200.0 MHz Baseband 
   10:                Decoder domain using cross_gth_logic.xci.
   11: 
   12:                Revision Notes:
   13:                1. Added a 32-cycle read pre-buffer (ST_BUFFER) so the 200 MHz 
   14:                   read domain starts cleanly after initial words are queued.
   15:                2. Synchronized 'out_clk_cnt', 'out_word128_cnt', 'frame_out_id',
   16:                   'frame_byte_cnt' (1..3117), and 'byte_out' to start on the 
   17:                   exact same clock edge when 'flag' first asserts high.
   18:                3. [Rev 2026-10-21 13:55 KST]: Registered 'fifo_out' into 
   19:                   'fifo_out_d1' to match 'flag' (rd_en_d2) latency and added 
   20:                   25/64 fractional rate pacer.
   21:                4. [Rev 2026-10-21 14:02 KST]: Separated sim_byte_q writer thread
   22:                   from unpacker thread and initialized rate_acc to 7'd63.
   23:                5. [Rev 2026-10-21 14:10 KST]: Clocked THREAD B (sim_byte_q 
   24:                   writer) on 'negedge clk_logic' (2.5 ns ahead of posedge 
   25:                   clk_logic) so every 128-bit word from fifo_out is queued 
   26:                   2.5 ns before THREAD C's 0.8 ns byte unpacker reaches the 
   27:                   320.0 ns (400-byte / 25-word) LCM boundary. This completely 
   28:                   eliminates the periodic 1-byte red 'X' glitches at bytes 
   29:                   401, 801, 1201, etc.
   30: ===========================================================================
   31: */
   32: 
   33: module rx_gth_logic (
   34:     input  wire         clk_gth,      // 312.5 MHz Write Clock (from gth64b66b_rx)
   35:     input  wire         clk_logic,    // 200.0 MHz Read Clock (to core_rx)
   36:     input  wire         rst_n,
   37:     input  wire         en,           // Continuous valid from gth64b66b_rx
   38:     input  wire [31:0]  data_in,      // Continuous 32-bit data from gth64b66b_rx
   39:     output wire         flag,         // 128-bit valid flag to core_rx
   40:     output wire [127:0] data_out      // 128-bit data stream to core_rx
   41: );
   42: 
   43:     // =======================================================
   44:     // 1. WRITE DOMAIN (312.5 MHz): AUTO TAIL-FLUSH FOR 32-TO-128 FIFO
   45:     // =======================================================
   46:     reg  [1:0]  wr_mod4_cnt;
   47:     reg         tail_flushing;
   48:     wire        fifo_wr_en;
   49:     wire [31:0] fifo_din;
   50: 
   51:     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
   52:         if (~rst_n) begin
   53:             wr_mod4_cnt   <= 2'd0;
   54:             tail_flushing <= 1'b0;
   55:         end else begin
   56:             if (en) begin
   57:                 wr_mod4_cnt   <= wr_mod4_cnt + 2'd1;
   58:                 tail_flushing <= 1'b0;
   59:             end else if (wr_mod4_cnt != 2'd0) begin
   60:                 wr_mod4_cnt   <= wr_mod4_cnt + 2'd1;
   61:                 tail_flushing <= 1'b1;
   62:             end else begin
   63:                 tail_flushing <= 1'b0;
   64:             end
   65:         end
   66:     end
   67: 
   68:     assign fifo_wr_en = en || (!en && (wr_mod4_cnt != 2'd0));
   69:     assign fifo_din   = en ? data_in : 32'd0;
   70: 
   71:     // =======================================================
   72:     // 2. XILINX ASYMMETRIC FIFO (32-bit @ 312.5M -> 128-bit @ 200M)
   73:     // =======================================================
   74:     wire         fifo_full;
   75:     wire         fifo_empty;
   76:     wire         wr_rst_busy;
   77:     wire         rd_rst_busy;
   78:     wire [127:0] fifo_out;
   79:     wire         rd_en;
   80: 
   81:     cross_gth_logic cross_inst (
   82:         .srst        (~rst_n),
   83:         .wr_clk      (clk_gth),
   84:         .wr_en       (fifo_wr_en),
   85:         .din         (fifo_din),
   86:         .rd_clk      (clk_logic),
   87:         .rd_en       (rd_en),
   88:         .dout        (fifo_out),
   89:         .full        (fifo_full),
   90:         .empty       (fifo_empty),
   91:         .wr_rst_busy (wr_rst_busy),
   92:         .rd_rst_busy (rd_rst_busy)
   93:     );
   94: 
   95:     // =======================================================
   96:     // 3. READ DOMAIN (200.0 MHz): 25/64 PACED READ & PIPELINE ALIGN
   97:     // =======================================================
   98:     localparam ST_IDLE   = 2'd0;
   99:     localparam ST_BUFFER = 2'd1;
  100:     localparam ST_READ   = 2'd2;
  101: 
  102:     reg [1:0]  rd_state;
  103:     reg [5:0]  buf_wait_cnt;
  104:     reg [4:0]  empty_idle_cnt;
  105:     reg [6:0]  rate_acc;
  106:     reg [10:0] rd_word_cnt;
  107: 
  108:     wire [6:0] next_rate_acc = rate_acc + 7'd25;
  109:     wire       rate_fire     = (next_rate_acc >= 7'd64);
  110: 
  111:     always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
  112:         if (~rst_n) begin
  113:             rd_state       <= ST_IDLE;
  114:             buf_wait_cnt   <= 6'd0;
  115:             empty_idle_cnt <= 5'd0;
  116:             rate_acc       <= 7'd63;
  117:             rd_word_cnt    <= 11'd0;
  118:         end else begin
  119:             case (rd_state)
  120:                 ST_IDLE: begin
  121:                     buf_wait_cnt   <= 6'd0;
  122:                     empty_idle_cnt <= 5'd0;
  123:                     rate_acc       <= 7'd63;
  124:                     rd_word_cnt    <= 11'd0;
  125:                     if (~fifo_empty && ~rd_rst_busy)
  126:                         rd_state <= ST_BUFFER;
  127:                 end
  128:                 ST_BUFFER: begin
  129:                     if (buf_wait_cnt < 6'd4)
  130:                         buf_wait_cnt <= buf_wait_cnt + 6'd1;
  131:                     else
  132:                         rd_state <= ST_READ;
  133:                 end
  134:                 ST_READ: begin
  135:                     if (fifo_empty) begin
  136:                         if (empty_idle_cnt < 5'd15)
  137:                             empty_idle_cnt <= empty_idle_cnt + 5'd1;
  138:                         else
  139:                             rd_state <= ST_IDLE;
  140:                     end else begin
  141:                         empty_idle_cnt <= 5'd0;
  142:                         if (rate_fire) begin
  143:                             rate_acc    <= next_rate_acc - 7'd64;
  144:                             rd_word_cnt <= rd_word_cnt + 11'd1;
  145:                         end else begin
  146:                             rate_acc    <= next_rate_acc;
  147:                         end
  148:                     end
  149:                 end
  150:                 default: rd_state <= ST_IDLE;
  151:             endcase
  152:         end
  153:     end
  154: 
  155:     assign rd_en = (rd_state == ST_READ) && (~fifo_empty) && (~rd_rst_busy) && rate_fire && (rd_word_cnt < 11'd780);
  156: 
  157:     reg         rd_en_d1;
  158:     reg         rd_en_d2;
  159:     reg [127:0] fifo_out_d1;
  160: 
  161:     always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
  162:         if (~rst_n) begin
  163:             rd_en_d1    <= 1'b0;
  164:             rd_en_d2    <= 1'b0;
  165:             fifo_out_d1 <= 128'd0;
  166:         end else begin
  167:             rd_en_d1    <= rd_en;
  168:             rd_en_d2    <= rd_en_d1;
  169:             if (rd_en_d1)
  170:                 fifo_out_d1 <= fifo_out;
  171:         end
  172:     end
  173: 
  174:     assign flag     = rd_en_d2;
  175:     assign data_out = (flag) ? fifo_out_d1 : 128'b0;
  176: 
  177:     // =======================================================
  178:     // 4. SIMULATION TRACKERS: RACE-FREE NEGEDGE WRITER & UNPACKER
  179:     // =======================================================
  180:     // synthesis translate_off
  181:     reg [15:0] out_clk_cnt;      // 200 MHz clock counter per frame (1..499)
  182:     reg [15:0] out_word128_cnt;  // 128-bit valid word counter (1..780)
  183:     reg [7:0]  sim_byte_q [0:16383];
  184:     integer    sim_wr_ptr;
  185:     integer    sim_rd_ptr;
  186:     reg        unpack_running;
  187: 
  188:     reg [7:0]  byte_out;
  189:     reg [11:0] frame_byte_cnt;   // 1..3117 per frame
  190:     reg [31:0] frame_out_id;     // 1, 2, 3, 4
  191:     reg [15:0] out_total_bytes;  // 1..12468
  192: 
  193:     initial begin
  194:         out_clk_cnt     = 16'd0;
  195:         out_word128_cnt = 16'd0;
  196:         sim_wr_ptr      = 0;
  197:         sim_rd_ptr      = 0;
  198:         unpack_running  = 1'b0;
  199:         byte_out        = 8'd0;
  200:         frame_byte_cnt  = 12'd0;
  201:         frame_out_id    = 32'd0;
  202:         out_total_bytes = 16'd0;
  203:     end
  204: 
  205:     // THREAD A: Clock counter (200 MHz) & 128-bit Word Counter (1..780)
  206:     always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
  207:         if (~rst_n) begin
  208:             out_word128_cnt <= 16'd0;
  209:             out_clk_cnt     <= 16'd0;
  210:         end else begin
  211:             if (rd_en_d1) begin
  212:                 out_word128_cnt <= out_word128_cnt + 16'd1;
  213:             end else if (!unpack_running && (rd_state == ST_IDLE)) begin
  214:                 out_word128_cnt <= 16'd0;
  215:             end
  216: 
  217:             if (rd_en_d1 && !unpack_running && (out_word128_cnt == 16'd0)) begin
  218:                 out_clk_cnt <= 16'd1;
  219:             end else if (unpack_running) begin
  220:                 if (frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd6 && out_clk_cnt > 16'd490)
  221:                     out_clk_cnt <= 16'd1;
  222:                 else
  223:                     out_clk_cnt <= out_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  224:             end else begin
  225:                 out_clk_cnt <= 16'd0;
  226:             end
  227:         end
  228:     end
  229: 
  230:     // THREAD B: Negedge Writer Thread (Runs 2.5 ns BEFORE posedge clk_logic!)
  231:     // Guarantees sim_byte_q is ALWAYS populated 2.5 ns before THREAD C reads
  232:     // at the 320.0 ns (400-byte) LCM boundary, completely eliminating red 'X'!
  233:     always @(negedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
  234:         if (~rst_n) begin
  235:             sim_wr_ptr = 0;
  236:         end else if (rd_en_d1) begin
  237:             sim_byte_q[sim_wr_ptr + 0]  = fifo_out[127:120];
  238:             sim_byte_q[sim_wr_ptr + 1]  = fifo_out[119:112];
  239:             sim_byte_q[sim_wr_ptr + 2]  = fifo_out[111:104];
  240:             sim_byte_q[sim_wr_ptr + 3]  = fifo_out[103:96];
  241:             sim_byte_q[sim_wr_ptr + 4]  = fifo_out[95:88];
  242:             sim_byte_q[sim_wr_ptr + 5]  = fifo_out[87:80];
  243:             sim_byte_q[sim_wr_ptr + 6]  = fifo_out[79:72];
  244:             sim_byte_q[sim_wr_ptr + 7]  = fifo_out[71:64];
  245:             sim_byte_q[sim_wr_ptr + 8]  = fifo_out[63:56];
  246:             sim_byte_q[sim_wr_ptr + 9]  = fifo_out[55:48];
  247:             sim_byte_q[sim_wr_ptr + 10] = fifo_out[47:40];
  248:             sim_byte_q[sim_wr_ptr + 11] = fifo_out[39:32];
  249:             sim_byte_q[sim_wr_ptr + 12] = fifo_out[31:24];
  250:             sim_byte_q[sim_wr_ptr + 13] = fifo_out[23:16];
  251:             sim_byte_q[sim_wr_ptr + 14] = fifo_out[15:8];
  252:             sim_byte_q[sim_wr_ptr + 15] = fifo_out[7:0];
  253:             sim_wr_ptr                  = sim_wr_ptr + 16;
  254:         end
  255:     end
  256: 
  257:     // THREAD C: Dedicated 0.8 ns Sub-Cycle Byte Unpacker Thread
  258:     always @(posedge clk_logic) begin
  259:         if (rst_n && rd_en_d1 && !unpack_running) begin
  260:             unpack_running = 1'b1;
  261:             while (out_total_bytes < 16'd12468) begin
  262:                 byte_out        = sim_byte_q[sim_rd_ptr];
  263:                 sim_rd_ptr      = sim_rd_ptr + 1;
  264:                 out_total_bytes = out_total_bytes + 16'd1;
  265: 
  266:                 if (frame_out_id == 32'd0) begin
  267:                     frame_out_id   = 32'd1;
  268:                     frame_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  269:                 end else if (frame_byte_cnt == 12'd3117) begin
  270:                     frame_out_id   = frame_out_id + 32'd1;
  271:                     frame_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  272:                 end else begin
  273:                     frame_byte_cnt = frame_byte_cnt + 12'd1;
  274:                 end
  275: 
  276:                 #0.8;
  277:             end
  278:             byte_out        = 8'd0;
  279:             frame_byte_cnt  = 12'd0;
  280:             frame_out_id    = 32'd0;
  281:             out_clk_cnt     = 16'd0;
  282:             out_word128_cnt = 16'd0;
  283:             unpack_running  = 1'b0;
  284:         end
  285:     end
  286:     // synthesis translate_on
  287: 
  288: endmodule
