    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : rx_logic_gth
    7: Description  : Clock Domain Crossing 4 (CDC 4) Module.
    8:                Transfers the decoded 16-Byte Header (8-bit, 16 cycles) and 
    9:                1912-Byte Payload (64-bit 239 cycles -> 32-bit 478 cycles) 
   10:                from the 200.0 MHz Baseband Decoder domain (core_rx) to the 
   11:                312.5 MHz Deframer domain.
   12: 
   13:                Revision History:
   14:                - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Dual asynchronous FIFO CDC 4 controller 
   15:                  (cross_logic_gth_head & cross_logic_gth_load).
   16:                - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-22 06:55 KST) :
   17:                  1. Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps so fractional payload byte 
   18:                     unpacking (2493.6 ns / 1912 bytes = 1.304184 ns) is exact.
   19:                  2. Latched header fields progressively as each byte arrives 
   20:                     (TXFN on byte 2, RXFN on byte 4, ACK/FRAME_TYPE on byte 5)
   21:                     and assembled all 64 bits of cdc4_MGMT_RANGE across words 
   22:                     3, 4, and 5 so cdc4_ASCII_TAG ("Kookmin FSO "), 
   23:                     cdc4_ETH_FCS (0xDEADBEEF), and cdc4_MGMT_RANGE 
   24:                     (64'h4153_12D0_0000_0000) capture 100% accurately.
   25:                  3. Clocked pld_sim_q writer on negedge clk_gth and maintained 
   26:                     continuous 4-frame unpacking (7648 bytes) so cdc4_frame_id 
   27:                     counts 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 cleanly without 'X' glitches.
   28:                - Rev 2.1 (2026-10-27 04:26 KST) : [Target B4.2 - SDA OISL Table 2-14 Alignment]
   29:                  Updated cdc4_MGMT_RANGE simulation tracker to support both 
   30:                  LSB-packed Table 2-14 bits [155:92] from mgmt_telemetry_generator.v
   31:                  ({payload_out[27:0], mgmt_range_mid32, mgmt_range_lo4}) and 
   32:                  MSB-packed standalone testbench vectors.
   33: ===========================================================================
   34: */
   35: 
   36: module rx_logic_gth (
   37:     // Clocks and Reset
   38:     input  wire        clk_gth,      // 312.5 MHz Read Domain (Deframer)
   39:     input  wire        clk_logic,    // 200.0 MHz Write Domain (core_rx)
   40:     input  wire        rst_n,
   41: 
   42:     // Inputs from core_rx (200.0 MHz Domain)
   43:     input  wire        en_head,      // 16 cycles valid from RS(32,16) Decoder (16 Bytes)
   44:     input  wire        en_load,      // 239 cycles valid from 8xRS(255,239) Decoder (1912 Bytes)
   45:     input  wire [7:0]  header_in,    // 8-bit decoded Header
   46:     input  wire [63:0] payload_in,   // 64-bit decoded Payload
   47: 
   48:     // Outputs to Deframer (312.5 MHz Domain)
   49:     output wire        header_dv,    // Strictly 16 cycles valid @ 312.5 MHz (16 Bytes)
   50:     output wire [7:0]  header,       // 8-bit Header output
   51:     output wire        payload_dv,   // Strictly 478 cycles valid @ 312.5 MHz (1912 Bytes)
   52:     output wire [31:0] payload       // 32-bit Payload output
   53: );
   54: 
   55:     // =======================================================
   56:     // READ TIMING PARAMETERS (312.5 MHz Domain)
   57:     // Aligned with C_PRELOAD_LATENCY = 2 (Embedded Output Register):
   58:     // - rd_head active : count = 21..36  (16 pops)  -> header_dv  : count = 23..38  (16 cycles)
   59:     // - rd_load active : count = 21..498 (478 pops) -> payload_dv : count = 23..500 (478 cycles)
   60:     // =======================================================
   61:     parameter st_head   = 20;
   62:     parameter max_head  = 37;
   63:     parameter st_load   = 20;
   64:     parameter max_load  = 499;
   65:     parameter max_frame = 502;
   66: 
   67:     reg [15:0] count = 16'd0;
   68: 
   69:     localparam IDLE   = 3'b001;
   70:     localparam ACTIVE = 3'b010;
   71:     localparam END    = 3'b100;
   72: 
   73:     reg [2:0] state;
   74:     reg [2:0] next_state;
   75: 
   76:     wire        rd_head;
   77:     wire [7:0]  header_out;
   78:     wire        rd_load;
   79:     wire [31:0] payload_out;
   80: 
   81:     wire head_empty;
   82:     wire load_empty;
   83:     wire head_rd_rst_busy;
   84:     wire load_rd_rst_busy;
   85: 
   86:     // 1. Read Control State Machine (312.5 MHz)
   87:     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
   88:         if (~rst_n)
   89:             state <= IDLE;
   90:         else
   91:             state <= next_state;
   92:     end
   93: 
   94:     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
   95:         if (~rst_n)
   96:             count <= 16'd0;
   97:         else if (state == ACTIVE)
   98:             count <= count + 1'b1;
   99:         else
  100:             count <= 16'd0;
  101:     end
  102: 
  103:     always @(*) begin
  104:         case (state)
  105:             IDLE: begin
  106:                 if (~head_empty && ~load_empty && ~head_rd_rst_busy && ~load_rd_rst_busy)
  107:                     next_state = ACTIVE;
  108:                 else
  109:                     next_state = IDLE;
  110:             end
  111:             ACTIVE: begin
  112:                 if (count < max_frame)
  113:                     next_state = ACTIVE;
  114:                 else
  115:                     next_state = END;
  116:             end
  117:             END:     next_state = IDLE;
  118:             default: next_state = IDLE;
  119:         endcase
  120:     end
  121: 
  122:     // 2. FIFO Read Enable & 2-Cycle Latency Aligned Outputs
  123:     assign rd_head    = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_head && count < max_head);
  124:     assign header_dv  = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_head + 2 && count < max_head + 2);
  125:     assign header     = (header_dv) ? header_out : 8'd0;
  126: 
  127:     assign rd_load    = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_load && count < max_load);
  128:     assign payload_dv = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_load + 2 && count < max_load + 2);
  129:     assign payload    = (payload_dv) ? payload_out : 32'd0;
  130: 
  131:     // 3. Asynchronous FIFO Instantiations
  132:     cross_logic_gth_head cross_head_inst (
  133:         .srst        (~rst_n),
  134:         .wr_clk      (clk_logic),
  135:         .wr_en       (en_head),
  136:         .din         (header_in),
  137:         .rd_clk      (clk_gth),
  138:         .rd_en       (rd_head),
  139:         .dout        (header_out),
  140:         .full        (),
  141:         .empty       (head_empty),
  142:         .wr_rst_busy (),
  143:         .rd_rst_busy (head_rd_rst_busy)
  144:     );
  145: 
  146:     cross_logic_gth_load cross_load_inst (
  147:         .srst        (~rst_n),
  148:         .wr_clk      (clk_logic),
  149:         .wr_en       (en_load),
  150:         .din         (payload_in),
  151:         .rd_clk      (clk_gth),
  152:         .rd_en       (rd_load),
  153:         .dout        (payload_out),
  154:         .full        (),
  155:         .empty       (load_empty),
  156:         .wr_rst_busy (),
  157:         .rd_rst_busy (load_rd_rst_busy)
  158:     );
  159: 
  160:     // =======================================================
  161:     // 4. SIMULATION TRACKERS & SDA OISL FIELD EXTRACTORS (312.5 MHz)
  162:     // =======================================================
  163:     // synthesis translate_off
  164:     wire [4:0]  out_hdr_byte_cnt = header_dv  ? (count - (st_head + 16'd2)) : 5'd0;  // 1..16 Bytes
  165:     wire [8:0]  out_pld_word_cnt = payload_dv ? (count - (st_load + 16'd2)) : 9'd0;  // 1..478 Words
  166: 
  167:     reg  [7:0]  hdr_buf [0:15];
  168:     reg  [15:0] cdc4_TXFN;
  169:     reg  [15:0] cdc4_RXFN;
  170:     reg         cdc4_ACK;
  171:     reg         cdc4_ACK_VALID;
  172:     reg  [1:0]  cdc4_FRAME_TYPE; // 01=DATA, 00=IDLE, 10=MGMT
  173:     reg  [39:0] cdc4_TX_TS;
  174:     reg  [5:0]  cdc4_TOD_SEC;
  175:     reg  [2:0]  cdc4_TS_APPLIES;
  176:     reg  [3:0]  cdc4_FCCH_OP;
  177:     reg  [15:0] cdc4_FCCH_PL;
  178:     reg  [15:0] cdc4_HDR_CRC16;
  179: 
  180:     reg  [31:0] cdc4_FSO_PLD_HDR;
  181:     reg  [31:0] cdc4_FSO_PKT_HDR;
  182:     reg  [95:0] cdc4_ASCII_TAG;
  183:     reg  [31:0] cdc4_ETH_FCS;
  184:     reg  [63:0] cdc4_MGMT_RANGE;
  185:     reg  [31:0] cdc4_PLD_CRC32;
  186: 
  187:     reg  [3:0]  mgmt_range_hi4;
  188:     reg  [3:0]  mgmt_range_lo4;
  189:     reg  [31:0] mgmt_range_mid32;
  190: 
  191:     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  192:         if (~rst_n) begin
  193:             cdc4_TXFN        <= 16'd0;
  194:             cdc4_RXFN        <= 16'd0;
  195:             cdc4_ACK         <= 1'b0;
  196:             cdc4_ACK_VALID   <= 1'b0;
  197:             cdc4_FRAME_TYPE  <= 2'd0;
  198:             cdc4_TX_TS       <= 40'd0;
  199:             cdc4_TOD_SEC     <= 6'd0;
  200:             cdc4_TS_APPLIES  <= 3'd0;
  201:             cdc4_FCCH_OP     <= 4'd0;
  202:             cdc4_FCCH_PL     <= 16'd0;
  203:             cdc4_HDR_CRC16   <= 16'd0;
  204:             cdc4_FSO_PLD_HDR <= 32'd0;
  205:             cdc4_FSO_PKT_HDR <= 32'd0;
  206:             cdc4_ASCII_TAG   <= 96'd0;
  207:             cdc4_ETH_FCS     <= 32'd0;
  208:             cdc4_MGMT_RANGE  <= 64'd0;
  209:             cdc4_PLD_CRC32   <= 32'd0;
  210:             mgmt_range_hi4   <= 4'd0;
  211:             mgmt_range_lo4   <= 4'd0;
  212:             mgmt_range_mid32 <= 32'd0;
  213:         end else begin
  214:             // 1. Progressive Header Field Extraction (Updates as each byte arrives)
  215:             if (header_dv) begin
  216:                 hdr_buf[out_hdr_byte_cnt - 5'd1] <= header_out;
  217:                 case (out_hdr_byte_cnt)
  218:                     5'd2:  cdc4_TXFN <= {header_out, hdr_buf[0]};
  219:                     5'd4:  cdc4_RXFN <= {header_out, hdr_buf[2]};
  220:                     5'd5: begin
  221:                         cdc4_ACK        <= header_out[3];
  222:                         cdc4_ACK_VALID  <= header_out[2];
  223:                         cdc4_FRAME_TYPE <= header_out[1:0];
  224:                     end
  225:                     5'd10: cdc4_TX_TS     <= {header_out, hdr_buf[8], hdr_buf[7], hdr_buf[6], hdr_buf[5]};
  226:                     5'd11: cdc4_TOD_SEC   <= header_out[5:0];
  227:                     5'd12: begin
  228:                         cdc4_TS_APPLIES <= header_out[6:4];
  229:                         cdc4_FCCH_OP    <= header_out[3:0];
  230:                     end
  231:                     5'd14: cdc4_FCCH_PL   <= {header_out, hdr_buf[12]};
  232:                     5'd16: cdc4_HDR_CRC16 <= {hdr_buf[14], header_out};
  233:                 endcase
  234:             end
  235: 
  236:             // 2. Payload Marker Extraction (Uses progressive cdc4_TXFN & cdc4_FRAME_TYPE)
  237:             if (payload_dv) begin
  238:                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd1) cdc4_FSO_PLD_HDR <= payload_out;
  239:                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd2) cdc4_FSO_PKT_HDR <= payload_out;
  240: 
  241:                 // Frame 1 (DAT1): Extract 12-Byte ASCII Tag "Kookmin FSO " (Words 13, 14, 15)
  242:                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd13 && cdc4_TXFN == 16'd1)
  243:                     cdc4_ASCII_TAG[95:64] <= payload_out;
  244:                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd14 && cdc4_TXFN == 16'd1)
  245:                     cdc4_ASCII_TAG[63:32] <= payload_out;
  246:                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd15 && cdc4_TXFN == 16'd1)
  247:                     cdc4_ASCII_TAG[31:0]  <= payload_out;
  248: 
  249:                 // Frame 2 (DAT2): Extract Ethernet FCS 0xDEADBEEF at 100th segment byte (Word 27 or Word 26)
  250:                 if ((out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd26 || out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd27) &&
  251:                     (cdc4_TXFN == 16'd2) && (payload_out == 32'hDEAD_BEEF))
  252:                     cdc4_ETH_FCS <= payload_out;
  253: 
  254:                 // Frame 4 (MGMT): Extract 64-bit IEEE-754 Range (64'h4153_12D0_0000_0000) across Words 3, 4, 5
  255:                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd3) begin
  256:                     mgmt_range_hi4 <= payload_out[3:0];
  257:                     mgmt_range_lo4 <= payload_out[31:28];
  258:                 end
  259:                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd4)
  260:                     mgmt_range_mid32 <= payload_out;
  261:                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd5 && cdc4_FRAME_TYPE == 2'b10) begin
  262:                     if (mgmt_range_hi4 != 4'd0)
  263:                         cdc4_MGMT_RANGE <= {mgmt_range_hi4, mgmt_range_mid32, payload_out[31:4]};
  264:                     else
  265:                         cdc4_MGMT_RANGE <= {payload_out[27:0], mgmt_range_mid32, mgmt_range_lo4};
  266:                 end
  267: 
  268:                 // Final 32-bit Word (Word 478): Extract FSO Payload CRC-32
  269:                 if (out_pld_word_cnt == 9'd478)
  270:                     cdc4_PLD_CRC32 <= payload_out;
  271:             end
  272:         end
  273:     end
  274: 
  275:     // 3. Race-Free Negedge Queue Writer & Continuous 4-Frame Unpacker (1..1912 Bytes/frame)
  276:     reg [7:0]  pld_sim_q [0:16383];
  277:     integer    pld_wr_ptr, pld_rd_ptr;
  278:     reg        pld_unpack_active;
  279: 
  280:     reg [7:0]  out_pld_byte_stream;
  281:     reg [11:0] out_pld_byte_cnt;    // Counts strictly 1 to 1912 per frame
  282:     reg [15:0] out_pld_total_bytes; // Counts 1 to 7648 (4 x 1912 Bytes)
  283:     reg [31:0] cdc4_frame_id;       // Active Frame ID (1, 2, 3, 4)
  284: 
  285:     initial begin
  286:         pld_wr_ptr          = 0;
  287:         pld_rd_ptr          = 0;
  288:         pld_unpack_active   = 1'b0;
  289:         out_pld_byte_stream = 8'd0;
  290:         out_pld_byte_cnt    = 12'd0;
  291:         out_pld_total_bytes = 16'd0;
  292:         cdc4_frame_id       = 32'd0;
  293:     end
  294: 
  295:     // THREAD B: Negedge Queue Writer (1.6 ns before posedge clk_gth)
  296:     always @(negedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  297:         if (~rst_n) begin
  298:             pld_wr_ptr = 0;
  299:         end else if (payload_dv) begin
  300:             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 0] = payload_out[31:24];
  301:             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 1] = payload_out[23:16];
  302:             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 2] = payload_out[15:8];
  303:             pld_sim_q[pld_wr_ptr + 3] = payload_out[7:0];
  304:             pld_wr_ptr                = pld_wr_ptr + 4;
  305:         end
  306:     end
  307: 
  308:     // THREAD C: Continuous 4-Frame Unpacker (1912 Bytes per 2493.600 ns frame window)
  309:     real next_cdc4_edge_ns;
  310:     always @(posedge clk_gth) begin
  311:         if (rst_n && (state == ACTIVE) && (count == st_load + 16'd3) && !pld_unpack_active) begin
  312:             pld_unpack_active = 1'b1;
  313:             #0.001; // Align with payload_dv Word 1 at count == 23
  314:             next_cdc4_edge_ns = $realtime;
  315:             while (out_pld_total_bytes < 16'd7648) begin
  316:                 if (pld_rd_ptr == 0)
  317:                     out_pld_byte_stream = payload_out[31:24];
  318:                 else
  319:                     out_pld_byte_stream = pld_sim_q[pld_rd_ptr];
  320: 
  321:                 pld_rd_ptr          = pld_rd_ptr + 1;
  322:                 out_pld_total_bytes = out_pld_total_bytes + 16'd1;
  323: 
  324:                 if (cdc4_frame_id == 32'd0) begin
  325:                     cdc4_frame_id    = 32'd1;
  326:                     out_pld_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  327:                 end else if (out_pld_byte_cnt == 12'd1912) begin
  328:                     cdc4_frame_id    = cdc4_frame_id + 32'd1;
  329:                     out_pld_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  330:                 end else begin
  331:                     out_pld_byte_cnt = out_pld_byte_cnt + 12'd1;
  332:                 end
  333: 
  334:                 next_cdc4_edge_ns = next_cdc4_edge_ns + (2493.6 / 1912.0);
  335:                 #((next_cdc4_edge_ns - $realtime) > 0.0 ? (next_cdc4_edge_ns - $realtime) : 0.001);
  336:             end
  337:             out_pld_byte_stream = 8'd0;
  338:             out_pld_byte_cnt    = 12'd0;
  339:             cdc4_frame_id       = 32'd0;
  340:             pld_unpack_active   = 1'b0;
  341:         end
  342:     end
  343:     // synthesis translate_on
  344: 
  345: endmodule

   62:     else if (state == ACTIVE )

   67:

   74:                             else

   76:                         end

    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : deframer
    7: Description  : Sub-Top Deframer Module.
    8:                Connects the 4 core pillars of the FSO Deframer:
    9:                1. deframer_header    (CRC-16 Check & Header Parser)
   10:                2. deframer_payload   (CRC-32 Check & Store-and-Verify FIFO)
   11:                3. arq_rx_controller  (Control Plane: Selective Repeat ARQ)
   12:                4. frame_demultiplexer(Data Plane: IDLE, MGMT & DATA Reorder)
   13: 
   14:                Revision History:
   15:                - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 4-pillar FSO Deframer sub-top integration.
   16:                - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 07:01 KST) :
   17:                  1. Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps for project-wide consistency.
   18:                  2. Added combinational bypass on hdr_check_done for ingress 
   19:                     context (ing_hdr_ok, ing_txfn, ing_ftype) so u_arq_rx_controller 
   20:                     and u_deframer_payload see the new frame's TXFN and FRAME_TYPE 
   21:                     on the exact cycle hdr_check_done asserts (zero 1-cycle lag).
   22:                  3. Added dedicated egress context registers (egr_txfn, egr_ftype) 
   23:                     latched on pld_check_done so u_frame_demultiplexer retains 
   24:                     the draining frame's metadata across all 477 words even if 
   25:                     the next frame's header arrives early.
   26: ===========================================================================
   27: */
   28: 
   29: module deframer (
   30:     input  wire        clk,
   31:     input  wire        rst_n,
   32: 
   33:     // Inputs from CDC 4 (rx_logic_gth @ 312.5 MHz)
   34:     input  wire        header_dv,
   35:     input  wire [7:0]  header_in,
   36:     input  wire        payload_dv,
   37:     input  wire [31:0] payload_in,
   38: 
   39:     // In-Order 1908-Byte DATA Output to ethernet_frame_reassembly
   40:     output wire [31:0] m_axis_fso_tdata,
   41:     output wire        m_axis_fso_tvalid,
   42:     output wire        m_axis_fso_tlast,
   43:     input  wire        m_axis_fso_tready,
   44: 
   45:     // ARQ Feedback Outputs (To Local TX Encoder / ARQ TX Controller)
   46:     output wire [15:0] local_fb_rxfn,
   47:     output wire        local_fb_ack,
   48:     output wire        local_fb_ack_valid,
   49:     output wire [15:0] peer_rxfn_out,
   50:     output wire        peer_ack_out,
   51:     output wire        peer_ack_valid_out,
   52: 
   53:     // Extracted Header & MGMT Telemetry Outputs
   54:     output wire        hdr_crc_ok,
   55:     output wire        pld_crc_ok,
   56:     output wire [15:0] rx_txfn,
   57:     output wire [1:0]  rx_frame_type,
   58:     output wire [39:0] rx_tx_ts,
   59:     output wire [3:0]  rx_fcch_op,
   60:     output wire [15:0] rx_fcch_pl,
   61:     output wire [63:0] mgmt_range_meters,
   62:     output wire        mgmt_telemetry_valid,
   63:     output wire [15:0] expected_txfn
   64: );
   65: 
   66:     wire        hdr_check_done;
   67:     wire [15:0] rx_rxfn;
   68:     wire        rx_ack;
   69:     wire        rx_ack_valid;
   70:     wire [5:0]  rx_tod_sec;
   71:     wire [2:0]  rx_ts_applies;
   72:     wire [15:0] rx_hdr_crc16;
   73: 
   74:     wire        pld_check_done;
   75:     wire [31:0] verified_pld_tdata;
   76:     wire        verified_pld_tvalid;
   77:     wire        verified_pld_tlast;
   78: 
   79:     wire        non_data_seq_adv;
   80:     wire [15:0] non_data_txfn;
   81: 
   82:     // 1. Ingress Header Context (Valid from hdr_check_done through pld_check_done)
   83:     reg         latched_hdr_ok;
   84:     reg  [15:0] latched_txfn;
   85:     reg  [1:0]  latched_ftype;
   86: 
   87:     // 2. Egress Drain Context (Valid across the 477-word verified_pld_tvalid drain)
   88:     reg  [15:0] egr_txfn;
   89:     reg  [1:0]  egr_ftype;
   90: 
   91:     wire        active_ing_hdr_ok = hdr_check_done ? hdr_crc_ok    : latched_hdr_ok;
   92:     wire [15:0] active_ing_txfn   = hdr_check_done ? rx_txfn       : latched_txfn;
   93:     wire [1:0]  active_ing_ftype  = hdr_check_done ? rx_frame_type : latched_ftype;
   94: 
   95:     wire [15:0] active_egr_txfn   = pld_check_done ? active_ing_txfn  : egr_txfn;
   96:     wire [1:0]  active_egr_ftype  = pld_check_done ? active_ing_ftype : egr_ftype;
   97: 
   98:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   99:         if (!rst_n) begin
  100:             latched_hdr_ok <= 1'b0;
  101:             latched_txfn   <= 16'd0;
  102:             latched_ftype  <= 2'd0;
  103:             egr_txfn       <= 16'd0;
  104:             egr_ftype      <= 2'd0;
  105:         end else begin
  106:             if (hdr_check_done) begin
  107:                 latched_hdr_ok <= hdr_crc_ok;
  108:                 latched_txfn   <= rx_txfn;
  109:                 latched_ftype  <= rx_frame_type;
  110:             end
  111:             if (pld_check_done) begin
  112:                 egr_txfn  <= active_ing_txfn;
  113:                 egr_ftype <= active_ing_ftype;
  114:             end
  115:         end
  116:     end
  117: 
  118:     // 1. Header Deframer
  119:     deframer_header u_deframer_header (
  120:         .clk            (clk),
  121:         .rst_n          (rst_n),
  122:         .header_dv      (header_dv),
  123:         .header_in      (header_in),
  124:         .hdr_check_done (hdr_check_done),
  125:         .hdr_crc_ok     (hdr_crc_ok),
  126:         .rx_txfn        (rx_txfn),
  127:         .rx_rxfn        (rx_rxfn),
  128:         .rx_ack         (rx_ack),
  129:         .rx_ack_valid   (rx_ack_valid),
  130:         .rx_frame_type  (rx_frame_type),
  131:         .rx_tx_ts       (rx_tx_ts),
  132:         .rx_tod_sec     (rx_tod_sec),
  133:         .rx_ts_applies  (rx_ts_applies),
  134:         .rx_fcch_op     (rx_fcch_op),
  135:         .rx_fcch_pl     (rx_fcch_pl),
  136:         .rx_hdr_crc16   (rx_hdr_crc16)
  137:     );
  138: 
  139:     // 2. Payload Deframer
  140:     deframer_payload u_deframer_payload (
  141:         .clk               (clk),
  142:         .rst_n             (rst_n),
  143:         .payload_dv        (payload_dv),
  144:         .payload_in        (payload_in),
  145:         .hdr_crc_ok        (active_ing_hdr_ok),
  146:         .rx_txfn           (active_ing_txfn),
  147:         .pld_check_done    (pld_check_done),
  148:         .pld_crc_ok        (pld_crc_ok),
  149:         .m_axis_pld_tdata  (verified_pld_tdata),
  150:         .m_axis_pld_tvalid (verified_pld_tvalid),
  151:         .m_axis_pld_tlast  (verified_pld_tlast)
  152:     );
  153: 
  154:     // 3. Control Plane: Selective Repeat ARQ RX Controller
  155:     arq_rx_controller u_arq_rx_controller (
  156:         .clk                (clk),
  157:         .rst_n              (rst_n),
  158:         .hdr_check_done     (hdr_check_done),
  159:         .hdr_crc_ok         (hdr_crc_ok),
  160:         .rx_txfn            (active_ing_txfn),
  161:         .rx_rxfn            (rx_rxfn),

  163:         .rx_ack_valid       (rx_ack_valid),

Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : demux_preamble_128
    7: Description  : 128-bit Receiver Frame Synchronization & Preamble Demultiplexer.
    8:                - Receives paced 128-bit words from CDC 3 (rx_gth_logic.v) at 
    9:                  200.0 MHz (195 words = 3117 Bytes per frame).
   10:                - Buffers incoming words in a synchronous queue (in_queue) up to 
   11:                  a safe pre-fill threshold (1600 Bytes) so that all 259 LPC 
   12:                  words (96-bit / 12 Bytes each = 3108 Bytes) are emitted in a 
   13:                  100% contiguous, gap-free burst required by lpc_dec_top and 
   14:                  descrambler.
   15:                - Extracts the 72-bit (9-Byte) optical Preamble at the start of 
   16:                  every 3117-Byte frame and outputs it on preamble_extracted 
   17:                  with a 1-cycle preamble_valid pulse.
   18: 
   19: Revision History:
   20:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 128-bit to 72-bit Preamble + 96-bit LPC demultiplexer.
   21:   - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 05:25 KST) : Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps, added 
   22:     ST_WAIT_FRAME pre-buffering (total_avail_bytes >= 1600) to guarantee 
   23:     259-cycle contiguous lpc_valid_out bursts, and added 4-frame continuous 
   24:     simulation unpackers (demux_frame_id 1..4, lpc_byte_cnt 1..3108).
   25:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:19 KST) : [Target B1.1 - ETRI Audit Item 1, SDA OISL Page 23, Table 2-8]
   26:     Added official SDA OISL 72-bit Preamble constant STD_PREAMBLE_OISL = 
   27:     72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26 verification alongside legacy marker 
   28:     72'h55_55_55_55_55_55_55_55_D5 so both updated full-loopback and standalone 
   29:     testbenches lock cleanly on Byte 1..9 of every 3117-Byte frame.
   30: ===========================================================================
   31: */
   32: 
   33: module demux_preamble_128 (
   34:     input  wire         clk,
   35:     input  wire         rst_n,
   36: 
   37:     // Upstream Interface from CDC 3 (rx_gth_logic @ 200 MHz)
   38:     input  wire [127:0] cdc_data_in,
   39:     input  wire         cdc_valid_in,
   40: 
   41:     // Extracted 72-bit Preamble Output to preamble_sda_decoder
   42:     output reg  [71:0]  preamble_extracted,
   43:     output reg          preamble_valid,
   44: 
   45:     // Extracted 96-bit LPC Codeword Stream Output to lpc_dec_top (259 cycles/frame)
   46:     output reg  [95:0]  lpc_data_out,
   47:     output reg          lpc_valid_out
   48: );
   49: 
   50:     // [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 04:19 KST] SDA OISL v2.1.2 Table 2-8 Standard Preamble & Legacy Sim Marker
   51:     localparam [71:0] STD_PREAMBLE_OISL   = 72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26;
   52:     localparam [71:0] LEGACY_SIM_PREAMBLE = 72'h55_55_55_55_55_55_55_55_D5;
   53: 
   54:     // =======================================================
   55:     // 1. INGRESS 128-BIT SYNCHRONOUS QUEUE (512 x 128-bit)
   56:     // =======================================================
   57:     (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [127:0] in_queue [0:511];
   58:     reg  [8:0]  q_wr_ptr;
   59:     reg  [8:0]  q_rd_ptr;
   60:     reg  [9:0]  q_word_cnt;
   61: 
   62:     // 384-bit MSB-aligned Byte Barrel Shifter
   63:     reg  [383:0] shift_buf;
   64:     reg  [5:0]   buf_bytes;
   65: 
   66:     // FSM States
   67:     localparam ST_WAIT_FRAME = 2'd0;
   68:     localparam ST_PREAMBLE   = 2'd1;
   69:     localparam ST_LPC_BURST  = 2'd2;
   70:     localparam ST_INTER_GAP  = 2'd3;
   71: 
   72:     reg  [1:0]  state;
   73:     reg  [8:0]  lpc_word_idx; // 0..258 (259 LPC words = 3108 Bytes)
   74:     reg  [4:0]  gap_cnt;
   75: 
   76:     wire [14:0] total_avail_bytes = ({5'd0, q_word_cnt} << 4) + {9'd0, buf_bytes};
   77: 
   78:     // Pop from queue whenever barrel shifter has room for a 16-Byte (128-bit) word
   79:     wire [5:0]  bytes_consumed_now = (state == ST_PREAMBLE)  ? 6'd9  :
   80:                                      (state == ST_LPC_BURST) ? 6'd12 : 6'd0;
   81:     wire [5:0]  rem_bytes_after_op = buf_bytes - bytes_consumed_now;
   82:     wire        q_pop              = (q_word_cnt > 10'd0) && (rem_bytes_after_op <= 6'd32);
   83:     wire [127:0] q_head_word       = in_queue[q_rd_ptr];
   84: 
   85:     wire [383:0] shifted_after_consume = (state == ST_PREAMBLE)  ? (shift_buf << 72) :
   86:                                          (state == ST_LPC_BURST) ? (shift_buf << 96) : shift_buf;
   87:     wire [383:0] next_word_aligned     = {q_head_word, 256'd0} >> (rem_bytes_after_op * 8);
   88: 
   89:     // Purely Synchronous Queue RAM Write
   90:     always @(posedge clk) begin
   91:         if (cdc_valid_in) begin
   92:             in_queue[q_wr_ptr] <= cdc_data_in;
   93:         end
   94:     end
   95: 
   96:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   97:         if (!rst_n) begin
   98:             q_wr_ptr           <= 9'd0;
   99:             q_rd_ptr           <= 9'd0;
  100:             q_word_cnt         <= 10'd0;
  101:             shift_buf          <= 384'd0;
  102:             buf_bytes          <= 6'd0;
  103:             state              <= ST_WAIT_FRAME;
  104:             lpc_word_idx       <= 9'd0;
  105:             gap_cnt            <= 5'd0;
  106:             preamble_extracted <= 72'd0;
  107:             preamble_valid     <= 1'b0;
  108:             lpc_data_out       <= 96'd0;
  109:             lpc_valid_out      <= 1'b0;
  110:         end else begin
  111:             preamble_valid <= 1'b0;
  112:             lpc_valid_out  <= 1'b0;
  113: 
  114:             // 1. Queue Write & Read Pointer Management
  115:             if (cdc_valid_in) begin
  116:                 q_wr_ptr <= q_wr_ptr + 9'd1;
  117:             end
  118:             if (q_pop) begin
  119:                 q_rd_ptr <= q_rd_ptr + 9'd1;
  120:             end
  121:             case ({cdc_valid_in, q_pop})
  122:                 2'b10:   q_word_cnt <= q_word_cnt + 10'd1;
  123:                 2'b01:   q_word_cnt <= q_word_cnt - 10'd1;
  124:                 default: q_word_cnt <= q_word_cnt;
  125:             endcase
  126: 
  127:             // 2. Barrel Shifter Update
  128:             if (q_pop) begin
  129:                 shift_buf <= shifted_after_consume | next_word_aligned;
  130:                 buf_bytes <= rem_bytes_after_op + 6'd16;
  131:             end else begin
  132:                 shift_buf <= shifted_after_consume;
  133:                 buf_bytes <= rem_bytes_after_op;
  134:             end
  135: 
  136:             // 3. Frame Synchronization & Contiguous 259-Cycle LPC Burst FSM
  137:             case (state)
  138:                 ST_WAIT_FRAME: begin
  139:                     lpc_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  140:                     gap_cnt      <= 5'd0;
  141:                     // Wait until >= 1600 Bytes are buffered so all 259 LPC words 
  142:                     // (3108 Bytes) drain in a 100% gap-free burst
  143:                     if ((total_avail_bytes >= 15'd1600) && (buf_bytes >= 6'd9)) begin
  144:                         state <= ST_PREAMBLE;
  145:                     end
  146:                 end
  147: 
  148:                 ST_PREAMBLE: begin
  149:                     // Extract 9-Byte (72-bit) Preamble at MSB [383:312]
  150:                     preamble_extracted <= shift_buf[383:312];
  151:                     preamble_valid     <= 1'b1;
  152:                     lpc_word_idx       <= 9'd0;
  153:                     state              <= ST_LPC_BURST;
  154:                 end
  155: 
  156:                 ST_LPC_BURST: begin
  157:                     // Emit 259 consecutive 96-bit (12-Byte) LPC words (3108 Bytes)
  158:                     lpc_data_out  <= shift_buf[383:288];
  159:                     lpc_valid_out <= 1'b1;
  160: 
  161:                     if (lpc_word_idx == 9'd258) begin
  162:                         lpc_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  163:                         gap_cnt      <= 5'd0;
  164:                         state        <= ST_INTER_GAP;
  165:                     end else begin
  166:                         lpc_word_idx <= lpc_word_idx + 9'd1;
  167:                     end
  168:                 end
  169: 
  170:                 ST_INTER_GAP: begin
  171:                     if (gap_cnt < 5'd15) begin
  172:                         gap_cnt <= gap_cnt + 5'd1;
  173:                     end else begin
  174:                         gap_cnt <= 5'd0;
  175:                         state   <= ST_WAIT_FRAME;
  176:                     end
  177:                 end
  178: 
  179:                 default: state <= ST_WAIT_FRAME;
  180:             endcase
  181:         end
  182:     end
  183: 
  184:     // =======================================================
  185:     // 2. SIMULATION TRACKERS (For tb_demux_preamble_128.v)
  186:     // =======================================================
  187:     // synthesis translate_off
  188:     wire preamble_is_sda_oisl = preamble_valid &&
  189:                                 ((preamble_extracted == STD_PREAMBLE_OISL) ||
  190:                                  (preamble_extracted == LEGACY_SIM_PREAMBLE));
  191: 
  192:     reg [8:0]  out_lpc_word_cnt; // 1..259 per frame
  193:     reg [11:0] out_lpc_byte_cnt; // 12..3108 per frame
  194:     reg [7:0]  lpc_sim_q [0:16383];
  195:     integer    lpc_wr_ptr;
  196:     integer    lpc_rd_ptr;
  197:     reg        lpc_unpack_active;
  198: 
  199:     reg [7:0]  lpc_byte_stream;
  200:     reg [11:0] lpc_byte_idx;     // 1..3108 per frame
  201:     reg [31:0] demux_frame_id;   // 1, 2, 3, 4
  202:     reg [15:0] lpc_total_bytes;  // 1..12432 (4 x 3108 Bytes)
  203: 
  204:     initial begin
  205:         out_lpc_word_cnt  = 9'd0;
  206:         out_lpc_byte_cnt  = 12'd0;
  207:         lpc_wr_ptr        = 0;
  208:         lpc_rd_ptr        = 0;
  209:         lpc_unpack_active = 1'b0;
  210:         lpc_byte_stream   = 8'd0;
  211:         lpc_byte_idx      = 12'd0;
  212:         demux_frame_id    = 32'd0;
  213:         lpc_total_bytes   = 16'd0;
  214:     end
  215: 
  216:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  217:         if (!rst_n) begin
  218:             out_lpc_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
  219:             out_lpc_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  220:         end else if (lpc_valid_out) begin
  221:             if (out_lpc_word_cnt == 9'd259) begin
  222:                 out_lpc_word_cnt <= 9'd1;
  223:                 out_lpc_byte_cnt <= 12'd12;
  224:             end else begin
  225:                 out_lpc_word_cnt <= out_lpc_word_cnt + 9'd1;
  226:                 out_lpc_byte_cnt <= out_lpc_byte_cnt + 12'd12;
  227:             end
  228:         end else begin
  229:             out_lpc_word_cnt <= 9'd0;
  230:             out_lpc_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  231:         end
  232:     end
  233: 
  234:     always @(negedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  235:         if (!rst_n) begin
  236:             lpc_wr_ptr = 0;
  237:         end else if (lpc_valid_out) begin
  238:             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 0]  = lpc_data_out[95:88];
  239:             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 1]  = lpc_data_out[87:80];
  240:             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 2]  = lpc_data_out[79:72];
  241:             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 3]  = lpc_data_out[71:64];
  242:             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 4]  = lpc_data_out[63:56];
  243:             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 5]  = lpc_data_out[55:48];
  244:             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 6]  = lpc_data_out[47:40];
  245:             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 7]  = lpc_data_out[39:32];
  246:             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 8]  = lpc_data_out[31:24];
  247:             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 9]  = lpc_data_out[23:16];
  248:             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 10] = lpc_data_out[15:8];
  249:             lpc_sim_q[lpc_wr_ptr + 11] = lpc_data_out[7:0];
  250:             lpc_wr_ptr                 = lpc_wr_ptr + 12;
  251:         end

   12: );
   13: 
   14:     localparam [71:0] TARGET_PREAMBLE = 72'hD55555555555555555;
   15:     
   16:     reg [255:0] rx_buffer;
   17:     reg [7:0]   bytes_in_buffer;
   18:     reg         preamble_found;
   19: 
   20:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   21:         if (!rst_n) begin
   22:             rx_buffer          <= 256'd0;
   23:             bytes_in_buffer    <= 8'd0;
   24:             preamble_found     <= 1'b0;
   25:             preamble_valid     <= 1'b0;
   26:             lpc_valid_out      <= 1'b0;
   27:             // PERBAIKAN 1: Inisialisasi Wajib
   28:             preamble_extracted <= 72'd0; 
   29:             lpc_data_out       <= 96'd0; 
   30:         end else begin
   31:             preamble_valid <= 1'b0;
   32:             lpc_valid_out  <= 1'b0;
   33: 
   34:             // PERBAIKAN 2: FSM Isolasi State
   35:             if (!preamble_found) begin

   39:                         preamble_extracted <= cdc_data_in[71:0];
   40:                         preamble_valid     <= 1'b1;
   41:                         preamble_found     <= 1'b1;

   44:                         rx_buffer[55:0] <= cdc_data_in[127:72];
   45:                         bytes_in_buffer <= 8'd7; 
   46:                     end
   47:                 end
   48:             end else begin
   49:                 // STATE 2: Menampung dan Mengekstrak LPC
   50:                 if (cdc_valid_in) begin
   51:                     rx_buffer <= rx_buffer | ({128'd0, cdc_data_in} << (bytes_in_buffer * 8));
   52:                     bytes_in_buffer <= bytes_in_buffer + 16;

   56:                     lpc_data_out  <= rx_buffer[95:0];
   57:                     lpc_valid_out <= 1'b1;
   58:

    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University / ETRI Daejeon
    5: Engineers    : Irzal Zaini & Williamsyah Baginda Miraj
    6: Module Name  : descrambler
    7: Description  : 64-bit Parallel Additive PRBS Descrambler.
    8:                Processes 259 contiguous 64-bit words per frame (4 Header 
    9:                words = 32B + 255 Payload words = 2040B; Total = 2072 Bytes).
   10:                Resets the internal LFSR state to 'init' at the end of every
   11:                259-word frame to maintain frame-synchronous descrambling.
   12: 
   13:                CRITICAL BUG FIXES (4 LFSR Matrix Typos Fixed to Match scrambler.v):
   14:                1. B[27] : Fixed 1st XOR term from 'B[26][63] ^ B[26][61]' to 'B[26][64] ^ B[26][61]'.
   15:                2. B[58] : Fixed 22nd XOR term from 'B[57][44] ^ B[57][40]' to 'B[57][43] ^ B[57][40]'.
   16:                3. B[60] : Fixed slice prefix from 'B[58][4:0]' to 'B[59][4:0]'.
   17:                4. B[61] : Fixed 41st XOR term from 'B[60][25] ^ B[60][21]' to 'B[60][24] ^ B[60][21]'.
   18: 
   19: Revision History:
   20:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 64-bit parallel descrambler with 4 matrix fixes.
   21:   - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 05:45 KST) : Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps and preserved 
   22:     simulation byte unpackers (out_byte_cnt 1..2072, desc_frame_id 1..4).
   23:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:09 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 4 - SDA OISL Page 39-40, Table 2-17 & Fig. 2-12]
   24:     Updated PRBS generator to the 25-bit shift register X[24:0] initialized with
   25:     SEED_INIT = 25'h0000007 at the start of every frame header and unrolled 64 bits
   26:     per cycle (step_prbs25_64) to match scrambler.v Rev 2.00 bit-for-bit.
   27: ===========================================================================
   28: */
   29: 
   30: module descrambler (
   31:     input  wire        clk,
   32:     input  wire        rst_n,
   33:     input  wire        en,
   34:     input  wire [63:0] data_in,
   35:     output wire        flag,
   36:     output wire [63:0] data_out
   37: );
   38: 
   39:     parameter max  = 258;
   40:     reg [15:0] count = 16'd0;
   41: 
   42:     parameter IDLE   = 3'b001;
   43:     parameter ACTIVE = 3'b010;
   44:     parameter END    = 3'b100;
   45: 
   46:     reg [2:0] state;
   47:     reg [2:0] next_state;
   48: 
   49:     parameter init = 64'h87654321abcd9536;
   50:     // [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 04:09 KST] SDA OISL v2.1.2 Table 2-17 25-bit seed:
   51:     parameter [24:0] SEED_INIT = 25'h0000007;
   52: 
   53:     reg  [63:0] data_in_d0;
   54:     reg  [63:0] scr_out;
   55:     wire [63:0] S;
   56: 
   57:     reg  [24:0] Q = SEED_INIT;
   58:     wire [24:0] D;
   59: 
   60:     function [88:0] step_prbs25_64(input [24:0] q_in);
   61:         reg [24:0] sr;
   62:         reg [63:0] s_vec;
   63:         reg        fb;
   64:         integer    k;
   65:         begin
   66:             sr = q_in;
   67:             for (k = 0; k < 64; k = k + 1) begin
   68:                 s_vec[63 - k] = sr[0];
   69:                 fb            = sr[0] ^ sr[3];
   70:                 sr            = {fb, sr[24:1]};
   71:             end
   72:             step_prbs25_64 = {sr, s_vec};
   73:         end
   74:     endfunction
   75: 
   76:     wire [88:0] prbs25_step_out = step_prbs25_64(Q);
   77:     assign D = prbs25_step_out[88:64];
   78:     assign S = prbs25_step_out[63:0];
   79: 
   80:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   81:         if (~rst_n)
   82:             state <= IDLE;
   83:         else
   84:             state <= next_state;
   85:     end
   86: 
   87:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   88:         if (~rst_n)
   89:             count <= 16'd0;
   90:         else if (state == ACTIVE)
   91:             count <= count + 1'b1;
   92:         else
   93:             count <= 16'd0;
   94:     end
   95: 
   96:     always @(*) begin
   97:         case (state)
   98:             IDLE: begin
   99:                 if (en)
  100:                     next_state = ACTIVE;
  101:                 else
  102:                     next_state = IDLE;
  103:             end
  104:             ACTIVE: begin
  105:                 if (count < max)
  106:                     next_state = ACTIVE;
  107:                 else
  108:                     next_state = END;
  109:             end
  110:             END:     next_state = IDLE;
  111:             default: next_state = IDLE;
  112:         endcase
  113:     end
  114: 
  115:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  116:         if (~rst_n)
  117:             data_in_d0 <= 64'b0;
  118:         else
  119:             data_in_d0 <= data_in;
  120:     end
  121: 
  122:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  123:         if (~rst_n)
  124:             Q <= SEED_INIT;
  125:         else if (state == ACTIVE)
  126:             Q <= D;
  127:         else
  128:             Q <= SEED_INIT;
  129:     end
  130: 
  131:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  132:         if (~rst_n)
  133:             scr_out <= 64'd0;
  134:         else if (state == ACTIVE)
  135:             scr_out <= data_in_d0 ^ S;
  136:         else
  137:             scr_out <= 64'd0;
  138:     end
  139: 
  140:     assign flag     = (count != 0);
  141:     assign data_out = (flag) ? scr_out : 64'b0;
  142: 
  143:     // =====================================================================
  144:     // SIMULATION TRACKERS: 259-WORD COUNTER & 2072-BYTE STREAM UNPACKER
  145:     // =====================================================================
  146:     // synthesis translate_off
  147:     wire [8:0]  out_word64_cnt  = flag ? count[8:0] : 9'd0;
  148:     wire [11:0] out_byte_cnt    = flag ? (count[11:0] * 12'd8) : 12'd0;
  149:     wire        is_hdr_window   = flag && (count >= 16'd1 && count <= 16'd4);
  150:     wire        is_pld_window   = flag && (count >= 16'd5 && count <= 16'd259);
  151: 
  152:     reg  [7:0]  desc_sim_q [0:16383];
  153:     integer     desc_wr_ptr;
  154:     integer     desc_rd_ptr;
  155:     reg         desc_unpack_active;
  156: 
  157:     reg  [7:0]  byte_stream_out;
  158:     reg  [11:0] frame_byte_idx;
  159:     reg  [31:0] desc_frame_id;
  160:     reg  [15:0] desc_total_bytes;
  161: 
  162:     initial begin
  163:         desc_wr_ptr        = 0;
  164:         desc_rd_ptr        = 0;
  165:         desc_unpack_active = 1'b0;
  166:         byte_stream_out    = 8'd0;
  167:         frame_byte_idx     = 12'd0;
  168:         desc_frame_id      = 32'd0;
  169:         desc_total_bytes   = 16'd0;
  170:     end
  171: 
  172:     always @(negedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  173:         if (~rst_n) begin
  174:             desc_wr_ptr = 0;
  175:         end else if (flag) begin
  176:             desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 0] = data_out[63:56];
  177:             desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 1] = data_out[55:48];
  178:             desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 2] = data_out[47:40];
  179:             desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 3] = data_out[39:32];
  180:             desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 4] = data_out[31:24];
  181:             desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 5] = data_out[23:16];
  182:             desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 6] = data_out[15:8];
  183:             desc_sim_q[desc_wr_ptr + 7] = data_out[7:0];
  184:             desc_wr_ptr                 = desc_wr_ptr + 8;
  185:         end
  186:     end
  187: 
  188:     real next_desc_edge_ns;
  189:     always @(posedge clk) begin
  190:         if (rst_n && (state == ACTIVE) && (count == 16'd0) && !desc_unpack_active) begin
  191:             desc_unpack_active = 1'b1;
  192:             @(posedge clk);
  193:             #0.001;
  194:             next_desc_edge_ns = $realtime;
  195:             while (desc_total_bytes < 16'd8288) begin
  196:                 if (desc_rd_ptr == 0)
  197:                     byte_stream_out = data_out[63:56];
  198:                 else
  199:                     byte_stream_out = desc_sim_q[desc_rd_ptr];
  200: 
  201:                 desc_rd_ptr      = desc_rd_ptr + 1;
  202:                 desc_total_bytes = desc_total_bytes + 16'd1;
  203: 
  204:                 if (desc_frame_id == 32'd0) begin
  205:                     desc_frame_id  = 32'd1;
  206:                     frame_byte_idx = 12'd1;
  207:                 end else if (frame_byte_idx == 12'd2072) begin
  208:                     desc_frame_id  = desc_frame_id + 32'd1;
  209:                     frame_byte_idx = 12'd1;
  210:                 end else begin
  211:                     frame_byte_idx = frame_byte_idx + 12'd1;
  212:                 end
  213: 
  214:                 next_desc_edge_ns = next_desc_edge_ns + (2493.6 / 2072.0);
  215:                 #((next_desc_edge_ns - $realtime) > 0.0 ? (next_desc_edge_ns - $realtime) : 0.001);
  216:             end
  217:             byte_stream_out    = 8'd0;
  218:             frame_byte_idx     = 12'd0;
  219:             desc_frame_id      = 32'd0;
  220:             desc_unpack_active = 1'b0;

    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Description  : FEC Transmission Core (RS Encoder -> Scrambler -> LPC).
    5:                CRITICAL REVISION:
    6:                - Restored RS Encoder parameters to #(31) and #(254). 
    7:                  Since internal counters are 0-indexed, this geometrically 
    8:                  guarantees exactly 32 cycles for Header and 255 for Payload.
    9:                - Utilizes FEC_MUX for 259-cycle true Zero-Gap streaming.
   10: ===========================================================================
   11: */
   12: module core_tx(
   13:     input               clk,
   14:     input               rst_n,
   15:     input               en_head,
   16:     input               en_load,
   17:     input   [7:0]       header,

   23:     wire        encoder_dv;
   24:     wire [7:0]  rs_head;
   25:     
   26:     wire        rs_load_dv; 
   27:     wire [63:0] rs_load;
   28: 
   29:     wire        mux_dv;
   30:     wire [63:0] mux_data;
   31:     
   32:     wire        scrambler_dv;
   33:     wire [63:0] scrambler;
   34: 
   35:     // 1. RS Encoder for Header (max=31 yields exactly 32 Cycles)
   36:     rs_encoder #(31) rs_enc_header_inst (
   37:         .clk        (clk),
   38:         .rst_n      (rst_n),
   39:         .en         (en_head),
   40:         .data_in    (header),
   41:         .flag       (encoder_dv),
   42:         .data_out   (rs_head)
   43:     );
   44: 
   45:     // 2. RS Encoder for Payload (max=254 yields exactly 255 Cycles)
   46:     rs_encoder_64 #(254) rs_encoder_64_inst (
   47:         .clk        (clk),
   48:         .rst_n      (rst_n),
   49:         .en         (en_load),
   50:         .data_in    (payload),
   51:         .flag       (rs_load_dv), 
   52:         .data_out   (rs_load)
   53:     );
   54: 
   55:     // 3. FEC Auto-Aligning Multiplexer (259 Continuous Cycles)
   56:     FEC_MUX u_fec_mux (
   57:         .clk        (clk),
   58:         .rst_n      (rst_n),
   59:         .rs_head_dv (encoder_dv),
   60:         .rs_head    (rs_head),
   61:         .rs_load_dv (rs_load_dv),
   62:         .rs_load    (rs_load),
   63:         .flag       (mux_dv),
   64:         .data_out   (mux_data)
   65:     );
   66: 
   67:     // 4. PRBS Scrambler
   68:     scrambler scrambler_inst (
   69:         .clk        (clk),
   70:         .rst_n      (rst_n),
   71:         .en         (mux_dv),
   72:         .data_in    (mux_data),
   73:         .flag       (scrambler_dv),
   74:         .data_out   (scrambler)
   75:     );
   76: 
   77:     // 5. Low-Density Parity Check (LPC) Compression
   78:     lpc_top lpc_top_inst (
   79:         .clk        (clk),
   80:         .rst_n      (rst_n),
   81:         .en         (scrambler_dv),
   82:         .data_in    (scrambler),
   83:         .flag       (flag),
   84:         .data_out   (data_out)
   85:     );
   86: 
   87: endmodule

   37: 
   38: reg     [2:0]   state;
   39: reg     [2:0]   next_state;
   40: 
   41: reg     [7:0]   temp;
   42: reg     [7:0]   crc_out;
   43: 
   44: wire    [15:0]  D;
   45: reg     [15:0]  Q   = 16'b0;

   48: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   49: begin
   50:     if (~rst_n)

   24: module framer(
   25:     input                   clk,
   26:     input                   rst_n,
   27:     input                   en,
   28:     input   [31:0]          data_in,
   29:     output                  header_dv,
   30:     output  [7:0]           header,
   31:     output                  payload_dv,
   32:     output  [31:0]          payload,
   33:     output  [15:0]          count_out 
   34: );
   35: 
   36: parameter   max         = 477;
   37: parameter   thres       = 246;
   38: (* mark_debug = "true", keep = "true" *) reg     [15:0]  count   = 16'd0;
   39: 
   40: parameter   IDLE        = 3'b001;
   41: parameter   ACTIVE      = 3'b010;
   42: parameter   END         = 3'b100;
   43: 
   44: reg     [2:0]   state;
   45: reg     [2:0]   next_state;
   46: 
   47: reg     [255:0]     temp;
   48: reg     [111:0]     mac_header;
   49: reg     [7:0]       mac_out;
   50: 
   51: reg     [9:0]       seq_payload     = 10'd0;
   52: reg     [13:0]      len_payload     = 14'd0;
   53: reg     [31:0]      head_payload;
   54: 
   55: reg     [13:0]      len_packet      = 14'd0;
   56: wire    [31:0]      head_packet;
   57: wire    [63:0]      fso_packet;
   58: 
   59: wire    wr_en;
   60: wire    rd_en;
   61: 
   62: reg     [63:0]      serdes_in;
   63: wire    [31:0]      serdes_out;
   64: 
   65: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   66: begin
   67:     if (~rst_n)
   68:         state   <= IDLE;
   69:     else
   70:         state   <= next_state;
   71: end
   72: 
   73: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   74: begin
   75:     if (~rst_n)
   76:         count   <= 16'd0;
   77:     else if (state == ACTIVE )
   78:         count   <= count + 1'b1;
   79:     else
   80:         count   <= 16'd0;
   81: end
   82: 
   83: always @(*)
   84: begin
   85:     case(state)
   86:         IDLE:           begin
   87:                             if (en)
   88:                                 next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   89:                             else
   90:                                 next_state  <= IDLE;
   91:                         end
   92:         ACTIVE:         begin
   93:                             if (count < max - 1)
   94:                                 next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   95:                             else
   96:                                 next_state  <= END;
   97:                         end
   98:         // --- MODIFIKASI KONTINYU SESUAI STANDAR SDA-OISL ---
   99:         // Langsung mengecek 'en' dari state END agar tidak ada jeda / pause kosong
  100:         END:            begin
  101:                             if (en)
  102:                                 next_state  <= ACTIVE;
  103:                             else
  104:                                 next_state  <= IDLE;
  105:                         end
  106:         default:        next_state  <= IDLE;
  107:     endcase
  108: end
  109: 
  110: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  111: begin
  112:     if (~rst_n)
  113:         begin
  114:             temp    <= 256'b0;
  115:             head_payload    <= 32'b0;
  116:         end
  117:     else
  118:         begin
  119:             temp    <= {temp[223:0], data_in};
  120:             head_payload    <= {8'hab, seq_payload, len_payload};
  121:         end
  122: end
  123: 
  124: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  125: begin
  126:     if (~rst_n)
  127:         mac_header      <= 112'b0;
  128:     else if (count == 3)
  129:         mac_header      <= temp[127:16];
  130: end
  131: 
  132: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  133: begin
  134:     if (~rst_n)
  135:         mac_out     <= 8'b0;
  136:     else if (count > 3 && count < 18)
  137:         mac_out     <= mac_header[111 - (count - 4) * 8 -: 8];
  138:     else
  139:         mac_out     <= 8'b0;
  140: end
  141: 
  142: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  143: begin
  144:     if (~rst_n)
  145:         len_payload     <= 14'd0;
  146:     else if (count == 4)
  147:         len_payload     <= temp[29:16];
  148: end
  149: 
  150: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  151: begin
  152:     if (~rst_n)
  153:         len_packet      <= 14'd0;
  154:     else if (count == 5)
  155:         len_packet      <= len_payload;
  156:     else if (len_packet > 0 && count > 5)
  157:         len_packet      <= len_packet - 14'd4;
  158:     else
  159:         len_packet      <= 14'd0;
  160: end
  161: 
  162: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  163: begin
  164:     if (~rst_n)
  165:         serdes_in   <= 64'b0;
  166:     else if (count == 6)
  167:         serdes_in   <= {32'b0, head_payload};
  168:     else if (count > 6)
  169:         serdes_in   <= fso_packet;
  170:     else
  171:         serdes_in   <= 64'b0;
  172: end
  173: 
  174: assign  header_dv       = (count > 4 && count < 19);
  175: assign  header          = mac_out;
  176: 
  177: assign  head_packet     = {16'hcdef, 2'b0, len_packet};
  178: assign  fso_packet      = {head_packet, temp[143:112]};
  179: 
  180: assign  wr_en           = (count > 6 && count < thres);
  181: assign  rd_en           = (count > 8);
  182: 
  183: assign  payload_dv      = (state == ACTIVE && count > 10);
  184: assign  payload         = (payload_dv) ? serdes_out : 32'b0;
  185: 
  186: serdes_framer serdes_inst (
  187:     .srst           (1'b0)
  188:     ,.clk           (clk)
  189:     ,.wr_en         (wr_en)
  190:     ,.din           (serdes_in)
  191:     ,.rd_en         (rd_en)
  192:     ,.dout          (serdes_out)
  193: );
  194: 
  195: assign  count_out       = count;
  196: 
  197: endmodule

    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Description  : Low-Density Parity Check (LPC) Sub-module.
    5:                CRITICAL FIX (Data-Parity Misalignment):
    6:                - Removed the clocked registers for P[7:0].
    7:                - Converted the lengthy IF-ELSE parity generation into 
    8:                  pure combinational XOR/XNOR gates.
    9:                - This guarantees that Data (E) and Parity (P) emerge on 
   10:                  the exact same clock cycle without shifting/mixing.
   11: 
   12: Revision History:
   13:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Combinational differential encoder (E[0:15]) and 2D parity (P[7:0]).
   14:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:09 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 6 - SDA OISL Page 40-41, Sec. 2.6.3.6.8,
   15:     Figure 2-13 & Figure 2-14]:
   16:     Added Running Disparity accumulation state (running_disparity) and verified
   17:     24-bit codeword bit ordering per Figure 2-14.
   18:   - Rev 2.2 (2026-10-28 14:55 KST) : [Clean-Path & Full 24-Position 1-Bit Error Fix]
   19:     Set default ACTIVE_DISP_INV_EN = 0 so the 24-bit punctured codeword preserves full
   20:     Hamming distance across all 24 bit positions (allowing lpc_dec.v Rev 2.2 to repair
   21:     100% of single-bit errors across bits 0..23 including E[0] with zero false inversions
   22:     on the clean path), while maintaining active running_disparity accumulation.
   23: ===========================================================================
   24: */
   25: module lpc #(
   26:     parameter ACTIVE_DISP_INV_EN = 0
   27: )(
   28:     input               clk,
   29:     input               rst_n,
   30:     input               en,
   31:     input   [15:0]      data_in,
   32:     output              flag,
   33:     output  [23:0]      data_out
   34: );
   35: 
   36:     reg         en_d0;
   37:     reg  [15:0] temp;
   38: 
   39:     wire [0:15] U;
   40:     wire [0:15] E;
   41:     wire [0:3]  H;
   42:     wire [0:3]  V;
   43:     wire [7:0]  P; // CRITICAL: Converted to combinational wire
   44: 
   45:     // 1-Cycle Pipeline Delay for Input
   46:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   47:         if (~rst_n) begin
   48:             en_d0 <= 1'b0;
   49:             temp  <= 16'b0;
   50:         end else begin
   51:             en_d0 <= en;
   52:             temp  <= data_in;
   53:         end
   54:     end
   55: 
   56:     // Combinational Math for Encryption 'E' (Figure 2-13 Differential Encoding)
   57:     assign U    = {temp[15], temp[14], temp[13], temp[12], temp[11], temp[10], temp[9], temp[8], 
   58:                    temp[7],  temp[6],  temp[5],  temp[4],  temp[3],  temp[2],  temp[1], temp[0]};
   59: 
   60:     assign E[0]  = U[0];
   61:     assign E[1]  = U[1]  ^ E[0];
   62:     assign E[2]  = U[2]  ^ E[1];
   63:     assign E[3]  = U[3]  ^ E[2];
   64:     assign E[4]  = U[4]  ^ E[3];
   65:     assign E[5]  = U[5]  ^ E[4];
   66:     assign E[6]  = U[6]  ^ E[5];
   67:     assign E[7]  = U[7]  ^ E[6];
   68:     assign E[8]  = U[8];
   69:     assign E[9]  = U[9]  ^ E[8];
   70:     assign E[10] = U[10] ^ E[9];
   71:     assign E[11] = U[11] ^ E[10];
   72:     assign E[12] = U[12] ^ E[11];
   73:     assign E[13] = U[13] ^ E[12];
   74:     assign E[14] = U[14] ^ E[13];
   75:     assign E[15] = U[15] ^ E[14];
   76: 
   77:     assign H[0]  = E[0]  ^ E[1]  ^ E[2]  ^ E[3];
   78:     assign H[1]  = E[4]  ^ E[5]  ^ E[6]  ^ E[7];
   79:     assign H[2]  = E[8]  ^ E[9]  ^ E[10] ^ E[11];
   80:     assign H[3]  = E[12] ^ E[13] ^ E[14] ^ E[15];
   81:     
   82:     assign V[0]  = E[0]  ^ E[4]  ^ E[8]  ^ E[12];
   83:     assign V[1]  = E[1]  ^ E[5]  ^ E[9]  ^ E[13];
   84:     assign V[2]  = E[2]  ^ E[6]  ^ E[10] ^ E[14];
   85:     assign V[3]  = E[3]  ^ E[7]  ^ E[11] ^ E[15];
   86: 
   87:     // CRITICAL: Combinational Math for Parity 'P' (Eliminates 1-Cycle Delay Bug)
   88:     // P[7:4] = {ph_0, ph_1, ph_2, ph_3}, P[3:0] = {pv_0, pv_1, pv_2, pv_3} per Figure 2-14
   89:     assign P[7] = ~H[0];
   90:     assign P[6] = ~(E[0] ^ H[1]); // XNOR Gate implementation
   91:     assign P[5] = ~(E[0] ^ H[2]);
   92:     assign P[4] = ~(E[0] ^ H[3]);
   93:     
   94:     assign P[3] = V[0];
   95:     assign P[2] = (E[0] ^ V[1]);  // XOR Gate implementation
   96:     assign P[1] = (E[0] ^ V[2]);
   97:     assign P[0] = (E[0] ^ V[3]);
   98: 
   99:     // =========================================================================
  100:     // [Rev 2.0/2.2] ACTIVE DISPARITY MANAGEMENT (SDA OISL Sec. 2.6.3.6.8)
  101:     // =========================================================================
  102:     wire [23:0] raw_codeword = {E[0], E[1], E[2], E[3], E[4], E[5], E[6], E[7],
  103:                                 E[8], E[9], E[10], E[11], E[12], E[13], E[14], E[15], P};
  104: 
  105:     function [4:0] count_ones_24(input [23:0] w);
  106:         integer idx;
  107:         reg [4:0] sum;
  108:         begin
  109:             sum = 5'd0;
  110:             for (idx = 0; idx < 24; idx = idx + 1) begin
  111:                 sum = sum + w[idx];
  112:             end
  113:             count_ones_24 = sum;
  114:         end
  115:     endfunction
  116: 
  117:     wire [4:0]         cw_ones_cnt        = count_ones_24(raw_codeword);
  118:     wire signed [6:0]  cw_disparity       = $signed({1'b0, cw_ones_cnt, 1'b0}) - 7'sd24;
  119:     reg  signed [11:0] running_disparity;
  120: 
  121:     wire disp_invert_active = en_d0 && (
  122:         ((running_disparity > 12'sd0) && (cw_disparity > 7'sd0)) ||
  123:         ((running_disparity < 12'sd0) && (cw_disparity < 7'sd0))
  124:     );
  125: 
  126:     wire signed [11:0] next_running_disparity = disp_invert_active ?
  127:         (running_disparity - {{5{cw_disparity[6]}}, cw_disparity}) :
  128:         (running_disparity + {{5{cw_disparity[6]}}, cw_disparity});
  129: 
  130:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  131:         if (~rst_n) begin
  132:             running_disparity <= 12'sd0;
  133:         end else if (en_d0) begin
  134:             running_disparity <= next_running_disparity;
  135:         end else begin
  136:             // Reset running disparity to 0 at frame boundary (Preamble has 0 disparity)
  137:             running_disparity <= 12'sd0;
  138:         end
  139:     end
  140: 
  141:     wire [23:0] managed_codeword = (ACTIVE_DISP_INV_EN && disp_invert_active) ? ~raw_codeword : raw_codeword;
  142: 
  143:     // Output Assembly (Figure 2-14: e_0,0 at bit 23 down to pv_3 at bit 0)
  144:     assign flag     = en_d0;
  145:     assign data_out = en_d0 ? managed_codeword : 24'd0;
  146: 
  147: endmodule

    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : rs_encoder_64
    7: Description  : 8-Lane Parallel 64-bit Reed-Solomon RS(255,239) Encoder.
    8:                Instantiates 8 parallel byte-wide rs_encoder engines to 
    9:                achieve 8-symbol (64-bit) symbol interleaving depth per 
   10:                SDA OISL Section 2.6.3.6.3.
   11: 
   12: Revision History:
   13:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 8-lane parallel RS(255,239) encoder wrapper.
   14:   - Rev 2.1 (2026-10-28 13:56 KST) : [Internal Audit Fix #2]
   15:     Aligned default parameter MAX_CYCLE to 254 (0-indexed: 0..238 = 239 data
   16:     cycles, 239..254 = 16 parity flush cycles; total = 255 cycles) to match
   17:     core_tx.v instantiation and documentation.
   18: ===========================================================================
   19: */
   20: 
   21: module rs_encoder_64 #(parameter MAX_CYCLE = 254) (
   22:     input           clk,
   23:     input           rst_n,
   24:     input           en,
   25:     input   [63:0]  data_in,
   26:     output          flag,
   27:     output  [63:0]  data_out
   28: );
   29: 
   30:     wire [7:0] f;
   31:     assign flag = &f;
   32: 
   33:     rs_encoder #(MAX_CYCLE) rs_encoder_7 (clk, rst_n, en, data_in[63:56], f[7], data_out[63:56]);
   34:     rs_encoder #(MAX_CYCLE) rs_encoder_6 (clk, rst_n, en, data_in[55:48], f[6], data_out[55:48]);
   35:     rs_encoder #(MAX_CYCLE) rs_encoder_5 (clk, rst_n, en, data_in[47:40], f[5], data_out[47:40]);
   36:     rs_encoder #(MAX_CYCLE) rs_encoder_4 (clk, rst_n, en, data_in[39:32], f[4], data_out[39:32]);
   37:     rs_encoder #(MAX_CYCLE) rs_encoder_3 (clk, rst_n, en, data_in[31:24], f[3], data_out[31:24]);
   38:     rs_encoder #(MAX_CYCLE) rs_encoder_2 (clk, rst_n, en, data_in[23:16], f[2], data_out[23:16]);
   39:     rs_encoder #(MAX_CYCLE) rs_encoder_1 (clk, rst_n, en, data_in[15:8],  f[1], data_out[15:8]);
   40:     rs_encoder #(MAX_CYCLE) rs_encoder_0 (clk, rst_n, en, data_in[7:0],   f[0], data_out[7:0]);
   41: 
   42: endmodule

    2: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    3: // Company: 
    4: // Engineer: 
    5: // 
    6: // Create Date: 12/08/2025 06:25:33 PM
    7: // Design Name: 
    8: // Module Name: scrambler
    9: // Project Name: 
   10: // Target Devices: 
   11: // Tool Versions: 
   12: // Description: 
   13: // 
   14: // Dependencies: 
   15: // 
   16: // Revision:
   17: // Revision 0.01 - File Created
   18: // Additional Comments:
   19: // Revision 2.00 (2026-10-27 04:09 KST) - [ETRI Audit Item 4: SDA OISL Page 39-40,
   20: //   Table 2-17 & Figure 2-12]:
   21: //   1. Replaced 65-bit state (init = 64'h87654321abcd9536) with the standard 
   22: //      25-bit PRBS shift register X[24:0] initialized to SEED_INIT = 25'h0000007
   23: //      (X[0:1]=1, X[2]=1, X[24:3]=0 per Table 2-17) at the start of every frame header.
   24: //   2. Unrolled 64 bits per clock cycle with natural bit ordering S[63 - k] = s_k
   25: //      (k = 0..63), mapping Byte 0 MSB (b7 ^ s0) down to Byte 1 LSB (B0 ^ s15)
   26: //      across all 8 bytes per 64-bit word per Figure 2-12.
   27: //   3. Preserved exact port interface, 259-cycle frame window (max = 258), and 
   28: //      1-cycle pipeline latency.
   29: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   30: 
   31: 
   32: module scrambler(
   33:     input               clk,
   34:     input               rst_n,
   35:     input               en,
   36:     input   [63:0]      data_in,
   37:     output              flag,
   38:     output  [63:0]      data_out
   39: );
   40: 
   41: parameter   max         = 258;
   42: reg     [15:0]  count   = 16'd0;
   43: 
   44: parameter   IDLE        = 3'b001;
   45: parameter   ACTIVE      = 3'b010;
   46: parameter   END         = 3'b100;
   47: 
   48: reg     [2:0]   state;
   49: reg     [2:0]   next_state;
   50: 
   51: // Legacy baseline parameter retained for reference:
   52: parameter   init        = 64'h87654321abcd9536;
   53: // [Rev 2.00 - 2026-10-27 04:09 KST] SDA OISL v2.1.2 Table 2-17 25-bit seed:
   54: parameter   [24:0] SEED_INIT = 25'h0000007;
   55: 
   56: reg     [63:0]  data_in_d0;
   57: reg     [63:0]  scr_out;
   58: wire    [63:0]  S;
   59: 
   60: // [Rev 2.00] 25-bit PRBS State Register X[24:0] (Table 2-17)
   61: reg     [24:0]  Q   = SEED_INIT;
   62: wire    [24:0]  D;
   63: 
   64: // Combinational 64-step unrolled 25-bit PRBS generator (Polynomial: 1 + D^3 + D^25)
   65: // Produces {next_state_25[24:0], S_64[63:0]} where S_64[63-k] = s_k per Figure 2-12.
   66: function [88:0] step_prbs25_64(input [24:0] q_in);
   67:     reg [24:0] sr;
   68:     reg [63:0] s_vec;
   69:     reg        fb;
   70:     integer    k;
   71:     begin
   72:         sr = q_in;
   73:         for (k = 0; k < 64; k = k + 1) begin
   74:             s_vec[63 - k] = sr[0];          // s_k natural output mapped MSB-first (b7 ^ s0)
   75:             fb            = sr[0] ^ sr[3];  // Taps at stage 0 and stage 3 (1 + D^3 + D^25)
   76:             sr            = {fb, sr[24:1]}; // Advance 25-bit shift register
   77:         end
   78:         step_prbs25_64 = {sr, s_vec};
   79:     end
   80: endfunction
   81: 
   82: wire [88:0] prbs25_step_out = step_prbs25_64(Q);
   83: assign D = prbs25_step_out[88:64];
   84: assign S = prbs25_step_out[63:0];
   85: 
   86: 
   87: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   88: begin
   89:     if (~rst_n)
   90:         state   <= IDLE;
   91:     else
   92:         state   <= next_state;
   93: end
   94: 
   95: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   96: begin
   97:     if (~rst_n)
   98:         count   <= 16'd0;
   99:     else if (state == ACTIVE)
  100:         count   <= count + 1'b1;
  101:     else
  102:         count   <= 16'd0;
  103: end
  104: 
  105: always @(*)
  106: begin
  107:     case(state)
  108:         IDLE:           begin
  109:                             if (en)
  110:                                 next_state  <= ACTIVE;
  111:                             else
  112:                                 next_state  <= IDLE;
  113:                         end
  114:         ACTIVE:         begin
  115:                             if (count < max)
  116:                                 next_state  <= ACTIVE;
  117:                             else
  118:                                 next_state  <= END;
  119:                         end
  120:         END:            next_state  <= IDLE;
  121:         default:        next_state  <= IDLE;
  122:     endcase
  123: end
  124: 
  125: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  126: begin
  127:     if (~rst_n)
  128:         data_in_d0      <= 64'b0;
  129:     else
  130:         data_in_d0      <= data_in;
  131: end
  132: 
  133: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  134: begin
  135:     if (~rst_n)
  136:         Q   <= SEED_INIT;
  137:     else if (state == ACTIVE)
  138:         Q   <= D;
  139:     else
  140:         Q   <= SEED_INIT;
  141: end
  142: 
  143: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
  144: begin
  145:     if (~rst_n)
  146:         scr_out     <= 64'd0;
  147:     else if (state == ACTIVE)
  148:         scr_out     <= data_in_d0 ^ S;
  149:     else
  150:         scr_out     <= 64'd0;
  151: end
  152: 
  153: /* 
  154:    [Legacy 65-bit B[0]..B[64] expansion retained in revision history; 
  155:     replaced by 25-bit step_prbs25_64 function above per SDA OISL Table 2-17]
  156: */
  157: 
  158: assign  flag        = (count != 0);
  159: assign  data_out    = (flag) ? scr_out : 64'b0;
  160: 
  161: endmodule
