    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Description  : Clock Domain Crossing 1 (CDC 1) Subsystem.
    7:                Bridges the high-speed 312.5 MHz GTH TX domain from the 
    8:                SDA Framer to the 200 MHz Baseband Logic domain.
    9: 
   10:                Key Features & Revisions:
   11:                1. Asymmetric Bus Width: Converts 32-bit payload (312.5 MHz) 
   12:                   to 64-bit payload (200 MHz) using Xilinx Independent Clock 
   13:                   FIFO primitives to maintain high-throughput math pipeline.
   14:                2. Smart Trigger: Replaced fragile pulse synchronization with 
   15:                   reliable FIFO 'empty' flag monitoring. This ensures 
   16:                   Zero-Gap continuous streams are processed seamlessly.
   17:                3. Backpressure Mechanism: Outputs a 'cdc_ready' signal 
   18:                   derived from FIFO 'full' flags. This throttles the upstream 
   19:                   Framer, preventing throughput collisions and memory overflows.
   20:                4. Multi-Frame Continuous Read & 10G Pacing Alignment:
   21:                   Aligned 'max_head' (25) and 'max_load' (404) with FIFO read 
   22:                   latency so 'rd_head' pops strictly 16 bytes and 'rd_load' pops 
   23:                   strictly 239 words per frame.
   24:                5. [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 04:19 KST - Target B2 Audit Fix]:
   25:                   Aligned 'header_dv' and 'payload_dv' with C_PRELOAD_LATENCY = 2.
   26:                6. [Rev 2.1 - 2026-10-28 13:56 KST - Internal Audit Fix #6]:
   27:                   Added a modulo-25 fractional cycle accumulator (frame_mod25_cnt)
   28:                   that alternates between 499 cycles (2495.0 ns, 18 times out of 25)
   29:                   and 498 cycles (2490.0 ns, 7 times out of 25), achieving an exact
   30:                   long-term average frame period of:
   31:                     (18 * 2495.0 ns + 7 * 2490.0 ns) / 25 = 2493.600 ns
   32:                   matching the 3117-Byte @ 10 Gbps optical frame rate with zero drift.
   33: ===========================================================================
   34: */
   35: 
   36: module x_gth_logic(
   37:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   38:     // System Clocks and Reset
   39:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   40:     input               clk_gth,      // Fast clock from GTH (e.g., 312.5 MHz)
   41:     input               clk_logic,    // Slow clock for Baseband (e.g., 200 MHz)
   42:     input               rst_n,        // Active-low asynchronous reset
   43:     
   44:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   45:     // Inputs from SDA Framer (Write Domain - 312.5 MHz)
   46:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   47:     input               en_head,      // Header write enable
   48:     input               en_load,      // Payload write enable
   49:     input   [7:0]       header_in,    // 8-bit Header data
   50:     input   [31:0]      payload_in,   // 32-bit Payload data
   51:     
   52:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   53:     // Output to SDA Framer (Write Domain - 312.5 MHz)
   54:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   55:     output              cdc_ready,    // Backpressure to throttle Framer
   56: 
   57:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   58:     // Outputs to FEC Encoder (Read Domain - 200 MHz)
   59:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   60:     output              header_dv,    // Header data valid flag
   61:     output  [7:0]       header,       // 8-bit Header data
   62:     output              payload_dv,   // Payload data valid flag
   63:     output  [63:0]      payload       // Widened 64-bit Payload data
   64: );
   65: 
   66:     // =======================================================
   67:     // TIMING CONSTANTS (Aligned with FEC RS Latency & C_PRELOAD_LATENCY = 2)
   68:     // =======================================================
   69:     parameter   st_head     = 8;
   70:     parameter   max_head    = 25;     // count 9..24 (rd_head = 16 pops), count 11..26 (header_dv = 16 cycles)
   71:     parameter   st_load     = 164;    // 164 cycles synchronization delay for RS Header
   72:     parameter   max_load    = 404;    // count 165..403 (rd_load = 239 pops), count 167..405 (payload_dv = 239 cycles)
   73:     parameter   max_frame   = 496;    // Base terminal count (499 cycles = 2495.0 ns; modulated to 495 = 2490.0 ns 7/25 frames)
   74: 
   75:     reg     [15:0]  count           = 16'd0;
   76:     reg     [4:0]   frame_mod25_cnt = 5'd0; // [Rev 2.1] 0..24 fractional pacing counter (498.72 cycles avg = 2493.600 ns)
   77:     wire    [15:0]  active_max_frame = (frame_mod25_cnt < 5'd18) ? max_frame : (max_frame - 16'd1);
   78: 
   79:     parameter   IDLE        = 3'b001;
   80:     parameter   ACTIVE      = 3'b010;
   81:     parameter   END         = 3'b100;
   82: 
   83:     reg     [2:0]   state;
   84:     reg     [2:0]   next_state;
   85: 
   86:     wire    rd_head;
   87:     wire    [7:0]   header_out;
   88:     wire    rd_load;
   89:     wire    [63:0]  payload_out;
   90: 
   91:     // Internal FIFO Flags
   92:     wire    head_empty;
   93:     wire    load_empty;
   94:     wire    head_full;
   95:     wire    load_full;
   96:     wire    head_wr_rst_busy;
   97:     wire    head_rd_rst_busy;
   98:     wire    load_wr_rst_busy;
   99:     wire    load_rd_rst_busy;
  100: 
  101:     // =======================================================
  102:     // 1. BACKPRESSURE LOGIC (Write Domain)
  103:     // =======================================================
  104:     assign cdc_ready = ~(head_full | load_full | head_wr_rst_busy | load_wr_rst_busy);
  105: 
  106:     // =======================================================
  107:     // 2. FINITE STATE MACHINE (Read Domain - clk_logic)
  108:     // =======================================================
  109:     always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
  110:         if (~rst_n)
  111:             state <= IDLE;
  112:         else
  113:             state <= next_state;
  114:     end
  115: 
  116:     // Cycle Counter & Modulo-25 Fractional Pacer (Exact 2493.600 ns Average)
  117:     always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
  118:         if (~rst_n) begin
  119:             count           <= 16'd0;
  120:             frame_mod25_cnt <= 5'd0;
  121:         end else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
  122:             count <= count + 1'b1;
  123:         end else begin
  124:             count <= 16'd0;
  125:             if (state == END) begin
  126:                 if (frame_mod25_cnt == 5'd24)
  127:                     frame_mod25_cnt <= 5'd0;
  128:                 else
  129:                     frame_mod25_cnt <= frame_mod25_cnt + 5'd1;
  130:             end
  131:         end
  132:     end
  133: 
  134:     // State Transitions
  135:     always @(*) begin
  136:         case(state)
  137:             IDLE: begin
  138:                 if (~head_empty && ~load_empty && ~head_rd_rst_busy && ~load_rd_rst_busy)
  139:                     next_state <= ACTIVE;
  140:                 else
  141:                     next_state <= IDLE;
  142:             end
  143:             
  144:             ACTIVE: begin
  145:                 if (count < active_max_frame)
  146:                     next_state <= ACTIVE;
  147:                 else
  148:                     next_state <= END;
  149:             end
  150:             
  151:             END: begin
  152:                 next_state <= IDLE;
  153:             end
  154:             
  155:             default: next_state <= IDLE;
  156:         endcase
  157:     end
  158: 
  159:     // =======================================================
  160:     // 3. FIFO READ GATING & OUTPUT ASSIGNMENTS
  161:     // =======================================================
  162:     assign  rd_head     = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_head && count < max_head);
  163:     assign  header_dv   = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_head + 2 && count < max_head + 2);
  164:     assign  header      = (header_dv) ? header_out : 8'b0;
  165: 
  166:     assign  rd_load     = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_load && count < max_load);
  167:     assign  payload_dv  = (state == ACTIVE) && (count > st_load + 2 && count < max_load + 2);
  168:     assign  payload     = (payload_dv) ? payload_out : 64'b0;
  169: 
  170:     // =======================================================
  171:     // 4. IP CORE INSTANTIATIONS (Xilinx FIFO Generator)
  172:     // =======================================================
  173:     cross_gth_logic_head cross_head_inst (
  174:         .srst           (~rst_n),
  175:         .wr_clk         (clk_gth),
  176:         .wr_en          (en_head),
  177:         .din            (header_in),
  178:         .rd_clk         (clk_logic),
  179:         .rd_en          (rd_head),
  180:         .dout           (header_out),
  181:         .full           (head_full),
  182:         .empty          (head_empty),
  183:         .wr_rst_busy    (head_wr_rst_busy),
  184:         .rd_rst_busy    (head_rd_rst_busy)
  185:     );
  186: 
  187:     cross_gth_logic_load cross_load_inst (
  188:         .srst           (~rst_n),
  189:         .wr_clk         (clk_gth),
  190:         .wr_en          (en_load),
  191:         .din            (payload_in),
  192:         .rd_clk         (clk_logic),
  193:         .rd_en          (rd_load),
  194:         .dout           (payload_out),
  195:         .full           (load_full),
  196:         .empty          (load_empty),
  197:         .wr_rst_busy    (load_wr_rst_busy),
  198:         .rd_rst_busy    (load_rd_rst_busy)
  199:     );
  200: 
  201: endmodule

    1: `timescale 1ns / 100ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : x_logic_gth
    7: Description  : Clock Domain Crossing 2 (CDC 2) & Modulo-4 Byte-Packing Shifter.
    8:                - Bridges the 200.0 MHz 128-bit MUX Gearbox domain to the 
    9:                  312.5 MHz 32-bit GTH TX domain via cross_logic_gth FIFO.
   10:                - Strips the 3 trailing zero-padding bytes on the 195th word 
   11:                  (cdc_keep == 16'h1FFF -> 13 valid bytes) and seamlessly packs 
   12:                  consecutive 3117-Byte frames back-to-back across 32-bit word 
   13:                  boundaries (4 frames = 12,468 Bytes = 3117 clocks @ 312.5 MHz, 
   14:                  exact 2.493600 us per frame).
   15: 
   16: Revision History:
   17:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 128-to-32 bit CDC 2 with modulo-4 byte barrel shifter.
   18:   - Rev 2.2 (2026-10-28 14:55 KST) : [Gray-Code CDC & FIFO Full Protection]
   19:     1. Converted cross-domain frame counter (wr_frame_cnt) to Gray Code 
   20:        (wr_frame_gray) before the 2-stage synchronizer (marked with 
   21:        ASYNC_REG = "TRUE") and decoded Gray-to-Binary in the clk_gth domain 
   22:        to eliminate multi-bit binary CDC sampling glitches.
   23:     2. Gated FIFO write enable (fifo_wr_en) with !fifo_full & !wr_rst_busy 
   24:        and exposed 'cdc2_ready' for lossless upstream flow control.
   25: ===========================================================================
   26: */
   27: 
   28: module x_logic_gth (
   29:     input  wire         clk_gth,     // 312.5 MHz Read Domain
   30:     input  wire         clk_logic,   // 200.0 MHz Write Domain
   31:     input  wire         rst_n,
   32:     input  wire         en,
   33:     input  wire [127:0] data_in,
   34:     input  wire         data_in_dv,
   35:     input  wire [15:0]  cdc_keep,
   36:     output reg          flag,
   37:     output reg  [31:0]  data_out
   38: );
   39: 
   40:     wire        fifo_full;
   41:     wire        fifo_empty;
   42:     wire        wr_rst_busy;
   43:     wire        rd_rst_busy;
   44:     wire [31:0] fifo_dout;
   45:     wire        cdc2_ready = ~fifo_full & ~wr_rst_busy;
   46: 
   47:     // =======================================================
   48:     // 1. WRITE DOMAIN (200 MHz): FRAME TRACKER & GRAY-CODE CDC
   49:     // =======================================================
   50:     reg [7:0]  wr_word_idx;
   51:     reg [31:0] wr_frame_cnt;
   52:     wire       fifo_wr_en = en && data_in_dv && (~fifo_full) && (~wr_rst_busy);
   53: 
   54:     // Binary-to-Gray conversion in clk_logic domain
   55:     wire [31:0] wr_frame_gray_next = wr_frame_cnt ^ (wr_frame_cnt >> 1);
   56:     reg  [31:0] wr_frame_gray;
   57: 
   58:     always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
   59:         if (!rst_n) begin
   60:             wr_word_idx   <= 8'd0;
   61:             wr_frame_cnt  <= 32'd0;
   62:             wr_frame_gray <= 32'd0;
   63:         end else begin
   64:             wr_frame_gray <= wr_frame_gray_next;
   65:             if (fifo_wr_en) begin
   66:                 if ((cdc_keep == 16'h1FFF) || (wr_word_idx == 8'd194)) begin
   67:                     wr_word_idx  <= 8'd0;
   68:                     wr_frame_cnt <= wr_frame_cnt + 32'd1;
   69:                 end else begin
   70:                     wr_word_idx  <= wr_word_idx + 8'd1;
   71:                 end
   72:             end else if (!data_in_dv) begin
   73:                 wr_word_idx <= 8'd0;
   74:             end
   75:         end
   76:     end
   77: 
   78:     // 2-Stage Gray-Code Synchronizer into clk_gth (312.5 MHz) Domain
   79:     (* ASYNC_REG = "TRUE" *) reg [31:0] wr_frame_gray_sync1;
   80:     (* ASYNC_REG = "TRUE" *) reg [31:0] wr_frame_gray_sync2;
   81: 
   82:     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
   83:         if (!rst_n) begin
   84:             wr_frame_gray_sync1 <= 32'd0;
   85:             wr_frame_gray_sync2 <= 32'd0;
   86:         end else begin
   87:             wr_frame_gray_sync1 <= wr_frame_gray;
   88:             wr_frame_gray_sync2 <= wr_frame_gray_sync1;
   89:         end
   90:     end
   91: 
   92:     // Gray-to-Binary conversion in clk_gth domain
   93:     function [31:0] gray2bin32(input [31:0] g);
   94:         integer k;
   95:         reg [31:0] b;
   96:         begin
   97:             b[31] = g[31];
   98:             for (k = 30; k >= 0; k = k - 1) begin
   99:                 b[k] = b[k + 1] ^ g[k];
  100:             end
  101:             gray2bin32 = b;
  102:         end
  103:     endfunction
  104: 
  105:     wire [31:0] wr_frame_cnt_gth = gray2bin32(wr_frame_gray_sync2);
  106: 
  107:     // =======================================================
  108:     // 2. ASYNCHRONOUS FIFO (128-bit @ 200M -> 32-bit @ 312.5M)
  109:     // =======================================================
  110:     reg  [11:0] pop_word_idx;
  111:     wire         need_word;
  112:     wire        fifo_rd_en = (~fifo_empty) && (~rd_rst_busy) && need_word;
  113: 
  114:     cross_logic_gth u_async_fifo (
  115:         .srst        (~rst_n),
  116:         .wr_clk      (clk_logic),
  117:         .rd_clk      (clk_gth),
  118:         .din         (data_in),
  119:         .wr_en       (fifo_wr_en),
  120:         .rd_en       (fifo_rd_en),
  121:         .dout        (fifo_dout),
  122:         .full        (fifo_full),
  123:         .empty       (fifo_empty),
  124:         .wr_rst_busy (wr_rst_busy),
  125:         .rd_rst_busy (rd_rst_busy)
  126:     );
  127: 
  128:     // =======================================================
  129:     // 3. READ DOMAIN (312.5 MHz): 3117-BYTE BARREL SHIFTER
  130:     // =======================================================
  131:     reg  [1:0]  pipe_valid;
  132:     reg  [2:0]  pipe_bytes_0;
  133:     reg  [2:0]  pipe_bytes_1;
  134:     wire [2:0]  popped_valid_bytes = (pop_word_idx == 12'd779) ? 3'd1 : 3'd4;
  135: 
  136:     reg  [95:0] shift_reg;
  137:     reg  [4:0]  avail_bytes;
  138:     reg         stream_active;
  139:     reg  [31:0] rd_frame_cnt;
  140:     reg  [11:0] rd_frame_bytes;
  141: 
  142:     wire        has_4_bytes    = (avail_bytes >= 5'd4);
  143:     wire        is_final_flush = stream_active && (rd_frame_cnt + 32'd1 >= wr_frame_cnt_gth) &&
  144:                                  fifo_empty && (!pipe_valid[0]) && (!pipe_valid[1]) &&
  145:                                  (avail_bytes > 5'd0) && (avail_bytes < 5'd4);
  146:     wire [4:0]  bytes_consumed = has_4_bytes ? 5'd4 : (is_final_flush ? avail_bytes : 5'd0);
  147:     wire [4:0]  next_avail_pre = avail_bytes - bytes_consumed;
  148: 
  149:     assign need_word = stream_active && (avail_bytes <= 5'd8);
  150: 
  151:     wire [95:0] shifted_reg    = shift_reg << (bytes_consumed * 8);
  152:     wire [95:0] incoming_alg   = ({fifo_dout, 64'd0} &
  153:                                   ((pipe_bytes_1 == 3'd1) ? 96'hFF00_0000_0000_0000_0000_0000 :
  154:                                                             96'hFFFF_FFFF_0000_0000_0000_0000))
  155:                                  >> (next_avail_pre * 8);
  156: 
  157:     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  158:         if (!rst_n) begin
  159:             pop_word_idx   <= 12'd0;
  160:             pipe_valid     <= 2'b00;
  161:             pipe_bytes_0   <= 3'd0;
  162:             pipe_bytes_1   <= 3'd0;
  163:             shift_reg      <= 96'd0;
  164:             avail_bytes    <= 5'd0;
  165:             stream_active  <= 1'b0;
  166:             rd_frame_cnt   <= 32'd0;
  167:             rd_frame_bytes <= 12'd0;
  168:             flag           <= 1'b0;
  169:             data_out       <= 32'd0;
  170:         end else begin
  171:             // 2-Cycle FIFO Read Pipeline (C_PRELOAD_LATENCY = 2)
  172:             pipe_valid[0] <= fifo_rd_en;
  173:             pipe_valid[1] <= pipe_valid[0];
  174:             pipe_bytes_0  <= fifo_rd_en ? popped_valid_bytes : 3'd0;
  175:             pipe_bytes_1  <= pipe_bytes_0;
  176: 
  177:             if (fifo_rd_en) begin
  178:                 if (pop_word_idx == 12'd779)
  179:                     pop_word_idx <= 12'd0;
  180:                 else
  181:                     pop_word_idx <= pop_word_idx + 12'd1;
  182:             end else if (!stream_active && fifo_empty) begin
  183:                 pop_word_idx <= 12'd0;
  184:             end
  185: 
  186:             // Start streaming once at least 1 complete frame is buffered in FIFO
  187:             if (!stream_active) begin
  188:                 if (wr_frame_cnt_gth > rd_frame_cnt) begin
  189:                     stream_active <= 1'b1;
  190:                 end
  191:                 flag     <= 1'b0;
  192:                 data_out <= 32'd0;
  193:             end else begin
  194:                 if (has_4_bytes || is_final_flush) begin
  195:                     flag     <= 1'b1;
  196:                     data_out <= shift_reg[95:64];
  197:                     if (rd_frame_bytes + {7'd0, bytes_consumed} >= 12'd3117) begin
  198:                         rd_frame_bytes <= (rd_frame_bytes + {7'd0, bytes_consumed}) - 12'd3117;
  199:                         rd_frame_cnt   <= rd_frame_cnt + 32'd1;
  200:                     end else begin
  201:                         rd_frame_bytes <= rd_frame_bytes + {7'd0, bytes_consumed};
  202:                     end
  203:                 end else begin
  204:                     flag     <= 1'b0;
  205:                     data_out <= 32'd0;
  206:                     if (fifo_empty && (!pipe_valid[0]) && (!pipe_valid[1]) && (avail_bytes == 5'd0)) begin
  207:                         stream_active <= 1'b0;
  208:                     end
  209:                 end
  210:             end
  211: 
  212:             // Update Barrel Shifter
  213:             if (pipe_valid[1]) begin
  214:                 shift_reg   <= shifted_reg | incoming_alg;
  215:                 avail_bytes <= next_avail_pre + {2'd0, pipe_bytes_1};
  216:             end else begin
  217:                 shift_reg   <= shifted_reg;
  218:                 avail_bytes <= next_avail_pre;
  219:             end
  220:         end
  221:     end
  222: 
  223:     // =======================================================
  224:     // 4. SUB-CYCLE 0.8 NS BYTE & FRAME TRACKERS (For Waveform)
  225:     // =======================================================
  226:     reg [7:0]  byte_out;
  227:     reg [15:0] out_clk_cnt;
  228:     reg [11:0] frame_byte_cnt;
  229:     reg [31:0] frame_out_id;
  230: 
  231: `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  232:     integer b_sub;
  233:     reg [31:0] cur_w;
  234:     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  235:         if (!rst_n) begin
  236:             byte_out       <= 8'h00;
  237:             out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  238:             frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  239:             frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  240:         end else begin
  241:             #0.001;
  242:             if (flag) begin
  243:                 cur_w = data_out;
  244:                 if (frame_out_id == 32'd0) begin
  245:                     frame_out_id   = 32'd1;
  246:                     out_clk_cnt    = 16'd1;
  247:                     frame_byte_cnt = 12'd0;
  248:                 end else begin
  249:                     out_clk_cnt    = out_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  250:                 end
  251: 
  252:                 for (b_sub = 0; b_sub < 4; b_sub = b_sub + 1) begin
  253:                     if (b_sub > 0) #(0.8);
  254:                     byte_out = cur_w[31 - (b_sub * 8) -: 8];
  255:                     if (frame_byte_cnt == 12'd3117) begin
  256:                         frame_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  257:                         frame_out_id   = frame_out_id + 32'd1;
  258:                         out_clk_cnt    = 16'd1;
  259:                     end else begin
  260:                         frame_byte_cnt = frame_byte_cnt + 12'd1;
  261:                     end
  262:                 end
  263:             end else begin
  264:                 byte_out       <= 8'h00;
  265:                 out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  266:                 frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  267:                 frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  268:             end
  269:         end
  270:     end
  271: `else
  272:     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  273:         if (!rst_n) begin
  274:             byte_out       <= 8'h00;
  275:             out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  276:             frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  277:             frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  278:         end else if (flag) begin
  279:             byte_out       <= data_out[31:24];
  280:             out_clk_cnt    <= out_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  281:             frame_byte_cnt <= (frame_byte_cnt >= 12'd3114) ? 12'd3117 : (frame_byte_cnt + 12'd4);
  282:             if (frame_out_id == 32'd0) frame_out_id <= 32'd1;
  283:         end else begin
  284:             byte_out       <= 8'h00;
  285:             out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  286:             frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  287:             frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  288:         end
  289:     end
  290: `endif

    3: module error_inject_hotswap #(
    4:     parameter MAX_ERROR = 47
    5: )(
    6:     input  wire        clk,
    7:     input  wire        rst_n,
    8:     input  wire        en,
    9:     input  wire [31:0] data_in,
   10:     output wire [31:0] data_out,
   11:     output wire        flag
   12: );
   13: 
   14:     reg [31:0] error_mem [0:MAX_ERROR];
   15:     reg [15:0] err_counter;
   16: 
   17:     initial begin
   18:         $readmemh("error.mem", error_mem);
   19:     end
   20: 
   21:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   22:         if (!rst_n) begin
   23:             err_counter <= 16'd0;
   24:         end else begin
   25:             if (en) begin
   26:                 if (err_counter < MAX_ERROR)
   27:                     err_counter <= err_counter + 1'b1;
   28:             end else begin
   29:                 err_counter <= 16'd0;
   30:             end
   31:         end
   32:     end
   33: 
   34:     wire inject_active = (en && (err_counter <= MAX_ERROR));
   35:     assign data_out = (en) ? (inject_active ? (data_in ^ error_mem[err_counter]) : data_in) : 32'd0;
   36:     assign flag     = inject_active;
   37: 
   38: endmodule

Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Description  : Dynamic AXI4-Stream Ethernet Packet Generator.
    7:                Features:
    8:                - Dynamically adjustable frame size via input port.
    9:                - Generates standard Ethernet Headers (MAC, IPv4, UDP).
   10:                - Appends custom payload and simulated FCS (0xDEADBEEF).
   11: ===========================================================================
   12: */
   13: 
   14: module eth_axis_packet_gen #(
   15:     // --- Header Configuration ---
   16:     parameter [47:0] DEST_MAC = 48'hAA_BB_CC_DD_EE_FF, 
   17:     parameter [47:0] SRC_MAC  = 48'h11_22_33_44_55_66, 
   18:     parameter [31:0] SRC_IP   = {8'd192, 8'd168, 8'd10, 8'd1}, 
   19:     parameter [31:0] DEST_IP  = {8'd192, 8'd168, 8'd10, 8'd2}, 
   20:     
   21:     // --- Custom Marker Payload ---
   22:     parameter [31:0] PAYLOAD_WORD_1 = 32'h4B_6F_6F_6B, // ASCII "Kook"
   23:     parameter [31:0] PAYLOAD_WORD_2 = 32'h6D_69_6E_20, // ASCII "min "
   24:     parameter [31:0] PAYLOAD_WORD_3 = 32'h46_53_4F_20  // ASCII "FSO "
   25: )(
   26:     input  wire        clk,
   27:     input  wire        rst_n,
   28:     input  wire        trigger,           // Trigger 1 cycle HIGH to fire
   29:     input  wire [15:0] frame_size_bytes,  // Target size (e.g., 2000 for Jumbo)
   30:     
   31:     // --- AXI4-Stream Output ---
   32:     output reg [31:0]  m_axis_tdata,
   33:     output reg [3:0]   m_axis_tkeep,
   34:     output reg         m_axis_tvalid,
   35:     output reg         m_axis_tlast,
   36:     input  wire        m_axis_tready
   37: );
   38: 
   39:     localparam S_IDLE = 2'd0, S_DATA = 2'd1, S_DONE = 2'd2;
   40: 
   41:     reg [1:0]  state;
   42:     reg [15:0] word_count; 
   43:     reg [15:0] total_words;
   44: 
   45:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   46:         if (~rst_n) begin
   47:             state         <= S_IDLE;
   48:             m_axis_tdata  <= 32'd0;
   49:             m_axis_tkeep  <= 4'd0;
   50:             m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   51:             m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
   52:             word_count    <= 16'd0;
   53:             total_words   <= 16'd0;
   54:         end else begin
   55:             case (state)
   56:                 S_IDLE: begin
   57:                     m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   58:                     m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
   59:                     word_count    <= 16'd0;
   60:                     if (trigger) begin
   61:                         // Convert bytes to 32-bit words (divide by 4)
   62:                         total_words <= frame_size_bytes >> 2; 
   63:                         state       <= S_DATA;
   64:                     end
   65:                 end
   66: 
   67:                 S_DATA: begin
   68:                     // Backpressure control: only advance if receiver is ready
   69:                     if (m_axis_tready || !m_axis_tvalid) begin
   70:                         m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b1;
   71:                         m_axis_tkeep  <= 4'hF; // All 4 bytes valid
   72: 
   73:                         // Packet Assembly Multiplexer
   74:                         case (word_count)
   75:                             // Ethernet MAC Header
   76:                             16'd0: m_axis_tdata <= DEST_MAC[47:16]; 
   77:                             16'd1: m_axis_tdata <= {DEST_MAC[15:0], SRC_MAC[47:32]};
   78:                             16'd2: m_axis_tdata <= SRC_MAC[31:0];
   79:                             16'd3: m_axis_tdata <= 32'h0800_4500; // EtherType (IPv4) + IP Header
   80:                             
   81:                             // IP & UDP Headers
   82:                             16'd4: m_axis_tdata <= 32'h002E_0000; 
   83:                             16'd5: m_axis_tdata <= 32'h4000_4011; // Protocol UDP
   84:                             16'd6: m_axis_tdata <= {16'h0000, SRC_IP[31:16]}; 
   85:                             16'd7: m_axis_tdata <= {SRC_IP[15:0], DEST_IP[31:16]}; 
   86:                             16'd8: m_axis_tdata <= {DEST_IP[15:0], 16'h1234}; 
   87:                             
   88:                             // Payload Data
   89:                             16'd9:  m_axis_tdata <= PAYLOAD_WORD_1; 
   90:                             16'd10: m_axis_tdata <= PAYLOAD_WORD_2; 
   91:                             16'd11: m_axis_tdata <= PAYLOAD_WORD_3; 
   92:                             
   93:                             // End of Frame & Padding
   94:                             (total_words - 1): m_axis_tdata <= 32'hDEADBEEF; // Simulated FCS
   95:                             default: m_axis_tdata <= {16'hAAAA, word_count}; // Dummy Jumbo Data
   96:                         endcase
   97: 
   98:                         // Frame termination logic
   99:                         if (word_count == (total_words - 1)) begin
  100:                             m_axis_tlast <= 1'b1;
  101:                             state        <= S_DONE;
  102:                         end else begin
  103:                             m_axis_tlast <= 1'b0;
  104:                             word_count   <= word_count + 1'b1;
  105:                         end
  106:                     end
  107:                 end
  108: 
  109:                 S_DONE: begin
  110:                     // Wait for last word to be accepted
  111:                     if (m_axis_tready && m_axis_tvalid) begin
  112:                         m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  113:                         m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  114:                         state         <= S_IDLE;
  115:                     end
  116:                 end
  117:             endcase
  118:         end
  119:     end
  120: endmodule

Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 100ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : eth_mac_packing_tx
    7: Description  : Dynamic Ethernet MAC Transmit Stream Packer.
    8:                Forwards variable-length Ethernet frames (including the 8-Byte
    9:                Preamble, e.g., 502 cycles = 2008 Bytes for a 2000-Byte Jumbo 
   10:                packet, or 18 cycles = 72 Bytes for a 64-Byte Mini packet) 
   11:                from mux_eth_32 to xgmii_tx_formatter while tracking active 
   12:                word and byte counts per packet.
   13:                
   14:                Revision Notes:
   15:                - Removed the hardcoded 483-cycle (1930-Byte) truncation limit 
   16:                  so full 2008-Byte Jumbo frames pass through without loss.
   17: ===========================================================================
   18: */
   19: 
   20: module eth_mac_packing_tx #(
   21:     parameter MAX_SAFE_WORDS = 16'd4096 // Up to 16 KB Super-Jumbo safety ceiling
   22: )(
   23:     input  wire        clk,
   24:     input  wire        rst_n,
   25:     input  wire [31:0] mux_data,
   26:     input  wire        mux_valid,
   27:     output wire [31:0] pack_data,
   28:     output wire        pack_valid,
   29:     output reg  [15:0] tx_word_cnt,
   30:     output reg  [15:0] tx_byte_cnt
   31: );
   32: 
   33:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   34:         if (!rst_n) begin
   35:             tx_word_cnt <= 16'd0;
   36:             tx_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
   37:         end else begin
   38:             if (mux_valid) begin
   39:                 if (tx_word_cnt < MAX_SAFE_WORDS) begin
   40:                     tx_word_cnt <= tx_word_cnt + 16'd1;
   41:                     tx_byte_cnt <= tx_byte_cnt + 16'd4;
   42:                 end
   43:             end else begin
   44:                 tx_word_cnt <= 16'd0;
   45:                 tx_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
   46:             end
   47:         end
   48:     end
   49: 
   50:     assign pack_valid = mux_valid && (tx_word_cnt < MAX_SAFE_WORDS);
   51:     assign pack_data  = pack_valid ? mux_data : 32'd0;
   52: 
   53: endmodule

    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: 
    3: module eth_mac_segmenter(
    4:     input  wire        clk,
    5:     input  wire        rst_n,
    6:     input  wire [31:0] mac_data,
    7:     input  wire        mac_valid,
    8:     output reg  [31:0] payload_data,
    9:     output reg         payload_en
   10: );
   11:     // 1908 Byte = 477 siklus (32-bit)
   12:     localparam MAX_CYCLES = 16'd477;
   13: 
   14:     localparam IDLE = 2'd0;
   15:     localparam SEND = 2'd1;
   16:     localparam PAD  = 2'd2;
   17: 
   18:     reg [1:0]  state;
   19:     reg [15:0] cycle_count;
   20: 
   21:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   22:         if (!rst_n) begin
   23:             state        <= IDLE;
   24:             cycle_count  <= 16'd0;
   25:             payload_data <= 32'd0;
   26:             payload_en   <= 1'b0;
   27:         end else begin
   28:             case (state)
   29:                 IDLE: begin
   30:                     cycle_count <= 16'd0;
   31:                     if (mac_valid) begin
   32:                         state        <= SEND;
   33:                         payload_data <= mac_data;
   34:                         payload_en   <= 1'b1;
   35:                         cycle_count  <= 16'd1;
   36:                     end else begin
   37:                         payload_data <= 32'd0;
   38:                         payload_en   <= 1'b0;
   39:                     end
   40:                 end
   41: 
   42:                 SEND: begin
   43:                     if (cycle_count == MAX_CYCLES) begin
   44:                         if (!mac_valid) begin
   45:                             state        <= IDLE;
   46:                             payload_en   <= 1'b0;
   47:                             cycle_count  <= 16'd0;
   48:                         end else begin
   49:                             payload_data <= mac_data;
   50:                             payload_en   <= 1'b1;
   51:                             cycle_count  <= 16'd1;
   52:                         end
   53:                     end 
   54:                     else if (!mac_valid) begin
   55:                         state        <= PAD;
   56:                         payload_data <= 32'd0;
   57:                         payload_en   <= 1'b1;
   58:                         cycle_count  <= cycle_count + 1'b1;
   59:                     end 
   60:                     else begin
   61:                         payload_data <= mac_data;
   62:                         payload_en   <= 1'b1;
   63:                         cycle_count  <= cycle_count + 1'b1;
   64:                     end
   65:                 end
   66: 
   67:                 PAD: begin
   68:                     // LOGIKA ANTI-STUCK: Gunakan >= dan force reset
   69:                     if (cycle_count >= MAX_CYCLES) begin
   70:                         state        <= IDLE;
   71:                         payload_data <= 32'd0;
   72:                         payload_en   <= 1'b0;
   73:                         cycle_count  <= 16'd0;
   74:                     end else begin
   75:                         payload_data <= 32'd0;
   76:                         payload_en   <= 1'b1;
   77:                         cycle_count  <= cycle_count + 1'b1;
   78:                     end
   79:                 end
   80:             endcase
   81:         end
   82:     end
   83: endmodule

    9:                synchronization pattern (7 Bytes of 0x55 followed by 1 Byte 
   10:                of 0xD5) for prepending to reassembled Ethernet packets.

   19:     // Word 1 [63:32] : 32'h5555_5555 (Transmitted on Preamble Cycle 1)
   20:     // Word 2 [31:0]  : 32'h5555_55D5 (Transmitted on Preamble Cycle 2)

    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : eth_preamble_remover
    7: Description  : 8-Byte Ethernet Preamble & SFD (2 x 32-bit words) Stripper.
    8:                Strips the first two 32-bit words (Preamble + SFD) of each 
    9:                incoming Ethernet frame from xgmii_rx_parser and forwards the 
   10:                clean Layer-2 Ethernet MAC frame (starting at DEST_MAC) to 
   11:                packaging_and_segmentation.
   12: 
   13:                Revision Notes:
   14:                - Preserved original 2-word Preamble/SFD stripping logic.
   15:                - Standardized AXI-Stream port declarations to ensure 100% 
   16:                  synthesis compatibility with eth_rx_front_end_top.v.
   17: ===========================================================================
   18: */
   19: 
   20: module eth_preamble_remover (
   21:     input  wire        clk,
   22:     input  wire        rst_n,
   23: 
   24:     // AXI-Stream Slave Input from xgmii_rx_parser
   25:     input  wire [31:0] s_axis_tdata,
   26:     input  wire        s_axis_tvalid,
   27:     input  wire        s_axis_tlast,
   28:     output wire        s_axis_tready,
   29: 
   30:     // AXI-Stream Master Output to packaging_and_segmentation
   31:     output reg  [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
   32:     output reg         m_axis_tvalid,
   33:     output reg         m_axis_tlast,
   34:     input  wire        m_axis_tready
   35: );
   36: 
   37:     assign s_axis_tready = m_axis_tready;
   38: 
   39:     reg [1:0] preamble_word_cnt;
   40: 
   41:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   42:         if (!rst_n) begin
   43:             preamble_word_cnt <= 2'd0;
   44:             m_axis_tdata      <= 32'd0;
   45:             m_axis_tvalid     <= 1'b0;
   46:             m_axis_tlast      <= 1'b0;
   47:         end else if (m_axis_tready) begin
   48:             if (s_axis_tvalid) begin
   49:                 if (s_axis_tlast) begin
   50:                     preamble_word_cnt <= 2'd0;
   51:                 end else if (preamble_word_cnt < 2'd2) begin
   52:                     preamble_word_cnt <= preamble_word_cnt + 2'd1;
   53:                 end
   54: 
   55:                 // Strip Word 0 (Preamble) and Word 1 (Preamble + SFD)
   56:                 if (preamble_word_cnt >= 2'd2) begin
   57:                     m_axis_tdata  <= s_axis_tdata;
   58:                     m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b1;
   59:                     m_axis_tlast  <= s_axis_tlast;
   60:                 end else begin
   61:                     m_axis_tdata  <= 32'd0;
   62:                     m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   63:                     m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
   64:                 end
   65:             end else begin
   66:                 preamble_word_cnt <= 2'd0;
   67:                 m_axis_tdata      <= 32'd0;
   68:                 m_axis_tvalid     <= 1'b0;
   69:                 m_axis_tlast      <= 1'b0;
   70:             end
   71:         end
   72:     end
   73: 
   74: endmodule

    9:                Parser, Ethernet Preamble & SFD Remover, and Fixed 1900-Byte 
   10:                FSO Payload Packaging & Segmentation unit.

   14:                2. Wrapped eth_10g_pcs_pma_rx_0 inside a generate block 
   15:                   controlled by RUN_MODE (1 = Simulation / XGMII Direct Input, 
   16:                   0 = Hardware SFP+ Mode).
   17:                3. Matched exact port connections on u_rx_parser 
   18:                   (xgmii_rx_parser) and physical_mac_rx_inst 
   19:                   (eth_10g_pcs_pma_rx_0 with DRP loopback and 
   20:                   configuration_vector) so both SIM_MODE=1 and SIM_MODE=0 
   21:                   synthesize cleanly without [Synth 8-11365].
   22:                4. [Rev 2.2 - 2026-10-28 14:55 KST]: Exported 'seg_valid_bytes'
   23:                   [10:0] output port to propagate exact ingress packet/segment 
   24:                   byte length metadata to sda_encoder -> ethernet_fso_framer -> 
   25:                   fso_payload_top -> fso_payload.
   26: ===========================================================================

   29: module eth_rx_front_end_top #(
   30:     parameter RUN_MODE = 1 // 1 = Simulation / XGMII Direct Mode, 0 = Hardware SFP+ Mode
   31: )(

   43:     input  wire        fso_ready,

   45: 
   46:     // Physical SFP+ & Clocking Ports for 10G PCS/PMA RX IP Core
   47:     input  wire        refclk_p,

   60:             wire [31:0] phy_xgmii_rxd;

   73:                 .rxrecclk_out           (),
   74:                 .refclk_p               (refclk_p),

   87:                 .reset_counter_done_out (),
   88:                 .reset                  (reset),
   89:                 .xgmii_txd              (32'h0707_0707),
   90:                 .xgmii_txc              (4'b1111),
   91:                 .xgmii_rxd              (phy_xgmii_rxd),
   92:                 .xgmii_rxc              (phy_xgmii_rxc),
   93:                 .txp                    (txp_unused),
   94:                 .txn                    (txn_unused),
   95:                 .rxp                    (rxp),
   96:                 .rxn                    (rxn),
   97:                 .configuration_vector   (536'd0),
   98:                 .status_vector          (),

  109:                 .drp_drdy_o             (drp_drdy_w),
  110:                 .drp_drpdo_o            (drp_drpdo_w),

    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : eth_tx_back_end_top
    7: Description  : 10G Ethernet Transmit Back-End Top Module (Egress to PC 2).
    8:                Integrates the MAC Transmit Stream Packer, the 32-bit XGMII 
    9:                Formatter, and the Xilinx 10G Ethernet PCS/PMA IP Core 
   10:                (eth_10g_pcs_pma_tx_0.xci).
   11:                
   12:                Revision Notes:
   13:                1. Aligned hierarchy with handwritten system architecture:
   14:                   eth_preamble_gen and mux_eth_32 are now housed inside 
   15:                   ethernet_frame_reassembly.v, while eth_tx_back_end_top.v 
   16:                   houses eth_mac_packing_tx, xgmii_tx_formatter, and 
   17:                   eth_10g_pcs_pma_tx_0.
   18:                2. Added RUN_MODE parameter (1 = Simulation Mode, 0 = Hardware 
   19:                   SFP+ Mode) using a generate block to mirror eth_rx_front_end_top.v.
   20:                3. Encapsulated ILA 3 (RX & PC 2 Egress Stage) telemetry 
   21:                   registers (dbg_pc2_xgmii_txd, dbg_pc2_xgmii_txc, 
   22:                   dbg_rx_eth_byte_cnt, dbg_rx_eth_pkt_cnt) inside this module 
   23:                   so SDAOISL10Gto10G_top schematic remains 100% clean.
   24:                4. Connected exact eth_10g_pcs_pma_tx_0 port list including 
   25:                   configuration_vector(536'd0), pma_pmd_type(3'b101), and 
   26:                   internal DRP loopback (drp_req -> drp_gnt, drp_*_o -> drp_*_i) 
   27:                   so the 10G PCS/PMA core completes hardware reset properly.
   28:                5. [Rev 2026-10-22 07:09 KST]: Updated timescale precision to 
   29:                   1ns/1ps for project-wide simulation consistency.
   30: ===========================================================================
   31: */
   32: 
   33: module eth_tx_back_end_top #(
   34:     parameter RUN_MODE = 1 // 1 = Simulation Mode, 0 = Hardware SFP+ Mode
   35: )(
   36:     input  wire        clk,       // 312.5 MHz Clock
   37:     input  wire        rst_n,     // Active-low reset
   38:     
   39:     // Input 1922 Byte / 2008 Byte Reassembled Ethernet Frame from ethernet_frame_reassembly
   40:     input  wire [31:0] data_in,
   41:     input  wire        en,
   42:     
   43:     // Output menuju Simulasi Testbench (XGMII Probing Output)
   44:     output wire [31:0] xgmii_txd,
   45:     output wire [3:0]  xgmii_txc,
   46: 
   47:     // Port SFP+ & Clocking Fisik untuk IP Core
   48:     input  wire        refclk_p,
   49:     input  wire        refclk_n,
   50:     input  wire        reset,
   51:     input  wire        dclk,
   52:     output wire        txp,
   53:     output wire        txn
   54: );
   55: 
   56:     wire [31:0] pack_data;
   57:     wire        pack_valid;
   58:     wire [15:0] tx_word_cnt;
   59:     wire [15:0] tx_byte_cnt;
   60: 
   61:     wire [31:0] xgmii_txd_wire;
   62:     wire [3:0]  xgmii_txc_wire;
   63: 
   64:     // 1. Dynamic MAC Stream Packer (Packing and Segmentation)
   65:     eth_mac_packing_tx u_packing (
   66:         .clk         (clk),
   67:         .rst_n       (rst_n),
   68:         .mux_data    (data_in),
   69:         .mux_valid   (en),
   70:         .pack_data   (pack_data),
   71:         .pack_valid  (pack_valid),
   72:         .tx_word_cnt (tx_word_cnt),
   73:         .tx_byte_cnt (tx_byte_cnt)
   74:     );
   75: 
   76:     // 2. IEEE 802.3ae 32-bit XGMII Transmit Formatter
   77:     xgmii_tx_formatter u_formatter (
   78:         .clk       (clk),
   79:         .rst_n     (rst_n),
   80:         .mac_data  (pack_data),
   81:         .mac_valid (pack_valid),
   82:         .xgmii_txd (xgmii_txd_wire),
   83:         .xgmii_txc (xgmii_txc_wire)
   84:     );
   85: 
   86:     // CABANG 1: Teruskan ke pin output untuk Testbench Simulasi
   87:     assign xgmii_txd = xgmii_txd_wire;
   88:     assign xgmii_txc = xgmii_txc_wire;
   89:

    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : ethernet_frame_reassembly
    7: Description  : SDA OISL Section 2.6.3.7.7 Ethernet Frame Reassembly, 
    8:                Zero-Padding Stripper, and Preamble Injection Top Module.
    9: 
   10:                KEY OPERATIONS:
   11:                1. Receives in-order 1908-Byte (477-word) verified FSO DATA 
   12:                   frames from fso_ethernet_deframer.v at 312.5 MHz.
   13:                2. Validates and strips the 4-Byte FSO Payload Header (0xAB) 
   14:                   and 4-Byte FSO Packet Header (0xCDEF) per Table 2-18.
   15:                3. Reconstructs segmented Ethernet packets across multiple FSO 
   16:                   frames (e.g., 1900 Bytes from Frame 1 + 100 Bytes from 
   17:                   Frame 2 = 2000 Bytes) while stripping all trailing FSO 
   18:                   zero-padding (e.g., 1800 or 1804 Bytes).
   19:                4. Commits the reassembled packet to the egress drain FSM only 
   20:                   when all bytes of the Ethernet packet have arrived, ensuring 
   21:                   a 100% contiguous burst with ZERO intra-packet gaps.
   22:                5. Instantiates eth_preamble_gen.v and mux_eth_32.v to prepend 
   23:                   the 8-Byte Ethernet Preamble + SFD (64'h55555555_555555D5), 
   24:                   outputting 2008 Bytes (502 words) to eth_tx_back_end_top.v.
   25: 
   26: Revision History:
   27:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Multi-frame Ethernet de-segmenter & Preamble MUX wrapper.
   28:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:34 KST) : [Target B6.3 - SDA OISL Page 43-46, Sec. 2.6.3.7.4 - 2.6.3.7.7,
   29:     Figure 2-17 & Table 2-18; ETRI Review Item 4.2(2) & Item 5.1]
   30:     Added support for strict Table 2-18 Continuation Frames and Multi-Packet Packing.
   31:   - Rev 2.1 (2026-10-28 13:56 KST) : [Internal Audit Fix #4 - Strict State-Based Header Detection]
   32:     Removed '(fso_word_idx == 9'd1) ||' from 'is_pkt_hdr_word' so that an FSO Packet 
   33:     Header (0xCDEF) is recognized ONLY when no prior packet is mid-continuation 
   34:     (rem_pkt_bytes == 16'd0). This guarantees that payload data words beginning with 
   35:     16'hCDEF inside a continuation segment or active packet body are treated strictly 
   36:     as Ethernet data and never misinterpreted as a packet header.
   37: ===========================================================================
   38: */
   39: 
   40: module ethernet_frame_reassembly #(
   41:     parameter [15:0] DEFAULT_PKT_BYTES = 16'd2000 // Fallback when Packet Header length field is 0 in legacy TBs
   42: )(
   43:     input  wire        clk,
   44:     input  wire        rst_n,
   45: 
   46:     // In-Order 1908-Byte (477-Word) Verified FSO DATA Stream from Deframer
   47:     input  wire [31:0] s_axis_fso_tdata,
   48:     input  wire        s_axis_fso_tvalid,
   49:     input  wire        s_axis_fso_tlast,
   50:     output wire        s_axis_fso_tready,
   51: 
   52:     // Reassembled Ethernet Frame Output (Includes 8B Preamble = 2008B for 2000B Jumbo)
   53:     output wire [31:0] m_axis_eth_tdata,
   54:     output wire        m_axis_eth_tvalid,
   55:     output wire        m_axis_eth_tlast,
   56:     input  wire        m_axis_eth_tready,
   57: 
   58:     // Diagnostic Telemetry Outputs
   59:     output reg  [15:0] reassembled_pkt_bytes,
   60:     output reg  [15:0] reassembled_pkt_cnt
   61: );
   62: 
   63:     // =======================================================
   64:     // 1. PACKET COMMIT BUFFER (1024 x 33-bit: {pkt_eof, data[31:0]})
   65:     // =======================================================
   66:     (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [32:0] pkt_buf [0:1023];
   67:     reg [9:0]  wr_ptr;
   68:     reg [9:0]  committed_wr_ptr;
   69:     reg [9:0]  rd_ptr;
   70: 
   71:     wire [9:0] buf_used      = wr_ptr - rd_ptr;
   72:     assign s_axis_fso_tready = (buf_used < 10'd960);
   73: 
   74:     // =======================================================
   75:     // 2. SDA OISL TABLE 2-18 HEADER PARSER & DE-SEGMENTER
   76:     // =======================================================
   77:     reg [8:0]  fso_word_idx;
   78:     reg        fso_frame_valid_magic;
   79:     reg [15:0] rem_pkt_bytes;
   80:     reg [15:0] cur_pkt_total_bytes;
   81:     reg [9:0]  expected_fso_seq;
   82:     reg        seq_initialized;
   83: 
   84:     wire       fire_in            = s_axis_fso_tvalid && s_axis_fso_tready;
   85:     wire       is_pld_hdr_word    = (fso_word_idx == 9'd0);
   86:     wire       pld_magic_ok       = (s_axis_fso_tdata[31:24] == 8'hAB);
   87:     wire [9:0] rx_fso_seq_num     = s_axis_fso_tdata[23:14];
   88:     wire [13:0] rx_pld_hdr_len    = s_axis_fso_tdata[13:0];
   89: 
   90:     wire       word_has_pkt_magic = (s_axis_fso_tdata[31:16] == 16'hCDEF);
   91:     wire [15:0] parsed_pkt_len    = (s_axis_fso_tdata[13:0] != 14'd0) ?
   92:                                     {2'b00, s_axis_fso_tdata[13:0]} : DEFAULT_PKT_BYTES;
   93: 
   94:     // [Rev 2.1] Strict state-based Packet Header detection:
   95:     // A word is an FSO Packet Header (0xCDEF) ONLY when no packet is mid-reassembly
   96:     // (rem_pkt_bytes == 16'd0). During a continuation segment (rem_pkt_bytes > 0),
   97:     // all words after Word 0 are strictly treated as Ethernet payload data!
   98:     wire is_pkt_hdr_word = (!is_pld_hdr_word) && fso_frame_valid_magic &&
   99:                            (rem_pkt_bytes == 16'd0) && word_has_pkt_magic;
  100: 
  101:     // A word is valid Ethernet payload data if it's not a header and rem_pkt_bytes > 0
  102:     wire is_eth_data_word   = (!is_pld_hdr_word) && (!is_pkt_hdr_word) &&
  103:                               fso_frame_valid_magic && (rem_pkt_bytes > 16'd0);
  104:     wire word_completes_pkt = is_eth_data_word && (rem_pkt_bytes <= 16'd4);
  105: 
  106:     // Purely Synchronous Packet Buffer Write
  107:     always @(posedge clk) begin
  108:         if (fire_in && is_eth_data_word) begin
  109:             pkt_buf[wr_ptr] <= {word_completes_pkt, s_axis_fso_tdata};
  110:         end
  111:     end
  112: 
  113:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  114:         if (!rst_n) begin
  115:             fso_word_idx          <= 9'd0;
  116:             fso_frame_valid_magic <= 1'b0;
  117:             rem_pkt_bytes         <= 16'd0;
  118:             cur_pkt_total_bytes   <= 16'd0;
  119:             expected_fso_seq      <= 10'd0;
  120:             seq_initialized       <= 1'b0;
  121:             wr_ptr                <= 10'd0;
  122:             committed_wr_ptr      <= 10'd0;
  123:             reassembled_pkt_bytes <= 16'd0;
  124:             reassembled_pkt_cnt   <= 16'd0;
  125:         end else if (fire_in) begin
  126:             // Advance FSO frame word index (0..476 = 477 words)
  127:             if (s_axis_fso_tlast || (fso_word_idx == 9'd476)) begin
  128:                 fso_word_idx <= 9'd0;
  129:             end else begin
  130:                 fso_word_idx <= fso_word_idx + 9'd1;
  131:             end
  132: 
  133:             // 1. Word 0: Validate FSO Payload Header (0xAB) per Sec. 2.6.3.7.7
  134:             if (is_pld_hdr_word) begin
  135:                 if (pld_magic_ok) begin
  136:                     fso_frame_valid_magic <= 1'b1;
  137:                     expected_fso_seq      <= rx_fso_seq_num + 10'd1;
  138:                     seq_initialized       <= 1'b1;
  139: 
  140:                     // Sec. 2.6.3.7.7 Sequence Skip Handling:
  141:                     // If sequence number skipped while a partial packet was incomplete,
  142:                     // discard the partial packet rolled back to committed_wr_ptr.
  143:                     if (seq_initialized && (rx_fso_seq_num != expected_fso_seq) && (rem_pkt_bytes > 16'd0)) begin
  144:                         wr_ptr        <= committed_wr_ptr;
  145:                         rem_pkt_bytes <= 16'd0;
  146:                     end else if ((rem_pkt_bytes > 16'd0) && (rx_pld_hdr_len != 14'd0)) begin
  147:                         // Update remaining continuation length from Table 2-18 Payload Header
  148:                         rem_pkt_bytes <= {2'b00, rx_pld_hdr_len};
  149:                     end
  150:                 end else begin
  151:                     // Invalid 0xAB magic number: discard entire FSO frame per Sec. 2.6.3.7.7
  152:                     fso_frame_valid_magic <= 1'b0;
  153:                 end
  154:             end
  155: 
  156:             // 2. FSO Packet Header (0xCDEF): Start of New Packet (only when rem_pkt_bytes == 0)
  157:             else if (is_pkt_hdr_word) begin
  158:                 rem_pkt_bytes       <= parsed_pkt_len;
  159:                 cur_pkt_total_bytes <= parsed_pkt_len;
  160:             end
  161: 
  162:             // 3. Active Ethernet Payload Words (Strips trailing zero-padding automatically)
  163:             else if (is_eth_data_word) begin
  164:                 wr_ptr <= wr_ptr + 10'd1;
  165:                 if (word_completes_pkt) begin
  166:                     rem_pkt_bytes         <= 16'd0;
  167:                     committed_wr_ptr      <= wr_ptr + 10'd1;
  168:                     reassembled_pkt_bytes <= cur_pkt_total_bytes;
  169:                     reassembled_pkt_cnt   <= reassembled_pkt_cnt + 16'd1;
  170:                 end else begin
  171:                     rem_pkt_bytes <= rem_pkt_bytes - 16'd4;
  172:                 end
  173:             end
  174:         end
  175:     end
  176: 
  177:     // =======================================================
  178:     // 3. CONTIGUOUS EGRESS DRAIN FSM (Zero Intra-Packet Gap)
  179:     // =======================================================
  180:     localparam ST_IDLE  = 2'd0;
  181:     localparam ST_DRAIN = 2'd1;
  182:     localparam ST_GAP   = 2'd2;
  183: 
  184:     reg [1:0]  drain_state;
  185:     reg [2:0]  inter_pkt_gap;
  186:     reg [31:0] asm_tdata;
  187:     reg        asm_tvalid;
  188:     reg        asm_tlast;
  189: 
  190:     wire        pkt_ready_to_drain = (rd_ptr != committed_wr_ptr);
  191:     wire [32:0] head_pkt_word      = pkt_buf[rd_ptr];
  192: 
  193:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  194:         if (!rst_n) begin
  195:             drain_state   <= ST_IDLE;
  196:             rd_ptr        <= 10'd0;
  197:             inter_pkt_gap <= 3'd0;
  198:             asm_tdata     <= 32'd0;
  199:             asm_tvalid    <= 1'b0;
  200:             asm_tlast     <= 1'b0;
  201:         end else begin
  202:             case (drain_state)
  203:                 ST_IDLE: begin
  204:                     asm_tdata  <= 32'd0;
  205:                     asm_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  206:                     asm_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  207:                     if (pkt_ready_to_drain && m_axis_eth_tready) begin
  208:                         drain_state <= ST_DRAIN;
  209:                     end
  210:                 end
  211: 
  212:                 ST_DRAIN: begin
  213:                     if (m_axis_eth_tready) begin
  214:                         asm_tdata  <= head_pkt_word[31:0];
  215:                         asm_tvalid <= 1'b1;
  216:                         asm_tlast  <= head_pkt_word[32];
  217:                         rd_ptr     <= rd_ptr + 10'd1;
  218: 
  219:                         if (head_pkt_word[32]) begin
  220:                             inter_pkt_gap <= 3'd0;
  221:                             drain_state   <= ST_GAP;
  222:                         end
  223:                     end
  224:                 end
  225: 
  226:                 ST_GAP: begin
  227:                     asm_tdata  <= 32'd0;
  228:                     asm_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  229:                     asm_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  230:                     // Allow 6 cycles for mux_eth_32 (2-cycle Preamble) + XGMII IPG
  231:                     if (inter_pkt_gap < 3'd5) begin
  232:                         inter_pkt_gap <= inter_pkt_gap + 3'd1;
  233:                     end else begin
  234:                         inter_pkt_gap <= 3'd0;
  235:                         drain_state   <= ST_IDLE;
  236:                     end
  237:                 end
  238: 
  239:                 default: drain_state <= ST_IDLE;
  240:             endcase
  241:         end
  242:     end
  243: 
  244:     // =======================================================
  245:     // 4. ETHERNET PREAMBLE GENERATOR & 2-CYCLE INJECTION MUX
  246:     // =======================================================
  247:     wire [63:0] eth_preamble_sfd;
  248: 
  249:     eth_preamble_gen u_eth_preamble_gen (
  250:         .preamble_sfd (eth_preamble_sfd)
  251:     );
  252: 
  253:     mux_eth_32 u_mux_eth_32 (
  254:         .clk           (clk),
  255:         .rst_n         (rst_n),
  256:         .asm_data_in   (asm_tdata),
  257:         .asm_valid_in  (asm_tvalid),
  258:         .asm_last_in   (asm_tlast),
  259:         .preamble_sfd  (eth_preamble_sfd),
  260:         .eth_data_out  (m_axis_eth_tdata),
  261:         .eth_valid_out (m_axis_eth_tvalid),
  262:         .eth_last_out  (m_axis_eth_tlast)
  263:     );
  264: 
  265: endmodule

    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Description  : Ethernet to FSO Framer Grand Top Module.
    7:                Implements the core "SDA Encoder" framing block from the architecture.
    8:                
    9:                Subsystem Integrations:
   10:                1. Data Checker: Validates incoming Ethernet frames.
   11:                2. arq_tx_controller.v: The Brain - SDA OCT State Machine.
   12:                3. fso_header_top.v: 16-Byte Header Generator & FSO CRC-16.
   13:                4. fso_payload_top.v: 1912-Byte Payload Assembler, IDLE/MGMT generators,
   14:                   ARQ Retransmit RAM controller, and Final Multiplexer.
   15:                
   16:                Revision Note: 
   17:                - Fixed Clock Domain Crossing (CDC) Interface. Header AXI-Stream 
   18:                  output is now strictly 8-bit to match x_gth_logic.v requirements.
   19:                  Port mappings have been rigidly aligned to prevent synthesis failures.
   20:                - ETRI Timing Management Compliance: Connected 'tx_ts_in' and 
   21:                  'ts_applies_in' to the Timestamp Manager with deterministic 
   22:                  pipeline latency pre-compensation (TX_PIPE_LATENCY_PS = 2,313,200 ps)
   23:                  so the Header TX_TS reflects the exact physical optical egress time.
   24:                - [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 04:26 KST - Target B5.3 Audit Fix]:
   25:                  1. Fixed 'active_ts_applies' encoding per SDA OISL Table 2-9 & 
   26:                     Section 2.6.3.3.4 (Page 24 & 26): value 3'b000 indicates that 
   27:                     TX_TS applies to the CURRENT frame (when ts_valid == 1'b1).
   28:                  2. Added pending ACK/NAK holding registers (pending_ack_valid, 
   29:                     pending_ack, pending_rxfn) so that any 1-cycle 'rx_ack_valid_in' 
   30:                     pulse arriving while a frame is mid-transmission (frame_busy == 1) 
   31:                     is captured and held until the next 'tx_trigger_gen' fires.
   32:                - [Rev 2.2 - 2026-10-28 14:55 KST]: Connected 'seg_valid_bytes' [10:0]
   33:                  from XGMII Front-End Segmenter to u_fso_payload_top.
   34: ===========================================================================
   35: */
   36: 
   37: module ethernet_fso_framer #(
   38:     // Deterministic delay from Header latch to first Preamble bit exiting GTH TX (in picoseconds)
   39:     parameter [39:0] TX_PIPE_LATENCY_PS = 40'd2_313_200
   40: )(
   41:     input  wire        clk,
   42:     input  wire        rst_n,
   43: 
   44:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   45:     // 1. INPUT: Ethernet Data & Length Metadata from XGMII Front-End Segmenter
   46:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   47:     input  wire [31:0] s_axis_eth_tdata,
   48:     input  wire        s_axis_eth_tvalid,
   49:     input  wire        s_axis_eth_tlast,
   50:     output wire        s_axis_eth_tready,
   51:     input  wire [10:0] seg_valid_bytes,
   52: 
   53:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   54:     // 2. INPUT: Telemetry, PNT, and FCCH (From Satellite Subsystems)
   55:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   56:     input  wire        mgmt_trigger_1hz,
   57:     input  wire [5:0]  rx_phy_ts_sec,
   58:     input  wire [39:0] rx_phy_ts_picosec,
   59:     input  wire [5:0]  tx_phy_ts_sec,
   60:     input  wire [39:0] tx_phy_ts_picosec,
   61:     input  wire [63:0] range_meters,
   62:     input  wire [31:0] range_ts_sec,
   63:     input  wire [39:0] range_ts_picosec,
   64:     input  wire        ts_valid,
   65:     input  wire [5:0]  tod_seconds_in, // Time of Day for Header Generation
   66:     input  wire [3:0]  fcch_opcode,    // Fast Control Channel Opcode
   67:     input  wire [15:0] fcch_pl,        // Fast Control Channel Payload
   68: 
   69:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   70:     // 3. INPUT: ARQ Feedback (From RX Decoder Path)
   71:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   72:     input  wire [15:0] rx_rxfn_in,      // Received Frame Number from space
   73:     input  wire        rx_ack_in,       // ACK/NAK status from space
   74:     input  wire        rx_ack_valid_in, // Asserts if the ACK field is valid
   75: 
   76:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   77:     // 4. OUTPUT: To CDC 1 (Clock Domain Crossing - x_gth_logic.v)
   78:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   79:     // Header Output Stream (16 Bytes Total - Sent 1 Byte per cycle)
   80:     output wire [7:0]  m_axis_hdr_tdata,
   81:     output wire        m_axis_hdr_tvalid,
   82:     output wire        m_axis_hdr_tlast,
   83:     input  wire        m_axis_hdr_tready,
   84: 
   85:     // Payload Output Stream (1912 Bytes Total - Sent 4 Bytes per cycle)
   86:     output wire [31:0] m_axis_fso_tdata,
   87:     output wire        m_axis_fso_tvalid,
   88:     output wire        m_axis_fso_tlast,
   89:     input  wire        m_axis_fso_tready,
   90:     
   91:     // Status Output
   92:     output wire        eth_data_error_flag
   93: );
   94: 
   95:     // =======================================================
   96:     // INTERNAL INTERCONNECT WIRES
   97:     // =======================================================
   98:     wire [15:0] tx_txfn_out;
   99:     wire [1:0]  payload_mux_sel;
  100:     wire [1:0]  frame_type_out;
  101:     wire        tx_trigger_gen;
  102:     wire        tx_stall_mac;
  103:     
  104:     wire        ddr4_write_req;
  105:     wire        ddr4_read_req;
  106:     wire        ddr4_delete_req;
  107:     wire [15:0] ddr4_addr;
  108: 
  109:     wire [31:0] chk_eth_tdata  = s_axis_eth_tdata;
  110:     wire        chk_eth_tvalid = s_axis_eth_tvalid;
  111:     wire        chk_eth_tlast  = s_axis_eth_tlast;
  112:     wire        payload_eth_tready;
  113: 
  114:     assign s_axis_eth_tready   = payload_eth_tready && !tx_stall_mac;
  115:     assign eth_data_error_flag = 1'b0;
  116:     assign m_axis_hdr_tlast    = 1'b0;
  117: 
  118:     wire hdr_sys_busy;
  119:     reg  payload_streaming;
  120:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  121:         if (!rst_n) payload_streaming <= 1'b0;
  122:         else if (tx_trigger_gen) payload_streaming <= 1'b1;
  123:         else if (m_axis_fso_tvalid && m_axis_fso_tready && m_axis_fso_tlast) payload_streaming <= 1'b0;
  124:     end
  125: 
  126:     wire frame_busy = hdr_sys_busy || payload_streaming;
  127: 
  128:     // =======================================================
  129:     // [Rev 2.0] PENDING ACK/NAK HOLDING LATCH FOR HEADER INSERTION
  130:     // =======================================================
  131:     reg [15:0] pending_rxfn;
  132:     reg        pending_ack;
  133:     reg        pending_ack_valid;
  134: 
  135:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  136:         if (!rst_n) begin
  137:             pending_rxfn      <= 16'd0;
  138:             pending_ack       <= 1'b0;
  139:             pending_ack_valid <= 1'b0;
  140:         end else begin
  141:             if (rx_ack_valid_in) begin
  142:                 pending_rxfn      <= rx_rxfn_in;
  143:                 pending_ack       <= rx_ack_in;
  144:                 pending_ack_valid <= 1'b1;
  145:             end else if (tx_trigger_gen) begin
  146:                 pending_ack_valid <= 1'b0;
  147:             end
  148:         end
  149:     end
  150: 
  151:     wire [15:0] hdr_rxfn_mux      = rx_ack_valid_in ? rx_rxfn_in : pending_rxfn;
  152:     wire        hdr_ack_mux       = rx_ack_valid_in ? rx_ack_in  : pending_ack;
  153:     wire        hdr_ack_valid_mux = rx_ack_valid_in | pending_ack_valid;
  154: 
  155:     // =======================================================
  156:     // ETRI TIMING MANAGER: ACTUAL EGRESS TIMESTAMP PREDICTION
  157:     // =======================================================
  158:     wire [39:0] predicted_egress_tx_ts = tx_phy_ts_picosec + TX_PIPE_LATENCY_PS;
  159:     wire [2:0]  active_ts_applies      = ts_valid ? 3'b000 : 3'b001;
  160: 
  161:     // =======================================================
  162:     // B. ARQ TX CONTROLLER (The Orchestrator Brain)
  163:     // =======================================================
  164:     arq_tx_controller u_arq_tx_controller (
  165:         .clk               (clk),
  166:         .rst_n             (rst_n),
  167:         .fso_data_valid    (chk_eth_tvalid),
  168:         .mgmt_tick_1hz     (mgmt_trigger_1hz),
  169:         .header_gen_busy   (frame_busy),
  170:         
  171:         .rx_rxfn_in        (rx_rxfn_in),
  172:         .rx_ack_in         (rx_ack_in),
  173:         .rx_ack_valid_in   (rx_ack_valid_in),
  174:         
  175:         .tx_txfn_out       (tx_txfn_out),
  176:         .tx_frame_type     (frame_type_out),
  177:         .tx_trigger_gen    (tx_trigger_gen),
  178:         .payload_mux_sel   (payload_mux_sel),
  179:         .tx_stall_mac      (tx_stall_mac),
  180:         
  181:         .ddr4_write_req    (ddr4_write_req),
  182:         .ddr4_read_req     (ddr4_read_req),
  183:         .ddr4_delete_req   (ddr4_delete_req),
  184:         .ddr4_addr         (ddr4_addr)
  185:     );
  186: 
  187:     // =======================================================
  188:     // C. HEADER TOP SUBSYSTEM (16-Byte Formatter)
  189:     // =======================================================
  190:     fso_header_top u_fso_header_top (
  191:         .clk                 (clk),
  192:         .rst_n               (rst_n),
  193:         .trigger_header_gen  (tx_trigger_gen),
  194:         
  195:         // Sequence & Status Inputs (From ARQ & Frame Scheduler)
  196:         .txfn_in             (tx_txfn_out),
  197:         .rxfn_in             (hdr_rxfn_mux),            
  198:         .ack_in              (hdr_ack_mux),             
  199:         .ack_valid_in        (hdr_ack_valid_mux),       
  200:         .frame_type_in       (frame_type_out),
  201:         
  202:         // PNT, Timestamp Manager & Control/Status Manager (FCCH)
  203:         .tx_ts_in            (predicted_egress_tx_ts),
  204:         .tod_seconds_in      (tod_seconds_in),
  205:         .ts_applies_in       (active_ts_applies),
  206:         .fcch_opcode_in      (fcch_opcode),
  207:         .fcch_pl_in          (fcch_pl),
  208:         
  209:         // Standardized 8-bit Output Stream
  210:         .final_header_byte   (m_axis_hdr_tdata),
  211:         .final_header_valid  (m_axis_hdr_tvalid),
  212:         .system_busy         (hdr_sys_busy)
  213:     );
  214: 
  215:     // =======================================================
  216:     // D. PAYLOAD TOP SUBSYSTEM (1912-Byte Formatter)
  217:     // =======================================================
  218:     fso_payload_top u_fso_payload_top (
  219:         .clk               (clk),
  220:         .rst_n             (rst_n),
  221:         
  222:         .s_axis_eth_tdata  (chk_eth_tdata),
  223:         .s_axis_eth_tvalid (chk_eth_tvalid && !tx_stall_mac),
  224:         .s_axis_eth_tlast  (chk_eth_tlast),
  225:         .s_axis_eth_tready (payload_eth_tready),
  226:         .seg_valid_bytes   (seg_valid_bytes),
  227:         
  228:         .payload_mux_sel   (payload_mux_sel),
  229:         .txfn_in           (tx_txfn_out),
  230:         .ddr4_write_req    (ddr4_write_req),
  231:         .ddr4_read_req     (ddr4_read_req),
  232:         .ddr4_delete_req   (ddr4_delete_req),
  233:         .ddr4_addr         (ddr4_addr),
  234:         
  235:         .mgmt_trigger_1hz  (mgmt_trigger_1hz),
  236:         .rx_phy_ts_sec     (rx_phy_ts_sec),
  237:         .rx_phy_ts_picosec (rx_phy_ts_picosec),
  238:         .tx_phy_ts_sec     (tx_phy_ts_sec),
  239:         .tx_phy_ts_picosec (tx_phy_ts_picosec),
  240:         .range_meters      (range_meters),
  241:         .range_ts_sec      (range_ts_sec),
  242:         .range_ts_picosec  (range_ts_picosec),
  243:         .ts_valid          (ts_valid),
  244:         
  245:         .m_axis_fso_tdata  (m_axis_fso_tdata),
  246:         .m_axis_fso_tvalid (m_axis_fso_tvalid),
  247:         .m_axis_fso_tlast  (m_axis_fso_tlast),
  248:         .m_axis_fso_tready (m_axis_fso_tready)
  249:     );
  250: 
  251: endmodule

    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : frame_demultiplexer
    7: Description  : Data Plane Frame Router (1908-Byte / 477-Word Payload).
    8:                Routes verified payloads based on rx_frame_type[1:0]:
    9:                - 2'b00 (IDLE): Routed to idle_discard.v
   10:                - 2'b10 (MGMT): Routed to mgmt_extraction.v
   11:                - 2'b01 (DATA): Routed to arq_rx_reorder_ddr4_wrapper.v
   12: ===========================================================================
   13: */
   14: 
   15: module frame_demultiplexer (
   16:     input  wire        clk,
   17:     input  wire        rst_n,
   18: 
   19:     // Verified 1908-Byte Payload from deframer_payload
   20:     input  wire [31:0] s_axis_pld_tdata,
   21:     input  wire        s_axis_pld_tvalid,
   22:     input  wire        s_axis_pld_tlast,
   23: 
   24:     // Header Context & Control Inputs
   25:     input  wire [1:0]  rx_frame_type,
   26:     input  wire [15:0] rx_txfn,
   27:     input  wire        non_data_seq_adv,
   28:     input  wire [15:0] non_data_txfn,
   29: 
   30:     // In-Order 1908-Byte DATA Output to ethernet_frame_reassembly
   31:     output wire [31:0] m_axis_data_tdata,
   32:     output wire        m_axis_data_tvalid,
   33:     output wire        m_axis_data_tlast,
   34:     input  wire        m_axis_data_tready,
   35: 
   36:     // Extracted MGMT Telemetry Outputs
   37:     output wire [5:0]  mgmt_rx_phy_ts_sec,
   38:     output wire [39:0] mgmt_rx_phy_ts_picosec,
   39:     output wire [5:0]  mgmt_tx_phy_ts_sec,
   40:     output wire [39:0] mgmt_tx_phy_ts_picosec,
   41:     output wire [63:0] mgmt_range_meters,
   42:     output wire [31:0] mgmt_range_ts_sec,
   43:     output wire [39:0] mgmt_range_ts_picosec,
   44:     output wire        mgmt_ts_valid,
   45:     output wire        mgmt_telemetry_valid,
   46: 
   47:     // Diagnostic Counters
   48:     output wire [15:0] expected_txfn,
   49:     output wire [15:0] idle_frame_cnt,
   50:     output wire [15:0] mgmt_frame_cnt
   51: );
   52: 
   53:     wire is_idle = (rx_frame_type == 2'b00);
   54:     wire is_data = (rx_frame_type == 2'b01);
   55:     wire is_mgmt = (rx_frame_type == 2'b10);
   56: 
   57:     // 1. IDLE Frame Termination (2'b00)
   58:     idle_discard u_idle_discard (
   59:         .clk               (clk),
   60:         .rst_n             (rst_n),
   61:         .s_axis_idle_tdata (is_idle ? s_axis_pld_tdata : 32'd0),
   62:         .s_axis_idle_tvalid(s_axis_pld_tvalid && is_idle),
   63:         .s_axis_idle_tlast (s_axis_pld_tlast  && is_idle),
   64:         .idle_frame_cnt    (idle_frame_cnt),
   65:         .idle_byte_cnt     ()
   66:     );
   67: 
   68:     // 2. MGMT Frame Telemetry Extraction (2'b10)
   69:     mgmt_extraction u_mgmt_extraction (
   70:         .clk                     (clk),
   71:         .rst_n                   (rst_n),
   72:         .s_axis_mgmt_tdata       (is_mgmt ? s_axis_pld_tdata : 32'd0),
   73:         .s_axis_mgmt_tvalid      (s_axis_pld_tvalid && is_mgmt),
   74:         .s_axis_mgmt_tlast       (s_axis_pld_tlast  && is_mgmt),
   75:         .mgmt_rx_phy_ts_sec      (mgmt_rx_phy_ts_sec),
   76:         .mgmt_rx_phy_ts_picosec  (mgmt_rx_phy_ts_picosec),
   77:         .mgmt_tx_phy_ts_sec      (mgmt_tx_phy_ts_sec),
   78:         .mgmt_tx_phy_ts_picosec  (mgmt_tx_phy_ts_picosec),
   79:         .mgmt_range_meters       (mgmt_range_meters),
   80:         .mgmt_range_ts_sec       (mgmt_range_ts_sec),
   81:         .mgmt_range_ts_picosec   (mgmt_range_ts_picosec),
   82:         .mgmt_ts_valid           (mgmt_ts_valid),
   83:         .mgmt_telemetry_valid    (mgmt_telemetry_valid),
   84:         .mgmt_frame_cnt          (mgmt_frame_cnt)
   85:     );
   86: 
   87:     // 3. Selective Repeat ARQ Reorder Buffer for DATA Frames (2'b01)
   88:     arq_rx_reorder_ddr4_wrapper u_arq_rx_reorder (
   89:         .clk               (clk),
   90:         .rst_n             (rst_n),
   91:         .s_axis_data_tdata (is_data ? s_axis_pld_tdata : 32'd0),
   92:         .s_axis_data_tvalid(s_axis_pld_tvalid && is_data),
   93:         .s_axis_data_tlast (s_axis_pld_tlast  && is_data),
   94:         .rx_txfn_in        (rx_txfn),
   95:         .non_data_seq_adv  (non_data_seq_adv),
   96:         .non_data_txfn     (non_data_txfn),
   97:         .m_axis_ord_tdata  (m_axis_data_tdata),
   98:         .m_axis_ord_tvalid (m_axis_data_tvalid),
   99:         .m_axis_ord_tlast  (m_axis_data_tlast),
  100:         .m_axis_ord_tready (m_axis_data_tready),
  101:         .expected_txfn     (expected_txfn)
  102:     );
  103: 
  104: endmodule
