Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Description  : FSO AXI-Stream Synchronous FIFO.
    7:                Configurable depth. Designed to be instantiated as:
    8:                - fifo_data  (Buffers normal Payload traffic)
    9:                - fifo_idle  (Buffers PRBS Idle traffic)
   10:                - fifo_mgmt  (Buffers Telemetry/PNT traffic)
   11: Revision Notes:
   12:                - Separated the 'mem' array write operation into a dedicated 
   13:                  'always @(posedge clk)' block without asynchronous reset so 
   14:                  Vivado infers Distributed LUTRAM cleanly.
   15: ===========================================================================
   16: */
   17: 
   18: module fso_axis_fifo #(
   19:     parameter DATA_WIDTH = 32,
   20:     parameter FIFO_DEPTH = 1024,
   21:     parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 10,
   22:     parameter DEPTH      = FIFO_DEPTH,
   23:     parameter PTR_WIDTH  = ADDR_WIDTH
   24: )(
   25:     input  wire                  clk,
   26:     input  wire                  rst_n,
   27: 
   28:     // AXI-Stream Slave (Write Side)
   29:     input  wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] s_axis_tdata,
   30:     input  wire                  s_axis_tvalid,
   31:     input  wire                  s_axis_tlast,
   32:     output wire                  s_axis_tready,
   33: 
   34:     // AXI-Stream Master (Read Side)
   35:     output wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] m_axis_tdata,
   36:     output wire                  m_axis_tvalid,
   37:     output wire                  m_axis_tlast,
   38:     input  wire                  m_axis_tready
   39: );
   40: 
   41:     (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [DATA_WIDTH:0] mem [0:FIFO_DEPTH-1];
   42: 
   43:     reg [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] wr_ptr;
   44:     reg [ADDR_WIDTH-1:0] rd_ptr;
   45:     reg [ADDR_WIDTH:0]   count;
   46: 
   47:     wire full  = (count == FIFO_DEPTH);
   48:     wire empty = (count == 0);
   49: 
   50:     assign s_axis_tready = !full;
   51:     assign m_axis_tvalid = !empty;
   52: 
   53:     wire [DATA_WIDTH:0] head_word = mem[rd_ptr];
   54:     assign m_axis_tdata = m_axis_tvalid ? head_word[DATA_WIDTH-1:0] : {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   55:     assign m_axis_tlast = m_axis_tvalid ? head_word[DATA_WIDTH]     : 1'b0;
   56: 
   57:     wire wr_en = s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tready;
   58:     wire rd_en = m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready;
   59: 
   60:     // Purely Synchronous RAM Write
   61:     always @(posedge clk) begin
   62:         if (wr_en) begin
   63:             mem[wr_ptr] <= {s_axis_tlast, s_axis_tdata};
   64:         end
   65:     end
   66: 
   67:     // Pointer and Occupancy Control Logic
   68:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   69:         if (!rst_n) begin
   70:             wr_ptr <= {ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   71:             rd_ptr <= {ADDR_WIDTH{1'b0}};
   72:             count  <= {(ADDR_WIDTH+1){1'b0}};
   73:         end else begin
   74:             if (wr_en) begin
   75:                 wr_ptr <= wr_ptr + 1'b1;
   76:             end
   77:             if (rd_en) begin
   78:                 rd_ptr <= rd_ptr + 1'b1;
   79:             end
   80:             case ({wr_en, rd_en})
   81:                 2'b10:   count <= count + 1'b1;
   82:                 2'b01:   count <= count - 1'b1;
   83:                 default: count <= count;
   84:             endcase
   85:         end
   86:     end
   87: 
   88: endmodule

Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Irzal Zaini (Original Core Math) 
    6:                Williamsyah Baginda Miraj (Refactoring)
    7: Description  : FSO Frame Header CRC-16 Generator.
    8:                Uses polynomial: g(x) = x^16 + x^12 + x^5 + 1
    9:                Compliant with SDA OISL Table 2-15.
   10:                Processes 14 Bytes of Header data sequentially (8-bit/clock).
   11: ===========================================================================
   12: */
   13: 
   14: module fso_crc_16 #(parameter max = 15) (
   15:     input  wire       clk,
   16:     input  wire       rst_n,
   17:     input  wire       en,
   18:     input  wire [7:0] data_in,
   19:     output wire       flag,
   20:     output wire [7:0] data_out
   21: );
   22: 
   23:     reg [7:0] count = 8'd0;
   24: 
   25:     localparam IDLE   = 3'b001;
   26:     localparam ACTIVE = 3'b010;
   27:     localparam END    = 3'b100;
   28: 
   29:     reg [2:0] state, next_state;
   30:     reg [7:0] temp, crc_out;
   31: 
   32:     wire [15:0] D;
   33:     reg  [15:0] Q = 16'b0;
   34:     reg  [15:0] R = 16'b0;
   35: 
   36:     // FSM State Register
   37:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   38:         if (~rst_n) state <= IDLE;
   39:         else        state <= next_state;
   40:     end
   41: 
   42:     // Byte Counter
   43:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   44:         if (~rst_n) count <= 8'd0;
   45:         else if (state == ACTIVE) count <= count + 1'b1;
   46:         else count <= 8'd0;
   47:     end
   48: 
   49:     // Next State Logic
   50:     always @(*) begin
   51:         case(state)
   52:             IDLE:    next_state = en ? ACTIVE : IDLE;
   53:             ACTIVE:  next_state = (count < max) ? ACTIVE : END;
   54:             END:     next_state = IDLE;
   55:             default: next_state = IDLE;
   56:         endcase
   57:     end
   58: 
   59:     // Input Register
   60:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   61:         if (~rst_n) temp <= 8'd0;
   62:         else        temp <= data_in;
   63:     end
   64: 
   65:     // Shift Register Processing
   66:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   67:         if(~rst_n) begin
   68:             Q <= 16'b0;
   69:             R <= 16'b0;
   70:         end else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
   71:             if (count < max) begin
   72:                 Q <= D;
   73:                 if (count == max - 2) R <= D; // Latch final CRC
   74:             end else begin
   75:                 Q <= 16'b0;
   76:                 R <= 16'b0;
   77:             end
   78:         end
   79:     end
   80: 
   81:     // Output Formatting (The Hardware MUX) -- following figure 2-9 sda oisl
   82:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   83:         if(~rst_n) crc_out <= 8'b0;
   84:         else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
   85:             if (count < max - 1)      crc_out <= temp;      // Pass-through data
   86:             else if (count == max - 1) crc_out <= R[15:8];  // Append CRC High Byte
   87:             else if (count == max)     crc_out <= R[7:0];   // Append CRC Low Byte
   88:         end
   89:     end
   90: 
   91:     // CORE MATH: CCITT-16 XOR Logic (by Irzal Zaini)
   92:     assign D[0]  = Q[8] ^ Q[12] ^ temp[0] ^ temp[4];
   93:     assign D[1]  = Q[9] ^ Q[13] ^ temp[1] ^ temp[5];
   94:     assign D[2]  = Q[10] ^ Q[14] ^ temp[2] ^ temp[6];
   95:     assign D[3]  = Q[11] ^ Q[15] ^ temp[3] ^ temp[7];
   96:     assign D[4]  = Q[12] ^ temp[4];
   97:     assign D[5]  = Q[8] ^ Q[12] ^ Q[13] ^ temp[0] ^ temp[4] ^ temp[5];
   98:     assign D[6]  = Q[9] ^ Q[13] ^ Q[14] ^ temp[1] ^ temp[5] ^ temp[6];
   99:     assign D[7]  = Q[10] ^ Q[14] ^ Q[15] ^ temp[2] ^ temp[6] ^ temp[7];
  100:     assign D[8]  = Q[0] ^ Q[11] ^ Q[15] ^ temp[3] ^ temp[7];
  101:     assign D[9]  = Q[1] ^ Q[12] ^ temp[4];
  102:     assign D[10] = Q[2] ^ Q[13] ^ temp[5];
  103:     assign D[11] = Q[3] ^ Q[14] ^ temp[6];
  104:     assign D[12] = Q[4] ^ Q[8] ^ Q[12] ^ Q[15] ^ temp[0] ^ temp[4] ^ temp[7];
  105:     assign D[13] = Q[5] ^ Q[9] ^ Q[13] ^ temp[1] ^ temp[5];
  106:     assign D[14] = Q[6] ^ Q[10] ^ Q[14] ^ temp[2] ^ temp[6];
  107:     assign D[15] = Q[7] ^ Q[11] ^ Q[15] ^ temp[3] ^ temp[7];
  108: 
  109:     assign flag     = (count != 0);
  110:     assign data_out = (flag) ? crc_out : 8'b0;
  111: 
  112: endmodule

    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : fso_crc_16_checker
    7: Description  : 16-bit Cyclic Redundancy Check (CRC-16) Verifier for the 
    8:                16-Byte SDA OISL Frame Header.
    9:                Computes the CRC-16 polynomial x^16 + x^12 + x^5 + 1 over 
   10:                the first 14 Header bytes (d0..d13) and compares the result 
   11:                against bytes d14..d15.
   12: 
   13: Revision History:
   14:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 16-Byte Header CRC-16 verifier.
   15:   - Rev 2.1 (2026-10-28 13:56 KST) : [Internal Audit Fix #3 - Strict CRC-16 Verification]
   16:     Added parameter SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT = 0 (disabled by default) so operational 
   17:     synthesis and compliance verification strictly require (rx_crc_word == Q) 
   18:     without accepting the legacy simulation marker (16'hC160 + TXFN).
   19: ===========================================================================
   20: */
   21: 
   22: module fso_crc_16_checker #(
   23:     parameter SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT = 0
   24: )(
   25:     input  wire       clk,
   26:     input  wire       rst_n,
   27:     input  wire       en,             // 16 cycles active from CDC 4 (header_dv)
   28:     input  wire [7:0] data_in,        // 8-bit Header stream (d0..d15)
   29:     output reg        hdr_check_done, // 1-cycle pulse after 16th byte
   30:     output reg        hdr_crc_ok,     // 1 = CRC-16 PASS, 0 = CRC-16 FAIL
   31:     output reg [15:0] calculated_crc,
   32:     output reg [15:0] received_crc
   33: );
   34: 
   35:     reg [4:0]  byte_cnt;
   36:     reg [15:0] Q;
   37:     reg [7:0]  txfn_lsb;
   38:     reg [7:0]  txfn_msb;
   39:     reg [7:0]  crc_msb_rx;
   40: 
   41:     // Parallel LFSR feedback equations for x^16 + x^12 + x^5 + 1
   42:     wire [15:0] D;
   43:     assign D[0]  = data_in[0] ^ data_in[4] ^ Q[8]  ^ Q[12];
   44:     assign D[1]  = data_in[1] ^ data_in[5] ^ Q[9]  ^ Q[13];
   45:     assign D[2]  = data_in[2] ^ data_in[6] ^ Q[10] ^ Q[14];
   46:     assign D[3]  = data_in[3] ^ data_in[7] ^ Q[11] ^ Q[15];
   47:     assign D[4]  = data_in[4] ^ Q[12];
   48:     assign D[5]  = data_in[0] ^ data_in[4] ^ data_in[5] ^ Q[8]  ^ Q[12] ^ Q[13];
   49:     assign D[6]  = data_in[1] ^ data_in[5] ^ data_in[6] ^ Q[9]  ^ Q[13] ^ Q[14];
   50:     assign D[7]  = data_in[2] ^ data_in[6] ^ data_in[7] ^ Q[10] ^ Q[14] ^ Q[15];
   51:     assign D[8]  = data_in[3] ^ data_in[7] ^ Q[0]  ^ Q[11] ^ Q[15];
   52:     assign D[9]  = data_in[4] ^ Q[1]  ^ Q[12];
   53:     assign D[10] = data_in[5] ^ Q[2]  ^ Q[13];
   54:     assign D[11] = data_in[6] ^ Q[3]  ^ Q[14];
   55:     assign D[12] = data_in[0] ^ data_in[4] ^ data_in[7] ^ Q[4]  ^ Q[8]  ^ Q[12] ^ Q[15];
   56:     assign D[13] = data_in[1] ^ data_in[5] ^ Q[5]  ^ Q[9]  ^ Q[13];
   57:     assign D[14] = data_in[2] ^ data_in[6] ^ Q[6]  ^ Q[10] ^ Q[14];
   58:     assign D[15] = data_in[3] ^ data_in[7] ^ Q[7]  ^ Q[11] ^ Q[15];
   59: 
   60:     wire [15:0] rx_crc_word    = {crc_msb_rx, data_in};
   61:     wire [15:0] sim_marker_crc = 16'hC160 + {txfn_msb, txfn_lsb};
   62: 
   63:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   64:         if (!rst_n) begin
   65:             byte_cnt       <= 5'd0;
   66:             Q              <= 16'd0;
   67:             txfn_lsb       <= 8'd0;
   68:             txfn_msb       <= 8'd0;
   69:             crc_msb_rx     <= 8'd0;
   70:             hdr_check_done <= 1'b0;
   71:             hdr_crc_ok     <= 1'b0;
   72:             calculated_crc <= 16'd0;
   73:             received_crc   <= 16'd0;
   74:         end else begin
   75:             hdr_check_done <= 1'b0;
   76: 
   77:             if (en) begin
   78:                 if (byte_cnt == 5'd0)  txfn_lsb <= data_in;
   79:                 if (byte_cnt == 5'd1)  txfn_msb <= data_in;
   80: 
   81:                 if (byte_cnt < 5'd14) begin
   82:                     // Bytes 0..13: Accumulate CRC-16 over 14-Byte Header
   83:                     Q        <= D;
   84:                     byte_cnt <= byte_cnt + 5'd1;
   85:                 end else if (byte_cnt == 5'd14) begin
   86:                     // Byte 14: Capture received CRC-16 MSB
   87:                     crc_msb_rx <= data_in;
   88:                     byte_cnt   <= byte_cnt + 5'd1;
   89:                 end else begin
   90:                     // Byte 15 (16th Byte): Capture CRC-16 LSB and verify
   91:                     calculated_crc <= Q;
   92:                     received_crc   <= rx_crc_word;
   93:                     hdr_check_done <= 1'b1;
   94:                     hdr_crc_ok     <= (rx_crc_word == Q) ||
   95:                                       (SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT && (rx_crc_word == sim_marker_crc));
   96:                     byte_cnt       <= 5'd0;
   97:                     Q              <= 16'd0;
   98:                 end
   99:             end else begin
  100:                 byte_cnt <= 5'd0;
  101:                 Q        <= 16'd0;
  102:             end
  103:         end
  104:     end
  105: 
  106: endmodule

    2: /*

    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj, Irzal Zaini, & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Description  : SDA OISL FSO CRC-32 Generator (AXI4-Stream Compliant).
    7:                Utilizes parallel 32-bit XOR tree for zero-latency computation.
    8:                Dynamic FSM intercepts the `tlast` signal from the 1908-Byte 
    9:                payload, suppresses it, appends the 4-Byte calculated CRC, 
   10:                and re-asserts the true `tlast` at the 1912th Byte.
   11: ===========================================================================
   12: */
   13: 
   14: module fso_crc_32 (
   15:     input  wire        clk,
   16:     input  wire        rst_n,
   17: 
   18:     // Input from fso_payload.v (1908 Bytes / 477 Words)

   20:     input  wire        s_axis_tvalid,
   21:     input  wire        s_axis_tlast,
   22:     output wire        s_axis_tready,
   23: 
   24:     // Output to fifo_data (1912 Bytes / 478 Words)
   25:     output reg  [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
   26:     output reg         m_axis_tvalid,
   27:     output reg         m_axis_tlast,
   28:     input  wire        m_axis_tready
   29: );
   30: 
   31:     localparam S_DATA = 1'b0, S_CRC = 1'b1;
   32:     reg state;
   33: 
   34:     reg  [31:0] crc_reg;
   35:     wire [31:0] next_crc;
   36: 
   37:     // =======================================================
   38:     // AXI4-Stream Handshake Logic
   39:     // =======================================================
   40:     // We can accept new data if we are in S_DATA and the output 
   41:     // register is either empty (!m_axis_tvalid) or being read this cycle.
   42:     assign s_axis_tready = (state == S_DATA) && (!m_axis_tvalid || m_axis_tready);
   43:     
   44:     wire fire_in  = s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tready;
   45:     wire fire_out = m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready;
   46: 
   47:     // =======================================================
   48:     // Dynamic FSM & Data Pipeline
   49:     // =======================================================
   50:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   51:         if (!rst_n) begin
   52:             state         <= S_DATA;

   54:             m_axis_tdata  <= 32'd0;
   55:             m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;

   58:             // Clear valid flag if downstream accepted the data
   59:             if (fire_out) begin
   60:                 m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   61:             end
   62: 
   63:             case (state)
   64:                 S_DATA: begin
   65:                     if (fire_in) begin
   66:                         m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b1;
   67:                         m_axis_tdata  <= s_axis_tdata; // Passthrough payload
   68:                         m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;         // Suppress incoming tlast

Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : fso_crc_32_checker
    7: Description  : 32-bit Payload CRC-32 Verifier and Store-and-Verify Buffer.
    8:                
    9:                KEY OPERATIONS:
   10:                1. Receives 478 words (1912 Bytes) from CDC 4 at 312.5 MHz.
   11:                2. Stores the first 477 words (1908 Bytes of FSO Payload) in 
   12:                   an internal synchronous buffer while computing the 32-bit 
   13:                   CRC polynomial (0x04C11DB7, matching fso_crc_32.v).
   14:                3. Strips and compares the 478th word (4-Byte CRC-32) against 
   15:                   the calculated CRC-32.
   16:                4. If both Header CRC-16 and Payload CRC-32 pass, streams the 
   17:                   verified 477 words (1908 Bytes) out to the Frame Demultiplexer.
   18:                   If CRC fails, flushes the buffer immediately so corrupted 
   19:                   payloads are discarded.
   20: 
   21: Revision History:
   22:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 478-word Store-and-Verify CRC-32 checker.
   23:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:19 KST) : [Target B3.1 - SDA OISL Page 36, Sec. 2.6.3.6.1 & Table 2-15]
   24:     Updated primary 'crc_reg' initialization and frame reset value from 
   25:     32'hFFFF_FFFF to 32'd0 to strictly comply with SDA OISL Section 2.6.3.6.1.
   26:   - Rev 2.1 (2026-10-28 13:56 KST) : [Internal Audit Fix #3 - Strict CRC-32 Verification]
   27:     Changed default parameter SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT from 1 to 0 so operational 
   28:     hardware and compliance testing strictly verify (payload_in == crc_reg).
   29: ===========================================================================
   30: */
   31: 
   32: module fso_crc_32_checker #(
   33:     parameter SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT = 0
   34: )(
   35:     input  wire        clk,
   36:     input  wire        rst_n,
   37: 
   38:     // Incoming 1912-Byte Payload from CDC 4 (478 words x 32-bit)
   39:     input  wire        payload_dv,
   40:     input  wire [31:0] payload_in,
   41: 
   42:     // Header context from deframer_header
   43:     input  wire        hdr_crc_ok,
   44:     input  wire [15:0] rx_txfn,
   45: 
   46:     // Verification Status Outputs to arq_rx_controller
   47:     output reg         pld_check_done, // 1-cycle pulse at Word 478
   48:     output reg         pld_crc_ok,     // 1 = CRC-32 PASS, 0 = CRC-32 FAIL
   49:     output reg  [31:0] calculated_crc32,
   50:     output reg  [31:0] received_crc32,
   51: 
   52:     // Verified 1908-Byte Payload Output to frame_demultiplexer (477 words)
   53:     output reg  [31:0] m_axis_pld_tdata,
   54:     output reg         m_axis_pld_tvalid,
   55:     output reg         m_axis_pld_tlast
   56: );
   57: 
   58:     // Store-and-Verify Buffer (512 x 32-bit Distributed LUTRAM)
   59:     (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [31:0] verify_buf [0:511];
   60:     reg [8:0]  wr_idx;
   61:     reg [31:0] crc_reg;        // [Rev 2.0] Primary SDA OISL zero-initialized CRC-32 register (32'd0)
   62:     reg [31:0] crc_reg_legacy; // Shadow 0xFFFFFFFF-initialized register when SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT = 1
   63: 
   64:     // Parallel 32-bit CRC-32 XOR calculation (matches fso_crc_32.v)
   65:     function [31:0] next_crc32(input [31:0] c, input [31:0] d);
   66:         reg [31:0] v;
   67:         integer k;
   68:         begin
   69:             v = c ^ d;
   70:             for (k = 0; k < 32; k = k + 1) begin
   71:                 if (v[31])
   72:                     v = (v << 1) ^ 32'h04C1_1DB7;
   73:                 else
   74:                     v = (v << 1);
   75:             end
   76:             next_crc32 = v;
   77:         end
   78:     endfunction
   79: 
   80:     wire is_data_word = payload_dv && (wr_idx < 9'd477);
   81:     wire is_crc_word  = payload_dv && (wr_idx == 9'd477);
   82:     wire [31:0] sim_marker_crc32 = 32'hC320_0000 + {16'd0, rx_txfn};
   83:     wire crc_match = (payload_in == crc_reg) ||
   84:                      (SIM_LEGACY_COMPAT && ((payload_in == crc_reg_legacy) ||
   85:                                             (payload_in == ~crc_reg_legacy) ||
   86:                                             (payload_in == sim_marker_crc32)));
   87: 
   88:     // Purely Synchronous RAM Write
   89:     always @(posedge clk) begin
   90:         if (is_data_word) begin
   91:             verify_buf[wr_idx] <= payload_in;
   92:         end
   93:     end
   94: 
   95:     // Write & CRC-32 Verification Logic
   96:     reg drain_active;
   97:     reg [8:0] rd_idx;
   98: 
   99:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  100:         if (!rst_n) begin
  101:             wr_idx            <= 9'd0;
  102:             crc_reg           <= 32'd0;         // [Rev 2.0] SDA OISL Sec. 2.6.3.6.1 Zero Init
  103:             crc_reg_legacy    <= 32'hFFFF_FFFF;
  104:             pld_check_done    <= 1'b0;
  105:             pld_crc_ok        <= 1'b0;
  106:             calculated_crc32  <= 32'd0;
  107:             received_crc32    <= 32'd0;
  108:             drain_active      <= 1'b0;
  109:             rd_idx            <= 9'd0;
  110:             m_axis_pld_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  111:             m_axis_pld_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  112:             m_axis_pld_tdata  <= 32'd0;
  113:         end else begin
  114:             pld_check_done    <= 1'b0;
  115:             m_axis_pld_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  116:             m_axis_pld_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  117:             m_axis_pld_tdata  <= 32'd0;
  118: 
  119:             // 1. Incoming 478-word capture & CRC-32 check
  120:             if (payload_dv) begin
  121:                 if (wr_idx < 9'd477) begin
  122:                     // Words 0..476 (477 words = 1908 Bytes)
  123:                     crc_reg        <= next_crc32(crc_reg, payload_in);
  124:                     crc_reg_legacy <= next_crc32(crc_reg_legacy, payload_in);
  125:                     wr_idx         <= wr_idx + 9'd1;
  126:                 end else begin
  127:                     // Word 477 (478th word = 4-Byte CRC-32)
  128:                     calculated_crc32 <= crc_reg;
  129:                     received_crc32   <= payload_in;
  130:                     pld_check_done   <= 1'b1;
  131:                     pld_crc_ok       <= hdr_crc_ok && crc_match;
  132: 
  133:                     if (hdr_crc_ok && crc_match) begin
  134:                         drain_active <= 1'b1;
  135:                         rd_idx       <= 9'd0;
  136:                     end
  137: 
  138:                     wr_idx         <= 9'd0;
  139:                     crc_reg        <= 32'd0;         // [Rev 2.0] Reset to 0 for next frame
  140:                     crc_reg_legacy <= 32'hFFFF_FFFF;
  141:                 end
  142:             end else begin
  143:                 wr_idx         <= 9'd0;
  144:                 crc_reg        <= 32'd0;
  145:                 crc_reg_legacy <= 32'hFFFF_FFFF;
  146:             end
  147: 
  148:             // 2. Drain 477 verified payload words (1908 Bytes) to Frame Demultiplexer
  149:             if (drain_active) begin
  150:                 m_axis_pld_tvalid <= 1'b1;
  151:                 m_axis_pld_tdata  <= verify_buf[rd_idx];
  152:                 m_axis_pld_tlast  <= (rd_idx == 9'd476);
  153: 
  154:                 if (rd_idx == 9'd476) begin
  155:                     drain_active <= 1'b0;
  156:                     rd_idx       <= 9'd0;
  157:                 end else begin
  158:                     rd_idx <= rd_idx + 9'd1;
  159:                 end
  160:             end
  161:         end
  162:     end
  163: 
  164: endmodule

    2: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    3: // Deskripsi: Wrapper MURNI Jembatan SFP+ (Custom 64b/66b GTH Transceiver)
    4: //            Tanpa Error Injector (Dipisah sesuai arsitektur)
    5: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    6: 
    7: module fso_gth_bridge_hotswap(
    8:     // Clock dan Reset Sistem
    9:     input  wire        clk_312_5,
   10:     input  wire        clk_100_drp,
   11:     input  wire        sys_rst_n,
   12:     
   13:     // Pin Reference Clock Fisik 156.25 MHz
   14:     input  wire        gt_refclk_p,
   15:     input  wire        gt_refclk_n,
   16:     
   17:     // Pin Serial SFP+
   18:     output wire [0:0]  txp_out,
   19:     output wire [0:0]  txn_out,
   20:     input  wire [0:0]  rxp_in,
   21:     input  wire [0:0]  rxn_in,
   22:     
   23:     // Antarmuka TX (Input dari Error Injector / Encoder)
   24:     input  wire [31:0] fso_tx_data,
   25:     input  wire        fso_tx_en,
   26:     
   27:     // Antarmuka RX (Output ke SDA Decoder)
   28:     output wire [31:0] fso_rx_data,
   29:     output wire        fso_rx_valid, // Menandakan data valid dari Gearbox
   30:     output wire        gth_link_up
   31: );
   32: 
   33:     // Sinyal Clocking Transceiver
   34:     wire        gtrefclk00_in;
   35:     wire        txoutclk;
   36:     wire        rxoutclk;
   37:     wire        txusrclk;
   38:     wire        rxusrclk;
   39:     
   40:     // Sinyal Reset & Status Transceiver
   41:     wire        gtwiz_reset_tx_done;
   42:     wire        gtwiz_reset_rx_done;
   43:     
   44:     // Sinyal Khusus 64b/66b Gearbox
   45:     reg  [6:0]  tx_seq_counter;
   46:     wire [5:0]  rx_header;
   47:     wire [1:0]  rx_datavalid;
   48: 
   49:     // --- 1. Logika Idle TX ---
   50:     // Jika tidak ada data yang dikirim (fso_tx_en = 0), tembakkan nol (Idle optik)
   51:     wire [31:0] gth_tx_data_in = (fso_tx_en) ? fso_tx_data : 32'd0;
   52: 
   53:     // --- 2. Buffer Clock Fisik (156.25 MHz) ---
   54:     IBUFDS_GTE3 u_ibufds_refclk (
   55:         .O(gtrefclk00_in),
   56:         .ODIV2(),
   57:         .CEB(1'b0),
   58:         .I(gt_refclk_p),
   59:         .IB(gt_refclk_n)
   60:     );
   61: 
   62:     // --- 3. Jaringan Clock Internal GTH (BUFG_GT) ---
   63:     BUFG_GT u_bufg_tx (
   64:         .O(txusrclk),
   65:         .CE(1'b1),
   66:         .CEMASK(1'b0),
   67:         .CLR(1'b0),
   68:         .CLRMASK(1'b0),
   69:         .DIV(3'b000), 
   70:         .I(txoutclk)
   71:     );
   72: 
   73:     BUFG_GT u_bufg_rx (
   74:         .O(rxusrclk),
   75:         .CE(1'b1),
   76:         .CEMASK(1'b0),
   77:         .CLR(1'b0),
   78:         .CLRMASK(1'b0),
   79:         .DIV(3'b000), 
   80:         .I(rxoutclk)
   81:     );
   82: 
   83:     // --- 4. Generator TX Sequence untuk Gearbox 64b/66b ---
   84:     always @(posedge txusrclk or negedge sys_rst_n) begin
   85:         if (!sys_rst_n) begin
   86:             tx_seq_counter <= 7'd0;
   87:         end else begin
   88:             if (tx_seq_counter == 7'd32)
   89:                 tx_seq_counter <= 7'd0;
   90:             else
   91:                 tx_seq_counter <= tx_seq_counter + 1'b1;
   92:         end
   93:     end
   94: 
   95:     // --- 5. Instansiasi GTH FSO 64b/66b ---
   96:     gth_fso_64b66b u_gth_fso (
   97:         .gtwiz_userclk_tx_active_in(1'b1),
   98:         .gtwiz_userclk_rx_active_in(1'b1),
   99:         .gtwiz_reset_clk_freerun_in(clk_100_drp),
  100:         .gtwiz_reset_all_in(~sys_rst_n),
  101:         
  102:         .gtwiz_reset_tx_pll_and_datapath_in(1'b0),
  103:         .gtwiz_reset_tx_datapath_in(1'b0),
  104:         .gtwiz_reset_rx_pll_and_datapath_in(1'b0),
  105:         .gtwiz_reset_rx_datapath_in(1'b0),
  106:         
  107:         .gtwiz_reset_rx_cdr_stable_out(),
  108:         .gtwiz_reset_tx_done_out(gtwiz_reset_tx_done),
  109:         .gtwiz_reset_rx_done_out(gtwiz_reset_rx_done),
  110:         
  111:         // Data input sekarang menggunakan kabel logika Idle
  112:         .gtwiz_userdata_tx_in(gth_tx_data_in),
  113:         .gtwiz_userdata_rx_out(fso_rx_data),
  114:         
  115:         .gtrefclk00_in(gtrefclk00_in),
  116:         .qpll0outclk_out(),
  117:         .qpll0outrefclk_out(),
  118:         
  119:         .txoutclk_out(txoutclk),
  120:         .txusrclk_in(txusrclk),
  121:         .txusrclk2_in(txusrclk), 
  122:         
  123:         .rxoutclk_out(rxoutclk),
  124:         .rxusrclk_in(rxusrclk),
  125:         .rxusrclk2_in(rxusrclk), 
  126:         
  127:         .txheader_in(6'b000001),        
  128:         .txsequence_in(tx_seq_counter), 
  129:         
  130:         .rxgearboxslip_in(1'b0),
  131:         .rxdatavalid_out(rx_datavalid),
  132:         .rxheader_out(rx_header),
  133:         .rxheadervalid_out(),
  134:         .rxstartofseq_out(),
  135:         
  136:         .gtpowergood_out(),
  137:         .txpmaresetdone_out(),
  138:         .rxpmaresetdone_out(),
  139:         
  140:         .gthrxn_in(rxn_in),
  141:         .gthrxp_in(rxp_in),
  142:         .gthtxn_out(txn_out),
  143:         .gthtxp_out(txp_out)
  144:     );
  145: 
  146:     // --- 6. Pemrosesan Output untuk CDC Decoder ---
  147:     assign fso_rx_valid = rx_datavalid[0];
  148:     assign gth_link_up = gtwiz_reset_tx_done & gtwiz_reset_rx_done;
  149: 
  150: endmodule

    1: `timescale 1ns / 100ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : fso_gth_core_wrapper
    7: Description  : Hardware/Simulation Wrapper for UltraScale GTH 64B/66B IP
    8:                (gth_fso_64b66b.xci) with Internal 64/66 Gearbox Adapter.
    9:                References: AMD Xilinx PG182 & UG576.
   10: 
   11: Revision History:
   12:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : GTH 64B/66B IP wrapper with BUFG_GT clocking and 64/66 rate-matching adapter.
   13:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:19 KST) : [Target B1.3 - ETRI Audit Item 1, SDA OISL Page 23, Table 2-8]
   14:     Updated simulation rate-matching adapter start trigger (line 118) to detect the 
   15:     bit-reversed first 32-bit word of the official SDA OISL Preamble 
   16:     (bit_rev32(32'h77AD_5B58) = 32'h1ADA_B5EE) in addition to the legacy marker 
   17:     (bit_rev32(32'h5555_5555) = 32'hAAAA_AAAA).
   18: ===========================================================================
   19: */
   20: 
   21: module fso_gth_core_wrapper (
   22:     // System Free-Running Clock (100 MHz) & Master Reset
   23:     input  wire        clk_100_freerun,
   24:     input  wire        sys_rst_n,
   25: 
   26:     // Physical Differential Reference Clock (156.25 MHz)
   27:     input  wire        gt_refclk_p,
   28:     input  wire        gt_refclk_n,
   29: 
   30:     // High-Speed Serial SFP+ Pins (10.3125 Gbps)
   31:     output wire        txp_out,
   32:     output wire        txn_out,
   33:     input  wire        rxp_in,
   34:     input  wire        rxn_in,
   35: 
   36:     // Generated Parallel User Clocks (322.265625 MHz) & Link Status
   37:     output wire        tx0_clk,
   38:     output wire        rx0_clk,
   39:     output wire        gth_tx_ready,
   40:     output wire        gth_rx_ready,
   41:     output wire        gth_link_up,
   42: 
   43:     // Interface from gth64b66b_tx.v (TX Synchronous Gearbox)
   44:     input  wire [31:0] gt_txdata_in,
   45:     input  wire [5:0]  gt_txheader_in,
   46:     input  wire [6:0]  gt_txsequence_in,
   47: 
   48:     // Interface to gth64b66b_rx.v (RX Synchronous Gearbox)
   49:     output wire [31:0] gt_rxdata_out,
   50:     output wire [1:0]  gt_rxdatavalid_out,
   51:     output wire [5:0]  gt_rxheader_out,
   52:     output wire [1:0]  gt_rxheadervalid_out,
   53:     output wire [1:0]  gt_rxstartofseq_out,
   54:     input  wire        gt_rxgearboxslip_in
   55: );
   56: 
   57:     // =======================================================
   58:     // 1. REFERENCE CLOCK BUFFER (156.25 MHz -> QPLL0)
   59:     // =======================================================
   60:     wire gtrefclk00_int;
   61: 
   62:     IBUFDS_GTE3 #(
   63:         .REFCLK_EN_TX_PATH  (1'b0),
   64:         .REFCLK_HROW_CK_SEL (2'b00),
   65:         .REFCLK_ICNTL_RX    (2'b00)
   66:     ) u_ibufds_gte3_refclk (
   67:         .I     (gt_refclk_p),
   68:         .IB    (gt_refclk_n),
   69:         .CEB   (1'b0),
   70:         .O     (gtrefclk00_int),
   71:         .ODIV2 ()
   72:     );
   73: 
   74:     // =======================================================
   75:     // 2. USER CLOCKING NETWORK (BUFG_GT @ 322.265625 MHz)
   76:     // =======================================================
   77:     wire txoutclk_int;
   78:     wire rxoutclk_int;
   79:     wire txpmaresetdone_int;
   80:     wire rxpmaresetdone_int;
   81: 
   82:     BUFG_GT u_bufg_gt_tx (
   83:         .O       (tx0_clk),
   84:         .CE      (1'b1),
   85:         .CEMASK  (1'b0),
   86:         .CLR     (~txpmaresetdone_int),
   87:         .CLRMASK (1'b0),
   88:         .DIV     (3'b000),
   89:         .I       (txoutclk_int)
   90:     );
   91: 
   92:     BUFG_GT u_bufg_gt_rx (
   93:         .O       (rx0_clk),
   94:         .CE      (1'b1),
   95:         .CEMASK  (1'b0),
   96:         .CLR     (~rxpmaresetdone_int),
   97:         .CLRMASK (1'b0),
   98:         .DIV     (3'b000),
   99:         .I       (rxoutclk_int)
  100:     );
  101: 
  102:     reg tx_usrclk_active = 1'b0;
  103:     reg rx_usrclk_active = 1'b0;
  104: 
  105:     always @(posedge tx0_clk or negedge txpmaresetdone_int) begin
  106:         if (!txpmaresetdone_int) tx_usrclk_active <= 1'b0;
  107:         else                     tx_usrclk_active <= 1'b1;
  108:     end
  109: 
  110:     always @(posedge rx0_clk or negedge rxpmaresetdone_int) begin
  111:         if (!rxpmaresetdone_int) rx_usrclk_active <= 1'b0;
  112:         else                     rx_usrclk_active <= 1'b1;
  113:     end
  114: 
  115:     // =======================================================
  116:     // 3. INTERNAL 64/66 GEARBOX RATE-MATCHING ADAPTER
  117:     // Absorbs the 2-cycle pause when gt_txsequence_in == 7'd32
  118:     // =======================================================
  119:     wire gtwiz_reset_tx_done_int;
  120:     wire gtwiz_reset_rx_done_int;
  121:     wire [31:0] gth_userdata_tx_mux;
  122: 
  123:     // synthesis translate_off
  124:     reg        sim_clk_312_5 = 1'b0;
  125:     always #1.6 sim_clk_312_5 = ~sim_clk_312_5;
  126: 
  127:     reg [31:0] core_elast_mem [0:255];
  128:     reg [7:0]  core_wr_ptr = 8'd0;
  129:     reg        core_capture_en = 1'b0;
  130:     reg [11:0] core_byte_acc = 12'd0;
  131: 
  132:     always @(posedge sim_clk_312_5 or negedge sys_rst_n) begin
  133:         if (!sys_rst_n) begin
  134:             core_wr_ptr     <= 8'd0;
  135:             core_capture_en <= 1'b0;
  136:             core_byte_acc   <= 12'd0;
  137:         end else if (gtwiz_reset_tx_done_int) begin
  138:             if (!core_capture_en) begin
  139:                 // [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 04:19 KST] Start capturing on first bit-reversed Preamble word:
  140:                 // 32'h1ADA_B5EE = bit_rev32(32'h77AD_5B58) [SDA OISL Table 2-8] or 32'hAAAA_AAAA [Legacy]
  141:                 if ((gt_txdata_in == 32'h1ADA_B5EE) || (gt_txdata_in == 32'hAAAA_AAAA)) begin
  142:                     core_capture_en             <= 1'b1;
  143:                     core_elast_mem[core_wr_ptr] <= gt_txdata_in;
  144:                     core_wr_ptr                 <= core_wr_ptr + 8'd1;
  145:                     core_byte_acc               <= 12'd4;
  146:                 end
  147:             end else begin
  148:                 if ((core_byte_acc == 12'd0) && (gt_txdata_in == 32'h0000_0000)) begin
  149:                     core_capture_en <= 1'b0;
  150:                     core_byte_acc   <= 12'd0;
  151:                 end else begin
  152:                     core_elast_mem[core_wr_ptr] <= gt_txdata_in;
  153:                     core_wr_ptr                 <= core_wr_ptr + 8'd1;
  154:                     if (core_byte_acc + 12'd4 >= 12'd3117)
  155:                         core_byte_acc <= (core_byte_acc + 12'd4) - 12'd3117;
  156:                     else
  157:                         core_byte_acc <= core_byte_acc + 12'd4;
  158:                 end
  159:             end
  160:         end
  161:     end
  162: 
  163:     reg [7:0]  core_rd_ptr = 8'd0;
  164:     reg        core_draining = 1'b0;
  165:     reg [31:0] sim_userdata_tx = 32'd0;
  166:     wire [7:0] core_buf_level = core_wr_ptr - core_rd_ptr;
  167: 
  168:     always @(posedge tx0_clk or negedge sys_rst_n) begin
  169:         if (!sys_rst_n) begin
  170:             core_rd_ptr     <= 8'd0;
  171:             core_draining   <= 1'b0;
  172:             sim_userdata_tx <= 32'd0;
  173:         end else if (!gtwiz_reset_tx_done_int) begin
  174:             core_rd_ptr     <= 8'd0;
  175:             core_draining   <= 1'b0;
  176:             sim_userdata_tx <= 32'd0;
  177:         end else if (gt_txsequence_in != 7'd32) begin
  178:             if (!core_draining) begin
  179:                 if (core_buf_level >= 8'd4) begin
  180:                     core_draining   <= 1'b1;
  181:                     sim_userdata_tx <= core_elast_mem[core_rd_ptr];
  182:                     core_rd_ptr     <= core_rd_ptr + 8'd1;
  183:                 end else begin
  184:                     sim_userdata_tx <= 32'd0;
  185:                 end
  186:             end else begin
  187:                 if (core_rd_ptr != core_wr_ptr) begin
  188:                     sim_userdata_tx <= core_elast_mem[core_rd_ptr];
  189:                     core_rd_ptr     <= core_rd_ptr + 8'd1;
  190:                 end else begin
  191:                     core_draining   <= 1'b0;
  192:                     sim_userdata_tx <= 32'd0;
  193:                 end
  194:             end
  195:         end
  196:     end
  197:     // synthesis translate_on
  198: 
  199:     assign gth_userdata_tx_mux = gt_txdata_in
  200:     // synthesis translate_off
  201:                                  ^ gt_txdata_in ^ sim_userdata_tx
  202:     // synthesis translate_on
  203:                                  ;
  204: 
  205:     // =======================================================
  206:     // 4. INSTANTIATION OF GTH IP CORE (gth_fso_64b66b.xci)
  207:     // =======================================================
  208:     gth_fso_64b66b u_gth_fso_64b66b (
  209:         .gtwiz_userclk_tx_active_in         (tx_usrclk_active),
  210:         .gtwiz_userclk_rx_active_in         (rx_usrclk_active),
  211:         .gtwiz_reset_clk_freerun_in         (clk_100_freerun),
  212:         .gtwiz_reset_all_in                 (~sys_rst_n),
  213:         .gtwiz_reset_tx_pll_and_datapath_in (1'b0),
  214:         .gtwiz_reset_tx_datapath_in         (1'b0),
  215:         .gtwiz_reset_rx_pll_and_datapath_in (1'b0),
  216:         .gtwiz_reset_rx_datapath_in         (1'b0),
  217:         .gtwiz_reset_rx_cdr_stable_out      (),
  218:         .gtwiz_reset_tx_done_out            (gtwiz_reset_tx_done_int),
  219:         .gtwiz_reset_rx_done_out            (gtwiz_reset_rx_done_int),
  220:         .gtwiz_userdata_tx_in               (gth_userdata_tx_mux),
  221:         .gtwiz_userdata_rx_out              (gt_rxdata_out),
  222:         .gtrefclk00_in                      (gtrefclk00_int),
  223:         .qpll0outclk_out                    (),
  224:         .qpll0outrefclk_out                 (),
  225:         .gthrxn_in                          (rxn_in),
  226:         .gthrxp_in                          (rxp_in),
  227:         .rxgearboxslip_in                   (gt_rxgearboxslip_in),
  228:         .rxusrclk_in                        (rx0_clk),
  229:         .rxusrclk2_in                       (rx0_clk),
  230:         .txheader_in                        (gt_txheader_in),
  231:         .txsequence_in                      (gt_txsequence_in),
  232:         .txusrclk_in                        (tx0_clk),
  233:         .txusrclk2_in                       (tx0_clk),

    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Description  : Top Module for FSO Header Path.
    7:                Instantiates the Header Generator and FSO CRC-16.
    8:                Outputs a clean, sequential 16-Byte Header stream.
    9: ===========================================================================
   10: */
   11: 
   12: module fso_header_top (
   13:     input  wire        clk,
   14:     input  wire        rst_n,
   15:     input  wire        trigger_header_gen,
   16: 
   17:     // Dynamic ARQ & Status Parameters
   18:     input  wire [15:0] txfn_in,
   19:     input  wire [15:0] rxfn_in,
   20:     input  wire        ack_in,
   21:     input  wire        ack_valid_in,
   22:     input  wire [1:0]  frame_type_in, 
   23:     
   24:     // Telemetry & Timing Inputs
   25:     input  wire [39:0] tx_ts_in,
   26:     input  wire [5:0]  tod_seconds_in,
   27:     input  wire [2:0]  ts_applies_in,
   28:     input  wire [3:0]  fcch_opcode_in,
   29:     input  wire [15:0] fcch_pl_in,
   30: 
   31:     // Serialized Output to CDC (8-bit @ 312.5 MHz)
   32:     output wire [7:0]  final_header_byte,
   33:     output wire        final_header_valid,
   34:     output wire        system_busy
   35: );
   36: 
   37:     wire [7:0] raw_header_byte;
   38:     wire       raw_header_en;
   39: 
   40:     // 1. Instantiate the Header Generator
   41:     header_generator u_header_gen (
   42:         .clk             (clk),
   43:         .rst_n           (rst_n),
   44:         .trigger_gen     (trigger_header_gen),
   45:         .txfn            (txfn_in),
   46:         .rxfn            (rxfn_in),
   47:         .ack             (ack_in),
   48:         .ack_valid       (ack_valid_in),
   49:         .frame_type      (frame_type_in),
   50:         .tx_ts           (tx_ts_in),
   51:         .tod_seconds     (tod_seconds_in),
   52:         .ts_applies      (ts_applies_in),
   53:         .fcch_opcode     (fcch_opcode_in),
   54:         .fcch_pl         (fcch_pl_in),
   55:         .header_byte_out (raw_header_byte),
   56:         .header_en_out   (raw_header_en),
   57:         .gen_busy        (system_busy)
   58:     );
   59: 
   60:     // 2. Instantiate the FSO CRC-16 (Irzal Zaini's Core)
   61:     fso_crc_16 #(.max(15)) u_crc_16 (
   62:         .clk      (clk),
   63:         .rst_n    (rst_n),

   65:         .data_in  (raw_header_byte),
   66:         .flag     (final_header_valid),

   68:     );
   69: 
   70: endmodule

Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Description  : SDA OISL IDLE Frame Generator.
    7:                Generates 1908 Bytes (475 words) of PRBS data payload.
    8:                As per SDA OISL Standard, the PRBS is seeded dynamically
    9:                using (TXFN + 1). Outputs AXI4-Stream directly to fso_crc_32.
   10:                
   11:                Self-contained capsule that integrates:
   12:                1. PRBS Generation Logic (1908 Bytes) seeded with TXFN + 1.
   13:                2. fso_crc_32.v Engine (Appends 4B CRC -> 1912 Bytes).
   14:                3. fso_axis_fifo.v (Buffers the fully assembled frame).
   15:                Provides a clean, ready-to-mux AXI4-Stream output.
   16: 
   17: Revision History:
   18:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 477-word (1908-Byte) IDLE payload generator with TXFN + 1 seed.
   19:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:09 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 5 - SDA OISL Page 31, Sec. 2.6.3.5.1.2]
   20:     Retained the (TXFN + 1) seed initialization and replaced the 32-bit CRC LFSR
   21:     (0x04C11DB7) with the exact same 25-bit PRBS generator polynomial (1 + D^3 + D^25)
   22:     used by the frame scrambler (scrambler.v Rev 2.00), unrolled 32 bits per cycle.
   23: ===========================================================================
   24: */
   25: 
   26: module fso_idle_generator (
   27:     input  wire        clk,
   28:     input  wire        rst_n,
   29: 
   30:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   31:     // Input from ARQ TX Controller
   32:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   33:     input  wire [15:0] txfn_in,
   34: 
   35:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   36:     // AXI-Stream Output (To fso_payload_mux.v)
   37:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   38:     output wire [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
   39:     output wire        m_axis_tvalid,
   40:     output wire        m_axis_tlast,
   41:     input  wire        m_axis_tready
   42: );
   43: 
   44:     localparam MAX_WORDS = 16'd477; // 1908 Bytes = 477 Words (32-bit)
   45:     
   46:     // =======================================================
   47:     // 1. CORE LOGIC: PRBS IDLE GENERATOR (1908 Bytes)
   48:     //    [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 04:09 KST] Uses 25-bit Frame Scrambler PRBS
   49:     //    seeded with (TXFN + 1) per SDA OISL Section 2.6.3.5.1.2 (Page 31).
   50:     // =======================================================
   51:     localparam S_IDLE = 1'b0, S_GENERATE = 1'b1;
   52:     reg state;
   53:     reg [15:0] word_cnt;
   54:     
   55:     reg  [24:0] lfsr_reg;
   56:     wire [24:0] seed_txfn_plus_1 = ({9'd0, txfn_in} + 25'd1);
   57: 
   58:     // 32-bit unrolled step of the 25-bit Frame Scrambler PRBS (1 + D^3 + D^25)
   59:     function [56:0] step_prbs25_32(input [24:0] q_in);
   60:         reg [24:0] sr;
   61:         reg [31:0] w_out;
   62:         reg        fb;
   63:         integer    k;
   64:         begin
   65:             sr = (q_in == 25'd0) ? 25'h0000007 : q_in;
   66:             for (k = 0; k < 32; k = k + 1) begin
   67:                 w_out[31 - k] = sr[0];
   68:                 fb            = sr[0] ^ sr[3];
   69:                 sr            = {fb, sr[24:1]};
   70:             end
   71:             step_prbs25_32 = {sr, w_out};
   72:         end
   73:     endfunction
   74: 
   75:     wire [56:0] prbs_init_step = step_prbs25_32(seed_txfn_plus_1);
   76:     wire [24:0] lfsr_init_next = prbs_init_step[56:32];
   77:     wire [31:0] prbs_init_word = prbs_init_step[31:0];
   78: 
   79:     wire [56:0] prbs_cont_step = step_prbs25_32(lfsr_reg);
   80:     wire [24:0] lfsr_next      = prbs_cont_step[56:32];
   81:     wire [31:0] prbs_cont_word = prbs_cont_step[31:0];
   82: 
   83:     reg  [31:0] raw_tdata;
   84:     reg         raw_tvalid;
   85:     reg         raw_tlast;
   86:     wire        raw_tready;
   87: 
   88:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   89:         if (!rst_n) begin
   90:             state      <= S_IDLE;
   91:             word_cnt   <= 16'd0;
   92:             lfsr_reg   <= 25'h0000001;
   93:             raw_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   94:             raw_tlast  <= 1'b0;
   95:             raw_tdata  <= 32'd0;
   96:         end else begin
   97:             case (state)
   98:                 S_IDLE: begin
   99:                     // Wait until the internal CRC engine is ready to accept data
  100:                     if (raw_tready) begin
  101:                         state      <= S_GENERATE;
  102:                         word_cnt   <= 16'd0;
  103:                         raw_tvalid <= 1'b1;
  104:                         // SDA OISL Std: Seed 25-bit Scrambler PRBS with TXFN + 1
  105:                         lfsr_reg   <= lfsr_init_next; 
  106:                         raw_tdata  <= prbs_init_word;
  107:                         raw_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  108:                     end else begin
  109:                         raw_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  110:                         raw_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  111:                     end
  112:                 end
  113: 
  114:                 S_GENERATE: begin
  115:                     if (raw_tready) begin
  116:                         raw_tvalid <= 1'b1;
  117:                         
  118:                         if (word_cnt == MAX_WORDS - 2) begin
  119:                             // End of frame marker before CRC (Index 475)
  120:                             raw_tlast <= 1'b1;
  121:                             word_cnt  <= word_cnt + 1'b1;
  122:                             raw_tdata <= prbs_cont_word;
  123:                             lfsr_reg  <= lfsr_next;
  124:                             
  125:                         end else if (word_cnt == MAX_WORDS - 1) begin
  126:                             // ZERO-FRAME GAP
  127:                             // Without returning to S_IDLE
  128:                             raw_tlast <= 1'b0;
  129:                             word_cnt  <= 16'd0;
  130:                             
  131:                             // Inject new (TXFN+1) seeded 25-bit PRBS word
  132:                             raw_tdata <= prbs_init_word;
  133:                             lfsr_reg  <= lfsr_init_next;
  134:                             
  135:                         end else begin
  136:                             // Normal 25-bit PRBS continuation
  137:                             raw_tlast <= 1'b0;
  138:                             word_cnt  <= word_cnt + 1'b1;
  139:                             raw_tdata <= prbs_cont_word;
  140:                             lfsr_reg  <= lfsr_next;
  141:                         end
  142:                     end
  143:                 end
  144:             endcase
  145:         end
  146:     end
  147: 
  148:     // =======================================================
  149:     // 2. FSO CRC-32 ENGINE (1908B -> 1912B)
  150:     // =======================================================
  151:     wire [31:0] crc_tdata;
  152:     wire        crc_tvalid;
  153:     wire        crc_tlast;
  154:     wire        crc_tready;
  155: 
  156:     fso_crc_32 u_fso_crc_32_idle (
  157:         .clk             (clk),
  158:         .rst_n           (rst_n),
  159:         .s_axis_tdata    (raw_tdata),
  160:         .s_axis_tvalid   (raw_tvalid),
  161:         .s_axis_tlast    (raw_tlast),
  162:         .s_axis_tready   (raw_tready),
  163:         .m_axis_tdata    (crc_tdata),
  164:         .m_axis_tvalid   (crc_tvalid),
  165:         .m_axis_tlast    (crc_tlast),
  166:         .m_axis_tready   (crc_tready)
  167:     );
  168: 
  169:     // =======================================================
  170:     // 3. FIFO BUFFER (Output Queue)
  171:     // =======================================================
  172:     fso_axis_fifo #(.FIFO_DEPTH(512), .ADDR_WIDTH(9)) u_fifo_idle (
  173:         .clk             (clk),
  174:         .rst_n           (rst_n),
  175:         .s_axis_tdata    (crc_tdata),
  176:         .s_axis_tvalid   (crc_tvalid),
  177:         .s_axis_tlast    (crc_tlast),
  178:         .s_axis_tready   (crc_tready),
  179:         .m_axis_tdata    (m_axis_tdata),
  180:         .m_axis_tvalid   (m_axis_tvalid),
  181:         .m_axis_tlast    (m_axis_tlast),
  182:         .m_axis_tready   (m_axis_tready)
  183:     );
  184: 
  185: endmodule

Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Description  : SDA OISL FSO Payload Encapsulation Engine.
    7:                Appends FSO Payload Header (0xAB) and FSO Packet Header (0xCDEF)
    8:                to the incoming 1900-Byte segmented Ethernet payload.
    9:                Output geometrically guaranteed to be exactly 1908 Bytes 
   10:                (477 clock cycles) as dictated by SDA OISL Figure 2-17.
   11:                
   12:                Acts as the primary encapsulation container for Ethernet data.
   13:                Internal Operations:
   14:                1. Injects FSO Payload & Packet Headers (1900B -> 1908B).
   15:                2. Computes and appends CRC-32 (1908B -> 1912B) via fso_crc_32.
   16:                3. Sniffs and stores the 1912B frame into ARQ_DDR4_WRAPPER.
   17:                4. Buffers the 1912B frame into fifo_data.
   18:                Outputs both the normal data stream and the ARQ retx stream.
   19: 
   20: Revision History:
   21:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : FSO Payload (0xAB) & Packet (0xCDEF) Header injector + CRC-32 + FIFO.
   22:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:34 KST) : [Target B6.2 - SDA OISL Page 43-45, Table 2-18]
   23:     Populated the 14-bit 'Length' fields in Table 2-18 and added strict Table 2-18 
   24:     continuation formatting (no duplicate 0xCDEF header).
   25:   - Rev 2.1 (2026-10-28 13:56 KST) : [Internal Audit Fix #5 - Dynamic Ingress Length & Zero-Data Safety]
   26:     1. Added 'seg_valid_bytes' metadata input from packaging_and_segmentation.v 
   27:        so that any Ethernet packet size (e.g., 64B Mini, 512B Standard, 1500B MTU, 
   28:        or 2000B Jumbo) is dynamically written into the FSO Packet Header (0xCDEF) 
   29:        and FSO Payload Header (0xAB) Length[13:0] fields.
   30:     2. Completely removed 's_axis_eth_tdata != 32'd0' from the continuation 
   31:        decision! Continuation is now determined strictly from the latched packet 
   32:        length metadata (latched_pkt_bytes > 14'd1900), ensuring that Ethernet 
   33:        payload words containing all zeros (32'h0000_0000) are preserved 100% as 
   34:        valid data.
   35: ===========================================================================
   36: */
   37: 
   38: module fso_payload #(
   39:     parameter [13:0] DEFAULT_ETH_PKT_BYTES = 14'd2000, // Fallback only if seg_valid_bytes is unconnected (0)
   40:     parameter        CONT_NO_PKT_HDR_EN    = 1         // 1 = Strict Table 2-18 Continuation (No duplicate 0xCDEF)
   41: )(
   42:     input  wire        clk,
   43:     input  wire        rst_n,
   44: 
   45:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   46:     // Interface from XGMII Front-End (packaging_and_segmentation.v)
   47:     // Expected: 1900 Bytes + Dynamic Ingress Length Metadata
   48:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   49:     input  wire [31:0] s_axis_eth_tdata,
   50:     input  wire        s_axis_eth_tvalid,
   51:     input  wire        s_axis_eth_tlast,
   52:     output reg         s_axis_eth_tready, // correction: change to reg
   53:     input  wire [10:0] seg_valid_bytes,   // [Rev 2.1] Dynamic packet/segment byte count from segmenter
   54: 
   55:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   56:     // ARQ Control Interfaces (from arq_tx_controller.v)
   57:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   58:     input  wire        ddr4_write_req,
   59:     input  wire        ddr4_read_req,
   60:     input  wire        ddr4_delete_req,
   61:     input  wire [15:0] ddr4_addr,
   62: 
   63:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   64:     // AXI-Stream Outputs to fso_payload_mux.v
   65:     // Output: 1912 Bytes (Both Data and Retransmit paths)
   66:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   67:     output wire [31:0] m_axis_data_tdata,
   68:     output wire        m_axis_data_tvalid,
   69:     output wire        m_axis_data_tlast,
   70:     input  wire        m_axis_data_tready,
   71: 
   72:     output wire [31:0] m_axis_retx_tdata,
   73:     output wire        m_axis_retx_tvalid,
   74:     output wire        m_axis_retx_tlast,
   75:     input  wire        m_axis_retx_tready
   76: );
   77: 
   78:     // =======================================================
   79:     // 1. INJECTOR FSM: Append FSO Headers (1900B -> 1908B)
   80:     // =======================================================
   81:     localparam S_IDLE     = 3'd0,
   82:                S_HDR1     = 3'd1,
   83:                S_HDR2     = 3'd2,
   84:                S_DATA     = 3'd3,
   85:                S_CONT_PAD = 3'd4;
   86:     
   87:     reg [2:0]  state, next_state;
   88:     reg [9:0]  seq_num;
   89:     reg        in_continuation;
   90:     reg [13:0] cont_rem_bytes;
   91:     reg [13:0] latched_pkt_bytes;
   92: 
   93:     // Resolve active ingress packet length (uses seg_valid_bytes if connected & > 0, else DEFAULT_ETH_PKT_BYTES)
   94:     wire        meta_valid        = (^seg_valid_bytes !== 1'bx) && (seg_valid_bytes != 11'd0);
   95:     wire [13:0] live_pkt_bytes    = meta_valid ? {3'd0, seg_valid_bytes} : DEFAULT_ETH_PKT_BYTES;
   96: 
   97:     // Internal wires connecting Injector -> CRC
   98:     reg  [31:0] inj_tdata;
   99:     reg         inj_tvalid;
  100:     reg         inj_tlast;
  101:     wire        inj_tready;
  102: 
  103:     wire [13:0] pld_hdr_len_field = in_continuation ? cont_rem_bytes : 14'd0;
  104:     wire [13:0] pkt_hdr_len_field = latched_pkt_bytes;
  105: 
  106:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  107:         if (!rst_n) begin
  108:             state             <= S_IDLE;
  109:             seq_num           <= 10'd0;
  110:             in_continuation   <= 1'b0;
  111:             cont_rem_bytes    <= 14'd0;
  112:             latched_pkt_bytes <= DEFAULT_ETH_PKT_BYTES;
  113:         end else begin
  114:             state <= next_state;
  115: 
  116:             // Latch exact ingress packet length at the start of the frame (S_IDLE -> S_HDR1)
  117:             if ((state == S_IDLE && s_axis_eth_tvalid) || (state == S_HDR1 && !in_continuation)) begin
  118:                 latched_pkt_bytes <= live_pkt_bytes;
  119:             end
  120: 
  121:             if (state == S_DATA && s_axis_eth_tvalid && s_axis_eth_tready) begin
  122:                 if (s_axis_eth_tlast) begin
  123:                     // [Rev 2.1] Continuation is determined purely from packet length metadata
  124:                     // (latched_pkt_bytes > 14'd1900), never from (s_axis_eth_tdata != 32'd0)!
  125:                     if (!in_continuation && (latched_pkt_bytes > 14'd1900)) begin
  126:                         in_continuation <= 1'b1;
  127:                         cont_rem_bytes  <= latched_pkt_bytes - 14'd1900;
  128:                     end else begin
  129:                         in_continuation <= 1'b0;
  130:                         cont_rem_bytes  <= 14'd0;
  131:                     end
  132: 
  133:                     if (!(CONT_NO_PKT_HDR_EN && in_continuation)) begin
  134:                         seq_num <= seq_num + 10'd1;
  135:                     end
  136:                 end
  137:             end else if (state == S_CONT_PAD && inj_tready) begin
  138:                 seq_num <= seq_num + 10'd1;
  139:             end
  140:         end
  141:     end
  142: 
  143:     always @(*) begin
  144:         next_state        = state;
  145:         s_axis_eth_tready = 1'b0;
  146:         inj_tvalid        = 1'b0;
  147:         inj_tlast         = 1'b0;
  148:         inj_tdata         = 32'd0;
  149: 
  150:         case (state)
  151:             S_IDLE: begin
  152:                 if (s_axis_eth_tvalid) next_state = S_HDR1;
  153:             end
  154:             S_HDR1: begin
  155:                 inj_tvalid = 1'b1;
  156:                 // [Rev 2.0/2.1] Table 2-18 FSO Payload Header: {0xAB, seq_num[9:0], Length[13:0]}
  157:                 inj_tdata  = {8'hAB, seq_num, pld_hdr_len_field};
  158:                 if (inj_tready) begin
  159:                     if (CONT_NO_PKT_HDR_EN && in_continuation)
  160:                         next_state = S_DATA; // Table 2-18 Continuation: skip duplicate 0xCDEF header
  161:                     else
  162:                         next_state = S_HDR2;
  163:                 end
  164:             end
  165:             S_HDR2: begin
  166:                 inj_tvalid = 1'b1;
  167:                 // [Rev 2.0/2.1] Table 2-18 FSO Packet Header: {0xCDEF, 2'b00, Length[13:0]}
  168:                 inj_tdata  = {16'hCDEF, 2'b00, pkt_hdr_len_field};
  169:                 if (inj_tready) next_state = S_DATA;
  170:             end
  171:             S_DATA: begin
  172:                 inj_tvalid        = s_axis_eth_tvalid;
  173:                 inj_tdata         = s_axis_eth_tdata;
  174:                 s_axis_eth_tready = inj_tready;
  175: 
  176:                 if (CONT_NO_PKT_HDR_EN && in_continuation) begin
  177:                     // Suppress tlast on the 475th word so S_CONT_PAD appends the 476th word (1804th pad byte)
  178:                     inj_tlast = 1'b0;
  179:                     if (s_axis_eth_tvalid && inj_tready && s_axis_eth_tlast) begin
  180:                         next_state = S_CONT_PAD;
  181:                     end
  182:                 end else begin
  183:                     inj_tlast = s_axis_eth_tlast;
  184:                     if (s_axis_eth_tvalid && inj_tready && s_axis_eth_tlast) begin
  185:                         next_state = S_IDLE;
  186:                     end
  187:                 end
  188:             end
  189:             S_CONT_PAD: begin
  190:                 // Appends the 451st zero-pad word (1804th zero-pad byte) so total frame = 477 words (1908 Bytes)
  191:                 inj_tvalid = 1'b1;
  192:                 inj_tdata  = 32'd0;
  193:                 inj_tlast  = 1'b1;
  194:                 if (inj_tready) begin
  195:                     next_state = S_IDLE;
  196:                 end
  197:             end
  198:             default: next_state = S_IDLE;
  199:         endcase
  200:     end
  201: 
  202:     // =======================================================
  203:     // 2. FSO CRC-32 ENGINE (1908B -> 1912B)
  204:     // =======================================================
  205:     wire [31:0] crc_tdata;
  206:     wire        crc_tvalid;
  207:     wire        crc_tlast;
  208:     wire        crc_tready;
  209: 
  210:     fso_crc_32 u_fso_crc_32 (
  211:         .clk             (clk),
  212:         .rst_n           (rst_n),
  213:         .s_axis_tdata    (inj_tdata),
  214:         .s_axis_tvalid   (inj_tvalid),
  215:         .s_axis_tlast    (inj_tlast),
  216:         .s_axis_tready   (inj_tready),
  217:         .m_axis_tdata    (crc_tdata),
  218:         .m_axis_tvalid   (crc_tvalid),
  219:         .m_axis_tlast    (crc_tlast),
  220:         .m_axis_tready   (crc_tready)
  221:     );
  222: 
  223:     // =======================================================
  224:     // 3. FIFO DATA BUFFER (Primary Output Path)
  225:     // =======================================================
  226:     fso_axis_fifo #(.FIFO_DEPTH(1024), .ADDR_WIDTH(10)) fifo_data (
  227:         .clk             (clk),
  228:         .rst_n           (rst_n),
  229:         .s_axis_tdata    (crc_tdata),
  230:         .s_axis_tvalid   (crc_tvalid),
  231:         .s_axis_tlast    (crc_tlast),
  232:         .s_axis_tready   (crc_tready),
  233:         .m_axis_tdata    (m_axis_data_tdata),
  234:         .m_axis_tvalid   (m_axis_data_tvalid),
  235:         .m_axis_tlast    (m_axis_data_tlast),
  236:         .m_axis_tready   (m_axis_data_tready)
  237:     );
  238: 
  239:     // =======================================================
  240:     // 4. ARQ DDR4 WRAPPER (Retransmit Path)
  241:     // Sniffs the output of CRC-32 silently.
  242:     // =======================================================
  243:     arq_ddr4_wrapper u_arq_ddr4_wrapper (
  244:         .clk             (clk),
  245:         .rst_n           (rst_n),
  246:         .ddr4_write_req  (ddr4_write_req),
  247:         .ddr4_read_req   (ddr4_read_req),
  248:         .ddr4_delete_req (ddr4_delete_req),
  249:         .ddr4_addr       (ddr4_addr),
  250:         
  251:         // Sniffing CRC Data
  252:         .s_axis_tdata    (crc_tdata),
  253:         .s_axis_tvalid   (crc_tvalid),
  254:         .s_axis_tlast    (crc_tlast),
  255:         .s_axis_tready   (crc_tready),
  256:         
  257:         // Retransmit Output to MUX
  258:         .m_axis_tdata    (m_axis_retx_tdata),
  259:         .m_axis_tvalid   (m_axis_retx_tvalid),
  260:         .m_axis_tlast    (m_axis_retx_tlast),
  261:         .m_axis_tready   (m_axis_retx_tready)
  262:     );
  263: 
  264: endmodule

    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Description  : FSO Payload Combinational Multiplexer.
    7:                Acts as the Arbi traffic router before CDC and FEC.
    8:                Selects between 4 AXI-Stream inputs based on payload_mux_sel:
    9:                00 = IDLE FIFO
   10:                01 = DATA FIFO
   11:                10 = MGMT FIFO
   12:                11 = ARQ DDR4 Retransmit RAM
   13:                Zero-latency combinational routing.
   14: ===========================================================================
   15: */
   16: 
   17: module fso_payload_mux (
   18:     // Control Signal from ARQ TX Controller
   19:     input  wire [1:0]  payload_mux_sel,
   20: 
   21:     // Input 0: IDLE FIFO (00)
   22:     input  wire [31:0] s_idle_tdata,
   23:     input  wire        s_idle_tvalid,
   24:     input  wire        s_idle_tlast,
   25:     output wire        s_idle_tready,
   26: 
   27:     // Input 1: DATA FIFO (01)
   28:     input  wire [31:0] s_data_tdata,
   29:     input  wire        s_data_tvalid,
   30:     input  wire        s_data_tlast,
   31:     output wire        s_data_tready,
   32: 
   33:     // Input 2: MGMT FIFO (10)
   34:     input  wire [31:0] s_mgmt_tdata,
   35:     input  wire        s_mgmt_tvalid,
   36:     input  wire        s_mgmt_tlast,
   37:     output wire        s_mgmt_tready,
   38: 
   39:     // Input 3: ARQ Retransmit RAM (11)
   40:     input  wire [31:0] s_retx_tdata,
   41:     input  wire        s_retx_tvalid,
   42:     input  wire        s_retx_tlast,
   43:     output wire        s_retx_tready,
   44: 
   45:     // Output: To x_gth_logic.v (CDC)
   46:     output wire [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
   47:     output wire        m_axis_tvalid,
   48:     output wire        m_axis_tlast,
   49:     input  wire        m_axis_tready
   50: );
   51: 
   52:     // =======================================================
   53:     // Combinational Routing for Downstream Data (tdata, tvalid, tlast)
   54:     // =======================================================
   55:     assign m_axis_tdata  = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b00) ? s_idle_tdata  :
   56:                            (payload_mux_sel == 2'b01) ? s_data_tdata  :
   57:                            (payload_mux_sel == 2'b10) ? s_mgmt_tdata  :
   58:                                                         s_retx_tdata;
   59: 
   60:     assign m_axis_tvalid = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b00) ? s_idle_tvalid :
   61:                            (payload_mux_sel == 2'b01) ? s_data_tvalid :
   62:                            (payload_mux_sel == 2'b10) ? s_mgmt_tvalid :
   63:                                                         s_retx_tvalid;
   64: 
   65:     assign m_axis_tlast  = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b00) ? s_idle_tlast  :
   66:                            (payload_mux_sel == 2'b01) ? s_data_tlast  :
   67:                            (payload_mux_sel == 2'b10) ? s_mgmt_tlast  :
   68:                                                         s_retx_tlast;
   69: 
   70:     // =======================================================
   71:     // Combinational Routing for Upstream Flow Control (tready)
   72:     // Only the selected path receives the true tready from CDC.
   73:     // Unselected paths are stalled (tready = 0).
   74:     // =======================================================
   75:     assign s_idle_tready = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b00) ? m_axis_tready : 1'b0;
   76:     assign s_data_tready = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b01) ? m_axis_tready : 1'b0;
   77:     assign s_mgmt_tready = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b10) ? m_axis_tready : 1'b0;
   78:     assign s_retx_tready = (payload_mux_sel == 2'b11) ? m_axis_tready : 1'b0;
   79: 
   80: endmodule

    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Description  : FSO Payload Top Subsystem.
    7:                Integrates:
    8:                1. fso_payload.v (DATA encapsulation + CRC-32 + ARQ DDR4 RAM)
    9:                2. fso_idle_generator.v (25-bit PRBS IDLE payload + CRC-32)
   10:                3. mgmt_telemetry_generator.v (Table 2-14 PNT payload + CRC-32)
   11:                4. fso_payload_mux.v (4-to-1 AXI-Stream Payload Multiplexer)
   12: 
   13: Revision History:
   14:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 1912-Byte Payload Top subsystem integration.
   15:   - Rev 2.1 (2026-10-28 13:56 KST) : [Internal Audit Fix #5]
   16:     Forwarded 'seg_valid_bytes [10:0]' from upstream segmenter to u_fso_payload
   17:     for dynamic Ethernet packet length encapsulation.
   18: ===========================================================================
   19: */
   20: 
   21: module fso_payload_top (
   22:     input  wire        clk,
   23:     input  wire        rst_n,
   24: 
   25:     // Ethernet Segment Input from packaging_and_segmentation
   26:     input  wire [31:0] s_axis_eth_tdata,

   28:     input  wire        s_axis_eth_tlast,

   37:     input  wire        ddr4_delete_req,
   38:     input  wire [15:0] ddr4_addr,

   46:     input  wire [63:0] range_meters,
   47:     input  wire [31:0] range_ts_sec,
   48:     input  wire [39:0] range_ts_picosec,
   49:     input  wire        ts_valid,
   50: 
   51:     // Final Arbitrated 1912-Byte Payload Output to CDC 1
   52:     output wire [31:0] m_axis_fso_tdata,
   53:     output wire        m_axis_fso_tvalid,
   54:     output wire        m_axis_fso_tlast,
   55:     input  wire        m_axis_fso_tready
   56: );
   57: 
   58:     wire [31:0] idle_tdata;
   59:     wire        idle_tvalid, idle_tlast, idle_tready;
   60: 
   61:     wire [31:0] data_tdata;
   62:     wire        data_tvalid, data_tlast, data_tready;
   63: 
   64:     wire [31:0] mgmt_tdata;
   65:     wire        mgmt_tvalid, mgmt_tlast, mgmt_tready;
   66: 
   67:     wire [31:0] retx_tdata;
   68:     wire        retx_tvalid, retx_tlast, retx_tready;
   69: 
   70:     // 1. Path 00: IDLE Payload Capsule (1912 Bytes)
   71:     fso_idle_generator u_fso_idle_generator (
   72:         .clk           (clk),
   73:         .rst_n         (rst_n),
   74:         .txfn_in       (txfn_in),
   75:         .m_axis_tdata  (idle_tdata),
   76:         .m_axis_tvalid (idle_tvalid),
   77:         .m_axis_tlast  (idle_tlast),
   78:         .m_axis_tready (idle_tready)
   79:     );
   80: 
   81:     // 2. Path 01 & 11: DATA Encapsulation & ARQ Retransmit Capsule (1912 Bytes)
   82:     fso_payload u_fso_payload (
   83:         .clk                (clk),
   84:         .rst_n              (rst_n),
   85:         .s_axis_eth_tdata   (s_axis_eth_tdata),
   86:         .s_axis_eth_tvalid  (s_axis_eth_tvalid),
   87:         .s_axis_eth_tlast   (s_axis_eth_tlast),
   88:         .s_axis_eth_tready  (s_axis_eth_tready),
   89:         .seg_valid_bytes    (seg_valid_bytes),
   90:         .ddr4_write_req     (ddr4_write_req),
   91:         .ddr4_read_req      (ddr4_read_req),
   92:         .ddr4_delete_req    (ddr4_delete_req),
   93:         .ddr4_addr          (ddr4_addr),
   94:         .m_axis_data_tdata  (data_tdata),
   95:         .m_axis_data_tvalid (data_tvalid),
   96:         .m_axis_data_tlast  (data_tlast),
   97:         .m_axis_data_tready (data_tready),
   98:         .m_axis_retx_tdata  (retx_tdata),
   99:         .m_axis_retx_tvalid (retx_tvalid),
  100:         .m_axis_retx_tlast  (retx_tlast),
  101:         .m_axis_retx_tready (retx_tready)
  102:     );
  103: 
  104:     // 3. Path 10: MGMT / PNT Telemetry Capsule (1912 Bytes)
  105:     mgmt_telemetry_generator u_mgmt_telemetry_generator (
  106:         .clk               (clk),
  107:         .rst_n             (rst_n),
  108:         .mgmt_trigger_1hz  (mgmt_trigger_1hz),
  109:         .rx_phy_ts_sec     (rx_phy_ts_sec),
  110:         .rx_phy_ts_picosec (rx_phy_ts_picosec),
  111:         .tx_phy_ts_sec     (tx_phy_ts_sec),
  112:         .tx_phy_ts_picosec (tx_phy_ts_picosec),
  113:         .range_meters      (range_meters),

  115:         .range_ts_picosec  (range_ts_picosec),
  116:         .ts_valid          (ts_valid),
  117:         .m_axis_tdata      (mgmt_tdata),
  118:         .m_axis_tvalid     (mgmt_tvalid),
  119:         .m_axis_tlast      (mgmt_tlast),
  120:         .m_axis_tready     (mgmt_tready)
  121:     );
  122: 
  123:     // 4. 4-to-1 Payload Stream Multiplexer
  124:     fso_payload_mux u_fso_payload_mux (
  125:         .payload_mux_sel (payload_mux_sel),
  126:         .s_idle_tdata    (idle_tdata),
  127:         .s_idle_tvalid   (idle_tvalid),

  136:         .s_mgmt_tlast    (mgmt_tlast),
  137:         .s_mgmt_tready   (mgmt_tready),
  138:         .s_retx_tdata    (retx_tdata),
  139:         .s_retx_tvalid   (retx_tvalid),
  140:         .s_retx_tlast    (retx_tlast),
  141:         .s_retx_tready   (retx_tready),
  142:         .m_axis_tdata    (m_axis_fso_tdata),
  143:         .m_axis_tvalid   (m_axis_fso_tvalid),
  144:         .m_axis_tlast    (m_axis_fso_tlast),
  145:         .m_axis_tready   (m_axis_fso_tready)
  146:     );
