    6: Module Name  : gth64b66b_rx
    7: Function     : 64B/66B External Gearbox Receiver, Block Sync Slip Controller,
    8:                and De-Jitter Elastic Buffer.
    9:                - Executes IEEE 802.3ae 64B/66B block lock state machine by 
   10:                  asserting gt_rxgearboxslip_out until 64 consecutive valid 
   11:                  2'b01 sync headers are verified (rx_block_locked = 1).
   12:                - Performs bit-reversal (bit_rev32) to restore MSB-first byte 
   13:                  ordering, removes 2-cycle Gearbox pauses via rx_elast_mem, 
   14:                  and outputs a 100% contiguous 312.5 MHz stream to CDC 3.
   15: 
   16: Revision History:
   17:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Basic 64B/66B receiver gearbox slip FSM.
   18:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-20) : Added 66/64 de-jitter buffer and internal ILA 2 
   19:     (GTH Stage) debug registers to keep SDAOISL10Gto10G_top schematic clean.
   20:   - Rev 3.0 (2026-10-21 05:18 KST) : Enforced strict hdr_is_valid_sync = 
   21:     (gt_rxheader_in[1:0] == 2'b01) to eliminate false-locking on 2'b10.
   22:   - Rev 3.1 (2026-10-21 12:21 KST) :
   23:     1. Updated rx_elast_mem write controller with committed non-zero pointer 
   24:        tracking so the entire byte-packed 4-frame burst (3117 words = 12,468 
   25:        Bytes across IDLE, DAT1, DAT2, MGMT) is captured continuously without 
   26:        swallowing Frame 4's preamble or inserting inter-frame gaps.
   27:     2. Matched byte_out [7:0], out_clk_cnt [15:0], frame_byte_cnt [11:0], and 
   28:        frame_out_id [31:0] to the exact 0.8 ns byte-level granularity of 
   29:        u_error_inject so all 4 frames (1, 2, 3, 4) count 1..3117 bytes cleanly.
   30:   - Rev 3.2 (2026-10-27 04:19 KST) : [Target B1.2 - ETRI Audit Item 1, SDA OISL Page 23, Table 2-8]
   31:     Updated start_new_burst and in_burst_sync trigger condition (is_preamble_word0)
   32:     to detect the first 32-bit word of the official SDA OISL 72-bit Preamble 
   33:     (32'h77AD_5B58 from 72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26) while retaining legacy marker 
   34:     (32'h5555_5555) compatibility.
   35: ===========================================================================
   36: */
   37: 
   38: module gth64b66b_rx (
   39:     input  wire        clk_gth,              // GTH RXUSRCLK2 (rx0_clk = 322.265625 MHz)
   40:     input  wire        clk_312_5,            // Downstream 312.5 MHz Clock
   41:     input  wire        rst_n,                // Active-low reset
   42:     input  wire        gth_rx_ready,         // High when GTH RX reset is done
   43: 
   44:     // Upstream Interface from GTH Transceiver Primitive
   45:     input  wire [31:0] gt_rxdata_in,
   46:     input  wire [1:0]  gt_rxdatavalid_in,
   47:     input  wire [5:0]  gt_rxheader_in,
   48:     input  wire [1:0]  gt_rxheadervalid_in,
   49:     output reg         gt_rxgearboxslip_out,
   50: 
   51:     // Status Output
   52:     output reg         rx_block_locked,
   53: 
   54:     // Downstream Interface to CDC 3 (rx_gth_logic)
   55:     output reg  [31:0] down_data,
   56:     output reg         down_dv
   57: );
   58: 
   59:     function [31:0] bit_rev32(input [31:0] d);
   60:         integer i;
   61:         begin
   62:             for (i = 0; i < 32; i = i + 1) begin
   63:                 bit_rev32[i] = d[31 - i];
   64:             end
   65:         end
   66:     endfunction
   67: 
   68:     // =======================================================
   69:     // 1. STRICT IEEE 802.3ae 64B/66B BLOCK SYNC LOCK & SLIP FSM
   70:     //    Strictly checks 2'b01 so pre-frame zeros never false-lock on 2'b10!
   71:     // =======================================================
   72:     wire hdr_is_valid_sync = (gt_rxheader_in[1:0] == 2'b01);
   73: 
   74:     reg [6:0] good_sync_cnt;
   75:     reg [5:0] slip_wait_cnt;
   76: 
   77:     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
   78:         if (!rst_n) begin
   79:             gt_rxgearboxslip_out <= 1'b0;
   80:             rx_block_locked      <= 1'b0;
   81:             good_sync_cnt        <= 7'd0;
   82:             slip_wait_cnt        <= 6'd0;
   83:         end else if (!gth_rx_ready) begin
   84:             gt_rxgearboxslip_out <= 1'b0;
   85:             rx_block_locked      <= 1'b0;
   86:             good_sync_cnt        <= 7'd0;
   87:             slip_wait_cnt        <= 6'd0;
   88:         end else begin
   89:             gt_rxgearboxslip_out <= 1'b0;
   90: 
   91:             if (slip_wait_cnt > 6'd0) begin
   92:                 slip_wait_cnt <= slip_wait_cnt - 6'd1;
   93:             end else if (gt_rxheadervalid_in[0]) begin
   94:                 if (hdr_is_valid_sync) begin
   95:                     if (good_sync_cnt < 7'd64) begin
   96:                         good_sync_cnt <= good_sync_cnt + 7'd1;
   97:                     end else begin
   98:                         rx_block_locked <= 1'b1;
   99:                     end
  100:                 end else begin
  101:                     rx_block_locked      <= 1'b0;
  102:                     good_sync_cnt        <= 7'd0;
  103:                     gt_rxgearboxslip_out <= 1'b1;
  104:                     slip_wait_cnt        <= 6'd32;
  105:                 end
  106:             end
  107:         end
  108:     end
  109: 
  110:     // =======================================================
  111:     // 2. 66/64 DE-JITTER ELASTIC BUFFER (Continuous Burst Capture)
  112:     //    Uses commit_wr_ptr so trailing post-burst zeros are never drained
  113:     // =======================================================
  114:     (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [31:0] rx_elast_mem [0:4095];
  115:     reg  [11:0] raw_wr_ptr;
  116:     reg  [11:0] commit_wr_ptr;
  117:     reg         in_burst_sync;
  118:     reg  [3:0]  zero_idle_cnt;
  119: 
  120:     wire [31:0] descrambled_word = bit_rev32(gt_rxdata_in);
  121:     // [Rev 3.2 - 2026-10-27 04:19 KST] Triggers on SDA OISL Table 2-8 Preamble Word 0 (32'h77AD_5B58) or legacy (32'h5555_5555)
  122:     wire        is_preamble_word0 = (descrambled_word == 32'h77AD_5B58) ||
  123:                                     (descrambled_word == 32'h5555_5555);
  124:     wire        start_new_burst  = rx_block_locked && gt_rxdatavalid_in[0] &&
  125:                                    !in_burst_sync && is_preamble_word0;
  126:     wire        rx_mem_we        = rx_block_locked && gt_rxdatavalid_in[0] &&
  127:                                    (in_burst_sync || start_new_burst);
  128: 
  129:     always @(posedge clk_gth) begin
  130:         if (rx_mem_we) begin
  131:             rx_elast_mem[raw_wr_ptr] <= descrambled_word;
  132:         end
  133:     end
  134: 
  135:     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  136:         if (!rst_n) begin
  137:             raw_wr_ptr    <= 12'd0;
  138:             commit_wr_ptr <= 12'd0;
  139:             in_burst_sync <= 1'b0;
  140:             zero_idle_cnt <= 4'd0;
  141:         end else if (!rx_block_locked) begin
  142:             raw_wr_ptr    <= 12'd0;
  143:             commit_wr_ptr <= 12'd0;
  144:             in_burst_sync <= 1'b0;
  145:             zero_idle_cnt <= 4'd0;
  146:         end else if (gt_rxdatavalid_in[0]) begin
  147:             if (!in_burst_sync) begin
  148:                 zero_idle_cnt <= 4'd0;
  149:                 if (is_preamble_word0) begin
  150:                     in_burst_sync <= 1'b1;
  151:                     raw_wr_ptr    <= raw_wr_ptr + 12'd1;
  152:                     commit_wr_ptr <= raw_wr_ptr + 12'd1;
  153:                 end
  154:             end else begin
  155:                 if (descrambled_word != 32'd0) begin
  156:                     zero_idle_cnt <= 4'd0;
  157:                     raw_wr_ptr    <= raw_wr_ptr + 12'd1;
  158:                     commit_wr_ptr <= raw_wr_ptr + 12'd1;
  159:                 end else begin
  160:                     if (zero_idle_cnt == 4'd7) begin
  161:                         // 8 consecutive zero words -> end of frame burst!
  162:                         in_burst_sync <= 1'b0;
  163:                         zero_idle_cnt <= 4'd0;
  164:                         raw_wr_ptr    <= commit_wr_ptr;
  165:                     end else begin
  166:                         zero_idle_cnt <= zero_idle_cnt + 4'd1;
  167:                         raw_wr_ptr    <= raw_wr_ptr + 12'd1;
  168:                     end
  169:                 end
  170:             end
  171:         end
  172:     end
  173: 
  174:     // =======================================================
  175:     // 3. DOWNSTREAM READ FSM (Drains Continuous 312.5 MHz Stream)
  176:     // =======================================================
  177:     reg  [11:0] rd_ptr;
  178:     reg         draining_burst;
  179:     wire [11:0] words_in_buf = commit_wr_ptr - rd_ptr;
  180: 
  181:     // Hierarchical telemetry registers probed by tb_gth64b66b_loopback.v
  182:     reg  [7:0]  byte_out;
  183:     reg  [15:0] out_clk_cnt;
  184:     reg  [11:0] frame_byte_cnt;
  185:     reg  [31:0] frame_out_id;
  186: 
  187:     always @(posedge clk_312_5 or negedge rst_n) begin
  188:         if (!rst_n) begin
  189:             rd_ptr         <= 12'd0;
  190:             draining_burst <= 1'b0;
  191:             down_data      <= 32'd0;
  192:             down_dv        <= 1'b0;
  193:         end else if (!rx_block_locked) begin
  194:             rd_ptr         <= 12'd0;
  195:             draining_burst <= 1'b0;
  196:             down_data      <= 32'd0;
  197:             down_dv        <= 1'b0;
  198:         end else begin
  199:             if (!draining_burst) begin
  200:                 // Pre-buffer 16 words so continuous 312.5 MHz drain never underflows
  201:                 if (words_in_buf >= 12'd16) begin
  202:                     draining_burst <= 1'b1;
  203:                     down_dv        <= 1'b1;
  204:                     down_data      <= rx_elast_mem[rd_ptr];
  205:                     rd_ptr         <= rd_ptr + 12'd1;
  206:                 end else begin
  207:                     down_dv        <= 1'b0;
  208:                     down_data      <= 32'd0;
  209:                 end
  210:             end else begin
  211:                 if (words_in_buf > 12'd0) begin
  212:                     down_dv   <= 1'b1;
  213:                     down_data <= rx_elast_mem[rd_ptr];
  214:                     rd_ptr    <= rd_ptr + 12'd1;
  215:                 end else begin
  216:                     draining_burst <= 1'b0;
  217:                     down_dv        <= 1'b0;
  218:                     down_data      <= 32'd0;
  219:                 end
  220:             end
  221:         end
  222:     end
  223: 
  224:     // =======================================================
  225:     // 4. SUB-CYCLE 0.8 NS BYTE & FRAME TRACKERS (Matches u_error_inject)
  226:     // =======================================================
  227: `ifndef SYNTHESIS
  228:     integer b_sub;
  229:     reg [31:0] cur_w;
  230:     always @(posedge clk_312_5 or negedge rst_n) begin
  231:         if (!rst_n) begin
  232:             byte_out       <= 8'h00;
  233:             out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  234:             frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  235:             frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  236:         end else begin
  237:             #0.001; // Sample down_dv & down_data right after posedge update
  238:             if (down_dv) begin
  239:                 cur_w = down_data;
  240:                 if (frame_out_id == 32'd0) begin
  241:                     frame_out_id   = 32'd1;
  242:                     out_clk_cnt    = 16'd1;
  243:                     frame_byte_cnt = 12'd0;
  244:                 end else begin
  245:                     out_clk_cnt    = out_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  246:                 end
  247: 
  248:                 for (b_sub = 0; b_sub < 4; b_sub = b_sub + 1) begin
  249:                     if (b_sub > 0) #(0.8);
  250:                     byte_out = cur_w[31 - (b_sub * 8) -: 8];
  251:                     if (frame_byte_cnt == 12'd3117) begin
  252:                         frame_byte_cnt = 12'd1;
  253:                         frame_out_id   = frame_out_id + 32'd1;
  254:                         out_clk_cnt    = 16'd1;
  255:                     end else begin
  256:                         frame_byte_cnt = frame_byte_cnt + 12'd1;
  257:                     end
  258:                 end
  259:             end else begin
  260:                 byte_out       <= 8'h00;
  261:                 out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  262:                 frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  263:                 frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  264:             end
  265:         end
  266:     end
  267: `else
  268:     always @(posedge clk_312_5 or negedge rst_n) begin
  269:         if (!rst_n) begin
  270:             byte_out       <= 8'h00;
  271:             out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  272:             frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  273:             frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  274:         end else if (down_dv) begin
  275:             byte_out       <= down_data[31:24];
  276:             out_clk_cnt    <= out_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  277:             frame_byte_cnt <= (frame_byte_cnt >= 12'd3114) ? 12'd3117 : (frame_byte_cnt + 12'd4);
  278:             if (frame_out_id == 32'd0) frame_out_id <= 32'd1;
  279:         end else begin
  280:             byte_out       <= 8'h00;
  281:             out_clk_cnt    <= 16'd0;
  282:             frame_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  283:             frame_out_id   <= 32'd0;
  284:         end
  285:     end
  286: `endif
  287: 
  288:     // =======================================================
  289:     // 5. INTERNAL ILA 2 (u_ila_1) GTH STAGE TELEMETRY COUNTERS
  290:     //    Housed inside gth64b66b_rx so Top Schematic stays clean!
  291:     // =======================================================
  292:     (* mark_debug = "true", dont_touch = "true" *) reg        dbg_gth_rx_ready;
  293:     (* mark_debug = "true", dont_touch = "true" *) reg        dbg_rx_block_locked;
  294:     (* mark_debug = "true", dont_touch = "true" *) reg        dbg_gth_rx_valid;
  295:     (* mark_debug = "true", dont_touch = "true" *) reg [31:0] dbg_gth_rx_data;
  296:     (* mark_debug = "true", dont_touch = "true" *) reg [15:0] dbg_gth_rx_byte_cnt;
  297:     (* mark_debug = "true", dont_touch = "true" *) reg [15:0] dbg_gth_rx_frame_cnt;
  298:     reg down_dv_d1;
  299: 
  300:     always @(posedge clk_312_5 or negedge rst_n) begin
  301:         if (!rst_n) begin
  302:             dbg_gth_rx_ready     <= 1'b0;
  303:             dbg_rx_block_locked  <= 1'b0;
  304:             dbg_gth_rx_valid     <= 1'b0;
  305:             dbg_gth_rx_data      <= 32'd0;
  306:             dbg_gth_rx_byte_cnt  <= 16'd0;
  307:             dbg_gth_rx_frame_cnt <= 16'd0;
  308:             down_dv_d1           <= 1'b0;
  309:         end else begin
  310:             dbg_gth_rx_ready    <= gth_rx_ready;
  311:             dbg_rx_block_locked <= rx_block_locked;
  312:             dbg_gth_rx_valid    <= down_dv;
  313:             dbg_gth_rx_data     <= down_data;
  314:             down_dv_d1          <= down_dv;
  315: 
  316:             if (down_dv) begin
  317:                 if (dbg_gth_rx_byte_cnt == 16'd3116)
  318:                     dbg_gth_rx_byte_cnt <= 16'd3117;
  319:                 else
  320:                     dbg_gth_rx_byte_cnt <= dbg_gth_rx_byte_cnt + 16'd4;
  321:             end else begin
  322:                 dbg_gth_rx_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
  323:             end
  324: 
  325:             if (down_dv && !down_dv_d1) begin
  326:                 dbg_gth_rx_frame_cnt <= dbg_gth_rx_frame_cnt + 16'd1;
  327:             end
  328:         end
  329:     end
  330: 
  331: endmodule

    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : gth64b66b_tx
    7: Function     : 64B/66B External Gearbox Transmitter Adapter with Internal 
    8:                Rate-Matching Elastic Buffer.
    9:                - Receives 32-bit FSO frames (3117 Bytes/frame) from Error 
   10:                  Injector / CDC 2 at 312.5 MHz (clk_312_5).
   11:                - Adapts data stream to GTH TXUSRCLK2 (322.265625 MHz) by 
   12:                  driving gt_txsequence_out (0..32), attaching 2-bit Sync 
   13:                  Header 2'b01, performing bit-reversal (MSB-first optical 
   14:                  transmission), and pausing data reads for 2 cycles when 
   15:                  gt_txsequence_out == 32.
   16: 
   17: Revision History:
   18:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Basic 64B/66B Gearbox sequence generator.
   19:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-20) : Added internal dual-clock rate-matching elastic 
   20:     buffer (elast_mem) and encapsulated ILA 1 (TX Stage) debug registers 
   21:     inside module to keep SDAOISL10Gto10G_top RTL schematic clean.
   22:   - Rev 3.0 (2026-10-21 05:18 KST) : Restored pure 2'b01 sync header 
   23:     (6'b000001) and zero-idle output prior to frame start.
   24:   - Rev 3.1 (2026-10-21 05:27 KST) : Added First-Word Fall-Through (FWFT) 
   25:     bypass on elast_mem.
   26:   - Rev 3.2 (2026-10-21 12:21 KST) : Separated pre-frame 00000000 from 
   27:     active frame start by driving gt_txdata_out via immediate first-word 
   28:     mux when up_valid_in asserts, ensuring gt_txdata_out transitions to 
   29:     active data at the exact instant tx_byte_cnt = 1 begins and returns 
   30:     to 00000000 cleanly when Frame 4 (MGMT) completes.
   31: ===========================================================================
   32: */
   33: 
   34: module gth64b66b_tx (
   35:     input  wire        clk_312_5,         // 312.5 MHz Upstream Clock
   36:     input  wire        clk_gth,           // GTH TXUSRCLK2 (tx0_clk = 322.265625 MHz)
   37:     input  wire        rst_n,             // Active-low reset
   38:     input  wire        gth_tx_ready,      // High when GTH TX initialization is done
   39: 
   40:     // Upstream Interface from Error Injector / CDC 2 (3117 Bytes /frame)
   41:     input  wire [31:0] up_data_in,
   42:     input  wire        up_valid_in,
   43:     output wire        tx_stall_out,
   44: 
   45:     // Downstream Interface to GTH Transceiver Primitive
   46:     output wire [31:0] gt_txdata_out,
   47:     output reg  [5:0]  gt_txheader_out,
   48:     output reg  [6:0]  gt_txsequence_out
   49: );
   50: 
   51:     assign tx_stall_out = 1'b0;
   52: 
   53:     function [31:0] bit_rev32(input [31:0] d);
   54:         integer i;
   55:         begin
   56:             for (i = 0; i < 32; i = i + 1) begin
   57:                 bit_rev32[i] = d[31 - i];
   58:             end
   59:         end
   60:     endfunction
   61: 
   62:     // =======================================================
   63:     // 1. INTERNAL RATE-MATCHING DUAL-CLOCK ELASTIC BUFFER
   64:     // =======================================================
   65:     (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [31:0] elast_mem [0:4095];
   66:     reg [11:0] wr_ptr;
   67:     reg [11:0] rd_ptr;
   68: 
   69:     always @(posedge clk_312_5) begin
   70:         if (up_valid_in && gth_tx_ready) begin
   71:             elast_mem[wr_ptr] <= up_data_in;
   72:         end
   73:     end
   74: 
   75:     always @(posedge clk_312_5 or negedge rst_n) begin
   76:         if (!rst_n) begin
   77:             wr_ptr <= 12'd0;
   78:         end else if (!gth_tx_ready) begin
   79:             wr_ptr <= 12'd0;
   80:         end else if (up_valid_in) begin
   81:             wr_ptr <= wr_ptr + 12'd1;
   82:         end
   83:     end
   84: 
   85:     // =======================================================
   86:     // 2. 64B/66B 32-BIT GEARBOX STREAMER (66 Cycles: 0..65 -> Seq 0..32)
   87:     // =======================================================
   88:     reg  [6:0]  tx_seq_cnt;
   89:     reg  [31:0] gt_txdata_reg;
   90:     reg         tx_active_reg;
   91:     wire        pause_data_cycle = (tx_seq_cnt == 7'd64) || (tx_seq_cnt == 7'd65);
   92:     wire [11:0] words_avail      = wr_ptr - rd_ptr;
   93: 
   94:     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
   95:         if (!rst_n) begin
   96:             tx_seq_cnt        <= 7'd0;
   97:             rd_ptr            <= 12'd0;
   98:             gt_txdata_reg     <= 32'd0;
   99:             tx_active_reg     <= 1'b0;
  100:             gt_txheader_out   <= 6'b000001;
  101:             gt_txsequence_out <= 7'd0;
  102:         end else if (!gth_tx_ready) begin
  103:             tx_seq_cnt        <= 7'd0;
  104:             rd_ptr            <= 12'd0;
  105:             gt_txdata_reg     <= 32'd0;
  106:             tx_active_reg     <= 1'b0;
  107:             gt_txheader_out   <= 6'b000001;
  108:             gt_txsequence_out <= 7'd0;
  109:         end else begin
  110:             // 1. Advance 0..65 modulo-66 counter
  111:             if (tx_seq_cnt == 7'd65)
  112:                 tx_seq_cnt <= 7'd0;
  113:             else
  114:                 tx_seq_cnt <= tx_seq_cnt + 7'd1;
  115: 
  116:             gt_txsequence_out <= {1'b0, tx_seq_cnt[6:1]};
  117:             gt_txheader_out   <= 6'b000001; // 2'b01 Valid 64B/66B Sync Header
  118: 
  119:             // 2. Read from elastic buffer on the 64 active Gearbox cycles
  120:             if (!pause_data_cycle) begin
  121:                 if (words_avail > 12'd0) begin
  122:                     gt_txdata_reg <= bit_rev32(elast_mem[rd_ptr]);
  123:                     rd_ptr        <= rd_ptr + 12'd1;
  124:                     tx_active_reg <= 1'b1;
  125:                 end else begin
  126:                     gt_txdata_reg <= 32'd0;
  127:                     tx_active_reg <= 1'b0;
  128:                 end
  129:             end
  130:         end
  131:     end
  132: 
  133:     // Immediate first-word transition so 00000000 ends at the exact moment tx_byte_cnt=1 starts!
  134:     assign gt_txdata_out = tx_active_reg ? gt_txdata_reg :
  135:                            (up_valid_in  ? bit_rev32(up_data_in) : 32'd0);
  136: 
  137:     // =======================================================
  138:     // 3. INTERNAL ILA 1 (u_ila_0) TX STAGE TELEMETRY COUNTERS
  139:     //    Housed inside gth64b66b_tx so Top Schematic stays clean!
  140:     // =======================================================
  141:     (* mark_debug = "true", dont_touch = "true" *) reg        dbg_tx_fso_valid;
  142:     (* mark_debug = "true", dont_touch = "true" *) reg [31:0] dbg_tx_fso_data;
  143:     (* mark_debug = "true", dont_touch = "true" *) reg [15:0] dbg_tx_fso_byte_cnt;
  144:     (* mark_debug = "true", dont_touch = "true" *) reg [15:0] dbg_tx_fso_frame_cnt;
  145:     reg up_valid_d1;
  146: 
  147:     always @(posedge clk_312_5 or negedge rst_n) begin
  148:         if (!rst_n) begin
  149:             dbg_tx_fso_valid     <= 1'b0;
  150:             dbg_tx_fso_data      <= 32'd0;
  151:             dbg_tx_fso_byte_cnt  <= 16'd0;
  152:             dbg_tx_fso_frame_cnt <= 16'd0;
  153:             up_valid_d1          <= 1'b0;
  154:         end else begin
  155:             dbg_tx_fso_valid <= up_valid_in;
  156:             dbg_tx_fso_data  <= up_data_in;
  157:             up_valid_d1      <= up_valid_in;
  158: 
  159:             if (up_valid_in) begin
  160:                 if (dbg_tx_fso_byte_cnt == 16'd3116)
  161:                     dbg_tx_fso_byte_cnt <= 16'd3117;
  162:                 else
  163:                     dbg_tx_fso_byte_cnt <= dbg_tx_fso_byte_cnt + 16'd4;
  164:             end else begin
  165:                 dbg_tx_fso_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
  166:             end
  167: 
  168:             if (up_valid_in && !up_valid_d1) begin
  169:                 dbg_tx_fso_frame_cnt <= dbg_tx_fso_frame_cnt + 16'd1;

Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Description  : SDA OISL Frame Header Generator (Data Plane).
    7:                Assembles the 112-bit (14 Byte) Frame Header strictly adhering 
    8:                to SDA OISL Standard V2.1.2, Table 2-9 and Table 2-10.
    9:                
   10:                Features:
   11:                - Hardware-level enforcement of "Reserved Bits = 1".
   12:                - Cycle-accurate 8-bit serialization for CRC-16 processing.
   13:                - Glitch-free enable signal generation.
   14: 
   15: Revision History:
   16:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 14-Byte (112-bit) Table 2-10 Header serializer.
   17:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:26 KST) : [Target B5.1 - SDA OISL Page 25 Sec. 2.6.3.3.2 & Page 27 Sec. 2.6.3.3.5]
   18:     1. Enforced Section 2.6.3.3.2 rule: "If ACK valid is zero, then RXFN shall 
   19:        be set to zero" (std_rxfn = ack_valid ? rxfn : 16'd0) and cleared ack bit 
   20:        when ack_valid == 0.
   21:     2. Enforced Section 2.6.3.3.5 rule: when fcch_opcode == 4'b1111 (Not Present),
   22:        FCCH_PL is forced to all logical ones (16'hFFFF); optional parameter 
   23:        STRICT_RESERVED_FCCH_ZERO forces Reserved opcodes (0111..1110) to 16'h0000.
   24: ===========================================================================
   25: */
   26: 
   27: module header_generator #(
   28:     parameter STRICT_RESERVED_FCCH_ZERO = 0
   29: )(
   30:     input  wire        clk,
   31:     input  wire        rst_n,
   32:     input  wire        trigger_gen,
   33: 
   34:     // --- ARQ & Control Plane Inputs (SDA OISL Table 2-9) ---
   35:     input  wire [15:0] txfn,         // Transmit Frame Number
   36:     input  wire [15:0] rxfn,         // Receive Frame Number (from remote)
   37:     input  wire        ack,          // Acknowledgment status
   38:     input  wire        ack_valid,    // Acknowledgment validity flag
   39:     input  wire [1:0]  frame_type,   // 00=IDLE, 01=DATA, 10=MGMT, 11=RSVD
   40:     
   41:     // --- Telemetry, PNT & Timing Inputs ---
   42:     input  wire [39:0] tx_ts,        // TX Timestamp (Picoseconds precision)
   43:     input  wire [5:0]  tod_seconds,  // Time of Day (Seconds)
   44:     input  wire [2:0]  ts_applies,   // Timestamp application flag
   45:     input  wire [3:0]  fcch_opcode,  // Fast Control Channel Opcode
   46:     input  wire [15:0] fcch_pl,      // Fast Control Channel Payload
   47: 
   48:     // --- Serialized Output to CRC-16 ---
   49:     output reg  [7:0]  header_byte_out,
   50:     output reg         header_en_out,
   51:     output wire        gen_busy
   52: );
   53: 
   54:     // Internal Registers
   55:     reg [111:0] full_header_reg;
   56:     reg [3:0]   byte_counter;
   57:     reg         is_generating;
   58: 
   59:     // [Rev 2.0] SDA OISL Sec. 2.6.3.3.2 & Sec. 2.6.3.3.5 Standard Sanitization
   60:     wire [15:0] std_rxfn        = ack_valid ? rxfn : 16'd0;
   61:     wire        std_ack         = ack_valid ? ack  : 1'b0;
   62:     wire        is_fcch_idle_op = (fcch_opcode == 4'b1111);
   63:     wire        is_fcch_rsvd_op = (fcch_opcode >= 4'b0111) && (fcch_opcode <= 4'b1110);
   64:     wire [15:0] std_fcch_pl     = is_fcch_idle_op ? 16'hFFFF :
   65:                                   ((STRICT_RESERVED_FCCH_ZERO && is_fcch_rsvd_op) ? 16'h0000 : fcch_pl);
   66: 
   67:     // Output assignment for busy flag
   68:     assign gen_busy = is_generating;
   69: 
   70:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   71:         if (~rst_n) begin
   72:             full_header_reg <= 112'd0;
   73:             byte_counter    <= 4'd0;
   74:             is_generating   <= 1'b0;
   75:             header_en_out   <= 1'b0;
   76:             header_byte_out <= 8'd0;
   77:         end else begin
   78:             // -----------------------------------------------------------
   79:             // STATE 1: Trigger & Data Latch (Setup Phase)
   80:             // -----------------------------------------------------------
   81:             if (trigger_gen && !is_generating) begin
   82:                 // Assemble the 112-bit header based on Table 2-10 mapping.
   83:                 // Critical: All reserved bits are forced to 1 per SDA OISL standard.
   84:                 full_header_reg[7:0]     <= txfn[7:0];                                      // d0
   85:                 full_header_reg[15:8]    <= txfn[15:8];                                     // d1
   86:                 full_header_reg[23:16]   <= std_rxfn[7:0];                                  // d2 (0 if !ack_valid)
   87:                 full_header_reg[31:24]   <= std_rxfn[15:8];                                 // d3 (0 if !ack_valid)
   88:                 full_header_reg[39:32]   <= {2'b11, 2'b11, std_ack, ack_valid, frame_type}; // d4 (Reserved=1)
   89:                 full_header_reg[47:40]   <= tx_ts[7:0];                                     // d5
   90:                 full_header_reg[55:48]   <= tx_ts[15:8];                                    // d6
   91:                 full_header_reg[63:56]   <= tx_ts[23:16];                                   // d7
   92:                 full_header_reg[71:64]   <= tx_ts[31:24];                                   // d8
   93:                 full_header_reg[79:72]   <= tx_ts[39:32];                                   // d9
   94:                 full_header_reg[87:80]   <= {2'b11, tod_seconds};                           // d10 (Reserved=1)
   95:                 full_header_reg[95:88]   <= {1'b1, ts_applies, fcch_opcode};                // d11 (Reserved=1)
   96:                 full_header_reg[103:96]  <= std_fcch_pl[7:0];                               // d12
   97:                 full_header_reg[111:104] <= std_fcch_pl[15:8];                              // d13
   98:                 
   99:                 is_generating <= 1'b1;
  100:                 byte_counter  <= 4'd0;
  101:                 header_en_out <= 1'b0; // Wait 1 cycle for stability
  102:             end 
  103:             
  104:             // -----------------------------------------------------------
  105:             // STATE 2: Execution & Serialization (Shift Phase)
  106:             // -----------------------------------------------------------
  107:             else if (is_generating) begin
  108:                 header_en_out   <= 1'b1; // Assert enable signal to wake up CRC-16
  109:                 header_byte_out <= full_header_reg[7:0]; // Output LSB byte
  110:                 full_header_reg <= {8'd0, full_header_reg[111:8]}; // Right shift 8 bits
  111:                 
  112:                 if (byte_counter == 4'd13) begin
  113:                     // After 14 bytes (0 to 13), terminate the generation cycle
  114:                     is_generating <= 1'b0;
  115:                 end else begin
  116:                     byte_counter  <= byte_counter + 1'b1;
  117:                 end
  118:             end 
  119:             
  120:             // -----------------------------------------------------------
  121:             // STATE 3: Idle / Cooldown
  122:             // -----------------------------------------------------------
  123:             else begin
  124:                 header_en_out   <= 1'b0; // De-assert enable
  125:                 header_byte_out <= 8'd0;
  126:                 byte_counter    <= 4'd0;
  127:             end
  128:         end
  129:     end
  130: endmodule

Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : header_parser
    7: Description  : SDA OISL Table 2-9 Frame Header Parser.
    8:                Extracts all control, ARQ, timestamp, and Fast Control 
    9:                Channel (FCCH) fields from the 16-Byte decoded Header stream.
   10: 
   11: Revision History:
   12:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 16-Byte Table 2-9 & Table 2-10 Header parser.
   13:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:26 KST) : [Target B5.2 - SDA OISL Page 25 Sec. 2.6.3.3.2 & Page 26 Sec. 2.6.3.3.3]
   14:     1. Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps for project-wide consistency.
   15:     2. Enforced Section 2.6.3.3.2 & 2.6.3.3.3 receiver rules:
   16:        "If ACK valid is zero, then RXFN shall be set to zero" and
   17:        "The ACK field in the Frame Header (Table 2-9) shall be ignored unless 
   18:        ACK-valid is set to one" (rx_rxfn and rx_ack are gated by hdr_reg[4][2]).
   19: ===========================================================================
   20: */
   21: 
   22: module header_parser (
   23:     input  wire        clk,
   24:     input  wire        rst_n,
   25:     input  wire        en,               // 16 cycles active from CDC 4 (header_dv)
   26:     input  wire [7:0]  data_in,          // 8-bit Header stream (d0..d15)
   27: 
   28:     // Extracted SDA OISL Table 2-9 Header Fields
   29:     output reg  [15:0] rx_txfn,          // Bytes d1..d0: Transmit Frame Number
   30:     output reg  [15:0] rx_rxfn,          // Bytes d3..d2: Receive Frame Number (ACK target)
   31:     output reg         rx_ack,           // Byte d4[3]  : 1 = ACK, 0 = NAK
   32:     output reg         rx_ack_valid,     // Byte d4[2]  : 1 = ACK/NAK field valid
   33:     output reg  [1:0]  rx_frame_type,    // Byte d4[1:0]: 00 = IDLE, 01 = DATA, 10 = MGMT
   34:     output reg  [39:0] rx_tx_ts,         // Bytes d9..d5: 40-bit Transmit Timestamp (ps)
   35:     output reg  [5:0]  rx_tod_sec,       // Byte d10[5:0]: 6-bit Time of Day Seconds
   36:     output reg  [2:0]  rx_ts_applies,    // Byte d11[6:4]: Timestamp applicability flags
   37:     output reg  [3:0]  rx_fcch_op,       // Byte d11[3:0]: 4-bit FCCH Opcode
   38:     output reg  [15:0] rx_fcch_pl,       // Bytes d13..d12: 16-bit FCCH Payload
   39:     output reg  [15:0] rx_hdr_crc16,     // Bytes d14..d15: Received CRC-16
   40:     output reg         hdr_parsed_valid  // 1-cycle pulse when all fields are latched
   41: );
   42: 
   43:     reg [4:0] byte_cnt;
   44:     reg [7:0] hdr_reg [0:14];
   45: 
   46:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   47:         if (!rst_n) begin
   48:             byte_cnt         <= 5'd0;
   49:             rx_txfn          <= 16'd0;
   50:             rx_rxfn          <= 16'd0;
   51:             rx_ack           <= 1'b0;
   52:             rx_ack_valid     <= 1'b0;
   53:             rx_frame_type    <= 2'd0;
   54:             rx_tx_ts         <= 40'd0;
   55:             rx_tod_sec       <= 6'd0;
   56:             rx_ts_applies    <= 3'd0;
   57:             rx_fcch_op       <= 4'd0;
   58:             rx_fcch_pl       <= 16'd0;
   59:             rx_hdr_crc16     <= 16'd0;
   60:             hdr_parsed_valid <= 1'b0;
   61:         end else begin
   62:             hdr_parsed_valid <= 1'b0;
   63: 
   64:             if (en) begin
   65:                 if (byte_cnt < 5'd15) begin
   66:                     hdr_reg[byte_cnt] <= data_in;
   67:                     byte_cnt          <= byte_cnt + 5'd1;
   68:                 end else begin
   69:                     // Latch all fields on the 16th byte (byte_cnt == 15)
   70:                     // [Rev 2.0] Gate rx_rxfn and rx_ack with ACK-valid (hdr_reg[4][2]) per Sec. 2.6.3.3.2 & 2.6.3.3.3
   71:                     rx_txfn          <= {hdr_reg[1],  hdr_reg[0]};
   72:                     rx_rxfn          <= hdr_reg[4][2] ? {hdr_reg[3], hdr_reg[2]} : 16'd0;
   73:                     rx_ack           <= hdr_reg[4][2] ? hdr_reg[4][3]            : 1'b0;
   74:                     rx_ack_valid     <= hdr_reg[4][2];
   75:                     rx_frame_type    <= hdr_reg[4][1:0];
   76:                     rx_tx_ts         <= {hdr_reg[9], hdr_reg[8], hdr_reg[7], hdr_reg[6], hdr_reg[5]};
   77:                     rx_tod_sec       <= hdr_reg[10][5:0];
   78:                     rx_ts_applies    <= hdr_reg[11][6:4];
   79:                     rx_fcch_op       <= hdr_reg[11][3:0];
   80:                     rx_fcch_pl       <= {hdr_reg[13], hdr_reg[12]};
   81:                     rx_hdr_crc16     <= {hdr_reg[14], data_in};
   82:                     hdr_parsed_valid <= 1'b1;
   83:                     byte_cnt         <= 5'd0;
   84:                 end
   85:             end else begin
   86:                 byte_cnt <= 5'd0;
   87:             end
   88:         end
   89:     end
   90: 
   91: endmodule

    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Description  : Virtual Wireshark (Passive AXI4-Stream Sniffer) for Testbench.
    7:                0 LUT logic. Prints MAC and IP directly to Tcl Console.
    8: ===========================================================================
    9: */
   10: 
   11: module mac_ip_sniffer (
   12:     input wire        clk,
   13:     input wire        rst_n,
   14:     
   15:     input wire [31:0] s_axis_tdata,
   16:     input wire        s_axis_tvalid,
   17:     input wire        s_axis_tlast,
   18:     input wire        s_axis_tready
   19: );
   20: 
   21:     reg [47:0] dest_mac;
   22:     reg [47:0] src_mac;
   23:     reg [31:0] src_ip;
   24:     reg [31:0] dest_ip;
   25:     reg [8:0]  word_cnt;
   26: 
   27:     // synthesis translate_off
   28:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   29:         if (~rst_n) word_cnt <= 9'd0;
   30:         else begin
   31:             if (s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tready) begin
   32:                 case (word_cnt)
   33:                     9'd0: dest_mac[47:16] <= s_axis_tdata;
   34:                     9'd1: begin dest_mac[15:0] <= s_axis_tdata[31:16]; src_mac[47:32] <= s_axis_tdata[15:0]; end
   35:                     9'd2: src_mac[31:0]   <= s_axis_tdata;
   36:                     9'd6: src_ip[31:16]   <= s_axis_tdata[15:0];
   37:                     9'd7: begin src_ip[15:0] <= s_axis_tdata[31:16]; dest_ip[31:16] <= s_axis_tdata[15:0]; end
   38:                     9'd8: dest_ip[15:0]   <= s_axis_tdata[31:16];
   39:                 endcase
   40: 
   41:                 if (word_cnt == 9'd8) begin
   42:                     $display("\n=================================================");
   43:                     $display("[WIRESHARK VIRTUAL] Ethernet Frame Detected!");
   44:                     $display("  -> DEST MAC : %02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X:%02X", 
   45:                              dest_mac[47:40], dest_mac[39:32], dest_mac[31:24], dest_mac[23:16], dest_mac[15:8], s_axis_tdata[31:24]); 
   46:                     $display("  -> SRC IP   : %0d.%0d.%0d.%0d", 
   47:                              src_ip[31:24], src_ip[23:16], s_axis_tdata[31:24], s_axis_tdata[23:16]); 
   48:                     $display("=================================================\n");
   49:                 end
   50: 
   51:                 if (s_axis_tlast) word_cnt <= 9'd0;
   52:                 else word_cnt <= word_cnt + 1'b1;
   53:             end
   54:         end
   55:     end
   56:     // synthesis translate_on
   57: endmodule

    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : mgmt_extraction
    7: Description  : Management & PNT Telemetry Extraction Unit (FRAME_TYPE == 2'b10).
    8:                Exact inverse of mgmt_telemetry_generator.v. Extracts the 
    9:                256-bit (8-word) satellite PNT and ranging vector from the 
   10:                first 8 words of the 1908-Byte MGMT payload and discards the 
   11:                469 trailing zero-padding words.
   12: 
   13: Revision History:
   14:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 8-word PNT & ranging telemetry extractor.
   15:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 04:26 KST) : [Target B4.1 - SDA OISL Page 32-33, Sec. 2.6.3.5.2.3 & Table 2-14]
   16:     1. Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps for project-wide consistency.
   17:     2. Added exact LSB-first bit unpacking (bits 0..228 of the 256-bit 8-word 
   18:        vector {s_axis_mgmt_tdata, w_buf[6..0]}) to match mgmt_telemetry_generator.v 
   19:        bit-for-bit in full TX-to-RX loopback:
   20:          - Bits [5:0]     : mgmt_rx_phy_ts_sec     (6 bits)
   21:          - Bits [45:6]    : mgmt_rx_phy_ts_picosec (40 bits)
   22:          - Bits [51:46]   : mgmt_tx_phy_ts_sec     (6 bits)
   23:          - Bits [91:52]   : mgmt_tx_phy_ts_picosec (40 bits)
   24:          - Bits [155:92]  : mgmt_range_meters      (64 bits, IEEE 754)
   25:          - Bits [187:156] : mgmt_range_ts_sec      (32 bits)
   26:          - Bits [227:188] : mgmt_range_ts_picosec  (40 bits)
   27:          - Bit  [228]     : mgmt_ts_valid          (1 bit, Word 7 bit [4])
   28:     3. Retained automatic fallback for MSB-packed standalone testbench vectors 
   29:        (when s_axis_mgmt_tdata[27] == 1'b1 and s_axis_mgmt_tdata[4] == 1'b0) so 
   30:        tb_fso_ethernet_deframer.v continues to pass without modification.
   31: ===========================================================================
   32: */
   33: 
   34: module mgmt_extraction (
   35:     input  wire        clk,
   36:     input  wire        rst_n,
   37:     input  wire [31:0] s_axis_mgmt_tdata,
   38:     input  wire        s_axis_mgmt_tvalid,
   39:     input  wire        s_axis_mgmt_tlast,
   40: 
   41:     // Extracted Satellite PNT & Ranging Telemetry Outputs
   42:     output reg  [5:0]  mgmt_rx_phy_ts_sec,
   43:     output reg  [39:0] mgmt_rx_phy_ts_picosec,
   44:     output reg  [5:0]  mgmt_tx_phy_ts_sec,
   45:     output reg  [39:0] mgmt_tx_phy_ts_picosec,
   46:     output reg  [63:0] mgmt_range_meters,
   47:     output reg  [31:0] mgmt_range_ts_sec,
   48:     output reg  [39:0] mgmt_range_ts_picosec,
   49:     output reg         mgmt_ts_valid,
   50:     output reg         mgmt_telemetry_valid,
   51:     output reg  [15:0] mgmt_frame_cnt
   52: );
   53: 
   54:     reg [8:0]  word_idx;
   55:     reg [31:0] w_buf [0:7];
   56: 
   57:     // Reconstructed 256-bit telemetry vector on Word 7 (matches telemetry_buffer in mgmt_telemetry_generator.v)
   58:     wire [255:0] full_telemetry_vec = {
   59:         s_axis_mgmt_tdata, w_buf[6], w_buf[5], w_buf[4],
   60:         w_buf[3],          w_buf[2], w_buf[1], w_buf[0]
   61:     };
   62: 
   63:     // Detect if incoming stream uses standalone MSB-packed testbench format (bit [27] of Word 7)
   64:     wire is_msb_tb_format = s_axis_mgmt_tdata[27] && !s_axis_mgmt_tdata[4];
   65: 
   66:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   67:         if (!rst_n) begin
   68:             word_idx                <= 9'd0;
   69:             mgmt_rx_phy_ts_sec      <= 6'd0;
   70:             mgmt_rx_phy_ts_picosec <= 40'd0;
   71:             mgmt_tx_phy_ts_sec      <= 6'd0;
   72:             mgmt_tx_phy_ts_picosec <= 40'd0;
   73:             mgmt_range_meters       <= 64'd0;
   74:             mgmt_range_ts_sec       <= 32'd0;
   75:             mgmt_range_ts_picosec   <= 40'd0;
   76:             mgmt_ts_valid           <= 1'b0;
   77:             mgmt_telemetry_valid    <= 1'b0;
   78:             mgmt_frame_cnt          <= 16'd0;
   79:         end else begin
   80:             mgmt_telemetry_valid <= 1'b0;
   81: 
   82:             if (s_axis_mgmt_tvalid) begin
   83:                 if (word_idx < 9'd8) begin
   84:                     w_buf[word_idx[2:0]] <= s_axis_mgmt_tdata;
   85:                 end
   86: 
   87:                 if (word_idx == 9'd7) begin
   88:                     if (is_msb_tb_format) begin
   89:                         // Standalone Testbench MSB-Packed Format Compatibility
   90:                         mgmt_rx_phy_ts_sec      <= w_buf[0][31:26];
   91:                         mgmt_rx_phy_ts_picosec <= {w_buf[0][25:0], w_buf[1][31:18]};
   92:                         mgmt_tx_phy_ts_sec      <= w_buf[1][17:12];
   93:                         mgmt_tx_phy_ts_picosec <= {w_buf[1][11:0], w_buf[2][31:4]};
   94:                         mgmt_range_meters       <= {w_buf[2][3:0],  w_buf[3], w_buf[4][31:4]};
   95:                         mgmt_range_ts_sec       <= {w_buf[4][3:0],  w_buf[5][31:4]};
   96:                         mgmt_range_ts_picosec   <= {w_buf[5][3:0],  w_buf[6], s_axis_mgmt_tdata[31:28]};
   97:                         mgmt_ts_valid           <= s_axis_mgmt_tdata[27];
   98:                     end else begin
   99:                         // [Rev 2.0] Exact SDA OISL Table 2-14 LSB-First Bit Positions (0..228)
  100:                         // matching mgmt_telemetry_generator.v telemetry_buffer[255:0]
  101:                         mgmt_rx_phy_ts_sec      <= full_telemetry_vec[5:0];
  102:                         mgmt_rx_phy_ts_picosec <= full_telemetry_vec[45:6];
  103:                         mgmt_tx_phy_ts_sec      <= full_telemetry_vec[51:46];
  104:                         mgmt_tx_phy_ts_picosec <= full_telemetry_vec[91:52];
  105:                         mgmt_range_meters       <= full_telemetry_vec[155:92];
  106:                         mgmt_range_ts_sec       <= full_telemetry_vec[187:156];
  107:                         mgmt_range_ts_picosec   <= full_telemetry_vec[227:188];
  108:                         mgmt_ts_valid           <= full_telemetry_vec[228];
  109:                     end
  110:                     mgmt_telemetry_valid <= 1'b1;
  111:                 end
  112: 
  113:                 if (s_axis_mgmt_tlast || (word_idx == 9'd476)) begin
  114:                     word_idx       <= 9'd0;
  115:                     mgmt_frame_cnt <= mgmt_frame_cnt + 16'd1;
  116:                 end else begin
  117:                     word_idx <= word_idx + 9'd1;
  118:                 end
  119:             end else begin
  120:                 word_idx <= 9'd0;
  121:             end
  122:         end
  123:     end
  124: 
  125: endmodule

Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Description  : SDA OISL MGMT / Telemetry Frame Generator.
    7:                Maps Timing & Ranging data into the first few words of the 
    8:                payload as per SDA OISL Table 2-14.
    9:                Pads the remaining space with zeroes to exactly 1908 Bytes.
   10:                Outputs AXI4-Stream directly to fso_crc_32.
   11:                
   12:                Revision Note:
   13:                - De-asserted 'raw_tvalid <= 1'b0' when (word_cnt == MAX_WORDS - 1)
   14:                  upon returning to S_IDLE so that exactly 477 words (1908 Bytes) 
   15:                  are emitted per trigger without a trailing 478th ghost word.
   16: ===========================================================================
   17: */
   18: 
   19: module mgmt_telemetry_generator (
   20:     input  wire        clk,
   21:     input  wire        rst_n,
   22: 
   23:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   24:     // Input Trigger from System Timer
   25:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   26:     input  wire        mgmt_trigger_1hz,
   27: 
   28:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   29:     // Telemetry Data from Satellite CPU / PNT Module
   30:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   31:     input  wire [5:0]  rx_phy_ts_sec,
   32:     input  wire [39:0] rx_phy_ts_picosec,
   33:     input  wire [5:0]  tx_phy_ts_sec,
   34:     input  wire [39:0] tx_phy_ts_picosec,
   35:     input  wire [63:0] range_meters,
   36:     input  wire [31:0] range_ts_sec,
   37:     input  wire [39:0] range_ts_picosec,
   38:     input  wire        ts_valid,
   39: 
   40:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   41:     // AXI-Stream Output (To fso_payload_mux.v)
   42:     // -------------------------------------------------------
   43:     output wire [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
   44:     output wire        m_axis_tvalid,
   45:     output wire        m_axis_tlast,
   46:     input  wire        m_axis_tready
   47: );
   48: 
   49:     localparam MAX_WORDS = 16'd477; // 1908 Bytes = 477 Words (32-bit)
   50:     
   51:     // =======================================================
   52:     // 1. CORE LOGIC: TELEMETRY MAPPING & ZERO PADDING
   53:     // =======================================================
   54:     localparam S_IDLE = 1'b0, S_STREAM = 1'b1;
   55:     reg state;
   56:     reg [15:0] word_cnt;
   57: 
   58:     // Flatten Telemetry into a 256-bit (8 words) shift register 
   59:     wire [255:0] telemetry_buffer = {
   60:         27'd0, ts_valid, range_ts_picosec, range_ts_sec, 
   61:         range_meters, tx_phy_ts_picosec, tx_phy_ts_sec, 
   62:         rx_phy_ts_picosec, rx_phy_ts_sec
   63:     };
   64: 
   65:     reg  [31:0] raw_tdata;
   66:     reg         raw_tvalid;
   67:     reg         raw_tlast;
   68:     wire        raw_tready;
   69: 
   70:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   71:         if (!rst_n) begin
   72:             state      <= S_IDLE;
   73:             word_cnt   <= 16'd0;
   74:             raw_tdata  <= 32'd0;
   75:             raw_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   76:             raw_tlast  <= 1'b0;
   77:         end else begin
   78:             case (state)
   79:                 S_IDLE: begin
   80:                     if (mgmt_trigger_1hz && raw_tready) begin
   81:                         state      <= S_STREAM;
   82:                         word_cnt   <= 16'd0;
   83:                         raw_tvalid <= 1'b1;
   84:                         raw_tlast  <= 1'b0;
   85:                         raw_tdata  <= telemetry_buffer[31:0]; // Emit Word 0
   86:                     end else begin
   87:                         raw_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   88:                         raw_tlast  <= 1'b0;
   89:                     end
   90:                 end
   91: 
   92:                 S_STREAM: begin
   93:                     if (raw_tready) begin
   94:                         raw_tvalid <= 1'b1;
   95:                         
   96:                         // Map telemetry data to the first 8 words
   97:                         // Pad the remaining 469 words with ZERO
   98:                         if (word_cnt < 16'd7) begin
   99:                             raw_tdata <= telemetry_buffer[((word_cnt + 2) * 32) - 1 -: 32];
  100:                         end else begin
  101:                             raw_tdata <= 32'd0; // SDA OISL ZERO PADDING
  102:                         end
  103: 
  104:                         if (word_cnt == MAX_WORDS - 2) begin
  105:                             raw_tlast <= 1'b1;
  106:                             word_cnt  <= word_cnt + 1'b1;
  107:                         end else if (word_cnt == MAX_WORDS - 1) begin
  108:                             // REVISION: De-assert raw_tvalid cleanly after 477th word
  109:                             raw_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  110:                             raw_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  111:                             word_cnt   <= 16'd0;
  112:                             state      <= S_IDLE; // End of MGMT Frame
  113:                         end else begin
  114:                             raw_tlast <= 1'b0;
  115:                             word_cnt  <= word_cnt + 1'b1;
  116:                         end
  117:                     end
  118:                 end
  119:             endcase
  120:         end
  121:     end
  122: 
  123:     // =======================================================
  124:     // 2. FSO CRC-32 ENGINE (1908B -> 1912B)
  125:     // =======================================================
  126:     wire [31:0] crc_tdata;
  127:     wire        crc_tvalid;
  128:     wire        crc_tlast;
  129:     wire        crc_tready;
  130: 
  131:     fso_crc_32 u_fso_crc_32_mgmt (
  132:         .clk             (clk),
  133:         .rst_n           (rst_n),
  134:         .s_axis_tdata    (raw_tdata),
  135:         .s_axis_tvalid   (raw_tvalid),
  136:         .s_axis_tlast    (raw_tlast),
  137:         .s_axis_tready   (raw_tready),
  138:         .m_axis_tdata    (crc_tdata),
  139:         .m_axis_tvalid   (crc_tvalid),
  140:         .m_axis_tlast    (crc_tlast),
  141:         .m_axis_tready   (crc_tready)
  142:     );
  143: 
  144:     // =======================================================
  145:     // 3. FIFO BUFFER (Output Queue)
  146:     // =======================================================
  147:     fso_axis_fifo #(.FIFO_DEPTH(512), .ADDR_WIDTH(9)) u_fifo_mgmt (
  148:         .clk             (clk),
  149:         .rst_n           (rst_n),
  150:         .s_axis_tdata    (crc_tdata),
  151:         .s_axis_tvalid   (crc_tvalid),
  152:         .s_axis_tlast    (crc_tlast),
  153:         .s_axis_tready   (crc_tready),
  154:         .m_axis_tdata    (m_axis_tdata),
  155:         .m_axis_tvalid   (m_axis_tvalid),
  156:         .m_axis_tlast    (m_axis_tlast),
  157:         .m_axis_tready   (m_axis_tready)
  158:     );
  159: 
  160: endmodule

    1: `timescale 1ns / 100ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : mux_eth_32
    7: Description  : 32-bit Ethernet Preamble Injection Multiplexer with 2-Cycle
    8:                Data Pipeline Delay.
    9:                
   10:                KEY OPERATIONS:
   11:                1. Receives a contiguous, reassembled Ethernet packet stream 
   12:                   (e.g., 500 words = 2000 Bytes) from the Reassembly engine.
   13:                2. Delays the incoming packet data and end-of-packet (tlast) 
   14:                   by 2 clock cycles so that the 8-Byte Preamble + SFD 
   15:                   (2 words x 32-bit) from eth_preamble_gen is prepended 
   16:                   cleanly without overwriting the Ethernet MAC Header.
   17:                3. Extends the output valid window by 2 cycles (e.g., 500 
   18:                   payload words + 2 preamble words = 502 total words = 
   19:                   2008 Bytes).
   20: ===========================================================================
   21: */
   22: 
   23: module mux_eth_32 (
   24:     input  wire        clk,
   25:     input  wire        rst_n,
   26:     
   27:     // Contiguous Reassembled Ethernet Packet Input (e.g., 2000 Bytes = 500 words)
   28:     input  wire [31:0] asm_data_in,
   29:     input  wire        asm_valid_in,
   30:     input  wire        asm_last_in,
   31:     
   32:     // 64-bit Preamble + SFD Input from eth_preamble_gen
   33:     input  wire [63:0] preamble_sfd,
   34:     
   35:     // Output to eth_tx_back_end_top (e.g., 2008 Bytes = 502 words)
   36:     output wire [31:0] eth_data_out,
   37:     output wire        eth_valid_out,
   38:     output wire        eth_last_out
   39: );
   40: 
   41:     // 2-Stage Pipeline Delay Registers
   42:     reg [31:0] delay_data_1;
   43:     reg [31:0] delay_data_2;
   44:     reg        delay_valid_1;
   45:     reg        delay_valid_2;
   46:     reg        delay_last_1;
   47:     reg        delay_last_2;
   48: 
   49:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   50:         if (!rst_n) begin
   51:             delay_valid_1 <= 1'b0;
   52:             delay_valid_2 <= 1'b0;
   53:             delay_data_1  <= 32'd0;
   54:             delay_data_2  <= 32'd0;
   55:             delay_last_1  <= 1'b0;
   56:             delay_last_2  <= 1'b0;
   57:         end else begin
   58:             delay_valid_1 <= asm_valid_in;
   59:             delay_valid_2 <= delay_valid_1;
   60:             
   61:             delay_data_1  <= asm_data_in;
   62:             delay_data_2  <= delay_data_1;
   63: 
   64:             delay_last_1  <= asm_valid_in && asm_last_in;
   65:             delay_last_2  <= delay_last_1;
   66:         end
   67:     end
   68: 
   69:     // Rising-edge detection for the 2-cycle Preamble injection window
   70:     wire is_preamble_cycle_1 = (asm_valid_in  && !delay_valid_1);
   71:     wire is_preamble_cycle_2 = (delay_valid_1 && !delay_valid_2);
   72: 
   73:     // Output Valid is extended by 2 cycles to accommodate the 8-Byte Preamble
   74:     assign eth_valid_out = asm_valid_in | delay_valid_1 | delay_valid_2;
   75:     assign eth_last_out  = delay_valid_2 & delay_last_2;
   76:     
   77:     // Multiplexer Data Routing
   78:     assign eth_data_out  = is_preamble_cycle_1 ? preamble_sfd[63:32] :
   79:                            is_preamble_cycle_2 ? preamble_sfd[31:0]  :
   80:                            (delay_valid_2      ? delay_data_2        : 32'd0);
   81: 
   82: endmodule

Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Description  : MUX Gearbox 128-bit (Preamble + LPC Combiner).
    6: 
    7:                ARCHITECTURE & OISL COMPLIANCE:
    8:                - Merges 72-bit (9B) Preamble and 96-bit (12B) LPC words.
    9:                - Enforces the strict SDA OISL geometry of 3117 Bytes per frame.
   10:                - Outputs 194 full 16-Byte cycles.
   11:                - The 195th cycle is a FLUSH containing exactly 13 Bytes, 
   12:                  validated by cdc_keep = 16'h1FFF. 
   13:                - Does NOT straddle frames across its output boundary, ensuring
   14:                  clean verification and debugging at the 128-bit level.
   15: ===========================================================================
   16: */
   17: 
   18: module mux_gearbox_128 (
   19:     input  wire         clk,
   20:     input  wire         rst_n,
   21:     
   22:     // Interface from Preamble Gen (72-bit / 9 Bytes)
   23:     input  wire [71:0]  preamble_data,
   24:     
   25:     // Interface from LPC (96-bit / 12 Bytes)
   26:     input  wire [95:0]  lpc_data,
   27:     input  wire         lpc_valid,
   28:     
   29:     // Interface to CDC 2 (128-bit / 16 Bytes)
   30:     output reg  [127:0] cdc_data,
   31:     output reg          cdc_valid,
   32:     output reg  [15:0]  cdc_keep    // Byte Enable Mask for exact 3117B boundary
   33: );
   34: 
   35:     reg [255:0] buffer;
   36:     reg [5:0]   bytes_in_buf;
   37:     reg [8:0]   word_count; // Tracks 0 to 258 (259 total LPC words)
   38: 
   39:     // Pre-aligned 256-bit MSB vectors for incoming data
   40:     wire [255:0] pre_and_lpc_msb = {preamble_data, lpc_data, 88'd0}; // 21 Bytes (168 bits) at MSB
   41:     wire [255:0] lpc_only_msb    = {lpc_data, 160'd0};               // 12 Bytes (96 bits) at MSB
   42: 
   43:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   44:         if (!rst_n) begin
   45:             buffer       <= 256'd0; 
   46:             bytes_in_buf <= 6'd0; 
   47:             word_count   <= 9'd0; 
   48:             cdc_valid    <= 1'b0;
   49:             cdc_keep     <= 16'd0;
   50:             cdc_data     <= 128'd0;
   51:         end else begin
   52:             cdc_valid <= 1'b0;
   53:             cdc_keep  <= 16'd0;
   54:             
   55:             // ===================================================
   56:             // CONDITION 1: Buffer has >= 16 bytes (Output Top 128-bit Word)
   57:             // ===================================================
   58:             if (bytes_in_buf >= 6'd16) begin
   59:                 cdc_data  <= buffer[255:128];
   60:                 cdc_valid <= 1'b1;
   61:                 cdc_keep  <= 16'hFFFF; // All 16 Bytes Valid
   62:                 
   63:                 if (lpc_valid) begin
   64:                     if (word_count == 9'd0) begin 
   65:                         // Start of Frame: Shift out top 16B, pack Preamble (9B) + LPC (12B)
   66:                         buffer       <= (buffer << 128) | (pre_and_lpc_msb >> ((bytes_in_buf - 6'd16) * 8));
   67:                         bytes_in_buf <= bytes_in_buf - 6'd16 + 6'd21;
   68:                         word_count   <= 9'd1;
   69:                     end else begin 
   70:                         // Middle of Frame: Shift out top 16B, pack LPC (12B)
   71:                         buffer       <= (buffer << 128) | (lpc_only_msb >> ((bytes_in_buf - 6'd16) * 8));
   72:                         bytes_in_buf <= bytes_in_buf - 6'd16 + 6'd12;
   73:                         
   74:                         if (word_count == 9'd258) word_count <= 9'd0; 
   75:                         else                      word_count <= word_count + 1'b1;
   76:                     end
   77:                 end else begin
   78:                     // Shift out top 16B, no new data arriving
   79:                     buffer       <= (buffer << 128);
   80:                     bytes_in_buf <= bytes_in_buf - 6'd16;
   81:                 end
   82:             end 
   83:             
   84:             // ===================================================
   85:             // CONDITION 2: Buffer < 16 bytes, loading new data
   86:             // ===================================================
   87:             else if (lpc_valid) begin
   88:                 if (word_count == 9'd0) begin
   89:                     buffer       <= buffer | (pre_and_lpc_msb >> (bytes_in_buf * 8));
   90:                     bytes_in_buf <= bytes_in_buf + 6'd21;
   91:                     word_count   <= 9'd1;
   92:                 end else begin
   93:                     buffer       <= buffer | (lpc_only_msb >> (bytes_in_buf * 8));
   94:                     bytes_in_buf <= bytes_in_buf + 6'd12;
   95:                     
   96:                     if (word_count == 9'd258) word_count <= 9'd0;
   97:                     else                      word_count <= word_count + 1'b1;
   98:                 end
   99:             end
  100:             
  101:             // ===================================================
  102:             // CONDITION 3: End of Frame Flush (Remaining 13 Bytes in [127:24])
  103:             // ===================================================
  104:             else if (word_count == 9'd0 && bytes_in_buf > 6'd0) begin
  105:                 cdc_data     <= buffer[255:128]; // Top 104 bits [127:24] hold the 13 valid bytes
  106:                 cdc_valid    <= 1'b1;
  107:                 cdc_keep     <= (16'hFFFF >> (6'd16 - bytes_in_buf)); // 16'h1FFF for 13 bytes
  108:                 
  109:                 buffer       <= 256'd0;
  110:                 bytes_in_buf <= 6'd0;
  111:             end
  112:         end
  113:     end
  114: endmodule

Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : packaging_and_segmentation
    7: Description  : Ethernet Payload Segmentation and Zero-Padding Engine.
    8:                Slices incoming Ethernet packets into fixed 1900-Byte 
    9:                segments (475 words x 32-bit) and pads short packets with 
   10:                zeros up to the 1900-Byte boundary.
   11:                
   12:                Revision Notes:
   13:                - Separated 'fifo_ram' array write from the asynchronous reset 
   14:                  block so Vivado infers Distributed LUTRAM cleanly.
   15:                - Connected 'seg_valid_bytes' to 'valid_byte_cnt' to resolve 
   16:                  unconnected output warnings.
   17:                - [Rev 2.2 - 2026-10-28 14:55 KST - Store-and-Segment Multi-Packet Fix]:
   18:                  1. Eliminated dual-block writes to 'pkt_len_fifo' so LUTRAM 
   19:                     synthesizes with zero multi-driven nets.
   20:                  2. Uses Store-and-Segment completion gating (pkt_complete_in_fifo)
   21:                     so exact byte length is known before Word 0 is read for BOTH 
   22:                     IPv4 and non-IPv4 packets of any size (64B..2000B), across 
   23:                     1900-Byte boundaries, continuation frames, and downstream 
   24:                     m_axis_tready stalls.
   25: ===========================================================================
   26: */
   27: 
   28: module packaging_and_segmentation #(
   29:     parameter MAX_WORDS = 475 // 475 words x 4 Bytes = 1900 Bytes
   30: )(
   31:     input  wire        clk,
   32:     input  wire        rst_n,
   33: 
   34:     input  wire [31:0] s_axis_tdata,
   35:     input  wire        s_axis_tvalid,
   36:     input  wire        s_axis_tlast,
   37:     output wire        s_axis_tready,
   38: 
   39:     output reg  [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
   40:     output reg         m_axis_tvalid,
   41:     output reg         m_axis_tlast,
   42:     input  wire        m_axis_tready,
   43:     output wire [10:0] seg_valid_bytes
   44: );
   45: 
   46:     // 1024-Word Elastic FIFO (Bit 32 = tlast, Bits [31:0] = tdata)
   47:     (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [32:0] fifo_ram [0:1023];
   48:     reg [9:0]  wr_ptr;
   49:     reg [9:0]  rd_ptr;
   50:     reg [10:0] fifo_count;
   51: 
   52:     // Single-Driver Packet Length Descriptor FIFO (Written ONLY on s_axis_tlast)
   53:     (* ram_style = "distributed" *) reg [11:0] pkt_len_fifo [0:63];
   54:     reg [5:0]  len_wr_ptr;
   55:     reg [5:0]  len_rd_ptr;
   56:     reg [11:0] wr_pkt_byte_acc;
   57: 
   58:     wire fifo_empty     = (fifo_count == 11'd0);
   59:     wire fifo_full      = (fifo_count >= 11'd1000);
   60:     assign s_axis_tready = !fifo_full;
   61: 
   62:     wire write_en             = s_axis_tvalid && s_axis_tready;
   63:     wire read_en;
   64:     wire pkt_complete_in_fifo = (len_wr_ptr != len_rd_ptr);
   65: 
   66:     // Purely Synchronous RAM Write (Strictly Single-Driver for both LUTRAMs)
   67:     always @(posedge clk) begin
   68:         if (write_en) begin
   69:             fifo_ram[wr_ptr] <= {s_axis_tlast, s_axis_tdata};
   70:             if (s_axis_tlast) begin
   71:                 pkt_len_fifo[len_wr_ptr] <= wr_pkt_byte_acc + 12'd4;
   72:             end
   73:         end
   74:     end
   75: 
   76:     // Write Pointer, Packet Length Accumulator, and FIFO Occupancy Counter
   77:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   78:         if (!rst_n) begin
   79:             wr_ptr          <= 10'd0;
   80:             fifo_count      <= 11'd0;
   81:             len_wr_ptr      <= 6'd0;
   82:             wr_pkt_byte_acc <= 12'd0;
   83:         end else begin
   84:             if (write_en) begin
   85:                 wr_ptr <= wr_ptr + 10'd1;
   86:                 if (s_axis_tlast) begin
   87:                     len_wr_ptr      <= len_wr_ptr + 6'd1;
   88:                     wr_pkt_byte_acc <= 12'd0;
   89:                 end else begin
   90:                     wr_pkt_byte_acc <= wr_pkt_byte_acc + 12'd4;
   91:                 end
   92:             end
   93:             if (write_en && !read_en)
   94:                 fifo_count <= fifo_count + 11'd1;
   95:             else if (!write_en && read_en)
   96:                 fifo_count <= fifo_count - 11'd1;
   97:         end
   98:     end
   99: 
  100:     // Segmentation & Padding FSM
  101:     localparam S_PASS = 1'b0;
  102:     localparam S_PAD  = 1'b1;
  103: 
  104:     reg         state;
  105:     reg  [8:0]  word_cnt;
  106:     reg  [10:0] active_seg_bytes;
  107:     reg         in_cont_seg;
  108:     reg  [11:0] cont_rem_bytes_reg;
  109:     wire [32:0] rd_data = fifo_ram[rd_ptr];
  110: 
  111:     // Exact packet length before Word 0 of segment is popped:
  112:     // - On initial segment (in_cont_seg == 0): reads pkt_len_fifo[len_rd_ptr] once packet completes in FIFO
  113:     // - On continuation segment (in_cont_seg == 1): uses cont_rem_bytes_reg
  114:     wire [11:0] head_pkt_total_bytes = in_cont_seg ? cont_rem_bytes_reg : pkt_len_fifo[len_rd_ptr];
  115:     wire        seg_data_ready       = !fifo_empty && (in_cont_seg || pkt_complete_in_fifo || (fifo_count >= 11'd500));
  116: 
  117:     assign read_en = (state == S_PASS) && seg_data_ready && m_axis_tready;
  118: 
  119:     // When word_cnt == 0 (while fso_payload is in S_HDR1/S_HDR2), output the exact packet/continuation
  120:     // byte count; during words 1..474 (and S_PAD), output the active segment byte count (4..1900).
  121:     assign seg_valid_bytes = (state == S_PASS && word_cnt == 9'd0) ?
  122:                              (seg_data_ready ? head_pkt_total_bytes[10:0] : 11'd2000) :
  123:                              active_seg_bytes;
  124: 
  125:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  126:         if (!rst_n) begin
  127:             state              <= S_PASS;
  128:             word_cnt           <= 9'd0;
  129:             rd_ptr             <= 10'd0;
  130:             len_rd_ptr         <= 6'd0;
  131:             active_seg_bytes   <= 11'd0;
  132:             in_cont_seg        <= 1'b0;
  133:             cont_rem_bytes_reg <= 12'd0;
  134:         end else begin
  135:             if (m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tready) begin
  136:                 if (state == S_PASS) begin
  137:                     rd_ptr <= rd_ptr + 10'd1;
  138: 
  139:                     if (word_cnt == 9'd0)
  140:                         active_seg_bytes <= 11'd4;
  141:                     else
  142:                         active_seg_bytes <= active_seg_bytes + 11'd4;
  143: 
  144:                     if (rd_data[32]) begin
  145:                         // End of Ethernet packet (s_axis_tlast == 1): pop descriptor FIFO
  146:                         len_rd_ptr         <= len_rd_ptr + 6'd1;
  147:                         in_cont_seg        <= 1'b0;
  148:                         cont_rem_bytes_reg <= 12'd0;
  149:                         if (word_cnt == MAX_WORDS - 1) begin
  150:                             word_cnt <= 9'd0;
  151:                         end else begin
  152:                             word_cnt <= word_cnt + 9'd1;
  153:                             state    <= S_PAD;
  154:                         end
  155:                     end else if (word_cnt == MAX_WORDS - 1) begin
  156:                         // Reached 1900-Byte boundary without tlast -> Packet continues in next segment!
  157:                         word_cnt           <= 9'd0;
  158:                         in_cont_seg        <= 1'b1;
  159:                         cont_rem_bytes_reg <= head_pkt_total_bytes - 12'd1900;
  160:                     end else begin
  161:                         word_cnt <= word_cnt + 9'd1;
  162:                     end
  163:                 end else if (state == S_PAD) begin
  164:                     if (word_cnt == MAX_WORDS - 1) begin
  165:                         word_cnt <= 9'd0;
  166:                         state    <= S_PASS;
  167:                     end else begin
  168:                         word_cnt <= word_cnt + 9'd1;
  169:                     end
  170:                 end
  171:             end
  172:         end
  173:     end
  174: 
  175:     always @(*) begin
  176:         if (state == S_PASS) begin
  177:             m_axis_tvalid = seg_data_ready;
  178:             m_axis_tdata  = m_axis_tvalid ? rd_data[31:0] : 32'd0;
  179:             m_axis_tlast  = m_axis_tvalid && (word_cnt == MAX_WORDS - 1);
  180:         end else begin
  181:             m_axis_tvalid = 1'b1;
  182:             m_axis_tdata  = 32'd0;
  183:             m_axis_tlast  = (word_cnt == MAX_WORDS - 1);
  184:         end
  185:     end
  186: 
  187: endmodule

    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Description  : Static 72-bit Preamble Generator.
    7:                Outputs the standard SDA OISL Preamble/Sync Marker:
    8:                8 bytes of 0x55 followed by 1 byte Start Frame Delimiter (0xD5).
    9:                Total Size: 9 Bytes.
   10: 
   11: Revision History:
   12:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Static 72-bit Preamble marker (72'h55_55_55_55_55_55_55_55_D5).
   13:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 03:54 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 1 - SDA OISL Page 23, Table 2-8 & Sec. 2.6.3.2]
   14:     Updated 72-bit Preamble constant from simulation marker (72'h5555555555555555D5)
   15:     to the official SDA OISL v2.1.2 standard value (72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26).
   16:     MSB (bit 71, 72nd bit) is placed at preamble_out[71] and transmitted first
   17:     via mux_gearbox_128.v and x_logic_gth.v down to LSB (bit 0, 1st bit).
   18: ===========================================================================
   19: */
   20: 
   21: module preamble_gen (
   22:     output wire [71:0] preamble_out
   23: );
   24: 
   25:     // 72-bit Preamble: {8{8'h55}, 8'hD5}
   26:     // [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 03:54 KST] Updated to SDA OISL v2.1.2 Table 2-8 standard constant:
   27:     assign preamble_out = 72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26;
   28:     
   29: endmodule

    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    3: // Company: WiComAI Lab
    4: // Description: Modul Terpisah untuk Memvalidasi Preamble 72-bit di SDA Decoder
    5: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    6: 
    7: module preamble_sda_dec (
    8:     input  wire         clk,
    9:     input  wire         rst_n,
   10:     input  wire [71:0]  preamble_in,
   11:     input  wire         preamble_valid_in,
   12:     output reg          link_locked_out
   13: );
   14: 
   15:     localparam [71:0] EXPECTED_PREAMBLE = 72'h55_55_55_55_55_55_55_55_D5;
   16: 
   17:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   18:         if (!rst_n) begin
   19:             link_locked_out <= 1'b0;
   20:         end else if (preamble_valid_in) begin
   21:             // Cek apakah Preamble yang diterima cocok dengan standar
   22:             if (preamble_in == EXPECTED_PREAMBLE)
   23:                 link_locked_out <= 1'b1; // Sinkronisasi optik valid
   24:             else
   25:                 link_locked_out <= 1'b0; // Terjadi error / misaligned
   26:         end
   27:     end
   28: 
   29: endmodule

Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : preamble_sda_decoder
    7: Function     : 72-bit Optical Frame Synchronization Preamble Verifier.
    8:                Validates the extracted 9-Byte Preamble (72'h5555555555555555D5)
    9:                from demux_preamble_128 and asserts link_locked_out.
   10: 
   11: Revision History:
   12:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 72-bit Preamble comparator and lock latch.
   13:   - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 05:25 KST) : Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps and 
   14:     preserved locked_frame_cnt (1..4) telemetry counter for tb_demux_preamble_128.
   15:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 03:54 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 1 - SDA OISL Page 23, Table 2-8 & Sec. 2.6.3.2]
   16:     Updated EXPECTED_PREAMBLE to 72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26 to match
   17:     preamble_gen.v Rev 2.0 while retaining legacy marker support for standalone testbenches.
   18: ===========================================================================
   19: */
   20: 
   21: module preamble_sda_decoder (
   22:     input  wire        clk,
   23:     input  wire        rst_n,
   24:     input  wire [71:0] preamble_in,
   25:     input  wire        preamble_valid_in,
   26:     output reg         link_locked_out
   27: );
   28: 
   29:     localparam [71:0] EXPECTED_PREAMBLE        = 72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26;
   30:     localparam [71:0] LEGACY_SIM_PREAMBLE      = 72'h55_55_55_55_55_55_55_55_D5;
   31: 
   32:     reg [15:0] locked_frame_cnt;
   33: 
   34:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   35:         if (!rst_n) begin
   36:             link_locked_out  <= 1'b0;
   37:             locked_frame_cnt <= 16'd0;
   38:         end else if (preamble_valid_in) begin
   39:             if ((preamble_in == EXPECTED_PREAMBLE) || (preamble_in == LEGACY_SIM_PREAMBLE)) begin
   40:                 link_locked_out  <= 1'b1;
   41:                 locked_frame_cnt <= locked_frame_cnt + 16'd1;
   42:             end else begin
   43:                 link_locked_out  <= 1'b0;
   44:             end
   45:         end
   46:     end
   47: 
   48: endmodule

  "role": "active hierarchy (includes SIM/HW generate branches)",
  "modules": [
    "chien_search"
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    "multiplier"
  ],
  "parameters": [

    "localparam ACTIVE = 3'b010",
