Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University / ETRI Daejeon
    5: Engineers    : Irzal Zaini & Williamsyah Baginda Miraj
    6: Module Name  : chien_search
    7: Description  : Reed-Solomon Chien Search Engine over GF(2^8).
    8:                Evaluates the Error Locator Polynomial (delta) across field 
    9:                elements to identify error positions (C0 == 0) and outputs 
   10:                the formal derivative evaluation (chien = C1) for Forney's 
   11:                algorithm.
   12: 
   13: Revision History:
   14:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Chien search step multipliers alpha^1..alpha^8 over 0x11D.
   15:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 03:54 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 2 & 3 - SDA OISL Page 37, Sec. 2.6.3.6.3]
   16:     Updated step multipliers (gf_1..gf_8) to powers of beta = alpha^11 over GF(2^8) 0x187
   17:     to match generator polynomial roots alpha^(11*j):
   18:       beta^1 (alpha^11) = 8'had, beta^2 (alpha^22) = 8'hbe, beta^3 (alpha^33) = 8'h3a,
   19:       beta^4 (alpha^44) = 8'h3c, beta^5 (alpha^55) = 8'hdc, beta^6 (alpha^66) = 8'h56,
   20:       beta^7 (alpha^77) = 8'hca, beta^8 (alpha^88) = 8'h42.
   21: ===========================================================================
   22: */
   23: 
   24: module chien_search #(
   25:     parameter max = 254
   26: )(
   27:     input  wire        clk,
   28:     input  wire        rst_n,
   29:     input  wire        en,
   30:     input  wire [71:0] delta,
   31:     output wire        flag,
   32:     output wire        error,
   33:     output wire [7:0]  chien
   34: );
   35: 
   36:     reg [7:0] count = 8'd0;
   37: 
   38:     localparam IDLE   = 3'b001;
   39:     localparam ACTIVE = 3'b010;
   40:     localparam END    = 3'b100;
   41: 
   42:     reg [2:0] state;
   43:     reg [2:0] next_state;
   44: 
   45:     reg [71:0] delta_d0;
   46: 
   47:     reg  [7:0] Q [0:8];
   48:     wire [7:0] D [0:8];
   49:     wire [7:0] C0;
   50:     wire [7:0] C1;
   51: 
   52:     // FSM State Register
   53:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   54:         if (~rst_n)
   55:             state <= IDLE;
   56:         else
   57:             state <= next_state;
   58:     end
   59: 
   60:     // Cycle Counter
   61:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   62:         if (~rst_n)
   63:             count <= 8'd0;
   64:         else if (state == ACTIVE)
   65:             count <= count + 1'b1;
   66:         else
   67:             count <= 8'd0;
   68:     end
   69: 
   70:     // Next State Logic
   71:     always @(*) begin
   72:         case (state)
   73:             IDLE: begin
   74:                 if (en)
   75:                     next_state = ACTIVE;
   76:                 else
   77:                     next_state = IDLE;
   78:             end
   79:             ACTIVE: begin
   80:                 if (count < max)
   81:                     next_state = ACTIVE;
   82:                 else
   83:                     next_state = END;
   84:             end
   85:             END:     next_state = IDLE;
   86:             default: next_state = IDLE;
   87:         endcase
   88:     end
   89: 
   90:     // Input Delta Register
   91:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   92:         if (~rst_n)
   93:             delta_d0 <= 72'b0;
   94:         else
   95:             delta_d0 <= delta;
   96:     end
   97: 
   98:     // Coefficient Shift Registers
   99:     integer i;
  100:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  101:         if (~rst_n) begin
  102:             for (i = 0; i < 9; i = i + 1)
  103:                 Q[i] <= 8'b0;
  104:         end else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
  105:             if (count == 8'd0) begin
  106:                 Q[8] <= delta_d0[71:64];
  107:                 Q[7] <= delta_d0[63:56];
  108:                 Q[6] <= delta_d0[55:48];
  109:                 Q[5] <= delta_d0[47:40];
  110:                 Q[4] <= delta_d0[39:32];
  111:                 Q[3] <= delta_d0[31:24];
  112:                 Q[2] <= delta_d0[23:16];
  113:                 Q[1] <= delta_d0[15:8];
  114:                 Q[0] <= delta_d0[7:0];
  115:             end else begin
  116:                 for (i = 0; i < 9; i = i + 1)
  117:                     Q[i] <= D[i];
  118:             end
  119:         end else begin
  120:             for (i = 0; i < 9; i = i + 1)
  121:                 Q[i] <= 8'b0;
  122:         end
  123:     end
  124: 
  125:     // GF(2^8) Multipliers for powers beta^1 to beta^8 (where beta = alpha^11 in GF 0x187)
  126:     multiplier gf_1 (8'had, Q[1], D[1]);
  127:     multiplier gf_2 (8'hbe, Q[2], D[2]);
  128:     multiplier gf_3 (8'h3a, Q[3], D[3]);
  129:     multiplier gf_4 (8'h3c, Q[4], D[4]);
  130:     multiplier gf_5 (8'hdc, Q[5], D[5]);
  131:     multiplier gf_6 (8'h56, Q[6], D[6]);
  132:     multiplier gf_7 (8'hca, Q[7], D[7]);
  133:     multiplier gf_8 (8'h42, Q[8], D[8]);
  134: 
  135:     assign D[0] = Q[0];
  136:     assign C0   = Q[0] ^ Q[1] ^ Q[2] ^ Q[3] ^ Q[4] ^ Q[5] ^ Q[6] ^ Q[7] ^ Q[8];
  137:     assign C1   = Q[1] ^ Q[3] ^ Q[5] ^ Q[7];
  138: 
  139:     assign flag  = (state == ACTIVE);
  140:     assign error = (count != 8'd0 && C0 == 8'b0);
  141:     assign chien = (count != 8'd0) ? C1 : 8'b0;
  142: 
  143: endmodule

    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University / ETRI Daejeon
    5: Engineers    : Irzal Zaini & Williamsyah Baginda Miraj
    6: Module Name  : euclid_proc
    7: Description  : Reed-Solomon Key Equation Solver (Euclidean Algorithm).
    8:                Computes the 72-bit Error Locator Polynomial (delta) and 
    9:                the 64-bit Error Evaluator Polynomial (omega) from the 
   10:                128-bit syndrome vector in 40 active clock cycles.
   11: ===========================================================================
   12: */
   13: 
   14: module euclid_proc #(
   15:     parameter max = 39
   16: )(
   17:     input  wire         clk,
   18:     input  wire         rst_n,
   19:     input  wire         en,
   20:     input  wire [127:0] syndrome,
   21:     output wire         flag,
   22:     output wire [71:0]  delta,
   23:     output wire [63:0]  omega
   24: );
   25: 
   26:     reg [7:0] count = 8'd0;
   27: 
   28:     localparam IDLE   = 4'b0001;
   29:     localparam INIT   = 4'b0010;
   30:     localparam ACTIVE = 4'b0100;
   31:     localparam END    = 4'b1000;
   32: 
   33:     reg [3:0] state;
   34:     reg [3:0] next_state;
   35: 
   36:     reg [127:0] syndrome_d0;
   37: 
   38:     reg [7:0] reg_A [0:16];
   39:     reg [7:0] reg_S [0:16];
   40:     reg [7:0] reg_C [0:16];
   41:     reg [7:0] reg_W [0:16];
   42:     reg [7:0] reg_T [0:16];
   43:     reg [7:0] reg_Y [0:16];
   44: 
   45:     wire [7:0] X [0:16];
   46:     wire [7:0] Y [0:16];
   47:     wire [7:0] Z [0:16];
   48:     wire [7:0] T [0:16];
   49: 
   50:     wire [7:0] B [0:16];
   51:     wire [7:0] C [0:16];
   52:     wire [7:0] D [0:16];
   53:     wire [7:0] S [0:16];
   54: 
   55:     wire [7:0] inv_0;
   56:     wire [7:0] fold_B;
   57:     wire [7:0] fold_D;
   58: 
   59:     reg [7:0] reg_inv_0;
   60:     reg [7:0] reg_fold_B;
   61:     reg [7:0] reg_fold_D;
   62: 
   63:     reg [7:0] pos = 8'd0;
   64: 
   65:     // FSM State Register
   66:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   67:         if (~rst_n)
   68:             state <= IDLE;
   69:         else
   70:             state <= next_state;
   71:     end
   72: 
   73:     // Cycle Counter
   74:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   75:         if (~rst_n)
   76:             count <= 8'd0;
   77:         else if (state == ACTIVE)
   78:             count <= count + 1'b1;
   79:         else
   80:             count <= 8'd0;
   81:     end
   82: 
   83:     // Next State Logic
   84:     always @(*) begin
   85:         case (state)
   86:             IDLE: begin
   87:                 if (en)
   88:                     next_state = INIT;
   89:                 else
   90:                     next_state = IDLE;
   91:             end
   92:             INIT:   next_state = ACTIVE;
   93:             ACTIVE: begin
   94:                 if (count < max)
   95:                     next_state = ACTIVE;
   96:                 else
   97:                     next_state = END;
   98:             end
   99:             END:     next_state = IDLE;
  100:             default: next_state = IDLE;
  101:         endcase
  102:     end
  103: 
  104:     // Input Syndrome Register
  105:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  106:         if (~rst_n)
  107:             syndrome_d0 <= 128'b0;
  108:         else
  109:             syndrome_d0 <= syndrome;
  110:     end
  111: 
  112:     // Sub-iteration Phase Counter (0 to 4)
  113:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  114:         if (~rst_n)
  115:             pos <= 8'd0;
  116:         else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
  117:             if (pos < 8'd4)
  118:                 pos <= pos + 1'b1;
  119:             else
  120:                 pos <= 8'd0;
  121:         end else if (state == END)
  122:             pos <= 8'd0;
  123:     end
  124: 
  125:     // Polynomial Register Updates
  126:     integer i;
  127:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  128:         if (~rst_n) begin
  129:             reg_inv_0  <= 8'b0;
  130:             reg_fold_B <= 8'b0;
  131:             reg_fold_D <= 8'b0;
  132: 
  133:             for (i = 0; i < 17; i = i + 1) begin
  134:                 reg_A[i] <= 8'b0;
  135:                 reg_C[i] <= 8'b0;
  136:                 reg_S[i] <= 8'b0;
  137:                 reg_W[i] <= 8'b0;
  138:                 reg_Y[i] <= 8'b0;
  139:                 reg_T[i] <= 8'b0;
  140:             end
  141:         end else if (state == INIT) begin
  142:             reg_A[16] <= 8'h01;
  143:             reg_T[0]  <= 8'h01;
  144: 
  145:             for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1)
  146:                 reg_A[i] <= 8'b0;
  147:             for (i = 1; i < 17; i = i + 1)
  148:                 reg_T[i] <= 8'b0;
  149:             for (i = 0; i < 17; i = i + 1) begin
  150:                 reg_C[i] <= 8'b0;
  151:                 reg_W[i] <= 8'b0;
  152:                 reg_Y[i] <= 8'b0;
  153:             end
  154: 
  155:             reg_S[16] <= syndrome_d0[127:120];
  156:             reg_S[15] <= syndrome_d0[119:112];
  157:             reg_S[14] <= syndrome_d0[111:104];
  158:             reg_S[13] <= syndrome_d0[103:96];
  159:             reg_S[12] <= syndrome_d0[95:88];
  160:             reg_S[11] <= syndrome_d0[87:80];
  161:             reg_S[10] <= syndrome_d0[79:72];
  162:             reg_S[9]  <= syndrome_d0[71:64];
  163:             reg_S[8]  <= syndrome_d0[63:56];
  164:             reg_S[7]  <= syndrome_d0[55:48];
  165:             reg_S[6]  <= syndrome_d0[47:40];
  166:             reg_S[5]  <= syndrome_d0[39:32];
  167:             reg_S[4]  <= syndrome_d0[31:24];
  168:             reg_S[3]  <= syndrome_d0[23:16];
  169:             reg_S[2]  <= syndrome_d0[15:8];

  171:             reg_S[0]  <= 8'b0;
  172:         end else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
  173:             case (pos)
  174:                 8'd0: reg_inv_0  <= inv_0;
  175:                 8'd1: reg_fold_B <= fold_B;
  176:                 8'd3: reg_fold_D <= fold_D;
  177:                 8'd4: begin

  181:                         reg_T[i] <= T[i];
  182:                     end
  183: 
  184:                     reg_S[16] <= S[14];
  185:                     reg_S[15] <= S[13];
  186:                     reg_S[14] <= S[12];
  187:                     reg_S[13] <= S[11];
  188:                     reg_S[12] <= S[10];
  189:                     reg_S[11] <= S[9];
  190:                     reg_S[10] <= S[8];
  191:                     reg_S[9]  <= S[7];
  192:                     reg_S[8]  <= S[6];
  193:                     reg_S[7]  <= S[5];
  194:                     reg_S[6]  <= S[4];
  195:                     reg_S[5]  <= S[3];
  196:                     reg_S[4]  <= S[2];
  197:                     reg_S[3]  <= S[1];
  198:                     reg_S[2]  <= S[0];
  199:                     reg_S[1]  <= 8'b0;
  200:                     reg_S[0]  <= 8'b0;
  201:                 end
  202:             endcase
  203: 
  204:             for (i = 0; i < 17; i = i + 1) begin
  205:                 reg_C[i] <= C[i];
  206:                 reg_Y[i] <= Y[i];
  207:             end
  208:         end
  209:     end
  210:

  212:     inverter   invert_0 (reg_S[16], inv_0);

  214:     multiplier gf_D     (reg_inv_0, reg_C[15], fold_D);

  222:     multiplier gf_B11 (reg_fold_B, reg_S[11], B[11]);

    7: Description  : Reed-Solomon Forney Algorithm Unit over GF(2^8).
    8:                Computes the error magnitude (forney = C0 * chien^-1) using 
    9:                the Error Evaluator Polynomial (omega) and the odd-power sum 
   10:                from the Chien Search module.
   11: 
   12: Revision History:
   13:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Forney error evaluator for root offset j_0 = 0 over 0x11D.
   14:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 03:54 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 2 & 3 - SDA OISL Page 37, Sec. 2.6.3.6.3]
   15:     Updated evaluator step multipliers (gf_d0..gf_7) to r_k = alpha^((11*(120+k)) % 255)
   16:     for k = 0..7 over GF(2^8) 0x187 so that the non-zero initial root offset (j_0 = 120,
   17:     factor beta^(120*m)) is automatically compensated in C0 every cycle without extra latency.
   18: ===========================================================================
   19: */
   20: 
   21: module forney_math #(
   22:     parameter max = 254
   23: )(
   24:     input  wire        clk,
   25:     input  wire        rst_n,
   26:     input  wire        en,
   27:     input  wire [63:0] omega,
   28:     input  wire [7:0]  chien,
   29:     output wire        flag,
   30:     output wire [7:0]  forney
   31: );
   32: 
   33:     reg [7:0] count = 8'd0;
   34: 
   35:     localparam IDLE   = 3'b001;
   36:     localparam ACTIVE = 3'b010;
   37:     localparam END    = 3'b100;
   38: 
   39:     reg [2:0] state;
   40:     reg [2:0] next_state;
   41: 
   42:     reg [63:0] omega_d0;
   43: 
   44:     reg  [7:0] Q [0:7];
   45:     wire [7:0] D [0:7];
   46:     wire [7:0] C0;
   47:     wire [7:0] C1;
   48:     wire [7:0] inv_0;
   49: 
   50:     // FSM State Register
   51:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   52:         if (~rst_n)
   53:             state <= IDLE;
   54:         else
   55:             state <= next_state;
   56:     end
   57: 
   58:     // Cycle Counter
   59:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   60:         if (~rst_n)
   61:             count <= 8'd0;
   62:         else if (state == ACTIVE)
   63:             count <= count + 1'b1;
   64:         else
   65:             count <= 8'd0;
   66:     end
   67: 
   68:     // Next State Logic
   69:     always @(*) begin
   70:         case (state)
   71:             IDLE: begin
   72:                 if (en)
   73:                     next_state = ACTIVE;
   74:                 else
   75:                     next_state = IDLE;
   76:             end
   77:             ACTIVE: begin
   78:                 if (count < max)
   79:                     next_state = ACTIVE;
   80:                 else
   81:                     next_state = END;
   82:             end
   83:             END:     next_state = IDLE;
   84:             default: next_state = IDLE;
   85:         endcase
   86:     end
   87: 
   88:     // Input Omega Register
   89:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   90:         if (~rst_n)
   91:             omega_d0 <= 64'b0;
   92:         else
   93:             omega_d0 <= omega;
   94:     end
   95: 
   96:     // Evaluator Shift Registers
   97:     integer i;
   98:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   99:         if (~rst_n) begin
  100:             for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1)
  101:                 Q[i] <= 8'b0;
  102:         end else if (state == ACTIVE) begin
  103:             if (count == 8'd0) begin
  104:                 Q[7] <= omega_d0[63:56];
  105:                 Q[6] <= omega_d0[55:48];
  106:                 Q[5] <= omega_d0[47:40];
  107:                 Q[4] <= omega_d0[39:32];
  108:                 Q[3] <= omega_d0[31:24];
  109:                 Q[2] <= omega_d0[23:16];
  110:                 Q[1] <= omega_d0[15:8];
  111:                 Q[0] <= omega_d0[7:0];
  112:             end else begin
  113:                 for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1)
  114:                     Q[i] <= D[i];
  115:             end
  116:         end else begin
  117:             for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1)
  118:                 Q[i] <= 8'b0;
  119:         end
  120:     end
  121: 
  122:     // GF(2^8) Inversion and Multipliers (beta^(120+k) for k = 0..7 in GF 0x187)
  123:     inverter   invert_0 (chien, inv_0);
  124:     multiplier gf_0     (inv_0, C0,   C1);
  125:     multiplier gf_d0    (8'h78, Q[0], D[0]);
  126:     multiplier gf_1     (8'h3f, Q[1], D[1]);
  127:     multiplier gf_2     (8'hac, Q[2], D[2]);
  128:     multiplier gf_3     (8'h13, Q[3], D[3]);
  129:     multiplier gf_4     (8'h84, Q[4], D[4]);
  130:     multiplier gf_5     (8'h06, Q[5], D[5]);
  131:     multiplier gf_6     (8'he0, Q[6], D[6]);
  132:     multiplier gf_7     (8'h8a, Q[7], D[7]);
  133: 
  134:     assign C0   = Q[0] ^ Q[1] ^ Q[2] ^ Q[3] ^ Q[4] ^ Q[5] ^ Q[6] ^ Q[7];
  135: 
  136:     assign flag   = (state == ACTIVE);
  137:     assign forney = (count != 8'd0) ? C1 : 8'b0;
  138: 
  139: endmodule

    8:                Maps an 8-bit field element 'a' to its multiplicative inverse 
    9:                'r = a^(-1)' using logarithm (alpha_value.mem) and antilogarithm 
   10:                (decimal_value.mem) lookup tables constructed with primitive 
   11:                polynomial p(x) = x^8 + x^4 + x^3 + x^2 + 1 (0x11D).

   17:     official SDA OISL v2.1.2 Galois Field generator polynomial F(x) = x^8 + x^7 + x^2 + x + 1 (0x187).
   18: ===========================================================================
   19: */
   20: 
   21: module inverter #(
   22:     parameter max = 255
   23: )(
   24:     input  wire [7:0] a,
   25:     output wire [7:0] r
   26: );
   27: 
   28:     wire [7:0] alpha_a;
   29:     wire [7:0] alpha_r;
   30: 
   31:     reg  [7:0] alpha_value   [0:max];
   32:     reg  [7:0] decimal_value [0:max];

   36:         $readmemh("decimal_value.mem", decimal_value);

   40:     assign alpha_r = (alpha_a == max) ? ((alpha_a == 8'b0) ? max : 8'b0) : (alpha_a - (alpha_a * 2) + max);
   41:     assign r       = decimal_value[alpha_r];

   17: ===========================================================================
   18: */
   19: 
   20: module multiplier #(
   21:     parameter max = 255
   22: )(
   23:     input  wire [7:0] a,
   24:     input  wire [7:0] b,
   25:     output wire [7:0] r
   26: );
   27: 
   28:     wire [7:0] alpha_a;
   29:     wire [7:0] alpha_b;
   30:     wire [7:0] alpha_r;
   31: 
   32:     reg  [7:0] alpha_value   [0:max];
   33:     reg  [7:0] decimal_value [0:max];
   34: 
   35:     initial begin
   36:         $readmemh("alpha_value.mem", alpha_value);
   37:         $readmemh("decimal_value.mem", decimal_value);
   38:     end
   39:

   41:     assign alpha_b = alpha_value[b];
   42:     assign alpha_r = (alpha_a == max || alpha_b == max) ? max : (alpha_a + alpha_b) % max;
   43:     assign r       = decimal_value[alpha_r];

   45: endmodule

    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University / ETRI Daejeon
    5: Engineers    : Irzal Zaini & Williamsyah Baginda Miraj
    6: Module Name  : rs_decoder
    7: Description  : Reed-Solomon Decoder Top Module with Dual-Port BRAM Buffer.
    8:                Supports both RS(255,239) for Payload (max_rd = 256 -> 239 
    9:                output bytes) and shortened RS(32,16) for Header (max_rd = 33 
   10:                -> 16 output bytes).
   11: 
   12:                Revision History:
   13:                - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Dual-port BRAM RS(255,239) / RS(32,16) decoder.
   14:                - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 06:20 KST) : Updated timescale to 1ns/1ps 
   15:                  and added simulation trackers (out_byte_cnt and 
   16:                  repaired_symbol_cnt) required by rs_decoder_64.v lines 106-110.
   17: ===========================================================================
   18: */
   19: 
   20: module rs_decoder #(
   21:     parameter max_rd = 256
   22: )(
   23:     input  wire       clk,
   24:     input  wire       rst_n,
   25:     input  wire       en,
   26:     input  wire [7:0] data_in,
   27:     output wire       flag,
   28:     output wire [7:0] data_out
   29: );
   30: 
   31:     localparam max_wr   = 254;
   32:     localparam max_hold = 43;
   33: 
   34:     // Write Path (Port A) State Machine
   35:     localparam WR_IDLE  = 3'b001;
   36:     localparam WR_WRITE = 3'b010;
   37:     localparam WR_HOLD  = 3'b100;
   38: 
   39:     reg [2:0]  wr_state;
   40:     reg [2:0]  wr_next_state;
   41:     reg [7:0]  con_wr   = 8'd0;
   42:     reg [7:0]  con_hold = 8'd0;
   43: 
   44:     // Read Path (Port B) State Machine
   45:     localparam RD_IDLE  = 3'b001;
   46:     localparam RD_READ  = 3'b010;
   47:     localparam RD_END   = 3'b100;
   48: 
   49:     reg [2:0]  rd_state;
   50:     reg [2:0]  rd_next_state;
   51:     reg [15:0] con_rd   = 16'd0;
   52: 
   53:     reg [7:0]  data_d0;
   54: 
   55:     wire         syndrome_dv;
   56:     wire [127:0] syndrome;
   57: 
   58:     wire         euclid_dv;
   59:     wire [71:0]  delta;
   60:     wire [63:0]  omega;
   61: 
   62:     wire         error_pos;
   63:     wire [7:0]   chien;
   64:     wire [7:0]   forney;
   65: 
   66:     wire         wr_en;
   67:     wire         rd_en;
   68:     wire [7:0]   rd_addr_b;
   69:     wire [7:0]   data_delay;
   70:     reg  [7:0]   decode_out;
   71: 
   72:     // 1. Port A Write FSM
   73:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   74:         if (~rst_n)
   75:             wr_state <= WR_IDLE;
   76:         else
   77:             wr_state <= wr_next_state;
   78:     end
   79: 
   80:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   81:         if (~rst_n)
   82:             con_wr <= 8'd0;
   83:         else if (wr_state == WR_WRITE)
   84:             con_wr <= con_wr + 1'b1;
   85:         else
   86:             con_wr <= 8'd0;
   87:     end
   88: 
   89:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   90:         if (~rst_n)
   91:             con_hold <= 8'd0;
   92:         else if (wr_state == WR_HOLD)
   93:             con_hold <= con_hold + 1'b1;
   94:         else
   95:             con_hold <= 8'd0;
   96:     end
   97: 
   98:     always @(*) begin
   99:         case (wr_state)
  100:             WR_IDLE: begin
  101:                 if (en)
  102:                     wr_next_state = WR_WRITE;
  103:                 else
  104:                     wr_next_state = WR_IDLE;
  105:             end
  106:             WR_WRITE: begin
  107:                 if (con_wr < max_wr)
  108:                     wr_next_state = WR_WRITE;
  109:                 else
  110:                     wr_next_state = WR_HOLD;
  111:             end
  112:             WR_HOLD: begin
  113:                 if (con_hold < max_hold)
  114:                     wr_next_state = WR_HOLD;
  115:                 else
  116:                     wr_next_state = WR_IDLE;
  117:             end
  118:             default: wr_next_state = WR_IDLE;
  119:         endcase
  120:     end
  121: 
  122:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  123:         if (~rst_n)
  124:             data_d0 <= 8'b0;
  125:         else
  126:             data_d0 <= data_in;
  127:     end
  128: 
  129:     // 2. Port B Read FSM
  130:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  131:         if (~rst_n)
  132:             rd_state <= RD_IDLE;
  133:         else
  134:             rd_state <= rd_next_state;
  135:     end
  136: 
  137:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  138:         if (~rst_n)
  139:             con_rd <= 16'd0;
  140:         else if (rd_state == RD_READ)
  141:             con_rd <= con_rd + 1'b1;
  142:         else
  143:             con_rd <= 16'd0;
  144:     end
  145: 
  146:     always @(*) begin
  147:         case (rd_state)
  148:             RD_IDLE: begin
  149:                 if (euclid_dv)
  150:                     rd_next_state = RD_READ;
  151:                 else
  152:                     rd_next_state = RD_IDLE;
  153:             end
  154:             RD_READ: begin
  155:                 if (con_rd < max_rd)
  156:                     rd_next_state = RD_READ;
  157:                 else
  158:                     rd_next_state = RD_END;
  159:             end
  160:             RD_END:  rd_next_state = RD_IDLE;
  161:             default: rd_next_state = RD_IDLE;
  162:         endcase
  163:     end
  164: 
  165:     // Error Correction XOR Logic
  166:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  167:         if (~rst_n)
  168:             decode_out <= 8'b0;
  169:         else if (rd_state == RD_READ && con_rd < max_rd - 16) begin
  170:             if (error_pos)
  171:                 decode_out <= data_delay ^ forney;
  172:             else
  173:                 decode_out <= data_delay;
  174:         end else
  175:             decode_out <= 8'b0;
  176:     end
  177: 
  178:     // 1-cycle address pre-fetch on Port B compensates for bram_rs 2-cycle read latency
  179:     assign wr_en     = (wr_state == WR_WRITE && con_wr < max_rd - 1);
  180:     assign rd_en     = euclid_dv || (rd_state == RD_READ);
  181:     assign rd_addr_b = (rd_state == RD_READ) ? (con_rd[7:0] + 8'd1) : 8'd0;
  182: 
  183:     assign flag      = (rd_state == RD_READ) && (con_rd > 1 && con_rd < max_rd - 15);
  184:     assign data_out  = (flag) ? decode_out : 8'b0;
  185: 
  186:     // 3. Dual-Port BRAM Data Delay Buffer
  187:     bram_rs bram_rs_inst (
  188:         .clka  (clk),
  189:         .ena   (wr_en),
  190:         .wea   (1'b1),
  191:         .addra (con_wr[7:0]),
  192:         .dina  (data_d0),
  193: 
  194:         .clkb  (clk),
  195:         .enb   (rd_en),
  196:         .addrb (rd_addr_b),
  197:         .doutb (data_delay)
  198:     );
  199: 
  200:     // 4. Reed-Solomon Sub-Modules
  201:     syndrome_unit syndrome_unit_inst (
  202:         .clk      (clk),
  203:         .rst_n    (rst_n),
  204:         .en       (en),
  205:         .data_in  (data_in),
  206:         .flag     (syndrome_dv),
  207:         .syndrome (syndrome)
  208:     );
  209: 
  210:     euclid_proc euclid_proc_inst (
  211:         .clk      (clk),
  212:         .rst_n    (rst_n),
  213:         .en       (syndrome_dv),
  214:         .syndrome (syndrome),
  215:         .flag     (euclid_dv),
  216:         .delta    (delta),
  217:         .omega    (omega)
  218:     );
  219: 
  220:     chien_search chien_search_inst (
  221:         .clk   (clk),
  222:         .rst_n (rst_n),
  223:         .en    (euclid_dv),
  224:         .delta (delta),
  225:         .flag  (),
  226:         .error (error_pos),
  227:         .chien (chien)
  228:     );
  229: 
  230:     forney_math forney_math_inst (
  231:         .clk    (clk),
  232:         .rst_n  (rst_n),
  233:         .en     (euclid_dv),
  234:         .omega  (omega),
  235:         .chien  (chien),
  236:         .flag   (),
  237:         .forney (forney)
  238:     );
  239: 
  240:     // =======================================================
  241:     // 5. SIMULATION TRACKERS (Required by rs_decoder_64.v)
  242:     // =======================================================
  243:     // synthesis translate_off
  244:     wire [8:0]  out_byte_cnt = flag ? (con_rd[8:0] - 9'd1) : 9'd0;
  245:     reg  [11:0] repaired_symbol_cnt;
  246: 
  247:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  248:         if (~rst_n)
  249:             repaired_symbol_cnt <= 12'd0;
  250:         else if (rd_state == RD_READ && con_rd < max_rd - 16 && error_pos && (forney != 8'd0))
  251:             repaired_symbol_cnt <= repaired_symbol_cnt + 12'd1;
  252:     end
  253:     // synthesis translate_on
  254: 
  255: endmodule

Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : rs_encoder
    7: Description  : Reed-Solomon (RS) Systematic Encoder over GF(2^8).
    8:                Appends 16 Parity bytes to an incoming data stream using 
    9:                generator polynomial g(x) = (x + alpha^0)...(x + alpha^15).
   10: 
   11:                Configuration:
   12:                - Payload RS(255,239): MAX_CYCLE = 254 (0-indexed: 0..254 = 255 cycles)
   13:                  -> Active Data Phase = 239 cycles (count = 0..238)
   14:                  -> Flush Parity Phase = 16 cycles (count = 239..254)
   15:                  -> Total Output = 255 cycles.
   16:                - Header RS(32,16)   : MAX_CYCLE = 31 (0-indexed: 0..31 = 32 cycles)
   17:                  -> Active Data Phase = 16 cycles (count = 0..15)
   18:                  -> Flush Parity Phase = 16 cycles (count = 16..31)
   19:                  -> Total Output = 32 cycles.
   20: 
   21: Revision History:
   22:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Baseline RS(255,239) / RS(32,16) encoder with roots alpha^0..alpha^15.
   23:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 03:54 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 3 - SDA OISL Page 37, Sec. 2.6.3.6.3]
   24:     Recalculated and replaced all 16 generator polynomial multiplier coefficients (gf_0..gf_f)
   25:     for g(x) = prod_{j=120}^{135} (x - alpha^(11*j)) over GF(2^8) primitive polynomial
   26:     F(x) = x^8 + x^7 + x^2 + x + 1 (0x187) in conventional basis.
   27:   - Rev 2.1 (2026-10-28 13:56 KST) : [Internal Audit Fix #1 & #2]
   28:     1. Changed FLUSH phase output assignment from 'C0' (Q[15] ^ data_d0) to pure 'Q[15]'
   29:        so that the 16 emitted parity bytes are completely isolated from any residual 
   30:        transitions on data_in / data_d0 after the active data window ends.
   31:     2. Aligned default parameter MAX_CYCLE to 254 (matching 0-indexed count 0..254 = 
   32:        255 total cycles used by core_tx.v).
   33: ===========================================================================
   34: */
   35: 
   36: module rs_encoder # (parameter MAX_CYCLE = 254) (
   37:     input           clk,
   38:     input           rst_n,
   39:     input           en,
   40:     input   [7:0]   data_in,
   41:     output          flag,
   42:     output  [7:0]   data_out
   43: );
   44:     
   45:     reg     [7:0]   count   = 8'd0;
   46: 
   47:     localparam  IDLE        = 4'b0001;
   48:     localparam  ACTIVE      = 4'b0010;
   49:     localparam  FLUSH       = 4'b0100;
   50:     localparam  END         = 4'b1000;
   51: 
   52:     reg     [3:0]   state;
   53:     reg     [3:0]   next_state;
   54: 
   55:     reg     [7:0]   data_d0;
   56: 
   57:     reg     [7:0]   Q   [0:15];
   58:     wire    [7:0]   D   [0:15];
   59:     wire    [7:0]   R   [0:15];
   60: 
   61:     wire    [7:0]   C0;
   62:     wire    [7:0]   C1;
   63: 
   64:     // =======================================================
   65:     // FSM LOGIC
   66:     // =======================================================
   67:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   68:         if (~rst_n)
   69:             state   <= IDLE;
   70:         else
   71:             state   <= next_state;
   72:     end
   73: 
   74:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   75:         if (~rst_n)
   76:             count   <= 8'd0;
   77:         else if (state == ACTIVE || state == FLUSH)
   78:             count   <= count + 1'b1;
   79:         else
   80:             count   <= 8'd0;
   81:     end
   82: 
   83:     always @(*) begin
   84:         case(state)
   85:             IDLE:   begin
   86:                         if (en) next_state <= ACTIVE;
   87:                         else    next_state <= IDLE;
   88:                     end
   89:             ACTIVE: begin
   90:                         // Read Data Phase
   91:                         if (count < MAX_CYCLE - 16) next_state <= ACTIVE;
   92:                         else                        next_state <= FLUSH;
   93:                     end
   94:             FLUSH:  begin
   95:                         // Dump 16 Parity Bytes Phase
   96:                         if (count < MAX_CYCLE) next_state <= FLUSH;
   97:                         else                   next_state <= END;
   98:                     end
   99:             END:    next_state <= IDLE;
  100:             default: next_state <= IDLE;
  101:         endcase
  102:     end
  103: 
  104:     // =======================================================
  105:     // DATA PIPELINE & SHIFT REGISTERS
  106:     // =======================================================
  107:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  108:         if (~rst_n)
  109:             data_d0 <= 8'b0;
  110:         else
  111:             data_d0 <= data_in;
  112:     end
  113: 
  114:     reg [7:0] i;
  115:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  116:         if (~rst_n) begin
  117:             for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1)
  118:                 Q[i]  <= 8'b0;
  119:         end 
  120:         else if (state == ACTIVE || state == FLUSH) begin
  121:             for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1)
  122:                 Q[i]  <= D[i];
  123:         end 
  124:         else begin
  125:             for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1)
  126:                 Q[i]  <= 8'b0;
  127:         end
  128:     end
  129: 
  130:     // =======================================================
  131:     // GALOIS FIELD MULTIPLIERS
  132:     // [Rev 2.0 - 2026-10-27 03:54 KST] Updated to SDA OISL v2.1.2 Page 37
  133:     // roots alpha^(11*j) for j = 120..135 over GF(2^8) 0x187:
  134:     // =======================================================
  135:     multiplier gf_0 (8'h01, C1, R[0]);
  136:     multiplier gf_1 (8'ha5, C1, R[1]);
  137:     multiplier gf_2 (8'h69, C1, R[2]);
  138:     multiplier gf_3 (8'h1b, C1, R[3]);
  139:     multiplier gf_4 (8'h9f, C1, R[4]);
  140:     multiplier gf_5 (8'h68, C1, R[5]);
  141:     multiplier gf_6 (8'h98, C1, R[6]);
  142:     multiplier gf_7 (8'h65, C1, R[7]);
  143:     multiplier gf_8 (8'h4a, C1, R[8]);
  144:     multiplier gf_9 (8'h65, C1, R[9]);
  145:     multiplier gf_a (8'h98, C1, R[10]);
  146:     multiplier gf_b (8'h68, C1, R[11]);
  147:     multiplier gf_c (8'h9f, C1, R[12]);
  148:     multiplier gf_d (8'h1b, C1, R[13]);
  149:     multiplier gf_e (8'h69, C1, R[14]);
  150:     multiplier gf_f (8'ha5, C1, R[15]);
  151: 
  152:     assign  D[0]  = R[0];
  153:     assign  D[1]  = R[1]  ^ Q[0];
  154:     assign  D[2]  = R[2]  ^ Q[1];
  155:     assign  D[3]  = R[3]  ^ Q[2];
  156:     assign  D[4]  = R[4]  ^ Q[3];
  157:     assign  D[5]  = R[5]  ^ Q[4];
  158:     assign  D[6]  = R[6]  ^ Q[5];
  159:     assign  D[7]  = R[7]  ^ Q[6];
  160:     assign  D[8]  = R[8]  ^ Q[7];
  161:     assign  D[9]  = R[9]  ^ Q[8];
  162:     assign  D[10] = R[10] ^ Q[9];
  163:     assign  D[11] = R[11] ^ Q[10];
  164:     assign  D[12] = R[12] ^ Q[11];
  165:     assign  D[13] = R[13] ^ Q[12];
  166:     assign  D[14] = R[14] ^ Q[13];
  167:     assign  D[15] = R[15] ^ Q[14];
  168: 
  169:     assign  C0       = Q[15] ^ data_d0;
  170:     assign  C1       = (state == FLUSH) ? 8'b0 : C0;
  171: 
  172:     // Output Mapping ([Rev 2.1] Output pure Q[15] during FLUSH so parity is immune to data_d0)
  173:     assign  flag     = (state == ACTIVE || state == FLUSH);
  174:     assign  data_out = (state == FLUSH) ? Q[15] : data_d0;
  175: 
  176: endmodule

    6: Module Name  : syndrome_unit
    7: Description  : Reed-Solomon Syndrome Computation Unit over GF(2^8).

   11:                automatically shift the codeword roots to align with the 
   12:                Chien search starting position (alpha^-254).

   14: Revision History:

   17:     Updated the 16 syndrome evaluation roots (gf_0..gf_f) to r_k = alpha^((11*(120+k)) % 255)
   18:     for j = 120..135 over GF(2^8) 0x187:
   19:       j=120 (alpha^45)=8'h78, j=121 (alpha^56)=8'h3f, j=122 (alpha^67)=8'hac, j=123 (alpha^78)=8'h13,
   20:       j=124 (alpha^89)=8'h84, j=125 (alpha^100)=8'h06, j=126 (alpha^111)=8'he0, j=127 (alpha^122)=8'h8a,
   21:       j=128 (alpha^133)=8'h9c, j=129 (alpha^144)=8'h88, j=130 (alpha^155)=8'h41, j=131 (alpha^166)=8'h73,
   22:       j=132 (alpha^177)=8'h35, j=133 (alpha^188)=8'h0b, j=134 (alpha^199)=8'h0a, j=135 (alpha^210)=8'ha7.
   23: ===========================================================================
   24: */
   25: 
   26: module syndrome_unit #(
   27:     parameter max = 255
   28: )(

Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 100ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : sda_decoder
    7: Description  : Complete SDA OISL Receiver Grand Top Module.
    8:                Integrates all 5 receiver stages:
    9:                1. rx_gth_logic             (CDC 3: 312.5M 32b -> 200M 128b)
   10:                2. core_rx                  (Demux 128, LPC Dec, Descrambler, 
   11:                                             FEC_Demux, RS(32,16) & 8xRS(255,239))
   12:                3. rx_logic_gth             (CDC 4: 200M -> 312.5M Hdr & Pld)
   13:                4. fso_ethernet_deframer    (CRC-16/32 Check, Header Parser, 
   14:                                             Selective Repeat ARQ & Frame Demux)
   15:                5. ethernet_frame_reassembly(De-Segmenter, Padding Stripper, 
   16:                                             eth_preamble_gen & mux_eth_32)
   17: ===========================================================================
   18: */
   19: 
   20: module sda_decoder (
   21:     input  wire        clk_gth,            // 312.5 MHz Clock
   22:     input  wire        clk_logic,          // 200.0 MHz Clock
   23:     input  wire        rst_n,              // Active-low reset
   24: 
   25:     // Input from gth64b66b_rx.v (312.5 MHz Domain, 3117 Bytes/frame)
   26:     input  wire        rx_fso_valid_in,
   27:     input  wire [31:0] rx_fso_data_in,
   28: 
   29:     // Reassembled Ethernet Frame Output to eth_tx_back_end_top (2008 Bytes for 2000B Jumbo)
   30:     output wire [31:0] m_axis_eth_tdata,
   31:     output wire        m_axis_eth_tvalid,
   32:     output wire        m_axis_eth_tlast,
   33: 
   34:     // Closed-Loop ARQ Feedback to sda_encoder
   35:     output wire [15:0] arq_fb_rxfn,
   36:     output wire        arq_fb_ack,
   37:     output wire        arq_fb_ack_valid,
   38: 
   39:     // Probing & Status Outputs
   40:     output wire        m_axis_hdr_tvalid,
   41:     output wire [7:0]  m_axis_hdr_tdata,
   42:     output wire        m_axis_fso_tvalid,
   43:     output wire [31:0] m_axis_fso_tdata,
   44:     output wire        rx_preamble_locked,
   45:     output wire        hdr_crc_ok,
   46:     output wire        pld_crc_ok
   47: );
   48: 
   49:     // 1. CDC 3 -> core_rx (200.0 MHz, 128-bit)
   50:     wire         core_dv;
   51:     wire [127:0] core_data;
   52: 
   53:     // 2. core_rx -> CDC 4 (200.0 MHz)
   54:     wire         rs_head_dv;
   55:     wire [7:0]   rs_head;
   56:     wire         rs_load_dv;
   57:     wire [63:0]  rs_load;
   58: 
   59:     // 3. CDC 4 -> fso_ethernet_deframer (312.5 MHz)
   60:     wire         cdc4_hdr_dv;
   61:     wire [7:0]   cdc4_hdr_data;
   62:     wire         cdc4_pld_dv;
   63:     wire [31:0]  cdc4_pld_data;
   64: 
   65:     assign m_axis_hdr_tvalid = cdc4_hdr_dv;
   66:     assign m_axis_hdr_tdata  = cdc4_hdr_data;
   67:     assign m_axis_fso_tvalid = cdc4_pld_dv;
   68:     assign m_axis_fso_tdata  = cdc4_pld_data;
   69: 
   70:     // 4. fso_ethernet_deframer -> ethernet_frame_reassembly (312.5 MHz, 1908 Bytes)
   71:     wire [31:0]  deframed_data_tdata;
   72:     wire         deframed_data_tvalid;
   73:     wire         deframed_data_tlast;
   74:     wire         deframed_data_tready;
   75: 
   76:     // Stage 1: CDC 3 (312.5 MHz 32b -> 200.0 MHz 128b)
   77:     rx_gth_logic u_cdc_rx_3 (
   78:         .clk_gth   (clk_gth),
   79:         .clk_logic (clk_logic),
   80:         .rst_n     (rst_n),
   81:         .en        (rx_fso_valid_in),
   82:         .data_in   (rx_fso_data_in),
   83:         .flag      (core_dv),
   84:         .data_out  (core_data)
   85:     );
   86: 
   87:     // Stage 2: FEC Reception Core (200.0 MHz)
   88:     core_rx u_core_rx (
   89:         .clk         (clk_logic),
   90:         .rst_n       (rst_n),
   91:         .en          (core_dv),
   92:         .data_in     (core_data),
   93:         .header_dv   (rs_head_dv),
   94:         .header      (rs_head),
   95:         .payload_dv  (rs_load_dv),
   96:         .payload     (rs_load),
   97:         .link_locked (rx_preamble_locked)
   98:     );
   99: 
  100:     // Stage 3: CDC 4 (200.0 MHz -> 312.5 MHz)
  101:     rx_logic_gth u_cdc_rx_4 (
  102:         .clk_gth    (clk_gth),
  103:         .clk_logic  (clk_logic),
  104:         .rst_n      (rst_n),
  105:         .en_head    (rs_head_dv),
  106:         .en_load    (rs_load_dv),
  107:         .header_in  (rs_head),
  108:         .payload_in (rs_load),
  109:         .header_dv  (cdc4_hdr_dv),
  110:         .header     (cdc4_hdr_data),
  111:         .payload_dv (cdc4_pld_dv),
  112:         .payload    (cdc4_pld_data)
  113:     );
  114: 
  115:     // Stage 4: FSO-to-Ethernet Deframer & Selective Repeat ARQ (312.5 MHz)
  116:     fso_ethernet_deframer u_fso_ethernet_deframer (
  117:         .clk                  (clk_gth),
  118:         .rst_n                (rst_n),
  119:         .s_axis_hdr_tvalid    (cdc4_hdr_dv),
  120:         .s_axis_hdr_tdata     (cdc4_hdr_data),
  121:         .s_axis_fso_tvalid    (cdc4_pld_dv),
  122:         .s_axis_fso_tdata     (cdc4_pld_data),
  123:         .m_axis_fso_tdata     (deframed_data_tdata),
  124:         .m_axis_fso_tvalid    (deframed_data_tvalid),
  125:         .m_axis_fso_tlast     (deframed_data_tlast),
  126:         .m_axis_fso_tready    (deframed_data_tready),
  127:         .local_fb_rxfn        (arq_fb_rxfn),
  128:         .local_fb_ack         (arq_fb_ack),
  129:         .local_fb_ack_valid   (arq_fb_ack_valid),
  130:         .peer_rxfn_out        (),
  131:         .peer_ack_out         (),
  132:         .peer_ack_valid_out   (),
  133:         .hdr_crc_ok           (hdr_crc_ok),
  134:         .pld_crc_ok           (pld_crc_ok),
  135:         .rx_txfn              (),
  136:         .rx_frame_type        (),
  137:         .rx_tx_ts             (),
  138:         .rx_fcch_op           (),
  139:         .rx_fcch_pl           (),
  140:         .mgmt_range_meters    (),
  141:         .mgmt_telemetry_valid (),
  142:         .expected_txfn        ()
  143:     );
  144: 
  145:     // Stage 5: Ethernet Frame Reassembly & Preamble Injection (312.5 MHz)
  146:     ethernet_frame_reassembly u_ethernet_frame_reassembly (
  147:         .clk                   (clk_gth),
  148:         .rst_n                 (rst_n),
  149:         .s_axis_fso_tdata      (deframed_data_tdata),
  150:         .s_axis_fso_tvalid     (deframed_data_tvalid),
  151:         .s_axis_fso_tlast      (deframed_data_tlast),
  152:         .s_axis_fso_tready     (deframed_data_tready),
  153:         .m_axis_eth_tdata      (m_axis_eth_tdata),
  154:         .m_axis_eth_tvalid     (m_axis_eth_tvalid),
  155:         .m_axis_eth_tlast      (m_axis_eth_tlast),
  156:         .m_axis_eth_tready     (1'b1),
  157:         .reassembled_pkt_bytes (),
  158:         .reassembled_pkt_cnt   ()
  159:     );
  160: 
  161: endmodule

    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    3: // Company: 
    4: // Engineer: 
    5: // 
    6: // Create Date: 09/29/2025 02:08:47 PM
    7: // Design Name: 
    8: // Module Name: stream_input
    9: // Project Name: 
   10: // Target Devices: 
   11: // Tool Versions: 
   12: // Description: 
   13: // 
   14: // Dependencies: 
   15: // 
   16: // Revision:
   17: // Revision 0.01 - File Created
   18: // Additional Comments:
   19: // 
   20: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   21: 
   22: 
   23: module stream_input(
   24:     input               clk,
   25:     input               rst_n,
   26:     input               en,
   27:     output              flag,
   28:     output  [31:0]      data_out
   29: );
   30: 
   31: parameter   max     = 240;
   32: reg     [31:0]      sample  [0:max];
   33: reg     [7:0]       count   = 8'd0;
   34: 
   35: initial
   36:     $readmemh("sample.mem", sample);
   37: 
   38: parameter   IDLE        = 3'b001;
   39: parameter   ACTIVE      = 3'b010;
   40: parameter   END         = 3'b100;
   41: 
   42: reg     [2:0]   state;
   43: reg     [2:0]   next_state;
   44: 
   45: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   46: begin
   47:     if (~rst_n)
   48:         state   <= IDLE;
   49:     else
   50:         state   <= next_state;
   51: end
   52: 
   53: always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
   54: begin
   55:     if (~rst_n)
   56:         count   <= 8'd0;
   57:     else if (state == ACTIVE)
   58:         count   <= count + 1'b1;
   59:     else
   60:         count   <= 8'd0;
   61: end
   62: 
   63: always @(*)
   64: begin
   65:     case(state)
   66:         IDLE:           begin
   67:                             if (en)
   68:                                 next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   69:                             else
   70:                                 next_state  <= IDLE;
   71:                         end
   72:         ACTIVE:         begin
   73:                             if (count < max)
   74:                                 next_state  <= ACTIVE;
   75:                             else
   76:                                 next_state  <= END;
   77:                         end
   78:         END:            next_state  <= IDLE;
   79:         default:        next_state  <= IDLE;
   80:     endcase
   81: end
   82: 
   83: assign  flag        = (state == ACTIVE);
   84: assign  data_out    = (flag) ? sample[count] : 32'b0;
   85: 
   86: 
   87: 
   88: endmodule

   18:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 15:55 KST) : [Table 2-10 & Table 2-18 Alignment]

   21:     Word 1 with Table 2-18 (64'hAB00_0000_CDEF_07D0 on DAT1, 64'hAB00_4064_AAAA_0001

   26: module tb_FEC_Demux();
   27: 
   28:     reg clk;   // 200.0 MHz Baseband Clock (5.0 ns)

   42:     wire [11:0] out_pld_byte_cnt = u_fec_demux.out_pld_byte_cnt; // 8..2040 Bytes
   43: 
   44:     FEC_Demux u_fec_demux (
   45:         .clk        (clk),
   46:         .rst_n      (rst_n),
   47:         .en         (desc_dv),
   48:         .data_in    (desc_data),
   49:         .header_dv  (rs_head_dv),

   51:         .payload_dv (rs_load_dv),
   52:         .payload    (rs_load_out)

   54: 
   55:     initial begin

   73:             total_hdr_bytes_out <= 0;
   74:             total_pld_words_out <= 0;
   75:         end else begin
   76:             if (rs_head_dv) total_hdr_bytes_out <= total_hdr_bytes_out + 1;
   77:             if (rs_load_dv) total_pld_words_out <= total_pld_words_out + 1;

   79:     end
   80:

   86:         #100;
   87:         rst_n     = 1'b1;
   88:     end
   89:

   92:             case (tb_state)
   93:                 ST_STREAM: begin
   94:                     if (cycle_cnt < 16'd259)
   95:                         cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 16'd1;
   96:                     else begin
   97:                         tb_state  <= ST_GAP;
   98:                         cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
   99:                     end
  100:                 end
  101:                 ST_GAP: begin
  102:                     if (cycle_cnt < 16'd35)
  103:                         cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 16'd1;
  104:                     else if (frame_id < 4'd4) begin
  105:                         frame_id  <= frame_id + 4'd1;
  106:                         tb_state  <= ST_STREAM;
  107:                         cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  108:                     end else begin
  109:                         tb_state  <= ST_DONE;
  110:                     end
  111:                 end
  112:                 default: tb_state <= ST_DONE;
  113:             endcase
  114:         end
  115:     end

  119:         desc_data = 64'd0;

  122:             desc_dv = 1'b1;
  123:             // Words 1..4: 32-Byte RS(32,16) Encoded Header (Table 2-10 LSB-first)
  124:             if      (cycle_cnt == 16'd1)   desc_data = {4'd0, frame_id, 8'h00, 16'h0000, 8'hFD, 24'h554433};
  125:             else if (cycle_cnt == 16'd2)   desc_data = 64'h2211_F28A_8899_0F28;
  126:             else if (cycle_cnt <= 16'd4)   desc_data = 64'hC1C2_C1C2_C1C2_C1C2;
  127:             // Words 5..259: 2040-Byte 8xRS(255,239) Encoded Payload (Table 2-18)
  128:             else if (cycle_cnt == 16'd5)   desc_data = (frame_id == 4'd2) ? 64'hAB00_4064_AAAA_0001 : 64'hAB00_0000_CDEF_07D0;
  129:             else if (cycle_cnt == 16'd243) desc_data = 64'hDA7A_DA7A_C320_0000 + {60'd0, frame_id};
  130:             else if (cycle_cnt >  16'd243) desc_data = 64'hB10C_B10C_B10C_B10C;
  131:             else begin
  132:                 if      (frame_id <= 4'd2) desc_data = 64'hDA7A_DA7A_DA7A_DA7A;
  133:                 else if (frame_id == 4'd3) desc_data = 64'h1D1E_1D1E_1D1E_1D1E;
  134:                 else                       desc_data = 64'hA1A1_A1A1_A1A1_A1A1;
  135:             end
  136:         end
  137:     end
  138: 
  139:     initial begin
  140:         wait(tb_state == ST_DONE);
  141:         #500;
  142:         $display("\n======================================================================");
  143:         $display(" RECEIVER FEC_DEMUX GEOMETRY VERIFICATION REPORT");
  144:         $display(" -> Total 8-bit RS Header Bytes Emitted (4 x 32B)    : %0d / 128 Bytes", total_hdr_bytes_out);
  145:         $display(" -> Total 64-bit RS Payload Words Emitted (4 x 255W) : %0d / 1020 Words (%0d Bytes)",

  147:         if (total_hdr_bytes_out == 128 && total_pld_words_out == 1020)
  148:             $display(" -> RESULT: [PASS] 100%% EXACT HEADER & PAYLOAD DEMULTIPLEXING!");
  149:         $display("======================================================================\n");

  151:     end

  153: endmodule

    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Description  : Comprehensive Verification Testbench for FEC Subsystem.
    7:                Includes RS Encoders and the FEC_MUX integration.
    8: 
    9:                Verification Objectives:
   10:                1. Prove RS Parity Generation: Observe the 16 additional
   11:                   parity bytes/words naturally appended to the data.
   12:                2. Prove Mathematical Gap: Demonstrate how the 16-cycle gap 
   13:                   between Header and Payload allows for parity computation.
   14:                3. Prove FEC_MUX Splicing: Validate that the output of FEC_MUX
   15:                   is exactly 259 continuous cycles (Zero-Gap) combining 
   16:                   both Header (32B -> 4 Words) and Payload (255 Words).
   17: Physical Data Geometry Validated:
   18:                - Input Header   : 16 Cycles  x 1 Byte = 16 Bytes or 2 Words
   19:                - Input Payload  : 239 Cycles x 8 Byte = 1912 Bytes or 239 Words 
   20:                - RS Head Out    : 32 Cycles  x 1 Byte = 32 Bytes or 4 Words
   21:                - RS Load Out    : 255 Cycles x 8 Byte = 2040 Bytes or 255 Words
   22:                - MUX Final Out  : 259 Cycles x 8 Byte = 2072 Bytes or 259 Words (Continuous Out)
   23: 
   24: Revision History:
   25:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 259-cycle FEC_MUX + RS(32,16) + 8xRS(255,239) geometry testbench.
   26:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 15:04 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 2 & Item 3 - SDA OISL Page 37, Sec. 2.6.3.6.3]
   27:     1. Aligned Header byte injection order with SDA OISL Table 2-10 (Page 25):
   28:        d0 (cycle 1) = TXFN[7:0] (LSB), d1 (cycle 2) = TXFN[15:8] (MSB), and 
   29:        d4 (cycle 5) = {4'b1111, ACK, ACK_valid, FRAME_TYPE[1:0]}.
   30:     2. Added an independent Golden-Vector Syndrome Verifier (u_hdr_synd_chk & 
   31:        u_pld_synd_chk_lane7) that evaluates every encoded 32-Byte Header and 
   32:        255-Byte Payload codeword at all 16 roots alpha^(11*j) (j = 120..135) over 
   33:        GF(2^8) primitive polynomial F(x) = x^8 + x^7 + x^2 + x + 1 (0x187) and 
   34:        verifies that all 16 syndromes equal 128'd0!
   35: ===========================================================================
   36: */
   37: 
   38: 
   39: module tb_FEC_RS();
   40: 
   41:     // =======================================================
   42:     // 1. SYSTEM CLOCKS AND RESET
   43:     // =======================================================
   44:     reg clk;   // 200.0 MHz Baseband Clock (Period: 5.0 ns)
   45:     reg rst_n;
   46: 
   47:     // =======================================================
   48:     // 2. DEVICE UNDER TEST (DUT) SIGNALS
   49:     // =======================================================
   50:     reg         en_head;
   51:     reg  [7:0]  header_in;
   52:     reg         en_load;
   53:     reg  [63:0] payload_in;
   54: 
   55:     wire        rs_head_dv;
   56:     wire [7:0]  rs_head_out;
   57:     wire        rs_load_dv;
   58:     wire [63:0] rs_load_out;
   59: 
   60:     wire        mux_dv;
   61:     wire [63:0] mux_data_out;
   62: 
   63:     // =======================================================
   64:     // 3. DUT INSTANTIATIONS
   65:     // =======================================================
   66:     rs_encoder #(31) u_rs_head (
   67:         .clk        (clk), 
   68:         .rst_n      (rst_n), 
   69:         .en         (en_head), 
   70:         .data_in    (header_in),
   71:         .flag       (rs_head_dv), 
   72:         .data_out   (rs_head_out)
   73:     );
   74: 
   75:     rs_encoder_64 #(254) u_rs_payload (
   76:         .clk        (clk), 
   77:         .rst_n      (rst_n), 
   78:         .en         (en_load), 
   79:         .data_in    (payload_in),
   80:         .flag       (rs_load_dv), 
   81:         .data_out   (rs_load_out)
   82:     );
   83: 
   84:     FEC_MUX u_fec_mux (
   85:         .clk        (clk), 
   86:         .rst_n      (rst_n), 
   87:         .rs_head_dv (rs_head_dv), 
   88:         .rs_head    (rs_head_out),
   89:         .rs_load_dv (rs_load_dv), 
   90:         .rs_load    (rs_load_out),
   91:         .flag       (mux_dv), 
   92:         .data_out   (mux_data_out)
   93:     );
   94: 
   95:     // [Rev 2.0] Independent Golden-Vector Syndrome Checkers over GF(0x187), roots j=120..135
   96:     wire         hdr_synd_done;
   97:     wire [127:0] hdr_syndrome_vec;
   98:     wire         pld_synd_done;
   99:     wire [127:0] pld_syndrome_vec;
  100: 
  101:     syndrome_unit #(.max(31)) u_hdr_synd_chk (
  102:         .clk      (clk),
  103:         .rst_n    (rst_n),
  104:         .en       (rs_head_dv),
  105:         .data_in  (rs_head_out),
  106:         .flag     (hdr_synd_done),
  107:         .syndrome (hdr_syndrome_vec)
  108:     );
  109: 
  110:     syndrome_unit #(.max(254)) u_pld_synd_chk_lane7 (
  111:         .clk      (clk),
  112:         .rst_n    (rst_n),
  113:         .en       (rs_load_dv),
  114:         .data_in  (rs_load_out[63:56]),
  115:         .flag     (pld_synd_done),
  116:         .syndrome (pld_syndrome_vec)
  117:     );
  118: 
  119:     // =======================================================
  120:     // 4. CLOCK & FSM GENERATION
  121:     // =======================================================
  122:     initial begin
  123:         clk = 1'b0;
  124:         forever #2.5 clk = ~clk; 
  125:     end
  126: 
  127:     localparam ST_HEAD      = 3'd0;
  128:     localparam ST_MATH_GAP  = 3'd1;
  129:     localparam ST_LOAD      = 3'd2;
  130:     localparam ST_FRAME_GAP = 3'd3;
  131:     localparam ST_DONE      = 3'd4;
  132: 
  133:     reg [2:0]  tb_state;
  134:     reg [3:0]  frame_id;
  135:     reg [15:0] cycle_cnt;
  136: 
  137:     initial begin
  138:         rst_n     = 1'b0;
  139:         tb_state  = ST_HEAD;
  140:         frame_id  = 4'd1;
  141:         cycle_cnt = 16'd1;
  142:         #100; rst_n = 1'b1;
  143:     end
  144: 
  145:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  146:         if (rst_n) begin
  147:             case (tb_state)
  148:                 ST_HEAD: begin
  149:                     if (cycle_cnt < 16) cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  150:                     else begin tb_state <= ST_MATH_GAP; cycle_cnt <= 16'd1; end
  151:                 end
  152:                 ST_MATH_GAP: begin
  153:                     // 16 Cycles latency gap for RS Header Parity
  154:                     if (cycle_cnt < 16) cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  155:                     else begin tb_state <= ST_LOAD; cycle_cnt <= 16'd1; end
  156:                 end
  157:                 ST_LOAD: begin
  158:                     if (cycle_cnt < 239) cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  159:                     else begin tb_state <= ST_FRAME_GAP; cycle_cnt <= 16'd1; end
  160:                 end
  161:                 ST_FRAME_GAP: begin
  162:                     // 35 Cycles gap between frames
  163:                     if (cycle_cnt < 35) cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  164:                     else begin
  165:                         if (frame_id < 4) begin
  166:                             frame_id <= frame_id + 1'b1;
  167:                             tb_state <= ST_HEAD;
  168:                             cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  169:                         end else begin
  170:                             tb_state <= ST_DONE;
  171:                         end
  172:                     end
  173:                 end
  174:             endcase
  175:         end
  176:     end
  177: 
  178:     // =======================================================
  179:     // 5. DATA INJECTION (Strict SDA OISL Formatting)
  180:     // =======================================================
  181:     always @(*) begin
  182:         en_head   = 1'b0; header_in  = 8'd0;
  183:         en_load   = 1'b0; payload_in = 64'd0;
  184: 
  185:         if (tb_state != ST_DONE) begin
  186:             // --- HEADER MAPPING (16 Bytes per Table 2-10: d0=TXFN[7:0], d1=TXFN[15:8]) ---
  187:             if (tb_state == ST_HEAD) begin
  188:                 en_head = 1'b1;
  189:                 if      (cycle_cnt == 1)  header_in = {4'd0, frame_id}; // d0: TXFN[7:0] (LSB)
  190:                 else if (cycle_cnt == 2)  header_in = 8'h00;            // d1: TXFN[15:8] (MSB)
  191:                 else if (cycle_cnt == 5)  header_in = (frame_id == 3) ? 8'hF0 : (frame_id == 4) ? 8'hF2 : 8'hFD; // d4: Reserved=1111 + Frame Type
  192:                 else if (cycle_cnt == 15) header_in = 8'hC1; // CRC-16 MSB
  193:                 else if (cycle_cnt == 16) header_in = 8'hC2; // CRC-16 LSB
  194:                 else                      header_in = 8'hAA; // ARQ / FCCH Dummy
  195:             end
  196:             
  197:             // --- PAYLOAD MAPPING (239 Words / 1912 Bytes) ---
  198:             else if (tb_state == ST_LOAD) begin
  199:                 en_load = 1'b1;
  200:                 if      (cycle_cnt == 1)   payload_in = 64'hAB00_0000_CDEF_07D0; // Payload Hdr + Packet Hdr (Table 2-18)
  201:                 else if (cycle_cnt == 2)   payload_in = 64'hAABB_CCDD_EEFF_1122; // Eth MAC Header
  202:                 else if (cycle_cnt == 239) payload_in = 64'hDA7A_DA7A_C3C3_C3C3; // CRC-32 Tail at [31:0]
  203:                 else begin
  204:                     if (frame_id <= 2)      payload_in = 64'hDA7A_DA7A_DA7A_DA7A; // DATA Pattern
  205:                     else if (frame_id == 3) payload_in = 64'h1D1E_1D1E_1D1E_1D1E; // IDLE Pattern
  206:                     else                    payload_in = 64'hA1A1_A1A1_A1A1_A1A1; // MGMT Pattern
  207:                 end
  208:             end
  209:         end
  210:     end
  211: 
  212:     // =======================================================
  213:     // 6. PERFECT WAVEFORM DUAL-TRACKERS (BYTES & WORDS)
  214:     // =======================================================
  215:     
  216:     // String Indicator
  217:     reg [31:0] mux_frame_type_str;
  218:     always @(*) begin
  219:         if      (frame_id == 1) mux_frame_type_str = "DAT1";
  220:         else if (frame_id == 2) mux_frame_type_str = "DAT2";
  221:         else if (frame_id == 3) mux_frame_type_str = "IDLE";
  222:         else if (frame_id == 4) mux_frame_type_str = "MGMT";
  223:         else                    mux_frame_type_str = "DONE";
  224:     end
  225: 
  226:     // --- A. INPUT TRACKERS ---
  227:     // 8-bit bus (1 cycle = 1 byte)
  228:     wire [4:0]  in_header_byte_idx  = en_head ? cycle_cnt[4:0] : 5'd0;                        // 1 to 16 Bytes
  229:     wire [2:0]  in_header_word_idx  = en_head ? ((cycle_cnt[4:0] - 1) / 8) + 1 : 3'd0;        // 1 to 2 Words
  230: 
  231:     // 64-bit bus (1 cycle = 8 bytes)
  232:     wire [8:0]  in_payload_word_idx = en_load ? cycle_cnt[8:0] : 9'd0;                        // 1 to 239 Words
  233:     wire [11:0] in_payload_byte_idx = en_load ? (cycle_cnt[8:0] * 8) : 12'd0;                 // 8 to 1912 Bytes
  234: 
  235:     // --- B. RS ENCODER OUTPUT TRACKERS ---
  236:     reg [5:0] r_rs_head_cnt = 0;
  237:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  238:         if (!rst_n) r_rs_head_cnt <= 0;
  239:         else r_rs_head_cnt <= rs_head_dv ? (r_rs_head_cnt + 1'b1) : 6'd0;
  240:     end
  241:     wire [5:0] cur_rs_head_cnt = rs_head_dv ? (r_rs_head_cnt + 1'b1) : 6'd0;
  242: 
  243:     // 8-bit bus (+ 16 Parity = 32 cycles)
  244:     wire [5:0]  rs_head_out_byte_idx = cur_rs_head_cnt;                                       // 1 to 32 Bytes
  245:     wire [2:0]  rs_head_out_word_idx = rs_head_dv ? ((cur_rs_head_cnt - 1) / 8) + 1 : 3'd0;   // 1 to 4 Words
  246: 
  247:     reg [8:0] r_rs_load_cnt = 0;
  248:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  249:         if (!rst_n) r_rs_load_cnt <= 0;
  250:         else r_rs_load_cnt <= rs_load_dv ? (r_rs_load_cnt + 1'b1) : 9'd0;
  251:     end
  252:     wire [8:0] cur_rs_load_cnt = rs_load_dv ? (r_rs_load_cnt + 1'b1) : 9'd0;
  253: 
  254:     // 64-bit bus (+ 16 Parity = 255 cycles)
  255:     wire [8:0]  rs_load_out_word_idx = cur_rs_load_cnt;                                       // 1 to 255 Words
  256:     wire [11:0] rs_load_out_byte_idx = rs_load_dv ? (cur_rs_load_cnt * 8) : 12'd0;            // 8 to 2040 Bytes
  257: 
  258:     // --- C. FEC MUX OUTPUT TRACKERS ---
  259:     reg [8:0] r_mux_cnt = 0;
  260:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  261:         if (!rst_n) r_mux_cnt <= 0;
  262:         else r_mux_cnt <= mux_dv ? (r_mux_cnt + 1'b1) : 9'd0;
  263:     end
  264:     wire [8:0] cur_mux_cnt = mux_dv ? (r_mux_cnt + 1'b1) : 9'd0;
  265: 
  266:     // 64-bit bus (4 Words Header + 255 Words Payload = 259 cycles)
  267:     wire [8:0]  mux_out_word_idx = cur_mux_cnt;                                               // 1 to 259 Words
  268:     wire [11:0] mux_out_byte_idx = mux_dv ? (cur_mux_cnt * 8) : 12'd0;                        // 8 to 2072 Bytes
  269: 
  270:     // [Rev 2.0] Syndrome Verification Counters (Proves GF(0x187) & roots j=120..135)
  271:     integer hdr_synd_pass_cnt = 0;
  272:     integer pld_synd_pass_cnt = 0;
  273:     always @(posedge clk) begin
  274:         if (hdr_synd_done) begin
  275:             if (hdr_syndrome_vec == 128'd0) hdr_synd_pass_cnt = hdr_synd_pass_cnt + 1;
  276:             $display(" [%0t] RS(32,16) Header Codeword Syndrome (GF 0x187, j=120..135)  = 0x%032X", $time, hdr_syndrome_vec);
  277:         end
  278:         if (pld_synd_done) begin
  279:             if (pld_syndrome_vec == 128'd0) pld_synd_pass_cnt = pld_synd_pass_cnt + 1;
  280:             $display(" [%0t] RS(255,239) Payload Codeword Syndrome (GF 0x187, j=120..135) = 0x%032X", $time, pld_syndrome_vec);
  281:         end
  282:     end
  283: 
  284:     // =======================================================
  285:     // 7. SIMULATION TERMINATION & LOGGING
  286:     // =======================================================
  287:     initial begin
  288:         wait(tb_state == ST_DONE);
  289:         #5000;
  290:         $display("\n=======================================================");
  291:         $display(" FEC SUBSYSTEM GEOMETRY & GF(0x187) VERIFICATION COMPLETE");
  292:         $display("=======================================================");
  293:         $display(" MUX Out successfully packed Header and Payload seamlessly.");
  294:         $display(" Output Profile: 259 Words (2072 Bytes) per Continuous Frame.");
  295:         $display(" Header  RS(32,16)   Zero-Syndrome Passes : %0d / 4", hdr_synd_pass_cnt);
  296:         $display(" Payload RS(255,239) Zero-Syndrome Passes : %0d / 4", pld_synd_pass_cnt);
  297:         if (hdr_synd_pass_cnt == 4 && pld_synd_pass_cnt == 4)
  298:             $display(" RESULT: [PASS] 100%% COMPLIANT WITH SDA OISL PAGE 37 (GF 0x187, j=120..135)!");
  299:         $display("=======================================================\n");
  300:         $finish;
  301:     end
  302: 
  303: endmodule
