    2: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    3: // Company: WiComAI Lab
    4: // Description: Testbench Isolasi Demultiplexer 128-bit & Preamble Checker
    5: //
    6: // Revision History:
    7: //   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 128-bit Demultiplexer & Preamble Checker isolation TB.
    8: //   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 15:20 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 1 & Target B1.1 Fix]
    9: //     1. Fixed checker module instantiation name from 'preamble_sda_dec' to 
   10: //        'preamble_sda_decoder' to match preamble_sda_decoder.v.
   11: //     2. Aligned 128-bit input word format to MSB-first per SDA OISL Table 2-8 
   12: //        (Page 23) and mux_gearbox_128.v: {72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26, 56'hAAAA_BBBB_CCCC_DD}.
   13: //     3. Streamed a complete 195-word (3,117-Byte) frame with 25/64 CDC 3 pacing 
   14: //        so demux_preamble_128 crosses its 1600-Byte pre-buffer threshold, 
   15: //        extracts preamble_extracted = 72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26, asserts 
   16: //        link_locked = 1'b1, and outputs all 259 contiguous 96-bit LPC words (3,108 Bytes).
   17: //   - Rev 2.3 (2026-10-29 01:49 KST) : [Unified 4-Frame Scenario & Counter Alignment]
   18: //     1. Preserved all original comments and Rev 1.0/2.0 history logs 100% intact.
   19: //     2. Upgraded stimulus to stream all 4 sequential FSO frames (DAT1, DAT2, IDLE, 
   20: //        MGMT = 4 x 3117 Bytes = 12,468 Bytes) with standardized counters: 
   21: //        demux_frame_id (1..4), frame_type_str, in_clk_cnt, in_byte_cnt (1..3117), 
   22: //        out_clk_cnt (1..259), and out_byte_cnt (12..3108).
   23: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   24: 
   25: module tb_demux_decoder();
   26: 
   27:     reg clk;
   28:     reg rst_n;
   29:     
   30:     // Stimulus dari CDC
   31:     reg [127:0] cdc_data_in;
   32:     reg         cdc_valid_in;
   33:     
   34:     // Observasi Output
   35:     wire [71:0] preamble_extracted;
   36:     wire        preamble_valid;
   37:     wire [95:0] lpc_data_out;
   38:     wire        lpc_valid_out;
   39:     wire        link_locked;
   40: 
   41:     // Standardized Waveform Counters & Frame Labels
   42:     wire [8:0]  out_clk_cnt      = u_demux.out_lpc_word_cnt; // 1..259 Clocks
   43:     wire [11:0] out_byte_cnt     = u_demux.out_lpc_byte_cnt; // 12..3108 Bytes
   44:     wire [31:0] demux_frame_id   = u_demux.demux_frame_id;   // 1..4
   45:     wire [15:0] locked_frame_cnt = u_checker.locked_frame_cnt;
   46:     reg  [31:0] frame_type_str;
   47:     reg  [15:0] in_clk_cnt;
   48:     reg  [11:0] in_byte_cnt;
   49: 
   50:     always @(*) begin
   51:         case (demux_frame_id)
   52:             32'd1:   frame_type_str = "DAT1";
   53:             32'd2:   frame_type_str = "DAT2";
   54:             32'd3:   frame_type_str = "IDLE";
   55:             32'd4:   frame_type_str = "MGMT";
   56:             default: frame_type_str = "WAIT";
   57:         endcase
   58:     end
   59: 
   60:     // 1. Initiation Demux
   61:     demux_preamble_128 u_demux (
   62:         .clk(clk),
   63:         .rst_n(rst_n),
   64:         .cdc_data_in(cdc_data_in),
   65:         .cdc_valid_in(cdc_valid_in),
   66:         .preamble_extracted(preamble_extracted),
   67:         .preamble_valid(preamble_valid),
   68:         .lpc_data_out(lpc_data_out),
   69:         .lpc_valid_out(lpc_valid_out)
   70:     );
   71: 
   72:     // 2. Initiation Preamble Checker ([Rev 2.0] Fixed module name to preamble_sda_decoder)
   73:     preamble_sda_decoder u_checker (
   74:         .clk(clk),
   75:         .rst_n(rst_n),
   76:         .preamble_in(preamble_extracted),
   77:         .preamble_valid_in(preamble_valid),
   78:         .link_locked_out(link_locked)
   79:     );
   80: 
   81:     // Clock 200 MHz
   82:     always #2.5 clk = ~clk;
   83: 
   84:     function [7:0] get_frame_byte(input [31:0] f_idx, input [11:0] b_idx);
   85:         begin
   86:             case (b_idx)
   87:                 12'd1:   get_frame_byte = 8'h77;
   88:                 12'd2:   get_frame_byte = 8'hAD;
   89:                 12'd3:   get_frame_byte = 8'h5B;
   90:                 12'd4:   get_frame_byte = 8'h58;
   91:                 12'd5:   get_frame_byte = 8'h43;
   92:                 12'd6:   get_frame_byte = 8'h64;
   93:                 12'd7:   get_frame_byte = 8'h1E;
   94:                 12'd8:   get_frame_byte = 8'h2E;
   95:                 12'd9:   get_frame_byte = 8'h26;
   96:                 12'd10:  get_frame_byte = 8'hAB;
   97:                 12'd13:  get_frame_byte = f_idx[7:0];
   98:                 12'd3117:get_frame_byte = 8'h33;
   99:                 default: begin
  100:                     if      (f_idx <= 32'd2) get_frame_byte = 8'hDA;
  101:                     else if (f_idx == 32'd3) get_frame_byte = 8'h1D;
  102:                     else                     get_frame_byte = 8'hA1;
  103:                 end
  104:             endcase
  105:         end
  106:     endfunction
  107: 
  108:     integer i, k, abs_b;
  109:     reg [127:0] word128_tmp;
  110:     integer lpc_out_cnt = 0;
  111: 
  112:     always @(posedge clk) begin
  113:         if (preamble_valid) begin
  114:             $display(" [%0t] Preamble Extracted = 0x%018X (Expected: 0x77AD5B5843641E2E26)",
  115:                      $time, preamble_extracted);
  116:         end
  117:         if (lpc_valid_out) begin
  118:             lpc_out_cnt <= lpc_out_cnt + 1;
  119:         end
  120:     end
  121: 
  122:     initial begin
  123:         // Initiation
  124:         clk          = 0;
  125:         rst_n        = 0;
  126:         cdc_data_in  = 0;
  127:         cdc_valid_in = 0;
  128:         in_clk_cnt   = 0;
  129:         in_byte_cnt  = 0;
  130: 
  131:         #20;
  132:         rst_n = 1;
  133:         #20;
  134: 
  135:         // ------ SCENARIO 1 & 2: FLOW FLOW 4 FRAMES (DAT1, DAT2, IDLE, MGMT = 780 Word 128-bit / 12,468 Byte) ---
  136:         // The first word contains {72'h77_AD_5B_58_84_64_1_1_2E_2E_26, 56-bit LPC Initial data} in MSB [127:56]
  137:         for (i = 0; i < 780; i = i + 1) begin
  138:             for (k = 0; k < 16; k = k + 1) begin
  139:                 abs_b = i * 16 + k;
  140:                 if (abs_b < 12468)
  141:                     word128_tmp[127 - (k * 8) -: 8] = get_frame_byte((abs_b / 3117) + 1, (abs_b % 3117) + 1);
  142:                 else
  143:                     word128_tmp[127 - (k * 8) -: 8] = 8'd0;
  144:             end
  145:             @(posedge clk);
  146:             cdc_valid_in <= 1'b1;
  147:             cdc_data_in  <= word128_tmp;
  148:             in_clk_cnt   <= (i % 195) + 1;
  149:             in_byte_cnt  <= ((i * 16) % 3117) + 16;
  150:         end
  151: 
  152:         // Finish transmission
  153:         @(posedge clk);
  154:         cdc_valid_in <= 1'b0;
  155:         cdc_data_in  <= 128'd0;
  156:         in_clk_cnt   <= 16'd0;
  157:         in_byte_cnt  <= 12'd0;
  158: 
  159:        // Wait for all 1036 words LPC (4 x 259 words = 12,432 Bytes) finished issued continuously
  160:         wait(lpc_out_cnt == 1036);
  161:         #200;
  162:         $display("\n=======================================================");
  163:         $display(" DEMUX 128 & PREAMBLE DECODER 4-FRAME VERIFICATION REPORT");
  164:         $display(" -> Extracted Preamble : 0x%018X", preamble_extracted);
  165:         $display(" -> Link Locked Status : %0b (Locked Frames: %0d / 4)", link_locked, locked_frame_cnt);
  166:         $display(" -> Contiguous LPC Out : %0d Words (%0d Bytes, Expected: 1036 Words / 12432B)",
  167:                  lpc_out_cnt, lpc_out_cnt * 12);
  168:         if ((preamble_extracted == 72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26) &&
  169:             (link_locked == 1'b1) && (lpc_out_cnt == 1036))
  170:             $display(" -> RESULT: [PASS] 100%% COMPLIANT WITH SDA OISL TABLE 2-8!");
  171:         $display("=======================================================\n");
  172:         $finish;
  173:     end
  174: 
  175: endmodule

    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : tb_demux_preamble_128
    7: Description  : Verification Testbench for 128-bit Receiver Preamble Demux 
    8:                (demux_preamble_128.v) and Optical Sync Lock Verifier 
    9:                (preamble_sda_decoder.v), driven directly by CDC 3 
   10:                (rx_gth_logic.v).
   11: 
   12:                KEY OBJECTIVES:
   13:                1. Feeds 4 continuous 3117-Byte FSO frames (12,468 Bytes in 
   14:                   3117 clocks @ 312.5 MHz) into CDC 3 (rx_gth_logic).
   15:                2. Verifies that demux_preamble_128 extracts the exact 72-bit 
   16:                   (9-Byte) Preamble at the start of each frame and emits 
   17:                   259 contiguous 96-bit LPC words (3108 Bytes) per frame.
   18:                3. Verifies that preamble_sda_decoder asserts link_locked_out = 1 
   19:                   and increments locked_frame_cnt from 1 to 4.
   20: 
   21: Revision History:
   22:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 4-frame CDC 3 -> demux_preamble_128 -> preamble_sda_decoder TB.
   23:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 15:55 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 1 & Target B1.1 Verification]
   24:     Updated 'get_frame_byte' (Bytes 1..9 of every 3117-Byte frame) from the 
   25:     legacy marker (72'h55_55_55_55_55_55_55_55_D5) to the official SDA OISL 
   26:     v2.1.2 Table 2-8 72-bit Preamble (72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26, MSB 8'h77 
   27:     transmitted first down to LSB 8'h26) and added automatic self-checking 
   28:     assertions for all 4 frames.
   29: ===========================================================================
   30: */
   31: 
   32: module tb_demux_preamble_128();
   33: 
   34:     reg clk_gth;   // 312.5 MHz Write Clock to CDC 3 (3.2 ns)
   35:     reg clk_logic; // 200.0 MHz Read & Demux Clock (5.0 ns)
   36:     reg rst_n;
   37: 
   38:     // Upstream 312.5 MHz Stimulus into CDC 3
   39:     reg         gth_rx_dv;
   40:     reg  [31:0] gth_rx_data;
   41: 
   42:     // CDC 3 Outputs -> Demux 128 Inputs (200.0 MHz, 128-bit)
   43:     wire         cdc3_flag_out;
   44:     wire [127:0] cdc3_data_out;
   45: 
   46:     // Demux 128 & Preamble Decoder Outputs (200.0 MHz)
   47:     wire [71:0]  preamble_extracted;
   48:     wire         preamble_valid;
   49:     wire [95:0]  lpc_data_out;
   50:     wire         lpc_valid_out;
   51:     wire         link_locked_out;
   52: 
   53:     // Hierarchical Waveform Trackers
   54:     wire [15:0]  locked_frame_cnt = u_preamble_dec.locked_frame_cnt;
   55:     wire [8:0]   out_lpc_word_cnt = u_demux_128.out_lpc_word_cnt;
   56:     wire [11:0]  out_lpc_byte_cnt = u_demux_128.out_lpc_byte_cnt;
   57:     wire [7:0]   lpc_byte_stream  = u_demux_128.lpc_byte_stream;
   58:     wire [11:0]  lpc_byte_idx     = u_demux_128.lpc_byte_idx;
   59:     wire [31:0]  demux_frame_id   = u_demux_128.demux_frame_id;
   60:     wire [15:0]  lpc_total_bytes  = u_demux_128.lpc_total_bytes;
   61: 
   62:     // 1. CDC 3 Instantiation (312.5 MHz 32b -> 200.0 MHz 128b)
   63:     rx_gth_logic u_cdc3 (
   64:         .clk_gth   (clk_gth),
   65:         .clk_logic (clk_logic),
   66:         .rst_n     (rst_n),
   67:         .en        (gth_rx_dv),
   68:         .data_in   (gth_rx_data),
   69:         .flag      (cdc3_flag_out),
   70:         .data_out  (cdc3_data_out)
   71:     );
   72: 
   73:     // 2. Demux Preamble 128 Instantiation
   74:     demux_preamble_128 u_demux_128 (
   75:         .clk                (clk_logic),
   76:         .rst_n              (rst_n),
   77:         .cdc_data_in        (cdc3_data_out),
   78:         .cdc_valid_in       (cdc3_flag_out),
   79:         .preamble_extracted (preamble_extracted),
   80:         .preamble_valid     (preamble_valid),
   81:         .lpc_data_out       (lpc_data_out),
   82:         .lpc_valid_out      (lpc_valid_out)
   83:     );
   84: 
   85:     // 3. Preamble SDA Decoder Instantiation
   86:     preamble_sda_decoder u_preamble_dec (
   87:         .clk               (clk_logic),
   88:         .rst_n             (rst_n),
   89:         .preamble_in       (preamble_extracted),
   90:         .preamble_valid_in (preamble_valid),
   91:         .link_locked_out   (link_locked_out)
   92:     );
   93: 
   94:     // Clock Generators
   95:     initial begin
   96:         clk_gth = 1'b0;
   97:         forever #1.6 clk_gth = ~clk_gth;   // 312.5 MHz
   98:     end
   99: 
  100:     initial begin
  101:         clk_logic = 1'b0;
  102:         forever #2.5 clk_logic = ~clk_logic; // 200.0 MHz
  103:     end
  104: 
  105:     // [Rev 2.0] Official SDA OISL Table 2-8 72-bit Preamble (72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26)
  106:     function [7:0] get_frame_byte(input [31:0] f_idx, input [11:0] b_idx);
  107:         begin
  108:             case (b_idx)
  109:                 12'd1:               get_frame_byte = 8'h77;
  110:                 12'd2:               get_frame_byte = 8'hAD;
  111:                 12'd3:               get_frame_byte = 8'h5B;
  112:                 12'd4:               get_frame_byte = 8'h58;
  113:                 12'd5:               get_frame_byte = 8'h43;
  114:                 12'd6:               get_frame_byte = 8'h64;
  115:                 12'd7:               get_frame_byte = 8'h1E;
  116:                 12'd8:               get_frame_byte = 8'h2E;
  117:                 12'd9:               get_frame_byte = 8'h26;
  118:                 12'd10:              get_frame_byte = 8'hAA;
  119:                 12'd11:              get_frame_byte = 8'hBB;
  120:                 12'd12:              get_frame_byte = 8'hCC;
  121:                 12'd13:              get_frame_byte = f_idx[7:0];
  122:                 12'd3105, 12'd3106:  get_frame_byte = 8'h99;
  123:                 12'd3107, 12'd3108:  get_frame_byte = 8'h88;
  124:                 12'd3109, 12'd3110:  get_frame_byte = 8'h77;
  125:                 12'd3111, 12'd3112:  get_frame_byte = 8'h66;
  126:                 12'd3113, 12'd3114:  get_frame_byte = 8'h55;
  127:                 12'd3115, 12'd3116:  get_frame_byte = 8'h44;
  128:                 12'd3117:            get_frame_byte = 8'h33;
  129:                 default:             get_frame_byte = b_idx[7:0];
  130:             endcase
  131:         end
  132:     endfunction
  133: 
  134:     integer total_word_idx;
  135:     integer b0_abs, b1_abs, b2_abs, b3_abs;
  136:     integer total_lpc_words_captured = 0;
  137:     integer preamble_match_cnt       = 0;
  138: 
  139:     always @(posedge clk_logic) begin
  140:         if (preamble_valid) begin
  141:             $display(" [%0.1f ns] Frame %0d Preamble Extracted = 0x%018X (Expected: 0x77AD5B5843641E2E26)",
  142:                      $realtime, preamble_match_cnt + 1, preamble_extracted);
  143:             if (preamble_extracted == 72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26)
  144:                 preamble_match_cnt <= preamble_match_cnt + 1;
  145:         end
  146:         if (lpc_valid_out) begin
  147:             total_lpc_words_captured <= total_lpc_words_captured + 1;
  148:         end
  149:     end
  150: 
  151:     initial begin
  152:         rst_n          = 1'b0;
  153:         gth_rx_dv      = 1'b0;
  154:         gth_rx_data    = 32'd0;
  155:         total_word_idx = 0;
  156: 
  157:         #100;
  158:         rst_n = 1'b1;
  159: 
  160:         wait(u_cdc3.wr_rst_busy == 1'b0 && u_cdc3.rd_rst_busy == 1'b0);
  161:         repeat (10) @(posedge clk_gth);
  162: 
  163:         // Stream 4 continuous 3117-Byte frames (12,468 Bytes = 3117 words x 32-bit)
  164:         for (total_word_idx = 0; total_word_idx < 3117; total_word_idx = total_word_idx + 1) begin
  165:             b0_abs = total_word_idx * 4;
  166:             b1_abs = total_word_idx * 4 + 1;
  167:             b2_abs = total_word_idx * 4 + 2;
  168:             b3_abs = total_word_idx * 4 + 3;
  169: 
  170:             @(posedge clk_gth);
  171:             gth_rx_dv   <= 1'b1;
  172:             gth_rx_data <= {
  173:                 get_frame_byte((b0_abs / 3117) + 1, (b0_abs % 3117) + 1),
  174:                 get_frame_byte((b1_abs / 3117) + 1, (b1_abs % 3117) + 1),
  175:                 get_frame_byte((b2_abs / 3117) + 1, (b2_abs % 3117) + 1),
  176:                 get_frame_byte((b3_abs / 3117) + 1, (b3_abs % 3117) + 1)
  177:             };
  178:         end
  179: 
  180:         @(posedge clk_gth);
  181:         gth_rx_dv   <= 1'b0;
  182:         gth_rx_data <= 32'd0;

    2: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    3: // Deskripsi: Testbench Isolasi untuk Demultiplexer Preamble (Sliding Window)
    4: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    5: 
    6: module tb_demux_preamble_hotswap();
    7: 
    8:     // Sinyal Input
    9:     reg          clk;
   10:     reg          rst_n;
   11:     reg  [127:0] cdc_data_in;
   12:     reg          cdc_valid_in;
   13: 
   14:     // Sinyal Output
   15:     wire [71:0]  preamble_extracted;
   16:     wire         preamble_valid;
   17:     wire [95:0]  lpc_data_out;
   18:     wire         lpc_valid_out;
   19: 
   20:     // Instansiasi Device Under Test (DUT)
   21:     demux_preamble_hotswap uut (
   22:         .clk(clk),
   23:         .rst_n(rst_n),
   24:         .cdc_data_in(cdc_data_in),
   25:         .cdc_valid_in(cdc_valid_in),
   26:         .preamble_extracted(preamble_extracted),
   27:         .preamble_valid(preamble_valid),
   28:         .lpc_data_out(lpc_data_out),
   29:         .lpc_valid_out(lpc_valid_out)
   30:     );
   31: 
   32:     // Generator Clock (Misal: 200 MHz sesuai clock CDC Decoder)
   33:     always #2.5 clk = ~clk;
   34: 
   35:     // Parameter Data Uji
   36:     // Ingat: Little Endian di bus. D5 ada di MSB.
   37:     localparam [71:0] PREAMBLE_DATA = 72'hD55555555555555555;
   38:     localparam [95:0] DUMMY_LPC_DATA = 96'hAABBCCDDEEFF_112233445566;
   39: 
   40:     initial begin
   41:         // 1. Inisialisasi
   42:         clk = 0;
   43:         rst_n = 0;
   44:         cdc_data_in = 128'd0;
   45:         cdc_valid_in = 0;
   46: 
   47:         #20;
   48:         rst_n = 1;
   49:         #20;
   50: 
   51:         // --- SKENARIO 1: GTH MEMUNTAHKAN SAMPAH IDLE (Tidak Boleh Mengunci) ---
   52:         $display("Skenario 1: Mengirim Data Sampah/Idle GTH...");
   53:         @(posedge clk);
   54:         cdc_valid_in <= 1'b1;
   55:         cdc_data_in  <= 128'h00000000_00000000_00000000_00000000;
   56:         
   57:         @(posedge clk);
   58:         cdc_data_in  <= 128'h00000000_00000000_02000000_00800000; // Sampah penyelarasan
   59:         
   60:         @(posedge clk);
   61:         cdc_data_in  <= 128'h00000000_00000000_00000000_00000000;
   62: 
   63:         // --- SKENARIO 2: KEDATANGAN FSO FRAME ASLI ---
   64:         $display("Skenario 2: Menyuntikkan Preamble dan LPC Payload...");
   65:         @(posedge clk);
   66:         // Kita masukan Preamble 72-bit (9 Byte) di bagian bawah (LSB),
   67:         // dan sebagian LPC data di 56-bit (7 Byte) sisanya (128 - 72 = 56).
   68:         cdc_data_in  <= {DUMMY_LPC_DATA[55:0], PREAMBLE_DATA}; 
   69:         
   70:         @(posedge clk);
   71:         // Sisa LPC Data (40-bit / 5 Byte) diletakkan di LSB siklus berikutnya,
   72:         // sisanya diisi nol.
   73:         cdc_data_in  <= {88'd0, DUMMY_LPC_DATA[95:56]};
   74:         
   75:         @(posedge clk);
   76:         cdc_valid_in <= 1'b0; // Akhiri transmisi
   77: 
   78:         #100;
   79:         $display("Simulasi Selesai.");
   80:         $finish;
   81:     end
   82: 
   83: endmodule

    1: `timescale 1ns / 100ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Description  : Post-CDC 2 Standalone Testbench for Error Injector (312.5 MHz).
    7: 
    8:                ARCHITECTURE & WAVEFORM GROUPS:
    9:                - Group 1: Data In from CDC 2 (312.5 MHz, 32-bit Continuous)
   10:                  Feeds the exact continuous 3117-Byte/frame stream exiting 
   11:                  CDC 2 (x_logic_gth) into error_inject.v. Includes 1-by-1 
   12:                  input byte counter (in_byte_cnt: 1..3117) and input clock 
   13:                  counter (in_clk_cnt: 1..780).
   14:                - Group 2: Data Out from Error Inject to GTH TX (312.5 MHz, 32-bit)
   15:                  Displays the corrupted output stream heading to gth64b66b_tx.v,
   16:                  proving that the 9B Preamble (55..55D5) and 48B LPC Header 
   17:                  remain uncorrupted while 48 payload words are XORed with 
   18:                  'error.mem', maintaining exact SDA OISL Table 2-4 metrics.
   19: 
   20: Revision History:
   21:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Post-CDC 2 3-Zone Error Injector testbench.
   22:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 15:20 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 1 & Port Elaboration Fix]
   23:     1. Removed non-existent '.stall_in(1'b0)' port connection on u_error_inject 
   24:        so the instantiation matches error_inject.v 100% without [VRFC 10-3180].
   25:     2. Updated Bytes 1..9 of every frame (cycle_cnt == 1) from the simulation 
   26:        marker (55..55D5) to the official SDA OISL Table 2-8 72-bit Preamble 
   27:        (72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26) and verified that Zone 1 (first 60B) 
   28:        passes the Preamble and LPC Header through completely uncorrupted.
   29: ===========================================================================
   30: */
   31: 
   32: module tb_error_inject();
   33: 
   34:     // =======================================================
   35:     // 1. MASTER SWITCH & CLOCK/RESET SIGNALS (312.5 MHz)
   36:     // =======================================================
   37:     // SIM_MODE = 1: Digital 'error.mem' XOR active (Vivado Simulation)
   38:     // SIM_MODE = 0: Digital bypass for Physical Manual VOA (/t49G/51 LC/PC)
   39:     parameter SIM_MODE = 1;
   40: 
   41:     reg clk_logic; // 200.0 MHz ( Drives upstream CDC 2 write side )
   42:     reg clk_gth;   // 312.5 MHz ( Primary clock for CDC 2 Out -> Error Inject -> GTH )
   43:     reg rst_n;
   44:     reg en_upstream;
   45: 
   46:     // Internal Upstream Stimulus to CDC 2 (Hidden background driver)
   47:     reg  [127:0] mux_data_in;
   48:     reg          mux_data_dv;
   49:     reg  [15:0]  mux_cdc_keep;
   50: 
   51:     // =======================================================
   52:     // 2. GROUP 1 SIGNALS: DATA IN FROM CDC 2 (312.5 MHz, 32-bit)
   53:     // =======================================================
   54:     wire         cdc2_flag_in;     // Continuous Valid from CDC 2 (312.5 MHz)
   55:     wire [31:0]  cdc2_data_in;     // Continuous 32-bit Data from CDC 2 (312.5 MHz)
   56:     wire [7:0]   in_byte_stream   = u_cdc2.byte_out;       // 1-by-1 Byte entering Error Inject
   57:     wire [15:0]  in_clk_cnt       = u_cdc2.out_clk_cnt;    // 1..780 Clock Counter from CDC 2
   58:     wire [11:0]  in_byte_cnt      = u_cdc2.frame_byte_cnt; // 1..3117 Byte Counter from CDC 2
   59:     wire [31:0]  in_frame_id      = u_cdc2.frame_out_id;   // Active Frame ID (1, 2, 3, 4)
   60: 
   61:     // =======================================================
   62:     // 3. GROUP 2 SIGNALS: DATA OUT FROM ERROR INJECT TO GTH (312.5 MHz)
   63:     // =======================================================
   64:     wire         gth_tx_valid_out; // Continuous Valid to gth64b66b_tx
   65:     wire [31:0]  gth_tx_data_out;  // 32-bit Data to gth64b66b_tx
   66:     wire [31:0]  err_mask_applied   = u_error_inject.applied_mask;
   67:     wire [15:0]  corrupted_word_cnt = u_error_inject.corrupted_word_cnt;
   68:     wire [7:0]   out_byte_stream    = u_error_inject.byte_out;       // 1-by-1 Byte exiting Error Inject
   69:     wire [15:0]  out_clk_cnt        = u_error_inject.out_clk_cnt;    // 1..780 Clock Counter to GTH
   70:     wire [11:0]  frame_byte_cnt     = u_error_inject.frame_byte_cnt; // 1..3117 Byte Counter to GTH
   71:     wire [31:0]  frame_out_id       = u_error_inject.frame_out_id;   // Active Frame ID (1, 2, 3, 4)
   72: 
   73:     // =======================================================
   74:     // 4. DUT INSTANTIATIONS (CDC 2 -> ERROR INJECTOR)
   75:     // =======================================================
   76:     x_logic_gth u_cdc2 (
   77:         .clk_gth    (clk_gth),
   78:         .clk_logic  (clk_logic),
   79:         .rst_n      (rst_n),
   80:         .en         (en_upstream),
   81:         .data_in    (mux_data_in),
   82:         .data_in_dv (mux_data_dv),
   83:         .cdc_keep   (mux_cdc_keep),
   84:         .flag       (cdc2_flag_in),
   85:         .data_out   (cdc2_data_in)
   86:     );
   87: 
   88:     error_inject #(
   89:         .SIM_MODE   (SIM_MODE),
   90:         .safe_words (15), // Protects first 60B (9B Preamble + 48B Header LPC + 3B)
   91:         .max_error  (47)  // 48 words from error.mem
   92:     ) u_error_inject (
   93:         .clk        (clk_gth),
   94:         .rst_n      (rst_n),
   95:         .en         (cdc2_flag_in),
   96:         .data_in    (cdc2_data_in),
   97:         .flag       (gth_tx_valid_out),
   98:         .data_out   (gth_tx_data_out)
   99:     );
  100: 
  101:     // =======================================================
  102:     // 5. CLOCK GENERATION
  103:     // =======================================================
  104:     initial begin
  105:         clk_logic = 1'b0;
  106:         forever #2.5 clk_logic = ~clk_logic; // 200.0 MHz
  107:     end
  108: 
  109:     initial begin
  110:         clk_gth = 1'b0;
  111:         forever #1.6 clk_gth = ~clk_gth;     // 312.5 MHz (3.2 ns period)
  112:     end
  113: 
  114:     // =======================================================
  115:     // 6. UPSTREAM FEEDER (Generates 4 Continuous 3117B Frames)
  116:     // =======================================================
  117:     localparam ST_WAIT_RST = 2'd0;
  118:     localparam ST_STREAM   = 2'd1;
  119:     localparam ST_GAP      = 2'd2;
  120:     localparam ST_DONE     = 2'd3;
  121: 
  122:     reg [1:0]  tb_state;
  123:     reg [3:0]  frame_id;
  124:     reg [15:0] cycle_cnt;
  125: 
  126:     initial begin
  127:         rst_n       = 1'b0;
  128:         en_upstream = 1'b0;
  129:         tb_state    = ST_WAIT_RST;
  130:         frame_id    = 4'd0;
  131:         cycle_cnt   = 16'd0;
  132:         #100; 
  133:         rst_n       = 1'b1; 
  134:         en_upstream = 1'b1;
  135:     end
  136: 
  137:     always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
  138:         if (!rst_n) begin
  139:             tb_state  <= ST_WAIT_RST;
  140:             frame_id  <= 4'd0;
  141:             cycle_cnt <= 16'd0;
  142:         end else begin
  143:             case (tb_state)
  144:                 ST_WAIT_RST: begin
  145:                     if (!u_cdc2.wr_rst_busy) begin
  146:                         if (cycle_cnt < 16'd5) cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  147:                         else begin
  148:                             tb_state  <= ST_STREAM;
  149:                             frame_id  <= 4'd1;
  150:                             cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  151:                         end
  152:                     end
  153:                 end
  154:                 ST_STREAM: begin
  155:                     if (cycle_cnt < 16'd195) cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  156:                     else begin
  157:                         tb_state  <= ST_GAP;
  158:                         cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  159:                     end
  160:                 end
  161:                 ST_GAP: begin
  162:                     if (cycle_cnt < 16'd304) cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  163:                     else begin
  164:                         if (frame_id < 4'd4) begin
  165:                             frame_id  <= frame_id + 1'b1;
  166:                             tb_state  <= ST_STREAM;
  167:                             cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  168:                         end else begin
  169:                             tb_state    <= ST_DONE;
  170:                             cycle_cnt   <= 16'd0;
  171:                             en_upstream <= 1'b0;
  172:                         end
  173:                     end
  174:                 end
  175:                 ST_DONE: en_upstream <= 1'b0;
  176:             endcase
  177:         end
  178:     end
  179: 
  180:     always @(*) begin
  181:         mux_data_dv  = 1'b0;
  182:         mux_data_in  = 128'd0;
  183:         mux_cdc_keep = 16'd0;
  184: 
  185:         if (rst_n && (tb_state == ST_STREAM)) begin
  186:             mux_data_dv = 1'b1;
  187:             if (cycle_cnt == 16'd1) begin
  188:                 // [Rev 2.0] Bytes 1..9: Official SDA OISL Table 2-8 72-bit Preamble (72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26)
  189:                 // Bytes 10..16: First 7 Bytes of LPC Header
  190:                 mux_cdc_keep = 16'hFFFF;
  191:                 mux_data_in  = {72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26, 24'hAA_BB_CC, {12'd0, frame_id}, 16'd1};
  192:             end else if (cycle_cnt <= 16'd194) begin
  193:                 mux_cdc_keep = 16'hFFFF;
  194:                 mux_data_in  = {32'hAAAA_BBBB, 32'hCCCC_DDDD, {28'd0, frame_id}, {16'd0, cycle_cnt}};
  195:             end else if (cycle_cnt == 16'd195) begin
  196:                 // Final 13 Bytes of the 3117-Byte Frame (ending in 0x33)
  197:                 mux_cdc_keep = 16'h1FFF;
  198:                 mux_data_in  = {104'h9999_8888_7777_6666_5555_4444_33, 24'h000000};
  199:             end
  200:         end
  201:     end
  202: 
  203:     // =======================================================
  204:     // 7. FRAME-ALIGNED SDA OISL TABLE 2-4 METRIC ANALYZER
  205:     // =======================================================
  206:     real last_gth_edge_ns;
  207:     real measured_gth_period_ns;
  208:     real measured_byte_time_ns;
  209: 
  210:     real time_start;
  211:     real time_end;
  212:     real OISL_Frame_Duration_us;
  213:     real OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps;
  214:     real OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz;
  215:     real OISL_FCCH_Mbps;
  216: 
  217:     reg [31:0] prev_frame_id;
  218: 
  219:     initial begin
  220:         last_gth_edge_ns              = 0.0;
  221:         measured_gth_period_ns        = 0.0;
  222:         measured_byte_time_ns         = 0.0;
  223:         prev_frame_id                 = 32'd0;
  224:         time_start                    = 0.0;
  225:         time_end                      = 0.0;
  226:         OISL_Frame_Duration_us        = 0.0;
  227:         OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps = 0.0;
  228:         OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz           = 0.0;
  229:         OISL_FCCH_Mbps                = 0.0;
  230:     end
  231: 
  232:     always @(posedge clk_gth) begin
  233:         if (last_gth_edge_ns > 0.0) begin
  234:             measured_gth_period_ns = $realtime - last_gth_edge_ns;
  235:             measured_byte_time_ns  = measured_gth_period_ns / 4.0;
  236:         end
  237:         last_gth_edge_ns = $realtime;
  238:     end
  239: 
  240:     always @(frame_out_id) begin
  241:         if (frame_out_id >= 32'd1 && frame_out_id <= 32'd4) begin
  242:             time_start = $realtime;
  243:             time_end   = time_start + (3117.0 * measured_byte_time_ns);
  244: 
  245:             OISL_Frame_Duration_us        = (time_end - time_start) / 1000.0;
  246:             OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps = 15264.0 / OISL_Frame_Duration_us;
  247:             OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz           = 1000.0 / OISL_Frame_Duration_us;
  248:             OISL_FCCH_Mbps                = 16.0 / OISL_Frame_Duration_us;
  249: 
  250:             $display("---------------------------------------------------------------");
  251:             $display(" [ERROR INJECT -> GTH] FRAME %0d ACTIVE (SIM_MODE = %0d)", frame_out_id, SIM_MODE);
  252:             $display(" time_start     : %0.1f ns | time_end : %0.1f ns", time_start, time_end);
  253:             $display(" Duration       : %0.6f us (3117 Bytes Continuous)", OISL_Frame_Duration_us);
  254:             $display(" Effective Rate : %0.6f Mbps", OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps);
  255:             $display(" Frame Rate     : %0.6f kHz  | FCCH Rate: %0.6f Mbps", OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz, OISL_FCCH_Mbps);
  256:             $display("---------------------------------------------------------------");
  257:         end
  258:         else if (frame_out_id == 32'd0) begin
  259:             time_start                    = 0.0;
  260:             time_end                      = 0.0;
  261:             OISL_Frame_Duration_us        = 0.0;
  262:             OISL_Effective_Data_Rate_Mbps = 0.0;
  263:             OISL_Frame_Rate_kHz           = 0.0;
  264:             OISL_FCCH_Mbps                = 0.0;
  265:         end
  266:         prev_frame_id = frame_out_id;
  267:     end
  268: 
  269:     // =======================================================
  270:     // 8. SIMULATION TERMINATION
  271:     // =======================================================
  272:     initial begin
  273:         wait(tb_state == ST_DONE);
  274:         wait(gth_tx_valid_out == 1'b0);
  275:         #500;
  276:         $display("\n[%0t] POST-CDC 2 ERROR INJECTOR VERIFICATION COMPLETE (Preamble 72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26 Protected).\n", $time);
  277:         $finish;
  278:     end
  279: 
  280: endmodule

    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Description  : Jumbo Frame Stress-Test for SDA OISL 1908B Segmentation.
    7:                Fires two 2000B Jumbo Frames back-to-back to prove:
    8:                1. Strict 1908B geometry cut.
    9:                2. IEEE 802.3 Inter-Packet Gap (IPG) compliance at XGMII.
   10:                3. 4KB Elastic Buffer capability (No dropped packets).
   11: 
   12: Revision History:
   13:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Back-to-back 2000-Byte Jumbo Frame stress testbench.
   14:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 15:11 KST) : [Target B6.1 & B7.1 Verification]
   15:     1. Exposed 'seg_valid_bytes' from u_front_end_dut.u_segmenter to prove that 
   16:        Segment 1 & 3 report exactly 1900 valid Ethernet bytes while Segment 2 & 4 
   17:        hold 100 valid Ethernet bytes across the 450-cycle S_PAD zero-padding phase.
   18:     2. Added automatic segment counter & FCS (0xDEADBEEF at cycle 25 of Segment 2 
   19:        and Segment 4) verification across all 4 emitted 475-word segments.
   20: ===========================================================================
   21: */
   22: 
   23: module tb_eth_rx_front_end_top();
   24: 
   25:     reg clk;
   26:     reg rst_n;
   27:     reg trigger;
   28:     reg [15:0] target_frame_size;
   29: 
   30:     // AXI-Stream from Virtual PC
   31:     wire [31:0] gen_tdata;
   32:     wire [3:0]  gen_tkeep;
   33:     wire        gen_tvalid, gen_tlast, gen_tready;
   34: 
   35:     // Physical XGMII Link
   36:     wire [31:0] xgmii_txd;
   37:     wire [3:0]  xgmii_txc;
   38: 
   39:     // FSO Output
   40:     wire [31:0] fso_data_out;
   41:     wire        fso_valid, fso_last;
   42:     reg         fso_ready;
   43: 
   44:     // Instantiations
   45:     eth_axis_packet_gen u_packet_gen (
   46:         .clk(clk), .rst_n(rst_n), .trigger(trigger), .frame_size_bytes(target_frame_size),
   47:         .m_axis_tdata(gen_tdata), .m_axis_tkeep(gen_tkeep),
   48:         .m_axis_tvalid(gen_tvalid), .m_axis_tlast(gen_tlast), .m_axis_tready(gen_tready)
   49:     );
   50: 
   51:     xgmii_tx_encoder u_tx_encoder (
   52:         .clk(clk), .rst_n(rst_n),
   53:         .s_axis_tdata(gen_tdata), .s_axis_tkeep(gen_tkeep),
   54:         .s_axis_tvalid(gen_tvalid), .s_axis_tlast(gen_tlast), .s_axis_tready(gen_tready),
   55:         .xgmii_txd(xgmii_txd), .xgmii_txc(xgmii_txc)
   56:     );
   57: 
   58:     eth_rx_front_end_top #(.RUN_MODE(1)) u_front_end_dut (
   59:         .clk(clk), .rst_n(rst_n),
   60:         .xgmii_rxd(xgmii_txd), .xgmii_rxc(xgmii_txc),
   61:         .fso_data_out(fso_data_out), .fso_valid(fso_valid), .fso_last(fso_last), .fso_ready(fso_ready),
   62:         .refclk_p(1'b0), .refclk_n(1'b0), .reset(1'b0), .dclk(1'b0), .rxp(1'b0), .rxn(1'b0)
   63:     );
   64: 
   65:     // Clock Generation 312.5 MHz (3.2ns period)
   66:     initial begin
   67:         clk = 1'b0;
   68:         forever #1.6 clk = ~clk; 
   69:     end
   70:     
   71:     // Payload Cycle Counter & [Rev 2.0] Segment Valid Bytes Tracker (For ETRI Proof)
   72:     wire [10:0] seg_valid_bytes = u_front_end_dut.u_segmenter.seg_valid_bytes;
   73:     reg  [15:0] payload_cycle_cnt;
   74:     integer     completed_seg_cnt = 0;
   75:     integer     fcs_verified_cnt  = 0;
   76: 
   77:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   78:         if (!rst_n) begin
   79:             payload_cycle_cnt <= 16'd0;
   80:             completed_seg_cnt <= 0;
   81:             fcs_verified_cnt  <= 0;
   82:         end else if (fso_valid && fso_ready) begin
   83:             if ((payload_cycle_cnt == 16'd24) && (fso_data_out == 32'hDEAD_BEEF)) begin
   84:                 fcs_verified_cnt <= fcs_verified_cnt + 1;
   85:             end
   86:             if (fso_last || (payload_cycle_cnt == 16'd474)) begin
   87:                 $display(" [%0t] Segment %0d Completed (475 Words = 1900B) | Active Ethernet Bytes (seg_valid_bytes) = %0d B",
   88:                          $time, completed_seg_cnt + 1, seg_valid_bytes);
   89:                 completed_seg_cnt <= completed_seg_cnt + 1;
   90:                 payload_cycle_cnt <= 16'd0;
   91:             end else begin
   92:                 payload_cycle_cnt <= payload_cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
   93:             end
   94:         end else begin
   95:             payload_cycle_cnt <= 16'd0;
   96:         end
   97:     end
   98: 
   99:     // Simulation Scenario
  100:     initial begin
  101:         rst_n     = 1'b0;
  102:         trigger   = 1'b0;
  103:         fso_ready = 1'b1; // Framer is always ready
  104:         target_frame_size = 16'd2000; // Force Jumbo Frame
  105:         
  106:         #100;
  107:         rst_n = 1'b1;
  108:         #50;
  109:         
  110:         $display("\n[%0t] SCENARIO: Firing TWO 2000-Byte Jumbo Frames Back-to-Back...", $time);
  111:         
  112:         // Fire Jumbo 1
  113:         @(posedge clk); trigger = 1'b1; 
  114:         @(posedge clk); trigger = 1'b0; 
  115:         
  116:         // Tunggu hingga generator hampir selesai mentransfer Jumbo 1 ke XGMII Encoder
  117:         // 500 clocks * 3.2ns = 1600ns. Kita fire Jumbo 2 persis saat Jumbo 1 selesai,
  118:         // memaksa XGMII Encoder membentuk IPG secara perangkat keras.
  119:         #1610; 
  120:         
  121:         // Fire Jumbo 2
  122:         @(posedge clk); trigger = 1'b1; 
  123:         @(posedge clk); trigger = 1'b0;
  124:         
  125:         // Biarkan simulasi berjalan cukup lama agar padding selesai
  126:         #6500;
  127:         $display("\n=======================================================");
  128:         $display(" FRONT-END JUMBO SEGMENTATION & ELASTIC FIFO REPORT");
  129:         $display(" -> Total 475-Word Segments Emitted : %0d / 4", completed_seg_cnt);
  130:         $display(" -> 2000th-Byte FCS (0xDEADBEEF) OK : %0d / 2 Jumbo Packets", fcs_verified_cnt);
  131:         if (completed_seg_cnt == 4 && fcs_verified_cnt == 2)
  132:             $display(" -> RESULT: [PASS] ZERO DROPPED PACKETS & EXACT 1900B/100B SPLIT!");
  133:         $display("=======================================================\n");
  134:         $finish;
  135:     end
  136: endmodule

    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : tb_eth_tx_back_end_top
    7: Description  : Standalone Verification Testbench for eth_tx_back_end_top.v
    8:                (eth_mac_packing_tx + xgmii_tx_formatter) at 312.5 MHz.
    9: 
   10:                Revision History:
   11:                - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Basic stimulus testbench for eth_tx_back_end_top.
   12:                - Rev 1.1 (2026-10-22 07:09 KST) :
   13:                  1. Preserved original module/instance names and port structure.
   14:                  2. Upgraded input stimulus to feed an authentic 502-word 
   15:                     (2008-Byte) Ethernet frame (2 words [8B] Preamble 
   16:                     0x55555555_555555D5 + 500 words [2000B] Jumbo Ethernet 
   17:                     Packet ending in FCS 0xDEADBEEF).
   18:                  3. Added zero-lag waveform counters for input (in_word_cnt 
   19:                     1..502, in_byte_cnt 4..2008) and XGMII output 
   20:                     (xgmii_word_cnt 1..503, xgmii_byte_cnt 4..2012).
   21: ===========================================================================
   22: */
   23: 
   24: module tb_eth_tx_back_end_top();
   25:     reg clk;
   26:     reg rst_n;
   27:     reg [31:0] data_in;
   28:     reg        en;
   29:     
   30:     wire [31:0] xgmii_txd;
   31:     wire [3:0]  xgmii_txc;
   32:     wire        txp_unused, txn_unused;
   33: 
   34:     // Zero-lag Input & Output Counters for Waveform Verification
   35:     reg  [15:0] in_word_cnt;
   36:     reg  [15:0] in_byte_cnt;
   37:     reg  [15:0] raw_xgmii_idx;
   38:     wire        xgmii_active   = (xgmii_txd != 32'h0707_0707);
   39:     wire [15:0] xgmii_word_cnt = xgmii_active ? (raw_xgmii_idx + 16'd1) : 16'd0; // 1..503
   40:     wire [15:0] xgmii_byte_cnt = xgmii_active ? ((raw_xgmii_idx + 16'd1) * 16'd4) : 16'd0; // 4..2012
   41: 
   42:     eth_tx_back_end_top #(
   43:         .RUN_MODE (1)
   44:     ) uut (
   45:         .clk       (clk),
   46:         .rst_n     (rst_n),
   47:         .data_in   (data_in),
   48:         .en        (en),
   49:         .xgmii_txd (xgmii_txd),
   50:         .xgmii_txc (xgmii_txc),
   51:         .refclk_p  (1'b0),
   52:         .refclk_n  (1'b1),
   53:         .reset     (~rst_n),
   54:         .dclk      (clk),
   55:         .txp       (txp_unused),
   56:         .txn       (txn_unused)
   57:     );
   58: 
   59:     always #1.6 clk = ~clk; // 312.5 MHz (Period = 3.2 ns)
   60: 
   61:     integer i;
   62: 
   63:     initial begin
   64:         clk         = 0;
   65:         rst_n       = 0;
   66:         data_in     = 32'd0;
   67:         en          = 0;
   68:         in_word_cnt = 16'd0;
   69:         in_byte_cnt = 16'd0;
   70:         
   71:         #20;
   72:         rst_n = 1;
   73:         repeat (10) @(posedge clk);
   74: 
   75:         // Simulation of input from ethernet_frame_reassembly (Exact 2008 Byte = 502 cycles:
   76:         // 8 Byte Preamble + 2000 Byte Ethernet Jumbo Package)
   77:         for (i = 0; i < 502; i = i + 1) begin
   78:             @(posedge clk);
   79:             en          <= 1'b1;
   80:             in_word_cnt <= i[15:0] + 16'd1;
   81:             in_byte_cnt <= (i[15:0] + 16'd1) * 16'd4;
   82: 
   83:             case (i)
   84:                 0:   data_in <= 32'h5555_5555; // Preamble Word 1 (Bytes 1..4)
   85:                 1:   data_in <= 32'h5555_55D5; // Preamble + SFD Word 2 (Bytes 5..8)
   86:                 2:   data_in <= 32'hDA01_0203; // Dest MAC [47:16]
   87:                 3:   data_in <= 32'h0405_5A01; // Dest MAC [15:0] + Src MAC [47:32]
   88:                 4:   data_in <= 32'h0203_0405; // Src MAC [31:0]
   89:                 5:   data_in <= 32'h0800_4500; // EtherType IPv4 (0x0800)
   90:                 11:  data_in <= 32'h4B6F_6F6B; // ASCII "Kook"
   91:                 12:  data_in <= 32'h6D69_6E20; // ASCII "min "
   92:                 13:  data_in <= 32'h4653_4F20; // ASCII "FSO "
   93:                 501: data_in <= 32'hDEAD_BEEF; // 502nd Word (Byte 2008): Ethernet FCS
   94:                 default: data_in <= 32'hA0A0_B0B0 + i;
   95:             endcase
   96:         end
   97: 
   98:         // stop send
   99:         @(posedge clk);
  100:         data_in     <= 32'd0;
  101:         en          <= 1'b0;
  102:         in_word_cnt <= 16'd0;
  103:         in_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
  104: 
  105:         #100;
  106:         $finish;
  107:     end
  108: 
  109:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  110:         if (!rst_n)
  111:             raw_xgmii_idx <= 16'd0;
  112:         else if (xgmii_active)
  113:             raw_xgmii_idx <= raw_xgmii_idx + 16'd1;
  114:         else
  115:             raw_xgmii_idx <= 16'd0;
  116:     end
  117: 
  118: endmodule

Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : tb_fso_deframer_payload
    7: Description  : Standalone Verification Testbench for Receiver Payload 
    8:                Deframer & Store-and-Verify CRC-32 Checker 
    9:                (deframer_payload.v / fso_crc_32_checker.v).
   10: 
   11:                KEY VERIFICATION OBJECTIVES:
   12:                1. Computes the true SDA OISL Table 2-15 CRC-32 polynomial 
   13:                   (0x04C11DB7) initialized to ZERO (32'd0 per Section 2.6.3.6.1, 
   14:                   Page 36) over 477 words (1908 Bytes) and appends it as the 
   15:                   478th word (Word 477 = 1912th Byte).
   16:                2. Clean Frames (Valid CRC-32): Verifies that pld_crc_ok asserts 1 
   17:                   and all 477 payload words (1908 Bytes) drain cleanly per frame.
   18:                3. Corrupted Frame (Corrupted CRC-32): Verifies that pld_crc_ok is 0 
   19:                   and the Store-and-Verify buffer flushes immediately without 
   20:                   emitting any corrupted words to the downstream demux.
   21: 
   22: Revision History:
   23:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 478-word Store-and-Verify Payload Deframer testbench.
   24:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 15:55 KST) : [Target B3.1 - SDA OISL Page 36, Sec. 2.6.3.6.1 Verification]
   25:     Verified true zero-initialized (32'd0) CRC-32 computation matching 
   26:     fso_crc_32.v (TX) and fso_crc_32_checker.v Rev 2.0 (RX).
   27:   - Rev 2.3 (2026-10-29 01:49 KST) : [Unified 4-Frame Scenario & Counter Alignment]
   28:     1. Preserved all original descriptions, comments, and Rev 1.0/2.0 history logs.
   29:     2. Streams all 4 standard frames (DAT1 [1900B], DAT2 [100B+Pad], IDLE [PRBS], 
   30:        MGMT [5000 km] = 4 x 478 words in -> 4 x 477 words out) followed by a 5th 
   31:        corrupted-CRC frame to verify immediate buffer flush.
   32:     3. Added standardized waveform counters: frame_id, frame_type_str, 
   33:        in_clk_cnt (1..478), in_byte_cnt (4..1912), out_clk_cnt (1..477), and 
   34:        out_byte_cnt (4..1908).
   35: ===========================================================================
   36: */
   37: 
   38: module tb_fso_deframer_payload();
   39: 
   40:     reg clk;   // 312.5 MHz Clock (3.2 ns)
   41:     reg rst_n;
   42: 
   43:     reg         payload_dv;
   44:     reg  [31:0] payload_in;
   45:     reg         hdr_crc_ok;
   46:     reg  [15:0] rx_txfn;
   47: 
   48:     wire        pld_check_done;
   49:     wire        pld_crc_ok;
   50:     wire [31:0] m_axis_pld_tdata;
   51:     wire        m_axis_pld_tvalid;
   52:     wire        m_axis_pld_tlast;
   53: 
   54:     wire [31:0] calculated_crc32 = u_dut.u_crc32_checker.calculated_crc32;
   55:     wire [31:0] received_crc32   = u_dut.u_crc32_checker.received_crc32;
   56: 
   57:     // Standardized Waveform Counters
   58:     reg  [3:0]  frame_id;
   59:     reg  [31:0] frame_type_str;
   60:     reg  [15:0] in_clk_cnt;   // 1..478 Clocks
   61:     reg  [15:0] in_byte_cnt;  // 4..1912 Bytes
   62:     reg  [15:0] out_clk_cnt;  // 1..477 Clocks
   63:     reg  [15:0] out_byte_cnt; // 4..1908 Bytes
   64:     integer     drained_word_cnt = 0;
   65: 
   66:     always @(*) begin
   67:         case (frame_id)
   68:             4'd1:    frame_type_str = "DAT1";
   69:             4'd2:    frame_type_str = "DAT2";
   70:             4'd3:    frame_type_str = "IDLE";
   71:             4'd4:    frame_type_str = "MGMT";
   72:             4'd5:    frame_type_str = "BAD!";
   73:             default: frame_type_str = "WAIT";
   74:         endcase
   75:     end
   76: 
   77:     deframer_payload u_dut (
   78:         .clk               (clk),
   79:         .rst_n             (rst_n),
   80:         .payload_dv        (payload_dv),
   81:         .payload_in        (payload_in),
   82:         .hdr_crc_ok        (hdr_crc_ok),
   83:         .rx_txfn           (rx_txfn),
   84:         .pld_check_done    (pld_check_done),
   85:         .pld_crc_ok        (pld_crc_ok),
   86:         .m_axis_pld_tdata  (m_axis_pld_tdata),
   87:         .m_axis_pld_tvalid (m_axis_pld_tvalid),
   88:         .m_axis_pld_tlast  (m_axis_pld_tlast)
   89:     );
   90: 
   91:     initial begin
   92:         clk = 1'b0;
   93:         forever #1.6 clk = ~clk;
   94:     end
   95: 
   96:     // Exact SDA OISL Section 2.6.3.6.1 Zero-Initialized CRC-32 Function (Matches fso_crc_32.v)
   97:     function [31:0] step_crc32(input [31:0] c, input [31:0] d);
   98:         reg [31:0] v;
   99:         integer k;
  100:         begin
  101:             v = c ^ d;
  102:             for (k = 0; k < 32; k = k + 1) begin
  103:                 if (v[31]) v = (v << 1) ^ 32'h04C1_1DB7;
  104:                 else       v = (v << 1);
  105:             end
  106:             step_crc32 = v;
  107:         end
  108:     endfunction
  109: 
  110:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  111:         if (!rst_n) begin
  112:             drained_word_cnt <= 0;
  113:             out_clk_cnt      <= 16'd0;
  114:             out_byte_cnt     <= 16'd0;
  115:         end else if (m_axis_pld_tvalid) begin
  116:             drained_word_cnt <= drained_word_cnt + 1;
  117:             out_clk_cnt      <= out_clk_cnt + 16'd1;
  118:             out_byte_cnt     <= out_byte_cnt + 16'd4;
  119:         end else begin
  120:             out_clk_cnt      <= 16'd0;
  121:             out_byte_cnt     <= 16'd0;
  122:         end
  123:     end
  124: 
  125:     wire [255:0] mgmt_lsb_vec = {
  126:         27'd0, 1'b1, 40'd0, 32'd1476000000,
  127:         64'h4153_12D0_0000_0000, 40'd0, 6'd15,
  128:         40'd16678204759, 6'd15
  129:     };
  130: 
  131:     task stream_payload_frame(input [3:0] f_id, input corrupt_crc);
  132:         integer w;
  133:         reg [31:0] running_crc;
  134:         reg [31:0] word_val;
  135:         begin
  136:             frame_id    = f_id;
  137:             rx_txfn     = {12'd0, f_id};
  138:             running_crc = 32'd0; // SDA OISL Sec. 2.6.3.6.1 Zero Initialization
  139:             for (w = 0; w < 477; w = w + 1) begin
  140:                 if (f_id == 4'd1) begin
  141:                     if      (w == 0)  word_val = 32'hAB00_0000;
  142:                     else if (w == 1)  word_val = 32'hCDEF_07D0;
  143:                     else if (w == 11) word_val = 32'h4B6F_6F6B; // "Kook"
  144:                     else if (w == 12) word_val = 32'h6D69_6E20; // "min "
  145:                     else if (w == 13) word_val = 32'h4653_4F20; // "FSO "
  146:                     else              word_val = 32'hDA7A_0000 + w[31:0];
  147:                 end else if (f_id == 4'd2) begin
  148:                     if      (w == 0)  word_val = 32'hAB00_4064;
  149:                     else if (w == 25) word_val = 32'hDEAD_BEEF;
  150:                     else if (w >  25) word_val = 32'd0;
  151:                     else              word_val = 32'hDA7A_2000 + w[31:0];
  152:                 end else if (f_id == 4'd3) begin
  153:                     word_val = 32'h1D1E_0000 + w[31:0];
  154:                 end else begin
  155:                     if (w < 8) word_val = mgmt_lsb_vec[(w * 32) +: 32];
  156:                     else       word_val = 32'd0;
  157:                 end
  158:                 running_crc = step_crc32(running_crc, word_val);
  159:                 @(posedge clk);
  160:                 payload_dv  <= 1'b1;
  161:                 payload_in  <= word_val;
  162:                 in_clk_cnt  <= w + 16'd1;
  163:                 in_byte_cnt <= (w + 16'd1) * 16'd4;
  164:             end
  165:             // 478th Word: True Zero-Initialized CRC-32 (or corrupted test word)
  166:             @(posedge clk);
  167:             payload_dv  <= 1'b1;
  168:             payload_in  <= corrupt_crc ? (running_crc ^ 32'h1234_5678) : running_crc;
  169:             in_clk_cnt  <= 16'd478;
  170:             in_byte_cnt <= 16'd1912;
  171: 
  172:             @(posedge clk);
  173:             payload_dv  <= 1'b0;
  174:             payload_in  <= 32'd0;
  175:             in_clk_cnt  <= 16'd0;
  176:             in_byte_cnt <= 16'd0;
  177:             repeat (500) @(posedge clk);
  178:         end
  179:     endtask
  180: 
  181:     initial begin
  182:         rst_n       = 1'b0;
  183:         payload_dv  = 1'b0;
  184:         payload_in  = 32'd0;
  185:         hdr_crc_ok  = 1'b1;
  186:         rx_txfn     = 16'd1;
  187:         frame_id    = 4'd0;
  188:         in_clk_cnt  = 16'd0;
  189:         in_byte_cnt = 16'd0;
  190:         #100;
  191:         rst_n       = 1'b1;
  192:         repeat (5) @(posedge clk);
  193: 
  194:         // =======================================================
  195:         // SCENARIO 1: Valid 478-Word Frames (DAT1, DAT2, IDLE, MGMT) with Zero-Init CRC-32
  196:         // =======================================================
  197:         $display("\n[SCENARIO 1] Streaming 4 Clean Frames (DAT1, DAT2, IDLE, MGMT: 477 Data Words + Zero-Init CRC-32)...");

  199:         stream_payload_frame(4'd2, 1'b0);
  200:         stream_payload_frame(4'd3, 1'b0);
  201:         stream_payload_frame(4'd4, 1'b0);
  202:         $display(" -> Clean Frames Drained Words = %0d / 1908 (4 x 477 Words)", drained_word_cnt);
  203: 
  204:         // =======================================================
  205:         // SCENARIO 2: Corrupted Frame (Must Flush & Emit 0 Words)
  206:         // =======================================================
  207:         $display("\n[SCENARIO 2] Streaming Frame 5 with Inverted/Corrupted CRC-32 (Expect Flush)...");
  208:         stream_payload_frame(4'd5, 1'b1);
  209:         $display(" -> Frame 5 pld_crc_ok = %0b | Total Drained Words = %0d (Expected: 1908)",

  211: 
  212:         if (drained_word_cnt == 1908 && pld_crc_ok == 1'b0)
  213:             $display(" -> RESULT: [PASS] ZERO-INIT CRC-32 & STORE-AND-VERIFY BUFFER VERIFIED 100%%!\n");
  214:         $finish;
  215:     end

    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : tb_fso_ethernet_deframer
    7: Description  : Comprehensive Verification Testbench for the Receiver FSO-to-
    8:                Ethernet Deframer & Selective Repeat ARQ Subsystem 
    9:                (fso_ethernet_deframer.v).
   10: 
   11:                SCENARIOS VERIFIED:
   12:                1. Frame 1 (TXFN=1, DATA): Valid CRC-16 & CRC-32 -> Generates 
   13:                   ACK(1) and drains 477 words (1908B) immediately.
   14:                2. Frame 2 (TXFN=2, DATA): Corrupted Payload CRC-32 -> Flushes 
   15:                   buffer and generates NAK(0) for TXFN=2.
   16:                3. Frame 3 (TXFN=3, DATA): Arrives out-of-order while TXFN=2 is 
   17:                   missing -> Generates ACK(3) and buffers in Selective Repeat 
   18:                   Reorder RAM (does NOT drain prematurely!).
   19:                4. Frame 4 (TXFN=4, IDLE) & Frame 5 (TXFN=5, MGMT): Verifies 
   20:                   IDLE discard and Table 2-14 LSB-first 64-bit IEEE-754 Range 
   21:                   extraction (64'h4153_12D0_0000_0000 = 5,000,000.0 m).
   22:                5. Frame 2 Retransmission (TXFN=2, DATA): Passes CRC-32 -> 
   23:                   Triggers back-to-back in-order release of TXFN=2 (477 words) 
   24:                   followed immediately by buffered TXFN=3 (477 words)!
   25: 
   26: Revision History:
   27:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 5-scenario Deframer + Selective Repeat ARQ reorder TB.
   28:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 15:55 KST) : [Target B3.1, B4.1 & B5.2 Verification]
   29:     1. Computed true zero-initialized Table 2-15 CRC-16 and CRC-32 on every frame.
   30:     2. Used LSB-packed Table 2-14 telemetry vector (matching mgmt_telemetry_generator.v)
   31:        to verify mgmt_extraction.v Rev 2.0.
   32: ===========================================================================
   33: */

   35: module tb_fso_ethernet_deframer();

   68:     fso_ethernet_deframer u_dut (
   69:         .clk                  (clk),
   70:         .rst_n                (rst_n),
   71:         .s_axis_hdr_tvalid    (s_axis_hdr_tvalid),
   72:         .s_axis_hdr_tdata     (s_axis_hdr_tdata),
   73:         .s_axis_fso_tvalid    (s_axis_fso_tvalid),
   74:         .s_axis_fso_tdata     (s_axis_fso_tdata),
   75:         .m_axis_fso_tdata     (m_axis_fso_tdata),
   76:         .m_axis_fso_tvalid    (m_axis_fso_tvalid),
   77:         .m_axis_fso_tlast     (m_axis_fso_tlast),
   78:         .m_axis_fso_tready    (m_axis_fso_tready),
   79:         .local_fb_rxfn        (local_fb_rxfn),
   80:         .local_fb_ack         (local_fb_ack),

   97:     initial begin
   98:         clk = 1'b0;
   99:         forever #1.6 clk = ~clk;
  100:     end
  101: 
  102:     // Zero-Initialized Table 2-15 CRC-16 (x^16 + x^12 + x^5 + 1)
  103:     function [15:0] step_crc16(input [15:0] q, input [7:0] d);
  104:         reg [15:0] nxt;
  105:         begin
  106:             nxt[0]  = d[0] ^ d[4] ^ q[8]  ^ q[12];
  107:             nxt[1]  = d[1] ^ d[5] ^ q[9]  ^ q[13];
  108:             nxt[2]  = d[2] ^ d[6] ^ q[10] ^ q[14];
  109:             nxt[3]  = d[3] ^ d[7] ^ q[11] ^ q[15];
  110:             nxt[4]  = d[4] ^ q[12];
  111:             nxt[5]  = d[0] ^ d[4] ^ d[5] ^ q[8]  ^ q[12] ^ q[13];
  112:             nxt[6]  = d[1] ^ d[5] ^ d[6] ^ q[9]  ^ q[13] ^ q[14];
  113:             nxt[7]  = d[2] ^ d[6] ^ d[7] ^ q[10] ^ q[14] ^ q[15];
  114:             nxt[8]  = d[3] ^ d[7] ^ q[0]  ^ q[11] ^ q[15];
  115:             nxt[9]  = d[4] ^ q[1]  ^ q[12];
  116:             nxt[10] = d[5] ^ q[2]  ^ q[13];
  117:             nxt[11] = d[6] ^ q[3]  ^ q[14];
  118:             nxt[12] = d[0] ^ d[4] ^ d[7] ^ q[4]  ^ q[8]  ^ q[12] ^ q[15];
  119:             nxt[13] = d[1] ^ d[5] ^ q[5]  ^ q[9]  ^ q[13];
  120:             nxt[14] = d[2] ^ d[6] ^ q[6]  ^ q[10] ^ q[14];
  121:             nxt[15] = d[3] ^ d[7] ^ q[7]  ^ q[11] ^ q[15];
  122:             step_crc16 = nxt;
  123:         end
  124:     endfunction
  125: 
  126:     // Zero-Initialized Table 2-15 CRC-32 (0x04C11DB7)
  127:     function [31:0] step_crc32(input [31:0] c, input [31:0] d);
  128:         reg [31:0] v;
  129:         integer k;
  130:         begin
  131:             v = c ^ d;
  132:             for (k = 0; k < 32; k = k + 1) begin
  133:                 if (v[31]) v = (v << 1) ^ 32'h04C1_1DB7;
  134:                 else       v = (v << 1);
  135:             end
  136:             step_crc32 = v;
  137:         end
  138:     endfunction
  139: 
  140:     // Table 2-14 LSB-First Telemetry Vector (Matches mgmt_telemetry_generator.v)
  141:     wire [255:0] mgmt_lsb_vec = {
  142:         27'd0, 1'b1, 40'd0, 32'd1476000000,
  143:         64'h4153_12D0_0000_0000, 40'd0, 6'd15,
  144:         40'd16678204759, 6'd15
  145:     };
  146: 
  147:     task send_fso_frame(
  148:         input [15:0] txfn,
  149:         input [1:0]  ftype,
  150:         input        corrupt_pld_crc
  151:     );
  152:         integer idx;
  153:         reg [7:0]  hb;
  154:         reg [15:0] crc16_acc;
  155:         reg [31:0] pw;
  156:         reg [31:0] crc32_acc;
  157:         begin
  158:             crc16_acc = 16'd0;
  159:             crc32_acc = 32'd0;
  160: 
  161:             for (idx = 0; idx < 478; idx = idx + 1) begin
  162:                 // 1. 16-Byte Header on Cycles 0..15
  163:                 if (idx < 14) begin
  164:                     case (idx)
  165:                         0:  hb = txfn[7:0];
  166:                         1:  hb = txfn[15:8];
  167:                         2:  hb = 8'h01;
  168:                         3:  hb = 8'h00;
  169:                         4:  hb = {4'b1111, 1'b1, 1'b1, ftype};
  170:                         10: hb = {2'b11, 6'd15};
  171:                         11: hb = {1'b1, 3'b000, 4'hA};
  172:                         12: hb = 8'h01;
  173:                         13: hb = 8'hF0;
  174:                         default: hb = 8'h55;
  175:                     endcase
  176:                     crc16_acc = step_crc16(crc16_acc, hb);
  177:                 end else if (idx == 14) begin
  178:                     hb = crc16_acc[15:8];
  179:                 end else if (idx == 15) begin
  180:                     hb = crc16_acc[7:0];
  181:                 end else begin
  182:                     hb = 8'd0;
  183:                 end
  184: 
  185:                 // 2. 478-Word Payload (477 Data Words + 478th Word CRC-32)
  186:                 if (idx < 477) begin
  187:                     if (ftype == 2'b10) begin
  188:                         // MGMT Frame (Table 2-14 LSB-first)
  189:                         if (idx < 8) pw = mgmt_lsb_vec[(idx * 32) +: 32];
  190:                         else         pw = 32'd0;
  191:                     end else if (ftype == 2'b00) begin
  192:                         // IDLE Frame
  193:                         pw = 32'h1D1E_0000 + idx[31:0];
  194:                     end else begin
  195:                         // DATA Frame (Table 2-18)
  196:                         if      (idx == 0) pw = (txfn == 16'd2) ? 32'hAB00_4064 : 32'hAB00_0000;
  197:                         else if (idx == 1) pw = (txfn == 16'd2) ? 32'hAAAA_0001 : 32'hCDEF_07D0;
  198:                         else               pw = {txfn, idx[15:0]};
  199:                     end
  200:                     crc32_acc = step_crc32(crc32_acc, pw);
  201:                 end else begin
  202:                     pw = corrupt_pld_crc ? (crc32_acc ^ 32'hDEAD_DEAD) : crc32_acc;
  203:                 end
  204: 
  205:                 @(posedge clk);
  206:                 s_axis_hdr_tvalid <= (idx < 16);
  207:                 s_axis_hdr_tdata  <= (idx < 16) ? hb : 8'd0;
  208:                 s_axis_fso_tvalid <= 1'b1;
  209:                 s_axis_fso_tdata  <= pw;
  210:             end
  211: 
  212:             @(posedge clk);
  213:             s_axis_hdr_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  214:             s_axis_hdr_tdata  <= 8'd0;
  215:             s_axis_fso_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  216:             s_axis_fso_tdata  <= 32'd0;
  217:             repeat (25) @(posedge clk);
  218:         end
  219:     endtask
  220: 
  221:     integer drained_data_frames = 0;
  222:     always @(posedge clk) begin
  223:         if (local_fb_ack_valid) begin
  224:             $display(" [%0t] ARQ Feedback Generated -> RXFN=%0d | ACK=%0b (%s)",
  225:                      $time, local_fb_rxfn, local_fb_ack, local_fb_ack ? "ACK" : "NAK");
  226:         end
  227:         if (m_axis_fso_tvalid && m_axis_fso_tready && m_axis_fso_tlast) begin
  228:             drained_data_frames <= drained_data_frames + 1;
  229:             $display(" [%0t] In-Order DATA Frame #%0d Drained to Reassembly! (next expected_txfn=%0d)",
  230:                      $time, drained_data_frames + 1, expected_txfn);
  231:         end
  232:     end
  233: 
  234:     initial begin
  235:         rst_n             = 1'b0;
  236:         s_axis_hdr_tvalid = 1'b0;
  237:         s_axis_hdr_tdata  = 8'd0;
  238:         s_axis_fso_tvalid = 1'b0;
  239:         s_axis_fso_tdata  = 32'd0;
  240:         m_axis_fso_tready = 1'b1;
  241:         #100;
  242:         rst_n             = 1'b1;
  243:         repeat (10) @(posedge clk);
  244: 
  245:         $display("\n--- STEP 1: Send TXFN=1 (DATA, Clean) -> Expect ACK(1) & Immediate Drain ---");
  246:         send_fso_frame(16'd1, 2'b01, 1'b0);
  247:         repeat (500) @(posedge clk);
  248: 
  249:         $display("\n--- STEP 2: Send TXFN=2 (DATA, Corrupted CRC-32) -> Expect NAK(2) & Flush ---");
  250:         send_fso_frame(16'd2, 2'b01, 1'b1);
  251: 
  252:         $display("\n--- STEP 3: Send TXFN=3 (DATA, Out-of-Order) -> Expect ACK(3) & Buffer in RAM ---");
  253:         send_fso_frame(16'd3, 2'b01, 1'b0);
  254: 
  255:         $display("\n--- STEP 4: Send TXFN=4 (IDLE) & TXFN=5 (MGMT 5000 km) ---");
  256:         send_fso_frame(16'd4, 2'b00, 1'b0);
  257:         send_fso_frame(16'd5, 2'b10, 1'b0);
  258: 
  259:         $display("\n--- STEP 5: Retransmit TXFN=2 (DATA, Clean) -> Expect In-Order Drain of TXFN=2 then TXFN=3! ---");
  260:         send_fso_frame(16'd2, 2'b01, 1'b0);
  261:         repeat (1200) @(posedge clk);
  262: 
  263:         $display("\n======================================================================");
  264:         $display(" FSO ETHERNET DEFRAMER & SELECTIVE REPEAT ARQ VERIFICATION REPORT");
  265:         $display(" -> In-Order DATA Frames Released : %0d / 3 (TXFN 1 -> TXFN 2 -> TXFN 3)", drained_data_frames);
  266:         $display(" -> Extracted MGMT Range (IEEE754): 0x%016X (Expected: 0x415312D000000000)", mgmt_range_meters);
  267:         if (drained_data_frames == 3 && mgmt_range_meters == 64'h4153_12D0_0000_0000)
  268:             $display(" -> RESULT: [PASS] ZERO-INIT CRC, SELECTIVE REPEAT ARQ & MGMT VERIFIED 100%%!");
  269:         $display("======================================================================\n");
  270:         $finish;
  271:     end
  272: 
  273: endmodule

    3: // Deskripsi: Testbench Loopback untuk GTH FSO 64b/66b

    9: //        modular GTH blocks (gth64b66b_tx + fso_gth_core_wrapper + gth64b66b_rx)

   95:         .gt_rxheader_out      (gt_rxheader_int),
   96:         .gt_rxheadervalid_out (gt_rxheadervalid_int),
   97:         .gt_rxstartofseq_out  (gt_rxstartofseq_int),
   98:         .gt_rxgearboxslip_in  (gt_rxgearboxslip_int)
   99:     );
  100: 
  101:     gth64b66b_rx u_gth64b66b_rx (
  102:         .clk_gth              (rx0_clk),
  103:         .clk_312_5            (clk_312_5),
  104:         .rst_n                (sys_rst_n),
  105:         .gth_rx_ready         (gth_rx_ready),
  106:         .gt_rxdata_in         (gt_rxdata_int),
  107:         .gt_rxdatavalid_in    (gt_rxdatavalid_int),
  108:         .gt_rxheader_in       (gt_rxheader_int),
  109:         .gt_rxheadervalid_in  (gt_rxheadervalid_int),
  110:         .gt_rxgearboxslip_out (gt_rxgearboxslip_int),
  111:         .rx_block_locked      (rx_block_locked),
  112:         .down_data            (fso_rx_data),
  113:         .down_dv              (fso_rx_valid)
  114:     );
  115: 
  116:     // --- PEMASANGAN KABEL FIBER VIRTUAL (LOOPBACK) ---
  117:     // Sinyal laser yang keluar dari TX langsung kita paksa masuk ke RX
  118:     assign rxp_in = txp_out;
  119:     assign rxn_in = txn_out;
  120: 
  121:     // Sinyal differential N selalu kebalikan dari P
  122:     assign gt_refclk_n = ~gt_refclk_p;
  123: 
  124:     // --- GENERATOR CLOCK MULTIPLE ---
  125:     // a) Clock Internal FPGA (312.5 MHz -> Periode 3.2 ns)
  126:     always #1.6 clk_312_5 = ~clk_312_5;
  127:     
  128:     // b) Clock DRP/Free-running (100 MHz -> Periode 10 ns)
  129:     always #5.0 clk_100_drp = ~clk_100_drp;
  130:     
  131:     // c) Clock Fisik Osilator SFP+ (Scaled #3.103 -> 322.265625 MHz tx0_clk/rx0_clk)
  132:     always #3.103 gt_refclk_p = ~gt_refclk_p;
  133: 
  134:     // Standardized 4-Frame Byte Generator (DAT1, DAT2, IDLE, MGMT)
  135:     function [7:0] get_frame_byte(input [31:0] f_idx, input [11:0] b_idx);
  136:         begin
  137:             case (b_idx)
  138:                 12'd1:   get_frame_byte = 8'h77; // Official SDA OISL Preamble MSB
  139:                 12'd2:   get_frame_byte = 8'hAD;
  140:                 12'd3:   get_frame_byte = 8'h5B;
  141:                 12'd4:   get_frame_byte = 8'h58;
  142:                 12'd5:   get_frame_byte = 8'h43;
  143:                 12'd6:   get_frame_byte = 8'h64;
  144:                 12'd7:   get_frame_byte = 8'h1E;
  145:                 12'd8:   get_frame_byte = 8'h2E;
  146:                 12'd9:   get_frame_byte = 8'h26; // Official SDA OISL Preamble LSB
  147:                 12'd10:  get_frame_byte = 8'hAB; // FSO Payload Header
  148:                 12'd13:  get_frame_byte = f_idx[7:0];
  149:                 12'd3117:get_frame_byte = 8'h33; // Frame Boundary Tail Byte
  150:                 default: begin
  151:                     if      (f_idx <= 32'd2) get_frame_byte = 8'hDA; // DAT1 / DAT2
  152:                     else if (f_idx == 32'd3) get_frame_byte = 8'h1D; // IDLE
  153:                     else                     get_frame_byte = 8'hA1; // MGMT
  154:                 end
  155:             endcase
  156:         end
  157:     endfunction
  158: 
  159:     // Standardized Counters for TX Input & RX Output
  160:     reg  [31:0] in_frame_id;
  161:     reg  [31:0] in_frame_type_str;
  162:     reg  [15:0] in_clk_cnt;
  163:     reg  [11:0] in_byte_cnt;
  164: 
  165:     wire [7:0]  rx_byte_out  = u_gth64b66b_rx.byte_out;
  166:     wire [15:0] out_clk_cnt  = u_gth64b66b_rx.out_clk_cnt;
  167:     wire [11:0] out_byte_cnt = u_gth64b66b_rx.frame_byte_cnt;
  168:     wire [31:0] out_frame_id = u_gth64b66b_rx.frame_out_id;
  169:     reg  [31:0] out_frame_type_str;
  170: 
  171:     always @(*) begin
  172:         case (in_frame_id)
  173:             32'd1:   in_frame_type_str = "DAT1";
  174:             32'd2:   in_frame_type_str = "DAT2";
  175:             32'd3:   in_frame_type_str = "IDLE";
  176:             32'd4:   in_frame_type_str = "MGMT";
  177:             default: in_frame_type_str = "WAIT";
  178:         endcase
  179:         case (out_frame_id)
  180:             32'd1:   out_frame_type_str = "DAT1";
  181:             32'd2:   out_frame_type_str = "DAT2";
  182:             32'd3:   out_frame_type_str = "IDLE";
  183:             32'd4:   out_frame_type_str = "MGMT";
  184:             default: out_frame_type_str = "WAIT";
  185:         endcase
  186:     end
  187: 
  188:     // --- SKENARIO PENGUJIAN ---
  189:     integer i, b0, b1, b2, b3;
  190:     integer rx_word_cnt = 0;
  191: 
  192:     always @(posedge clk_312_5) begin
  193:         if (fso_rx_valid) begin
  194:             if (rx_word_cnt == 0)
  195:                 $display("Waktu %0t: Kata Pertama Diterima di RX = 0x%08X (Expected: 0x77AD5B58)", $time, fso_rx_data);
  196:             rx_word_cnt <= rx_word_cnt + 1;
  197:         end
  198:     end
  199: 
  200:     initial begin
  201:         // Kondisi Awal (Mati)
  202:         clk_312_5   = 0;
  203:         clk_100_drp = 0;
  204:         gt_refclk_p = 0;
  205:         sys_rst_n   = 0;
  206:         fso_tx_data = 32'd0;
  207:         fso_tx_en   = 0;
  208:         in_frame_id = 32'd0;
  209:         in_clk_cnt  = 16'd0;
  210:         in_byte_cnt = 12'd0;
  211: 
  212:         // Nyalakan Power (Reset Dilepas)
  213:         #100;
  214:         sys_rst_n = 1;
  215:         $display("Waktu %0t: Power On, menunggu GTH PLL Lock...", $time);
  216: 
  217:         // CATATAN PENTING: Model GTH butuh waktu lama untuk Lock di simulasi!
  218:         // Kita harus menunggu sampai gth_link_up dan rx_block_locked bernilai 1.
  219:         wait(gth_link_up == 1'b1);
  220:         $display("Waktu %0t: GTH Link Up! Menunggu 64B/66B Gearbox Block Lock...", $time);
  221:         wait(rx_block_locked == 1'b1);
  222:         $display("Waktu %0t: 64B/66B Gearbox Locked! Memulai transmisi 4 Frame (DAT1, DAT2, IDLE, MGMT)...", $time);
  223:         
  224:         // Jeda stabilitas setelah Lock
  225:         #500;
  226: 
  227:         // --- MENGIRIM 4 FSO FRAME KONTINU (3117 Kata = 12,468 Byte: DAT1, DAT2, IDLE, MGMT) ---
  228:         for (i = 0; i < 3117; i = i + 1) begin
  229:             b0 = i * 4;
  230:             b1 = i * 4 + 1;
  231:             b2 = i * 4 + 2;
  232:             b3 = i * 4 + 3;
  233: 
  234:             @(posedge clk_312_5);
  235:             fso_tx_en   <= 1'b1;
  236:             fso_tx_data <= {
  237:                 get_frame_byte((b0 / 3117) + 1, (b0 % 3117) + 1),
  238:                 get_frame_byte((b1 / 3117) + 1, (b1 % 3117) + 1),
  239:                 get_frame_byte((b2 / 3117) + 1, (b2 % 3117) + 1),
  240:                 get_frame_byte((b3 / 3117) + 1, (b3 % 3117) + 1)
  241:             };
  242:             in_frame_id <= (b0 / 3117) + 1;
  243:             in_clk_cnt  <= ((b0 % 3117) / 4) + 1;
  244:             in_byte_cnt <= (b3 % 3117) + 1;
  245:         end
  246: 
  247:         // Selesai Kirim, kembali ke Idle
  248:         @(posedge clk_312_5);
  249:         fso_tx_en   <= 1'b0;
  250:         fso_tx_data <= 32'd0;
  251:         in_frame_id <= 32'd0;
  252:         in_clk_cnt  <= 16'd0;
  253:         in_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  254: 
  255:         // Tunggu seluruh 3117 kata (12,468 Byte) keluar dari RX
  256:         wait(rx_word_cnt == 3117);
  257:         #500;
  258:         $display("Waktu %0t: Simulasi Selesai. Total Kata Diterima di RX = %0d / 3117 (12,468 Byte).", $time, rx_word_cnt);
  259:         $finish;
  260:     end
  261: 
  262: endmodule

    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Description  : Verification Testbench for FSO Header Generation (Top Level).
    7:                Provides stimulus to mimic the ARQ TX Controller & PNT system.
    8:                Includes an intelligent Tcl logger to format hexadecimal output 
    9:                strictly matching SDA OISL Table 2-10 for ETRI reporting.
   10: 
   11: Revision History:
   12:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Table 2-10 16-Byte Header generation testbench.
   13:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 15:04 KST) :
   14:     1. Added explicit verification of hardware CRC-16 output bytes d14 (0x0F) 
   15:        and d15 (0x28) for polynomial g(x) = x^16 + x^12 + x^5 + 1 (Table 2-15).
   16:     2. Added Scenario 2 to verify Target B5.1 standard compliance rules:
   17:        - Section 2.6.3.3.2 (Page 25): When ack_valid_in == 0, RXFN (d2, d3) is 
   18:          automatically forced to 0x0000 even if rxfn_in = 16'hABCD.
   19:        - Section 2.6.3.3.5 (Page 27): When fcch_opcode_in == 4'b1111, FCCH_PL 
   20:          (d12, d13) is automatically forced to 0xFFFF.
   21:   - Rev 2.3 (2026-10-29 01:49 KST) : [Unified 4-Frame Scenario & Counter Alignment]
   22:     1. Preserved all original descriptions, d0..d15 Tcl console loggers, and 
   23:        previous revision history logs 100% intact.
   24:     2. Synchronized stimulus to generate the exact 4 sequential FSO Frame Headers:
   25:        - Frame 1 ("DAT1"): TXFN = 16'h1234, FRAME_TYPE = 2'b01 (DATA, First 1900B Jumbo)
   26:        - Frame 2 ("DAT2"): TXFN = 16'h0002, FRAME_TYPE = 2'b01 (DATA, Continuation 100B)
   27:        - Frame 3 ("IDLE"): TXFN = 16'h0003, FRAME_TYPE = 2'b00 (IDLE, ack_valid=0 -> RXFN=0, FCCH=4'hF -> 0xFFFF)
   28:        - Frame 4 ("MGMT"): TXFN = 16'h0004, FRAME_TYPE = 2'b10 (MGMT, 5000 km Ranging Telemetry)
   29:     3. Added standardized waveform counters: frame_id (1..4), frame_type_str, 
   30:        out_clk_cnt (1..16), out_byte_cnt (1..16), and total_hdr_bytes (1..64).
   31: ===========================================================================
   32: */

   34: module tb_fso_header_top();
   35: 
   36:     reg clk;
   37:     reg rst_n;
   38:     reg trigger_header_gen;
   39: 
   40:     // Simulated ARQ Control Plane Inputs
   41:     reg [15:0] txfn_in;
   42:     reg [15:0] rxfn_in;
   43:     reg        ack_in;
   44:     reg        ack_valid_in;
   45:     reg [1:0]  frame_type_in; 
   46:     
   47:     // Simulated Telemetry (PNT) Inputs
   48:     reg [39:0] tx_ts_in;
   49:     reg [5:0]  tod_seconds_in;
   50:     reg [2:0]  ts_applies_in;
   51:     reg [3:0]  fcch_opcode_in;
   52:     reg [15:0] fcch_pl_in;
   53: 
   54:     // DUT Outputs
   55:     wire [7:0] final_header_byte;

   59:     // Standardized Waveform Counters & ASCII Frame Identifier
