    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Description  : High-Fidelity Testbench for MUX Gearbox 128.
    6: 
    7:                VALIDATION OBJECTIVES:
    8:                1. Strict 3117-Byte Geometry: Proves the MUX correctly 
    9:                   combines Preamble and LPC and terminates exactly at 3117 
   10:                   Bytes using the cdc_keep masking signal.
   11:                2. OISL Packet Sequence: Simulates the progression of DAT1, 
   12:                   DAT2, IDLE, and MGMT frames.
   13:                3. Inter-Frame Gap: Simulates the physical 25.6 Gbps wait state.
   14: 
   15: Revision History:
   16:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 128-bit MUX Gearbox (9B Preamble + 3108B LPC = 3117B) testbench.
   17:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 15:11 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 1 - SDA OISL Page 23, Table 2-8 & Sec. 2.6.3.2]
   18:     1. Added automatic verification that the first 128-bit output word of every 
   19:        frame places the official 72-bit SDA OISL Preamble (72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26)
   20:        at MSB bits [127:56] (MSB transmitted first) concatenated with the top 
   21:        56 bits of LPC Word 1 at [55:0] (cdc_data = 128'h77AD5B58_43641E2E_26AAAABB_BBCCCCDD).
   22:     2. Verified that every frame emits exactly 194 full 16-Byte words (cdc_keep = 16'hFFFF)
   23:        plus a 195th flush word of 13 Bytes (cdc_keep = 16'h1FFF) = 3,117 Bytes (24,936 bits).
   24: ===========================================================================
   25: */
   26: 
   27: module tb_mux_gearbox();
   28: 
   29:     // =======================================================
   30:     // 1. SYSTEM CLOCKS AND RESET
   31:     // =======================================================
   32:     reg clk;   // 200.0 MHz Baseband Clock
   33:     reg rst_n;
   34: 
   35:     // =======================================================
   36:     // 2. DEVICE UNDER TEST (DUT) SIGNALS
   37:     // =======================================================
   38:     wire [71:0]  preamble_data;
   39:     
   40:     reg  [95:0]  lpc_data;
   41:     reg          lpc_valid;
   42:     
   43:     wire [127:0] cdc_data;
   44:     wire         cdc_valid;
   45:     wire [15:0]  cdc_keep;
   46: 
   47:     // =======================================================
   48:     // 3. DUT INSTANTIATIONS
   49:     // =======================================================
   50:     preamble_gen u_preamble (
   51:         .preamble_out (preamble_data)
   52:     );
   53: 
   54:     mux_gearbox_128 u_mux (
   55:         .clk           (clk),
   56:         .rst_n         (rst_n),
   57:         .preamble_data (preamble_data),
   58:         .lpc_data      (lpc_data),
   59:         .lpc_valid     (lpc_valid),
   60:         .cdc_data      (cdc_data),
   61:         .cdc_valid     (cdc_valid),
   62:         .cdc_keep      (cdc_keep)
   63:     );
   64: 
   65:     // =======================================================
   66:     // 4. CLOCK & FSM INJECTOR 
   67:     // =======================================================
   68:     initial begin
   69:         clk = 1'b0;
   70:         forever #2.5 clk = ~clk; 
   71:     end
   72: 
   73:     localparam ST_STREAM = 2'd0;
   74:     localparam ST_GAP    = 2'd1;
   75:     localparam ST_DONE   = 2'd2;
   76: 
   77:     reg [1:0]  tb_state;
   78:     reg [3:0]  frame_id;
   79:     reg [15:0] cycle_cnt;
   80: 
   81:     initial begin
   82:         rst_n     = 1'b0;
   83:         tb_state  = ST_STREAM;
   84:         frame_id  = 4'd1;
   85:         cycle_cnt = 16'd1;
   86:         #100; rst_n = 1'b1;
   87:     end
   88: 
   89:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   90:         if (rst_n) begin
   91:             case (tb_state)
   92:                 ST_STREAM: begin
   93:                     // 259 Continuous Words from LPC
   94:                     if (cycle_cnt < 259) cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
   95:                     else begin tb_state <= ST_GAP; cycle_cnt <= 16'd1; end
   96:                 end
   97:                 ST_GAP: begin
   98:                     // 110 Cycles of Gap: Wait for Framer to assemble next frame
   99:                     if (cycle_cnt < 110) cycle_cnt <= cycle_cnt + 1'b1;
  100:                     else begin
  101:                         if (frame_id < 4) begin
  102:                             frame_id <= frame_id + 1'b1;
  103:                             tb_state <= ST_STREAM;
  104:                             cycle_cnt <= 16'd1;
  105:                         end else begin
  106:                             tb_state <= ST_DONE;
  107:                         end
  108:                     end
  109:                 end
  110:             endcase
  111:         end
  112:     end
  113: 
  114:     // Combinational Data Assembly for LPC (96-bit words)
  115:     reg [31:0] frame_type_str;
  116:     always @(*) begin
  117:         lpc_valid = 1'b0; 
  118:         lpc_data  = 96'd0;
  119:         frame_type_str = "WAIT";
  120: 
  121:         if (tb_state == ST_STREAM) begin
  122:             lpc_valid = 1'b1;
  123:             
  124:             if      (frame_id == 1) frame_type_str = "DAT1";
  125:             else if (frame_id == 2) frame_type_str = "DAT2";
  126:             else if (frame_id == 3) frame_type_str = "IDLE";
  127:             else                    frame_type_str = "MGMT";
  128: 
  129:             // Simulated LPC Structure with identifiable words
  130:             if      (cycle_cnt == 1)   lpc_data = {64'hAAAA_BBBB_CCCC_DDDD, 16'd1, 16'hE0E0};
  131:             else if (cycle_cnt == 2)   lpc_data = {64'hEEEE_FFFF_1111_2222, 16'd2, 16'hE0E0};
  132:             else if (cycle_cnt == 259) lpc_data = {64'h9999_8888_7777_6666, 16'd259, 16'hE0E0};
  133:             else                       lpc_data = {32'd0, 32'd0, 16'd0, cycle_cnt[15:0]};
  134:         end
  135:     end
  136: 
  137:     // =======================================================
  138:     // 5. THE WAVEFORM TRACKERS (Global Clock, LPC, and 3117 Byte MUX)
  139:     // =======================================================
  140:     
  141:     // NEW: Global Clock Counter
  142:     reg [31:0] global_clk_cnt;
  143:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  144:         if (!rst_n) global_clk_cnt <= 32'd0;
  145:         else global_clk_cnt <= global_clk_cnt + 1'b1;
  146:     end
  147: 
  148:     // NEW: LPC Byte Counter (Tracks 12 Bytes up to 3108 Bytes)
  149:     reg [11:0] r_lpc_byte_cnt;
  150:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  151:         if (!rst_n) r_lpc_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  152:         else if (lpc_valid) r_lpc_byte_cnt <= r_lpc_byte_cnt + 12'd12;
  153:         else if (tb_state == ST_GAP && cycle_cnt == 10) r_lpc_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  154:     end
  155:     wire [11:0] track_lpc_bytes = lpc_valid ? (r_lpc_byte_cnt + 12'd12) : r_lpc_byte_cnt;
  156: 
  157:     // EXISTING: MUX 3117 Byte Tracker & [Rev 2.0] Table 2-8 Preamble MSB-First Verifier
  158:     reg [11:0] r_out_byte_cnt;
  159:     integer    preamble_msb_pass_cnt = 0;
  160:     integer    frame_3117b_pass_cnt  = 0;
  161: 
  162:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  163:         if (!rst_n) begin
  164:             r_out_byte_cnt        <= 12'd0;
  165:             preamble_msb_pass_cnt <= 0;
  166:             frame_3117b_pass_cnt  <= 0;
  167:         end else begin
  168:             if (cdc_valid) begin
  169:                 // Verify 1st 128-bit word of frame: [127:56] must be 72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26
  170:                 if (r_out_byte_cnt == 12'd0) begin
  171:                     $display(" [%0t] Frame %0d Word 1 cdc_data[127:56] (Preamble) = 0x%018X | cdc_data[55:0] (LPC MSB) = 0x%014X",
  172:                              $time, frame_id, cdc_data[127:56], cdc_data[55:0]);
  173:                     if (cdc_data[127:56] == 72'h77_AD_5B_58_43_64_1E_2E_26)
  174:                         preamble_msb_pass_cnt <= preamble_msb_pass_cnt + 1;
  175:                 end
  176: 
  177:                 if (cdc_keep == 16'hFFFF) begin
  178:                     r_out_byte_cnt <= r_out_byte_cnt + 12'd16;
  179:                 end else if (cdc_keep == 16'h1FFF) begin
  180:                     r_out_byte_cnt <= r_out_byte_cnt + 12'd13;
  181:                     if ((r_out_byte_cnt + 12'd13) == 12'd3117)
  182:                         frame_3117b_pass_cnt <= frame_3117b_pass_cnt + 1;
  183:                 end
  184:             end 
  185:             else if (tb_state == ST_GAP && cycle_cnt == 10) begin
  186:                 r_out_byte_cnt <= 12'd0;
  187:             end
  188:         end
  189:     end
  190: 
  191:     wire [11:0] gearbox_out_byte_cnt = cdc_valid ? 
  192:         (cdc_keep == 16'hFFFF ? (r_out_byte_cnt + 12'd16) : (r_out_byte_cnt + 12'd13)) 
  193:         : r_out_byte_cnt;
  194: 
  195:     // =======================================================
  196:     // 6. SIMULATION LOGGING
  197:     // =======================================================
  198:     initial begin
  199:         wait(tb_state == ST_DONE);
  200:         #5000;
  201:         $display("\n=======================================================");
  202:         $display(" MUX GEARBOX VERIFICATION COMPLETE (SDA OISL TABLE 2-8)");
  203:         $display(" Preamble (9B: 72'h77AD5B5843641E2E26) + LPC (3108B) merged.");
  204:         $display(" MUX output terminates STRICTLY at 3117 Bytes per frame.");
  205:         $display(" The 13-Byte flush is validated by cdc_keep = 16'h1FFF.");
  206:         $display(" Table 2-8 Preamble MSB-First Passes : %0d / 4 Frames", preamble_msb_pass_cnt);
  207:         $display(" Exact 3117-Byte Frame Passes        : %0d / 4 Frames", frame_3117b_pass_cnt);
  208:         if (preamble_msb_pass_cnt == 4 && frame_3117b_pass_cnt == 4)
  209:             $display(" RESULT: [PASS] 100%% COMPLIANT WITH ETRI AUDIT ITEM 1!");
  210:         $display("=======================================================\n");
  211:         $finish;
  212:     end
  213: 
  214: endmodule

    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : tb_reassembly_and_backend
    7: Description  : End-to-End Verification Testbench for Receiver Ethernet Frame 
    8:                Reassembly (ethernet_frame_reassembly.v) and 10G Ethernet TX 
    9:                Back-End (eth_tx_back_end_top.v).
   10: 
   11:                KEY VERIFICATION OBJECTIVES:
   12:                1. Feeds two 1908-Byte (477-word) FSO DATA frames carrying a 
   13:                   segmented 2000-Byte Ethernet Jumbo packet:
   14:                   - Frame 1 (Start Frame, 477 words = 1908B):
   15:                     * Word 0 = 32'hAB00_0000 (seq_num=0, Length=0)
   16:                     * Word 1 = 32'hCDEF_07D0 (Magic=0xCDEF, Length=2000 Bytes)
   17:                     * Words 2..476 = First 1900 Bytes (475 words) of Ethernet 
   18:                       Jumbo packet (MAC + IPv4 + UDP + "Kookmin FSO " + Body).
   19:                   - Frame 2 (Strict Table 2-18 Continuation Frame, 477 words = 1908B):
   20:                     * Word 0 = 32'hAB00_4064 (seq_num=1, Length=100 Bytes remaining)
   21:                     * Words 1..25 = Remaining 100 Bytes (25 words) of Ethernet 
   22:                       packet ending with FCS 32'hDEAD_BEEF at Word 25 (NO duplicate 
   23:                       0xCDEF Packet Header per Table 2-18 & ETRI Review Item 4.2(2)!).
   24:                     * Words 26..476 = 1804 Bytes (451 words) Zero Padding.
   25:                2. Inserts a 300-cycle inter-frame delay between Frame 1 and 
   26:                   Frame 2 to prove that ethernet_frame_reassembly holds commit 
   27:                   until the 2000th byte arrives (ZERO intra-packet gap!).
   28:                3. Verifies that eth_tx_back_end_top emits 503 contiguous XGMII 
   29:                   words (2012 Bytes = /S/ 0x555555FB, 0xD5555555, 500 Ethernet 
   30:                   words, and /T/ 0x070707FD) followed by 3 cycles of 0x07070707 IPG.
   31: 
   32: Revision History:
   33:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : Reassembly + 10G Ethernet Back-End verification TB.
   34:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 15:55 KST) : [Target B6.3 - SDA OISL Page 43-46, Table 2-18 & ETRI Item 4.2(2)]
   35:     Updated Frame 2 stimulus to the strict Table 2-18 Continuation Frame format 
   36:     (Word 0 = 32'hAB00_4064 + 25 words [100B] remaining Ethernet data + 451 words 
   37:     [1804B] zero padding = 477 words [1908B] without duplicate 0xCDEF header).
   38: ===========================================================================
   39: */
   40: 
   41: module tb_reassembly_and_backend();
   42: 
   43:     reg clk;   // 312.5 MHz Clock (3.2 ns)
   44:     reg rst_n;
   45: 
   46:     reg  [31:0] s_axis_fso_tdata;
   47:     reg         s_axis_fso_tvalid;
   48:     reg         s_axis_fso_tlast;
   49:     wire        s_axis_fso_tready;
   50: 
   51:     wire [31:0] reassembled_eth_tdata;
   52:     wire        reassembled_eth_tvalid;
   53:     wire        reassembled_eth_tlast;
   54:     wire [15:0] reassembled_pkt_bytes;
   55:     wire [15:0] reassembled_pkt_cnt;
   56: 
   57:     wire [31:0] pc2_xgmii_txd;
   58:     wire [3:0]  pc2_xgmii_txc;
   59: 
   60:     // 1. Ethernet Frame Reassembly & Preamble Injection (SDA OISL Sec. 2.6.3.7.7)
   61:     ethernet_frame_reassembly u_reassembly (
   62:         .clk                   (clk),
   63:         .rst_n                 (rst_n),
   64:         .s_axis_fso_tdata      (s_axis_fso_tdata),
   65:         .s_axis_fso_tvalid     (s_axis_fso_tvalid),
   66:         .s_axis_fso_tlast      (s_axis_fso_tlast),
   67:         .s_axis_fso_tready     (s_axis_fso_tready),
   68:         .m_axis_eth_tdata      (reassembled_eth_tdata),
   69:         .m_axis_eth_tvalid     (reassembled_eth_tvalid),
   70:         .m_axis_eth_tlast      (reassembled_eth_tlast),
   71:         .m_axis_eth_tready     (1'b1),
   72:         .reassembled_pkt_bytes (reassembled_pkt_bytes),
   73:         .reassembled_pkt_cnt   (reassembled_pkt_cnt)
   74:     );
   75: 
   76:     // 2. 10G Ethernet TX Back-End to PC 2
   77:     eth_tx_back_end_top #(.RUN_MODE(1)) u_backend (
   78:         .clk       (clk),
   79:         .rst_n     (rst_n),
   80:         .data_in   (reassembled_eth_tdata),
   81:         .en        (reassembled_eth_tvalid),
   82:         .xgmii_txd (pc2_xgmii_txd),
   83:         .xgmii_txc (pc2_xgmii_txc),
   84:         .refclk_p  (1'b0),
   85:         .refclk_n  (1'b1),
   86:         .reset     (1'b0),
   87:         .dclk      (1'b0),
   88:         .txp       (),
   89:         .txn       ()
   90:     );
   91: 
   92:     initial begin
   93:         clk = 1'b0;
   94:         forever #1.6 clk = ~clk;
   95:     end
   96: 
   97:     integer eth_out_words  = 0;
   98:     integer xgmii_pkt_words = 0;
   99:     reg     in_xgmii_frame = 1'b0;
  100:     reg [31:0] captured_last_eth_fcs;
  101: 
  102:     always @(posedge clk) begin
  103:         if (reassembled_eth_tvalid) begin
  104:             eth_out_words <= eth_out_words + 1;
  105:             if (reassembled_eth_tlast)
  106:                 captured_last_eth_fcs <= reassembled_eth_tdata;
  107:         end
  108:         if (pc2_xgmii_txc == 4'b0001 && pc2_xgmii_txd[7:0] == 8'hFB) begin
  109:             in_xgmii_frame  <= 1'b1;
  110:             xgmii_pkt_words <= 1;
  111:         end else if (in_xgmii_frame) begin
  112:             xgmii_pkt_words <= xgmii_pkt_words + 1;
  113:             if (pc2_xgmii_txc == 4'b1111 && pc2_xgmii_txd[7:0] == 8'hFD) begin
  114:                 in_xgmii_frame <= 1'b0;
  115:             end
  116:         end
  117:     end
  118: 
  119:     integer w;
  120:     initial begin
  121:         rst_n             = 1'b0;
  122:         s_axis_fso_tdata  = 32'd0;
  123:         s_axis_fso_tvalid = 1'b0;
  124:         s_axis_fso_tlast  = 1'b0;
  125:         #100;
  126:         rst_n             = 1'b1;
  127:         repeat (10) @(posedge clk);
  128: 
  129:         // =======================================================
  130:         // FRAME 1: Start Frame (4B 0xAB + 4B 0xCDEF + 1900B Eth = 1908B / 477 Words)
  131:         // =======================================================
  132:         $display("\n[%0t] Streaming FSO Frame 1 (Start Frame: 0xAB000000 + 0xCDEF07D0 + 1900B Data)...", $time);
  133:         for (w = 0; w < 477; w = w + 1) begin
  134:             @(posedge clk);
  135:             s_axis_fso_tvalid <= 1'b1;
  136:             s_axis_fso_tlast  <= (w == 476);
  137:             case (w)
  138:                 0:  s_axis_fso_tdata <= 32'hAB00_0000; // Table 2-18 FSO Payload Hdr (seq=0, Len=0)
  139:                 1:  s_axis_fso_tdata <= 32'hCDEF_07D0; // Table 2-18 FSO Packet Hdr (Len=2000B)
  140:                 2:  s_axis_fso_tdata <= 32'hAABB_CCDD; // DEST_MAC[47:16]
  141:                 3:  s_axis_fso_tdata <= 32'hEEFF_1122; // DEST_MAC[15:0], SRC_MAC[47:32]
  142:                 4:  s_axis_fso_tdata <= 32'h3344_5566; // SRC_MAC[31:0]
  143:                 5:  s_axis_fso_tdata <= 32'h0800_4500; // EtherType IPv4
  144:                 11: s_axis_fso_tdata <= 32'h4B6F_6F6B; // "Kook"
  145:                 12: s_axis_fso_tdata <= 32'h6D69_6E20; // "min "
  146:                 13: s_axis_fso_tdata <= 32'h4653_4F20; // "FSO "
  147:                 default: s_axis_fso_tdata <= {16'hAAAA, w[15:0]};
  148:             endcase
  149:         end
  150: 
  151:         @(posedge clk);
  152:         s_axis_fso_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  153:         s_axis_fso_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  154:         s_axis_fso_tdata  <= 32'd0;
  155: 
  156:         // Intentional 300-cycle inter-frame gap (Proves zero premature egress / zero intra-packet gap)
  157:         repeat (300) @(posedge clk);
  158: 
  159:         // =======================================================
  160:         // FRAME 2: Table 2-18 Continuation Frame (4B 0xAB004064 + 100B Data + 1804B Pad = 1908B)
  161:         // =======================================================
  162:         $display("[%0t] Streaming FSO Frame 2 (Table 2-18 Continuation: 0xAB004064 + 100B Data + 1804B Pad)...", $time);
  163:         for (w = 0; w < 477; w = w + 1) begin
  164:             @(posedge clk);
  165:             s_axis_fso_tvalid <= 1'b1;
  166:             s_axis_fso_tlast  <= (w == 476);
  167:             if      (w == 0)  s_axis_fso_tdata <= 32'hAB00_4064; // seq=1, Continuation Length = 100 Bytes
  168:             else if (w < 25)  s_axis_fso_tdata <= {16'hBBBB, w[15:0]}; // Bytes 1901..1996 (Words 1..24)
  169:             else if (w == 25) s_axis_fso_tdata <= 32'hDEAD_BEEF; // Bytes 1997..2000: Ethernet FCS at Word 25!
  170:             else              s_axis_fso_tdata <= 32'd0;         // Words 26..476: 1804 Bytes (451 words) Zero Padding
  171:         end
  172: 
  173:         @(posedge clk);
  174:         s_axis_fso_tvalid <= 1'b0;
  175:         s_axis_fso_tlast  <= 1'b0;
  176:         s_axis_fso_tdata  <= 32'd0;
  177: 
  178:         wait(eth_out_words == 502);
  179:         repeat (20) @(posedge clk);
  180: 
  181:         $display("\n======================================================================");
  182:         $display(" ETHERNET REASSEMBLY (TABLE 2-18) & 10G BACK-END VERIFICATION REPORT");
  183:         $display(" -> Reassembled Packet Size (No Preamble) : %0d Bytes (Expected: 2000B)", reassembled_pkt_bytes);
  184:         $display(" -> Reassembled + 8B Preamble Words       : %0d Words (2008 Bytes, Expected: 502)", eth_out_words);
  185:         $display(" -> Final Reassembled Word (Ethernet FCS) : 0x%08X (Expected: 0xDEADBEEF)", captured_last_eth_fcs);
  186:         $display(" -> Total XGMII Words Emitted (/S/.. /T/) : %0d Words (2012 Bytes, Expected: 503)", xgmii_pkt_words);
  187:         if (reassembled_pkt_bytes == 16'd2000 && eth_out_words == 502 &&
  188:             captured_last_eth_fcs == 32'hDEAD_BEEF && xgmii_pkt_words == 503)
  189:             $display(" -> RESULT: [PASS] 100%% COMPLIANT WITH TABLE 2-18 & ETRI ITEM 4.2(2)!");
  190:         $display("======================================================================\n");
  191:         $finish;
  192:     end
  193: 
  194: endmodule

    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : tb_rs_decoder_rx
    7: Description  : End-to-End Verification Testbench for Receiver Reed-Solomon 
    8:                Decoders:
    9:                - rs_decoder #(33) : Shortened RS(32,16) Header Decoder 
   10:                  (32 Bytes in -> 16 corrected Header Bytes out).
   11:                - rs_decoder_64    : 8-Lane Parallel RS(255,239) Payload Decoder 
   12:                  (255 Words / 2040 Bytes in -> 239 Words / 1912 Bytes out).
   13: 
   14:                KEY VERIFICATION OBJECTIVES:
   15:                1. Encodes 4 frames using Golden Reference rs_encoder #(31) 
   16:                   and rs_encoder_64 #(254) over GF(2^8) primitive polynomial 
   17:                   F(x) = x^8 + x^7 + x^2 + x + 1 (0x187) and generator roots 
   18:                   alpha^(11*j) for j = 120..135 (SDA OISL Page 37).
   19:                2. Injects symbol errors into both the 32-Byte Header (up to 
   20:                   4 symbol errors) and all 8 lanes of the 2040-Byte Payload 
   21:                   (up to 8 symbol errors per codeword = 64 corrupted bytes/frame).
   22:                3. Verifies 100% error correction and exact recovery of all 
   23:                   16 Header bytes and 1912 Payload bytes per frame.
   24: 
   25: Revision History:
   26:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : RS(32,16) Header & 8xRS(255,239) Payload Decoder TB.
   27:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 15:55 KST) : [ETRI Audit Item 2 & Item 3 Verification]
   28:     Verified unified GF(2^8) 0x187 lookup tables (decimal_value.mem & 
   29:     alpha_value.mem) and generator roots alpha^(11*j) (j = 120..135) across 
   30:     TX rs_encoder and RX syndrome_unit, euclid_proc, chien_search, and 
   31:     forney_math with multi-symbol error injection and Table 2-18 headers.
   32: ===========================================================================
   33: */
   34: 
   35: module tb_rs_decoder_rx();
   36: 
   37:     reg clk;   // 200.0 MHz Baseband Clock (5.0 ns)
   38:     reg rst_n;
   39: 
   40:     // Golden Reference TX Inputs
   41:     reg         tx_hdr_en;
   42:     reg  [7:0]  tx_hdr_in;
   43:     reg         tx_pld_en;
   44:     reg  [63:0] tx_pld_in;
   45: 
   46:     // Golden Reference TX RS Encoder Outputs
   47:     wire        enc_hdr_dv;
   48:     wire [7:0]  enc_hdr_out;
   49:     wire        enc_pld_dv;
   50:     wire [63:0] enc_pld_out;
   51: 
   52:     // Symbol Error Injection (Up to E = 8 symbol errors per codeword)
   53:     reg  [5:0]  hdr_sym_idx;
   54:     reg  [8:0]  pld_sym_idx;
   55:     wire [7:0]  hdr_err_mask = (enc_hdr_dv && (hdr_sym_idx >= 6'd3 && hdr_sym_idx <= 6'd6)) ?
   56:                                8'hA5 : 8'h00; // 4 symbol errors in RS(32,16) Header
   57:     wire [63:0] pld_err_mask = (enc_pld_dv && (pld_sym_idx >= 9'd10 && pld_sym_idx <= 9'd17)) ?
   58:                                64'hE175_0023_4600_8792 : 64'd0; // 8 symbol errors per RS(255,239) codeword
   59: 
   60:     wire [7:0]  noisy_hdr_in = enc_hdr_out ^ hdr_err_mask;
   61:     wire [63:0] noisy_pld_in = enc_pld_out ^ pld_err_mask;
   62: 
   63:     // Receiver DUT Outputs
   64:     wire        dec_hdr_dv;
   65:     wire [7:0]  dec_hdr_out;
   66:     wire        dec_pld_dv;
   67:     wire [63:0] dec_pld_out;
   68: 
   69:     // Hierarchical Probes
   70:     wire [11:0] repaired_hdr_bytes      = u_dut_rs_hdr_dec.repaired_symbol_cnt;
   71:     wire [11:0] total_repaired_pld_bytes = u_dut_rs_pld_dec.total_repaired_pld_bytes;
   72:     wire [31:0] fso_payload_header      = u_dut_rs_pld_dec.fso_payload_header;
   73:     wire [31:0] fso_packet_header       = u_dut_rs_pld_dec.fso_packet_header;
   74:     wire [31:0] fso_crc32_out           = u_dut_rs_pld_dec.fso_crc32_out;
   75:     wire [7:0]  pld_byte_stream         = u_dut_rs_pld_dec.pld_byte_stream;
   76:     wire [11:0] pld_byte_cnt            = u_dut_rs_pld_dec.pld_byte_cnt;
   77:     wire [31:0] rs_frame_id             = u_dut_rs_pld_dec.rs_frame_id;
   78: 
   79:     // 1. Golden Reference TX Encoders (GF 0x187, roots j=120..135)
   80:     rs_encoder #(31) u_ref_rs_hdr_enc (
   81:         .clk      (clk),
   82:         .rst_n    (rst_n),
   83:         .en       (tx_hdr_en),
   84:         .data_in  (tx_hdr_in),
   85:         .flag     (enc_hdr_dv),
   86:         .data_out (enc_hdr_out)
   87:     );
   88: 
   89:     rs_encoder_64 #(254) u_ref_rs_pld_enc (
   90:         .clk      (clk),
   91:         .rst_n    (rst_n),
   92:         .en       (tx_pld_en),
   93:         .data_in  (tx_pld_in),
   94:         .flag     (enc_pld_dv),
   95:         .data_out (enc_pld_out)
   96:     );
   97: 
   98:     // 2. Receiver DUT Decoders (GF 0x187, roots j=120..135)
   99:     rs_decoder #(33) u_dut_rs_hdr_dec (
  100:         .clk      (clk),
  101:         .rst_n    (rst_n),
  102:         .en       (enc_hdr_dv),
  103:         .data_in  (noisy_hdr_in),
  104:         .flag     (dec_hdr_dv),
  105:         .data_out (dec_hdr_out)
  106:     );
  107: 
  108:     rs_decoder_64 u_dut_rs_pld_dec (
  109:         .clk      (clk),
  110:         .rst_n    (rst_n),
  111:         .en       (enc_pld_dv),
  112:         .data_in  (noisy_pld_in),
  113:         .flag     (dec_pld_dv),
  114:         .data_out (dec_pld_out)
  115:     );
  116: 
  117:     initial begin
  118:         clk = 1'b0;
  119:         forever #2.5 clk = ~clk;
  120:     end
  121: 
  122:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
  123:         if (!rst_n) begin
  124:             hdr_sym_idx <= 6'd0;
  125:             pld_sym_idx <= 9'd0;
  126:         end else begin
  127:             hdr_sym_idx <= enc_hdr_dv ? (hdr_sym_idx + 6'd1) : 6'd0;
  128:             pld_sym_idx <= enc_pld_dv ? (pld_sym_idx + 9'd1) : 9'd0;
  129:         end
  130:     end
  131: 
  132:     // Reference FIFOs to Verify Decoded Outputs against Original TX Inputs
  133:     reg [7:0]  exp_hdr_q [0:255];
  134:     reg [63:0] exp_pld_q [0:2047];
  135:     integer    hdr_wr_p = 0, hdr_rd_p = 0;
  136:     integer    pld_wr_p = 0, pld_rd_p = 0;
  137:     integer    hdr_ok_cnt = 0, hdr_err_cnt = 0;
  138:     integer    pld_ok_cnt = 0, pld_err_cnt = 0;
  139: 
  140:     always @(posedge clk) begin
  141:         if (rst_n) begin
  142:             if (tx_hdr_en) begin
  143:                 exp_hdr_q[hdr_wr_p] = tx_hdr_in;
  144:                 hdr_wr_p            = hdr_wr_p + 1;
  145:             end
  146:             if (tx_pld_en) begin
  147:                 exp_pld_q[pld_wr_p] = tx_pld_in;
  148:                 pld_wr_p            = pld_wr_p + 1;
  149:             end
  150:             if (dec_hdr_dv) begin
  151:                 if (dec_hdr_out == exp_hdr_q[hdr_rd_p])
  152:                     hdr_ok_cnt = hdr_ok_cnt + 1;
  153:                 else
  154:                     hdr_err_cnt = hdr_err_cnt + 1;
  155:                 hdr_rd_p = hdr_rd_p + 1;
  156:             end
  157:             if (dec_pld_dv) begin
  158:                 if (dec_pld_out == exp_pld_q[pld_rd_p])
  159:                     pld_ok_cnt = pld_ok_cnt + 1;
  160:                 else
  161:                     pld_err_cnt = pld_err_cnt + 1;
  162:                 pld_rd_p = pld_rd_p + 1;
  163:             end
  164:         end
  165:     end
  166: 
  167:     integer f, c;
  168:     initial begin
  169:         rst_n     = 1'b0;
  170:         tx_hdr_en = 1'b0;
  171:         tx_hdr_in = 8'd0;
  172:         tx_pld_en = 1'b0;
  173:         tx_pld_in = 64'd0;
  174:         #100;
  175:         rst_n     = 1'b1;
  176:         repeat (5) @(posedge clk);
  177: 
  178:         for (f = 1; f <= 4; f = f + 1) begin
  179:             // 1. Feed 16 Bytes of Header + 239 Words of Payload
  180:             for (c = 1; c <= 239; c = c + 1) begin
  181:                 @(posedge clk);
  182:                 if (c <= 16) begin
  183:                     tx_hdr_en <= 1'b1;
  184:                     case (c)
  185:                         1:  tx_hdr_in <= f[7:0];  // d0: TXFN[7:0]
  186:                         2:  tx_hdr_in <= 8'h00;   // d1: TXFN[15:8]
  187:                         5:  tx_hdr_in <= (f == 3) ? 8'hF0 : (f == 4) ? 8'hF2 : 8'hFD;
  188:                         15: tx_hdr_in <= 8'h0F;   // d14: CRC-16 MSB
  189:                         16: tx_hdr_in <= 8'h28;   // d15: CRC-16 LSB
  190:                         default: tx_hdr_in <= 8'h55 + c[7:0];
  191:                     endcase
  192:                 end else begin
  193:                     tx_hdr_en <= 1'b0;
  194:                     tx_hdr_in <= 8'd0;
  195:                 end
  196: 
  197:                 tx_pld_en <= 1'b1;
  198:                 if      (c == 1)   tx_pld_in <= (f == 2) ? 64'hAB00_4064_AAAA_0001 : 64'hAB00_0000_CDEF_07D0;
  199:                 else if (c == 239) tx_pld_in <= 64'hDA7A_DA7A_C320_0000 + f[63:0];
  200:                 else               tx_pld_in <= {32'h4B6F_6F6B, f[15:0], c[15:0]};
  201:             end
  202: 
  203:             @(posedge clk);
  204:             tx_hdr_en <= 1'b0;
  205:             tx_pld_en <= 1'b0;
  206:             tx_pld_in <= 64'd0;
  207: 
  208:             // Wait for RS Decoder BRAM + Euclid + Chien/Forney pipeline before next frame
  209:             repeat (320) @(posedge clk);
  210:         end
  211: 
  212:         wait(hdr_ok_cnt + hdr_err_cnt == 64);
  213:         wait(pld_ok_cnt + pld_err_cnt == 956);
  214:         #500;
  215: 
  216:         $display("\n======================================================================");
  217:         $display(" REED-SOLOMON DECODER VERIFICATION REPORT (GF 0x187, ROOTS j=120..135)");
  218:         $display(" -> RS(32,16) Header Bytes Recovered   : %0d / 64  (Errors: %0d)", hdr_ok_cnt, hdr_err_cnt);
  219:         $display(" -> 8xRS(255,239) Payload Words Recov. : %0d / 956 (Errors: %0d)", pld_ok_cnt, pld_err_cnt);
  220:         $display(" -> Total Repaired Header Symbols      : %0d", repaired_hdr_bytes);
  221:         $display(" -> Total Repaired Payload Symbols     : %0d", total_repaired_pld_bytes);
  222:         if (hdr_ok_cnt == 64 && hdr_err_cnt == 0 && pld_ok_cnt == 956 && pld_err_cnt == 0)
  223:             $display(" -> RESULT: [PASS] 100%% COMPLIANT WITH ETRI AUDIT ITEM 2 & ITEM 3!");
  224:         $display("======================================================================\n");
  225:         $finish;
  226:     end
  227: 
  228: endmodule

   37: 
   38:     // =========================================================================
   39:     // 1. GENERATOR CLOCK FISIK (Presisi 10G)
   40:     // =========================================================================
   41:     // System Clock (300 MHz -> Periode 3.333 ns) untuk PLL Baseband 200 MHz
   42:     initial begin
   43:         sys_clk_p = 1'b0;
   44:         sys_clk_n = 1'b1;
   45:         forever #1.666 begin
   46:             sys_clk_p = ~sys_clk_p;
   47:             sys_clk_n = ~sys_clk_n;
   48:         end
   49:     end
   50: 
   51:     // MGT Reference Clock (156.25 MHz -> Periode 6.4 ns) untuk Transceiver GTH
   52:     initial begin
   53:         mgtrefclk_p = 1'b0;
   54:         mgtrefclk_n = 1'b1;
   55:         forever #3.2 begin
   56:             mgtrefclk_p = ~mgtrefclk_p;
   57:             mgtrefclk_n = ~mgtrefclk_n;
   58:         end
   59:     end
   60: 
   61:     // =========================================================================
   62:     // 2. SKENARIO SIMULASI
   63:     // =========================================================================
   64:     initial begin
   65:         // Loopback Internal GTH atau SFP+ fisik dimatikan, kita monitoring
   66:         // aliran sinyal secara pasif. (GTH di setting untuk internal loopback di exdes jika diperlukan).
   67:         RXN_IN = 4'b0000;
   68:         RXP_IN = 4'b0000;
   69: 
   70:         $display("[%0t] Memulai Simulasi End-to-End SDA OISL 10G...", $time);
   71:         
   72:         // Memberi waktu agar PLL (clk_wiz_0) dan Reset Internal GTH selesai mengunci (Lock)
   73:         #8000;
   74:         
   75:         $display("[%0t] PLL GTH dan Baseband Lock. Autorun memicu XGMII Packet Gen...", $time);
   76:         
   77:         // Simulasi berjalan cukup lama agar paket bisa melewati seluruh chain:
   78:         // XGMII -> Segmenter -> Framer -> CDC1 -> RS/LPC -> CDC2 -> ARQ -> GTH -> 
   79:         // GTH RX -> ARQ RX -> CDC1_RX -> Decoder -> CDC2_RX -> Assembler -> XGMII RX
   80:         #250000; 
   81: 
   82:         $display("[%0t] Simulasi Selesai. Periksa sinyal xgmii_rxd_out di ujung Egress.", $time);
   83:         $finish;
   84:     end
   85: 
   86: endmodule

    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Description  : High-Precision SDA OISL Testbench for CDC 1 (x_gth_logic.v).
    7: 
    8:                CRITICAL REVISION:
    9:                - Redesigned the stimulus generator using a pure FSM approach.
   10:                - Eliminated all off-by-one index shifting bugs.
   11:                - Achieved absolute True Zero-Gap streaming (en_head and en_load 
   12:                  never drop to 0 between frames unless backpressured).
   13:                - SDA OISL Geometry Compliance (16-Byte Header & 478-Word Payload).
   14: 
   15:                Scenario (4 Sequential Frames):
   16:                - Frame 1: DATA (1912B) - First 1900B of Jumbo Eth
   17:                - Frame 2: DATA (1912B) - Remaining 100B Eth + Padding
   18:                - Frame 3: IDLE (1912B) - PRBS Filler
   19:                - Frame 4: MGMT (1912B) - Telemetry
   20: 
   21: Revision History:
   22:   - Rev 1.0 (Initial) : 4-frame Zero-Gap CDC 1 testbench.
   23:   - Rev 2.0 (2026-10-27 15:11 KST) : [Target B2 Verification - C_PRELOAD_LATENCY = 2 Alignment]
   24:     1. Aligned Header byte 1 (d0 = TXFN[7:0]) and byte 2 (d1 = TXFN[15:8]) with 
   25:        SDA OISL Table 2-10 LSB-first ordering.
   26:     2. Added automatic boundary value verification proving that with the +2 
   27:        latency fix in x_gth_logic.v Rev 2.0:
   28:        - Header Byte 1  is {4'd0, frame_id} (no leading 8'h00 shift!)
   29:        - Header Byte 16 is 8'hC2 (CRC-16 LSB is never truncated!)
   30:        - Payload Word 1 is 64'hAB00_0000_CDEF_07D0 (FSO Headers intact!)
   31:        - Payload Word 239 [31:0] is 32'hC3C3_C3C3 (CRC-32 trailer is never truncated!)
   32: ===========================================================================
   33: */
   34: 
   35: module tb_x_gth_logic();
   36: 
   37:     // =======================================================
   38:     // 1. SYSTEM CLOCKS AND RESET
   39:     // =======================================================
   40:     reg clk_gth;   // Fast Write Domain Clock : 312.5 MHz (Period: 3.2 ns)
   41:     reg clk_logic; // Slow Read Domain Clock  : 200.0 MHz (Period: 5.0 ns)
   42:     reg rst_n;
   43: 
   44:     // =======================================================
   45:     // 2. DEVICE UNDER TEST (DUT) SIGNALS
   46:     // =======================================================
   47:     reg         en_head;
   48:     reg  [7:0]  header_in;
   49:     reg         en_load;
   50:     reg  [31:0] payload_in;
   51: 
   52:     wire        cdc_ready;
   53:     wire        header_dv;
   54:     wire [7:0]  header_out;
   55:     wire        payload_dv;
   56:     wire [63:0] payload_out;
   57: 
   58:     // =======================================================
   59:     // 3. VISUALIZATION AND TRACKING VARIABLES (For Vivado)
   60:     // =======================================================
   61:     // ASCII String to dynamically display Frame Type (Set Radix to ASCII)
   62:     reg [31:0] mux_frame_type_str; 
   63: 
   64:     // Current Frame Tracker (1 to 4)
   65:     reg [3:0]  current_frame_id;
   66: 
   67:     // --- INPUT INDICES ---
   68:     // Sequential indices to drive data injection
   69:     reg [4:0]  header_byte_index;   // 0 (Idle), 1 to 16 (Active)
   70:     reg [15:0] payload_word_index;  // 0 (Idle), 1 to 478 (Active)
   71: 
   72:     // --- OUTPUT INDICES (WAVEFORM VISUALIZERS) ---
   73:     // Internal hidden registers
   74:     reg [4:0]  out_header_cnt_reg;
   75:     reg [7:0]  out_payload_cnt_reg;
   76: 
   77:     // Combinational wires for perfect waveform alignment (Starts at 1)
   78:     wire [4:0] out_header_byte_idx  = header_dv  ? (out_header_cnt_reg + 1'b1)  : 5'd0;
   79:     wire [7:0] out_payload_word_idx = payload_dv ? (out_payload_cnt_reg + 1'b1) : 8'd0;
   80: 
   81:     // Output Verification Counters (Cumulative for final check)
   82:     integer verified_header_bytes  = 0;
   83:     integer verified_payload_words = 0;
   84:     integer hdr_crc16_tail_ok_cnt  = 0;
   85:     integer pld_crc32_tail_ok_cnt  = 0;
   86: 
   87:     // =======================================================
   88:     // 4. DUT INSTANTIATION
   89:     // =======================================================
   90:     x_gth_logic u_cdc_tx_1 (
   91:         .clk_gth    (clk_gth),
   92:         .clk_logic  (clk_logic),
   93:         .rst_n      (rst_n),
   94:         .en_head    (en_head),
   95:         .en_load    (en_load),
   96:         .header_in  (header_in),
   97:         .payload_in (payload_in),
   98:         .cdc_ready  (cdc_ready),
   99:         .header_dv  (header_dv),
  100:         .header     (header_out),
  101:         .payload_dv (payload_dv),
  102:         .payload    (payload_out)
  103:     );
  104: 
  105:     // =======================================================
  106:     // 5. CLOCK GENERATION & OUTPUT TRACKING
  107:     // =======================================================
  108:     initial begin
  109:         clk_gth = 1'b0;
  110:         forever #1.6 clk_gth = ~clk_gth; // 312.5 MHz
  111:     end
  112: 
  113:     initial begin
  114:         clk_logic = 1'b0;
  115:         forever #2.5 clk_logic = ~clk_logic; // 200.0 MHz
  116:     end
  117: 
  118:     // Sequential Tracker Logic for Outputs
  119:     always @(posedge clk_logic or negedge rst_n) begin
  120:         if (!rst_n) begin
  121:             out_header_cnt_reg     <= 5'd0;
  122:             out_payload_cnt_reg    <= 8'd0;
  123:             verified_header_bytes  <= 0;
  124:             verified_payload_words <= 0;
  125:             hdr_crc16_tail_ok_cnt  <= 0;
  126:             pld_crc32_tail_ok_cnt  <= 0;
  127:         end else begin
  128:             // Track Header (16 Bytes: d0..d15)
  129:             if (header_dv) begin
  130:                 out_header_cnt_reg    <= out_header_cnt_reg + 1'b1;
  131:                 verified_header_bytes <= verified_header_bytes + 1;
  132:                 if ((out_header_Byte_idx == 5'd16) && (header_out == 8'hC2))
  133:                     hdr_crc16_tail_ok_cnt <= hdr_crc16_tail_ok_cnt + 1;
  134:             end else begin
  135:                 out_header_cnt_reg    <= 5'd0;
  136:             end
  137: 
  138:             // Track Payload (239 Words @ 64-bit = 1912 Bytes)
  139:             if (payload_dv) begin
  140:                 out_payload_cnt_reg    <= out_payload_cnt_reg + 1'b1;
  141:                 verified_payload_words <= verified_payload_words + 1;
  142:                 if ((out_payload_word_idx == 8'd239) && (payload_out[31:0] == 32'hC3C3_C3C3))
  143:                     pld_crc32_tail_ok_cnt <= pld_crc32_tail_ok_cnt + 1;
  144:             end else begin
  145:                 out_payload_cnt_reg    <= 8'd0;
  146:             end
  147:         end
  148:     end
  149: 
  150:     // =======================================================
  151:     // 6. MAIN SCENARIO: TWO-PROCESS FSM ARCHITECTURE
  152:     // =======================================================
  153:     localparam ST_INIT   = 2'd0;
  154:     localparam ST_STREAM = 2'd1;
  155:     localparam ST_DONE   = 2'd2;
  156:     reg [1:0] tb_state;
  157: 
  158:     // --- PROCESS 1: SEQUENTIAL LOGIC (Index & State Management) ---
  159:     always @(posedge clk_gth or negedge rst_n) begin
  160:         if (!rst_n) begin
  161:             tb_state           <= ST_INIT;
  162:             current_frame_id   <= 4'd1;
  163:             header_byte_index  <= 5'd0;
  164:             payload_word_index <= 16'd0;
  165:         end else begin
  166:             case (tb_state)
  167:                 ST_INIT: begin
  168:                     // Wait for CDC FIFOs to assert ready before transmitting
  169:                     if (cdc_ready) begin
  170:                         tb_state           <= ST_STREAM;
  171:                         header_byte_index  <= 5'd1;
  172:                         payload_word_index <= 16'd1;
  173:                     end
  174:                 end
  175: 
  176:                 ST_STREAM: begin
  177:                     // Backpressure Check: Freeze counters if CDC is not ready
  178:                     if (cdc_ready) begin
  179:                         
  180:                         // 1. Advance Payload Index (Max 478 Words)
  181:                         if (payload_word_index < 478) begin
  182:                             payload_word_index <= payload_word_index + 1'b1;
  183:                         end else begin
  184:                             // End of Frame Reached
  185:                             if (current_frame_id < 4) begin
  186:                                 // Zero-Gap Transition to next frame
  187:                                 current_frame_id   <= current_frame_id + 1'b1;
  188:                                 payload_word_index <= 16'd1;
  189:                                 header_byte_index  <= 5'd1;
  190:                             end else begin
  191:                                 // All 4 frames transmitted
  192:                                 tb_state           <= ST_DONE;
  193:                                 payload_word_index <= 16'd0;
  194:                                 header_byte_index  <= 5'd0;
  195:                             end
  196:                         end
  197: 
  198:                         // 2. Advance Header Index (Max 16 Bytes)
  199:                         if (header_byte_index >= 1 && header_byte_index < 16) begin
  200:                             header_byte_index <= header_byte_index + 1'b1;
  201:                         end else if (header_byte_index == 16) begin
  202:                             // Park index to 0 after 16 bytes are sent
  203:                             header_byte_index <= 5'd0; 
  204:                         end
  205:                     end
  206:                 end
  207: 
  208:                 ST_DONE: begin
  209:                     // Keep indices parked
  210:                     header_byte_index  <= 5'd0;
  211:                     payload_word_index <= 16'd0;
  212:                 end
  213:             endcase
  214:         end
  215:     end
  216: 
  217:     // --- PROCESS 2: COMBINATIONAL LOGIC (Data Injection) ---
  218:     always @(*) begin
  219:         // Default Assignments (Prevents Latches)
  220:         en_head            = 1'b0;
  221:         header_in          = 8'd0;
  222:         en_load            = 1'b0;
  223:         payload_in         = 32'd0;
  224:         mux_frame_type_str = "WAIT";
  225: 
  226:         if (tb_state == ST_STREAM) begin
  227:             
  228:             // Apply combinational Backpressure to signals
  229:             if (cdc_ready) begin
  230:                 
  231:                 // --- MUX IDENTIFIER FOR WAVEFORM ---
  232:                 if      (current_frame_id == 1) mux_frame_type_str = "DAT1"; 
  233:                 else if (current_frame_id == 2) mux_frame_type_str = "DAT2"; 
  234:                 else if (current_frame_id == 3) mux_frame_type_str = "IDLE"; 
  235:                 else                            mux_frame_type_str = "MGMT"; 
  236: 
  237:                 // --- HEADER DATA MAPPING (Cycles 1 to 16 per Table 2-10) ---
  238:                 if (header_byte_index >= 1 && header_byte_index <= 16) begin
  239:                     en_head = 1'b1;
  240:                     case (header_byte_index)
  241:                         5'd1:  header_in = {4'd0, current_frame_id};    // d0: TXFN[7:0] (LSB)
  242:                         5'd2:  header_in = 8'h00;                       // d1: TXFN[15:8] (MSB)
  243:                         5'd15: header_in = 8'hC1;                       // d14: CRC-16 MSB
  244:                         5'd16: header_in = 8'hC2;                       // d15: CRC-16 LSB
  245:                         default: header_in = 8'hAA;                     // Dummy PNT/Config
  246:                     endcase
  247:                 end
  248: 
  249:                 // --- PAYLOAD DATA MAPPING (Cycles 1 to 478) ---
  250:                 if (payload_word_index >= 1 && payload_word_index <= 478) begin
  251:                     en_load = 1'b1;
  252:                     case (payload_word_index)
  253:                         16'd1:   payload_in = 32'hAB00_0000; // FSO Payload Header (Table 2-18)
  254:                         16'd2:   payload_in = 32'hCDEF_07D0; // FSO Packet Header (Len = 2000B)
  255:                         16'd478: payload_in = 32'hC3C3_C3C3; // FSO CRC-32 Tail
  256:                         default: begin
  257:                             // Main Data Body Patterns
  258:                             if (current_frame_id == 1 || current_frame_id == 2) 
  259:                                 payload_in = 32'hDA7A_DA7A; // DATA Pattern
  260:                             else if (current_frame_id == 3)             
  261:                                 payload_in = 32'h1D1E_1D1E; // IDLE Pattern
  262:                             else                                
  263:                                 payload_in = 32'hA1A1_A1A1; // MGMT Pattern
  264:                         end
  265:                     endcase
  266:                 end
  267:             end // End if (cdc_ready)
  268:             else begin
  269:                 // If CDC asserts Backpressure, freeze data (TREADY=0 behavior)
  270:                 mux_frame_type_str = "HOLD";
  271:             end
  272:         end 
  273:         else if (tb_state == ST_DONE) begin
  274:             mux_frame_type_str = "DONE";
  275:         end
  276:     end
  277: 
  278:     // =======================================================
  279:     // 7. EVALUATION & VERIFICATION REPORT
  280:     // =======================================================
  281:     initial begin
  282:         rst_n = 1'b0;
  283:         #100; rst_n = 1'b1;
  284: 
  285:         // Wait for FSM to complete injection
  286:         wait(tb_state == ST_DONE);
  287:         
  288:         // Provide sufficient time for the slower 200 MHz domain to drain FIFOs
  289:         #15000;
  290: 
  291:         $display("\n=======================================================");
  292:         $display(" CDC 1 (x_gth_logic) PRECISION REPORT (TARGET B2 FIX)");
  293:         $display("=======================================================");
  294:         
  295:         $display(" 1. HEADER DOMAIN CROSSING (8-bit -> 8-bit, Latency +2)");
  296:         $display("    Expected : 64 Bytes   (4 Frames x 16 Bytes)");
  297:         $display("    Captured : %0d Bytes  (CRC-16 Tail 0xC2 Intact: %0d / 4)", verified_header_bytes, hdr_crc16_tail_ok_cnt);
  298:         if (verified_header_bytes == 64 && hdr_crc16_tail_ok_cnt == 4) $display("    Result   : [PASS]");
  299:         else $display("    Result   : [FAIL]");
  300: 
  301:         $display("\n 2. PAYLOAD ASYMMETRIC CROSSING (32-bit -> 64-bit, Latency +2)");
  302:         $display("    Expected : 956 Words  (4 Frames x 239 Words @ 64-bit)");
  303:         $display("    Captured : %0d Words  (CRC-32 Tail 0xC3C3C3C3 Intact: %0d / 4)", verified_payload_words, pld_crc32_tail_ok_cnt);
  304:         if (verified_payload_words == 956 && pld_crc32_tail_ok_cnt == 4) $display("    Result   : [PASS]");
  305:         else $display("    Result   : [FAIL]");
  306:         $display("=======================================================\n");
  307: 
  308:         $finish;
  309:     end
  310: 
  311: endmodule

    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    3: // Company: WiComAI Lab Kookmin University
    4: // Engineer: Williamsyah Baginda Miraj
    5: // Deskripsi: Top-Level Module End-to-End (SDA OISL 10G Architecture)
    6: //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
    7: 
    8: module top 
    9: (
   10:     input         sys_clk_p,
   11:     input         sys_clk_n,
   12:     output [1:0]  tx_disable,
   13:     input         mgtrefclk_n,
   14:     input         mgtrefclk_p,    
   15:     input [3:0]   RXN_IN,
   16:     input [3:0]   RXP_IN,
   17:     output[3:0]   TXN_OUT,
   18:     output[3:0]   TXP_OUT,
   19:     output        fan
   20: );
   21: 
   22:     // =========================================================================
   23:     // SAKELAR MODE UTAMA (MASTER SWITCH)
   24:     // 1 = Mode Simulasi (Menggunakan xgmii_packet_gen internal)
   25:     // 0 = Mode Hardware (Menggunakan IP Core SFP+ untuk uji Python UDP)
   26:     // =========================================================================
   27:     localparam SIM_MODE = 1; 
   28: 
   29:     assign tx_disable = 2'd0;
   30:     assign fan        = 1'b0;
   31:     wire   rst_n      = 1'b1;
   32: 
   33:     // SISTEM CLOCKING
   34:     wire sys_clk;
   35:     wire clk_100M;
   36:     wire clk_logic;
   37: 
   38:     IBUFGDS sys_clk_inst (
   39:         .I  (sys_clk_p),
   40:         .IB (sys_clk_n),
   41:         .O  (sys_clk)
   42:     );
   43: 
   44:     clk_wiz_0 clk_wiz_0_inst (
   45:         .clk_in1  (sys_clk),
   46:         .clk_out1 (clk_100M),
   47:         .clk_out2 (clk_logic)
   48:     );
   49: 
   50:     wire tx0_clk; 
   51:     wire rx0_clk; 
   52: 
   53:     // KABEL PENGHUBUNG ANTAR MODUL
   54:     wire        trigger_en;
   55:     wire [31:0] xgmii_txd_in;
   56:     wire [3:0]  xgmii_txc_in;
   57:     
   58:     wire [31:0] seg_data;
   59:     wire        seg_valid;
   60:     wire [31:0] enc_data;
   61:     wire        enc_valid;
   62:     wire [31:0] err_data;
   63:     wire        err_valid;
   64:     
   65:     wire [31:0] gt_tx_data;
   66:     wire [3:0]  gt_tx_ctrl;
   67:     wire [31:0] gt_rx_data;
   68:     wire [3:0]  gt_rx_ctrl;
   69: 
   70:     wire [31:0] rec_data_align;
   71:     wire [3:0]  rec_ctrl_align;
   72:     wire        rec_valid;
   73:     wire [31:0] dec_data;
   74:     wire        dec_valid;
   75: 
   76:     wire [31:0] xgmii_rxd_out;
   77:     wire [3:0]  xgmii_rxc_out;
   78: 
   79:     // GENERATOR PAKET (Akan diabaikan oleh sistem jika SIM_MODE = 0)
   80:     autorun autorun_inst (
   81:         .clk   (tx0_clk),
   82:         .rst_n (rst_n),
   83:         .flag  (trigger_en) 
   84:     );
   85: 
   86:     xgmii_packet_gen packet_gen_inst (
   87:         .clk       (tx0_clk),
   88:         .rst_n     (rst_n),
   89:         .trigger   (trigger_en),
   90:         .xgmii_txd (xgmii_txd_in),
   91:         .xgmii_txc (xgmii_txc_in)
   92:     );
   93:         
   94:     // =========================================================================
   95:     // INGRESS: XGMII FRONT-END (Menerima parameter SIM_MODE)
   96:     // =========================================================================
   97:     wire eth_reset = ~rst_n;
   98: 
   99:     eth_rx_front_end_top #(
  100:         .RUN_MODE(SIM_MODE)
  101:     ) front_end_inst (
  102:         .clk            (tx0_clk),
  103:         .rst_n          (rst_n),
  104:         .xgmii_rxd      (xgmii_txd_in),  // Input dari Simulator
  105:         .xgmii_rxc      (xgmii_txc_in),
  106:         .data_out       (seg_data),     
  107:         .en             (seg_valid),
  108:         .debug_dest_mac (),

    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: 
    3: module xgmii_packet_gen(
    4:     input  wire        clk,
    5:     input  wire        rst_n,
    6:     input  wire        trigger,       // Beri sinyal '1' selama 1 clock untuk mengirim 1 frame
    7:     output reg  [31:0] xgmii_txd,
    8:     output reg  [3:0]  xgmii_txc
    9: );
   10: 
   11:     // =========================================================================
   12:     // [UBAH DISINI - KONFIGURASI UKURAN PAYLOAD]
   13:     // Ukuran Payload dalam satuan siklus (1 siklus = 4 Byte)
   14:     // - Paket Kecil (64 Byte)   = 16 
   15:     // - Standar (1500 Byte)     = 375 
   16:     // - Jumbo Frame (2000 Byte) = 500 (Segmenter akan memecah 2 frame)
   17:     // =========================================================================
   18:     localparam PAYLOAD_CYCLES = 16'd500; 
   19: 
   20:     // =========================================================================
   21:     // [UBAH DISINI - KONFIGURASI MAC ADDRESS]
   22:     // Format 48-bit (6 Byte)
   23:     // =========================================================================
   24:     localparam [47:0] DEST_MAC = 48'hAA_BB_CC_DD_EE_FF; // MAC PC 2 (Penerima)
   25:     localparam [47:0] SRC_MAC  = 48'h11_22_33_44_55_66; // MAC PC 1 (Pengirim)
   26: 
   27:     // =========================================================================
   28:     // [UBAH DISINI - KONFIGURASI IP ADDRESS (IPv4)]
   29:     // Format 32-bit (4 Byte)
   30:     // =========================================================================
   31:     localparam [31:0] SRC_IP  = {8'd192, 8'd168, 8'd1, 8'd10}; // 192.168.1.10
   32:     localparam [31:0] DEST_IP = {8'd192, 8'd168, 8'd1, 8'd20}; // 192.168.1.20
   33: 
   34:     // =========================================================================
   35:     // [UBAH DISINI - KONFIGURASI ISI TEKS PAYLOAD]
   36:     // Jika Anda ingin mengirim teks, ubah hex ASCII di bawah ini.
   37:     // Teks default: "Kookmin FSO " (12 karakter = 3 siklus x 4 Byte)
   38:     // =========================================================================
   39:     localparam [31:0] TEXT_WORD_1 = 32'h4B_6F_6F_6B; // "Kook"
   40:     localparam [31:0] TEXT_WORD_2 = 32'h6D_69_6E_20; // "min "
   41:     localparam [31:0] TEXT_WORD_3 = 32'h46_53_4F_20; // "FSO "
   42:     localparam [31:0] DUMMY_DATA  = 32'h5A_5A_5A_5A; // Data pengisi "ZZZZ"
   43: 
   44:     // FSM States
   45:     localparam IDLE      = 3'd0;
   46:     localparam PREAMBLE  = 3'd1;
   47:     localparam MAC_HEAD  = 3'd2;
   48:     localparam PAYLOAD   = 3'd3;
   49:     localparam FCS_TERM  = 3'd4;
   50:     localparam IPG_WAIT  = 3'd5;
   51: 
   52:     reg [2:0]  state;
   53:     reg [15:0] count;
   54: 
   55:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   56:         if (!rst_n) begin
   57:             state     <= IDLE;
   58:             count     <= 16'd0;
   59:             xgmii_txd <= 32'h07070707; // Idle XGMII (0x07) meniru standar IEEE
   60:             xgmii_txc <= 4'b1111;      // Control bit (F)
   61:         end else begin
   62:             case (state)
   63:                 IDLE: begin
   64:                     // TAHAP PERBAIKAN 1: Tahan transmisi di 07070707 secara permanen saat tidak ada trigger
   65:                     xgmii_txd <= 32'h07070707;
   66:                     xgmii_txc <= 4'b1111;
   67:                     if (trigger) begin
   68:                         state <= PREAMBLE;
   69:                         count <= 16'd0;
   70:                     end
   71:                 end
   72: 
   73:                 PREAMBLE: begin
   74:                     if (count == 0) begin
   75:                         // Start Byte (0xFB) on Lane 0 + Preamble
   76:                         xgmii_txd <= 32'h55_55_55_FB;
   77:                         xgmii_txc <= 4'b0001; 
   78:                         count <= count + 1;
   79:                     end else begin
   80:                         // Preamble + SFD (0xD5)
   81:                         xgmii_txd <= 32'hD5_55_55_55;
   82:                         xgmii_txc <= 4'b0000;
   83:                         state <= MAC_HEAD;
   84:                         count <= 0;
   85:                     end
   86:                 end
   87: 
   88:                 MAC_HEAD: begin
   89:                     xgmii_txc <= 4'b0000;
   90:                     if (count == 0) begin
   91:                         xgmii_txd <= DEST_MAC[47:16]; 
   92:                         count <= count + 1;
   93:                     end else if (count == 1) begin
   94:                         xgmii_txd <= {SRC_MAC[31:0]};
   95:                         count <= count + 1;
   96:                     end else if (count == 2) begin
   97:                         // IPv4 Type (0x0800) + IP Source (Partial)
   98:                         xgmii_txd <= {SRC_IP[15:0], 16'h0008};
   99:                         state <= PAYLOAD;
  100:                         count <= 0;
  101:                     end
  102:                 end
  103: 
  104:                 PAYLOAD: begin
  105:                     xgmii_txc <= 4'b0000;
  106:                     if (count == 0)      xgmii_txd <= TEXT_WORD_1;
  107:                     else if (count == 1) xgmii_txd <= TEXT_WORD_2;
  108:                     else if (count == 2) xgmii_txd <= TEXT_WORD_3;
  109:                     else                 xgmii_txd <= DUMMY_DATA;
  110: 
  111:                     if (count == PAYLOAD_CYCLES - 1) begin
  112:                         state <= FCS_TERM;
  113:                         count <= 0;
  114:                     end else begin
  115:                         count <= count + 1;
  116:                     end
  117:                 end
  118: 
  119:                 FCS_TERM: begin
  120:                     if (count == 0) begin
  121:                         // Meniru laporan Gio: FCS berupa deadbeef
  122:                         xgmii_txd <= 32'hDEADBEEF; // Dummy FCS
  123:                         xgmii_txc <= 4'b0000;
  124:                         count <= count + 1;
  125:                     end else begin
  126:                         // Terminate Byte (0xFD) - Sesuai gambar Gio di presentasi
  127:                         xgmii_txd <= 32'h07_07_07_FD; 
  128:                         xgmii_txc <= 4'b1111; // 1 means control char
  129:                         state <= IPG_WAIT;
  130:                         count <= 0;
  131:                     end
  132:                 end
  133: 
  134:                 IPG_WAIT: begin
  135:                     xgmii_txd <= 32'h07070707; // Inter-Packet Gap (Idles)
  136:                     xgmii_txc <= 4'b1111;
  137:                     // TAHAP PERBAIKAN 2: Menggunakan > 2 (min 3 siklus IPG) dan langsung transisi ke IDLE
  138:                     // Minimum IPG adalah 96 bits atau 3 siklus clock
  139:                     if (count == 16'd3) begin 
  140:                         state <= IDLE;
  141:                     end else begin
  142:                         count <= count + 1'b1;
  143:                     end
  144:                 end
  145:             endcase
  146:         end
  147:     end
  148: endmodule

Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : xgmii_rx_parser
    7: Description  : 32-bit IEEE 802.3ae XGMII Receive Frame Delimiter Parser.
    8:                Detects the XGMII Start control character (/S/ = 0xFB on Lane 0)
    9:                and Terminate control character (/T/ = 0xFD on any lane) to 
   10:                convert raw XGMII words into an AXI-Stream frame.
   11: 
   12:                Revision Notes:
   13:                - Preserved original XGMII /S/ (0xFB) and /T/ (0xFD) detection
   14:                  state machine.
   15:                - Standardized port interface (clk, rst_n, xgmii_rxd, xgmii_rxc,
   16:                  m_axis_tdata, m_axis_tvalid, m_axis_tlast) to match 
   17:                  eth_rx_front_end_top.v without port mismatch errors.
   18: ===========================================================================
   19: */
   20: 
   21: module xgmii_rx_parser (
   22:     input  wire        clk,
   23:     input  wire        rst_n,
   24: 
   25:     // Raw 32-bit XGMII Input from 10G PCS/PMA or Simulation Encoder
   26:     input  wire [31:0] xgmii_rxd,
   27:     input  wire [3:0]  xgmii_rxc,
   28: 
   29:     // AXI-Stream Output (Includes 8-Byte Preamble/SFD starting with 0x555555FB)
   30:     output reg  [31:0] m_axis_tdata,
   31:     output reg         m_axis_tvalid,
   32:     output reg         m_axis_tlast
   33: );
   34: 
   35:     localparam S_IDLE = 1'b0;
   36:     localparam S_DATA = 1'b1;
   37: 
   38:     reg state;
   39: 
   40:     // Detect Start (/S/ = 0xFB in Lane 0 with control bit rxc[0] == 1)
   41:     wire is_start_lane0 = (xgmii_rxc[0] == 1'b1) && (xgmii_rxd[7:0] == 8'hFB);
   42: 
   43:     // Detect Terminate (/T/ = 0xFD in any lane with corresponding control bit == 1)
   44:     wire is_term_lane0  = (xgmii_rxc[0] == 1'b1) && (xgmii_rxd[7:0]   == 8'hFD);
   45:     wire is_term_lane1  = (xgmii_rxc[1] == 1'b1) && (xgmii_rxd[15:8]  == 8'hFD);
   46:     wire is_term_lane2  = (xgmii_rxc[2] == 1'b1) && (xgmii_rxd[23:16] == 8'hFD);
   47:     wire is_term_lane3  = (xgmii_rxc[3] == 1'b1) && (xgmii_rxd[31:24] == 8'hFD);
   48:     wire is_terminate   = is_term_lane0 | is_term_lane1 | is_term_lane2 | is_term_lane3;
   49: 
   50:     // 1-Cycle lookahead pipeline register so m_axis_tlast asserts on the final
   51:     // valid Ethernet FCS word right before a Lane-0 Terminate word (0x070707FD)
   52:     reg [31:0] rxd_d1;
   53:     reg        valid_d1;
   54: 
   55:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   56:         if (!rst_n) begin
   57:             state         <= S_IDLE;
   58:             rxd_d1        <= 32'd0;
   59:             valid_d1      <= 1'b0;
   60:             m_axis_tdata  <= 32'd0;
   61:             m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   62:             m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
   63:         end else begin
   64:             case (state)
   65:                 S_IDLE: begin
   66:                     m_axis_tvalid <= 1'b0;
   67:                     m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
   68:                     if (is_start_lane0) begin
   69:                         // Replace 0xFB with 0x55 so downstream preamble remover sees clean 0x55
   70:                         rxd_d1   <= {xgmii_rxd[31:8], 8'h55};
   71:                         valid_d1 <= 1'b1;
   72:                         state    <= S_DATA;
   73:                     end else begin
   74:                         valid_d1 <= 1'b0;
   75:                     end
   76:                 end
   77: 
   78:                 S_DATA: begin
   79:                     if (is_terminate) begin
   80:                         // Current cycle contains /T/ (0xFD): flush buffered word with tlast = 1
   81:                         m_axis_tdata  <= rxd_d1;
   82:                         m_axis_tvalid <= valid_d1;
   83:                         m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b1;
   84:                         valid_d1      <= 1'b0;
   85:                         state         <= S_IDLE;
   86:                     end else if (xgmii_rxc == 4'b0000) begin
   87:                         // Normal data word: output previous buffered word and latch current word
   88:                         m_axis_tdata  <= rxd_d1;
   89:                         m_axis_tvalid <= valid_d1;
   90:                         m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b0;
   91:                         rxd_d1        <= xgmii_rxd;
   92:                         valid_d1      <= 1'b1;
   93:                     end else begin
   94:                         // Unexpected control character: terminate frame safely
   95:                         m_axis_tdata  <= rxd_d1;
   96:                         m_axis_tvalid <= valid_d1;
   97:                         m_axis_tlast  <= 1'b1;
   98:                         valid_d1      <= 1'b0;
   99:                         state         <= S_IDLE;
  100:                     end
  101:                 end
  102:             endcase
  103:         end
  104:     end
  105: 
  106: endmodule

Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 1ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Description  : AXI4-Stream to XGMII (32-bit @ 312.5 MHz) Encoder.
    7:                Simulates PHY behavior: Injects 0xFB at lane 0, 0x55 Preamble, 
    8:                0xD5 SFD, and enforces a strict IEEE 802.3 IPG of 9.6ns.
    9: ===========================================================================
   10: */
   11: 
   12: module xgmii_tx_encoder (
   13:     input  wire        clk,
   14:     input  wire        rst_n,
   15: 
   16:     input  wire [31:0] s_axis_tdata,
   17:     input  wire [3:0]  s_axis_tkeep,
   18:     input  wire        s_axis_tvalid,
   19:     input  wire        s_axis_tlast,
   20:     output reg         s_axis_tready,
   21: 
   22:     output reg  [31:0] xgmii_txd,
   23:     output reg  [3:0]  xgmii_txc
   24: );
   25: 
   26:     localparam XGMII_TERM = 8'hFD;
   27:     localparam S_IDLE       = 3'd0, S_PREAMBLE_1 = 3'd1, S_PREAMBLE_2 = 3'd2;
   28:     localparam S_DATA       = 3'd3, S_TERM_EXT   = 3'd4, S_IPG        = 3'd5;
   29: 
   30:     reg [2:0] state;
   31:     reg [1:0] ipg_cnt;
   32: 
   33:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   34:         if (~rst_n) begin
   35:             state         <= S_IDLE;
   36:             ipg_cnt       <= 2'd0;
   37:             xgmii_txd     <= 32'h07070707;
   38:             xgmii_txc     <= 4'b1111;
   39:             s_axis_tready <= 1'b0;
   40:         end else begin
   41:             case (state)
   42:                 S_IDLE: begin
   43:                     xgmii_txd     <= 32'h07070707; 
   44:                     xgmii_txc     <= 4'b1111;
   45:                     s_axis_tready <= 1'b0;
   46:                     if (s_axis_tvalid) state <= S_PREAMBLE_1;
   47:                 end
   48: 
   49:                 S_PREAMBLE_1: begin
   50:                     xgmii_txd     <= 32'h555555FB; // 0xFB strictly on lane 0
   51:                     xgmii_txc     <= 4'b0001; 
   52:                     state         <= S_PREAMBLE_2;
   53:                 end
   54: 
   55:                 S_PREAMBLE_2: begin
   56:                     xgmii_txd     <= 32'hD5555555; 
   57:                     xgmii_txc     <= 4'b0000;
   58:                     s_axis_tready <= 1'b1;         
   59:                     state         <= S_DATA;
   60:                 end
   61: 
   62:                 S_DATA: begin
   63:                     if (s_axis_tvalid) begin
   64:                         if (s_axis_tlast) begin
   65:                             s_axis_tready <= 1'b0; 
   66:                             case (s_axis_tkeep)
   67:                                 4'b0001: begin xgmii_txd <= {16'h0707, XGMII_TERM, s_axis_tdata[7:0]}; xgmii_txc <= 4'b1110; state <= S_IPG; end
   68:                                 4'b0011: begin xgmii_txd <= {8'h07, XGMII_TERM, s_axis_tdata[15:0]}; xgmii_txc <= 4'b1100; state <= S_IPG; end
   69:                                 4'b0111: begin xgmii_txd <= {XGMII_TERM, s_axis_tdata[23:0]}; xgmii_txc <= 4'b1000; state <= S_IPG; end
   70:                                 4'b1111: begin xgmii_txd <= s_axis_tdata; xgmii_txc <= 4'b0000; state <= S_TERM_EXT; end
   71:                             endcase
   72:                         end else begin
   73:                             xgmii_txd <= s_axis_tdata;
   74:                             xgmii_txc <= 4'b0000;
   75:                         end
   76:                     end
   77:                 end
   78: 
   79:                 S_TERM_EXT: begin
   80:                     xgmii_txd <= {24'h070707, XGMII_TERM};
   81:                     xgmii_txc <= 4'b1111;
   82:                     state     <= S_IPG;
   83:                 end
   84: 
   85:                 S_IPG: begin
   86:                     xgmii_txd <= 32'h07070707;
   87:                     xgmii_txc <= 4'b1111;
   88:                     if (ipg_cnt == 2'd1) begin // Min 3 cycles (9.6 ns)
   89:                         ipg_cnt <= 2'd0;
   90:                         state   <= S_IDLE; 
   91:                     end else begin
   92:                         ipg_cnt <= ipg_cnt + 1'b1;
   93:                     end
   94:                 end
   95:             endcase
   96:         end
   97:     end
   98: endmodule

Sumber baseline lengkap
    1: `timescale 1ns / 100ps
    2: /*
    3: ===========================================================================
    4: Company      : WiComAI Lab, Kookmin University
    5: Engineers    : Williamsyah Baginda Miraj & Giovanni Dwi
    6: Module Name  : xgmii_tx_formatter
    7: Description  : IEEE 802.3ae 32-bit XGMII Transmit Formatter.
    8:                Converts the framed Ethernet stream (8-Byte Preamble + 
    9:                Payload + FCS) into physical XGMII data (xgmii_txd[31:0]) and 
   10:                control (xgmii_txc[3:0]) signals for eth_10g_pcs_pma_tx_0.
   11: 
   12:                KEY OPERATIONS:
   13:                1. Idle State:
   14:                   Drives XGMII Idle characters (xgmii_txd = 32'h0707_0707, 
   15:                   xgmii_txc = 4'b1111).
   16:                2. Cycle 1 (Start of Frame /S/):
   17:                   Replaces the first byte of the Preamble in Lane 0 with the 
   18:                   XGMII Start control code 0xFB (xgmii_txd = 32'h5555_55FB, 
   19:                   xgmii_txc = 4'b0001).
   20:                3. Cycle 2 (Preamble + SFD 0xD5):
   21:                   Places the Start Frame Delimiter (0xD5) in Lane 3 
   22:                   (xgmii_txd = 32'hD555_5555, xgmii_txc = 4'b0000) to match 
   23:                   Xilinx 10G PCS/PMA and xgmii_rx_parser lane ordering.
   24:                4. Payload Cycles & Dynamic Termination (/T/):
   25:                   Streams all Ethernet payload words (xgmii_txc = 4'b0000) 
   26:                   until 'mac_valid' de-asserts at the end of the packet, then 
   27:                   appends the XGMII Terminate control code 0xFD followed by 
   28:                   Idle (xgmii_txd = 32'h0707_07FD, xgmii_txc = 4'b1111) and 
   29:                   enforces a 3-cycle (12-Byte) Inter-Packet Gap (IPG).
   30: ===========================================================================
   31: */
   32: 
   33: module xgmii_tx_formatter (
   34:     input  wire        clk,
   35:     input  wire        rst_n,
   36:     input  wire [31:0] mac_data,
   37:     input  wire        mac_valid,
   38:     output reg  [31:0] xgmii_txd,
   39:     output reg  [3:0]  xgmii_txc
   40: );
   41: 
   42:     localparam IDLE     = 2'd0;
   43:     localparam ACTIVE   = 2'd1;
   44:     localparam IPG_WAIT = 2'd2;
   45: 
   46:     reg [1:0]  state;
   47:     reg [15:0] count;
   48: 
   49:     always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
   50:         if (!rst_n) begin
   51:             state     <= IDLE;
   52:             count     <= 16'd0;
   53:             xgmii_txd <= 32'h0707_0707;
   54:             xgmii_txc <= 4'b1111;
   55:         end else begin
   56:             case (state)
   57:                 IDLE: begin
   58:                     if (mac_valid) begin
   59:                         state     <= ACTIVE;
   60:                         count     <= 16'd1;
   61:                         // Cycle 1: Inject XGMII Start /S/ (0xFB) in Lane 0
   62:                         xgmii_txd <= {mac_data[31:8], 8'hFB};
   63:                         xgmii_txc <= 4'b0001;
   64:                     end else begin
   65:                         xgmii_txd <= 32'h0707_0707;
   66:                         xgmii_txc <= 4'b1111;
   67:                     end
   68:                 end
   69: 
   70:                 ACTIVE: begin
   71:                     if (mac_valid) begin
   72:                         count <= count + 16'd1;
   73:                         if (count == 16'd1 && mac_data == 32'h5555_55D5) begin
   74:                             // Cycle 2: Align SFD (0xD5) to XGMII Lane 3 [31:24]
   75:                             xgmii_txd <= 32'hD555_5555;
   76:                             xgmii_txc <= 4'b0000;
   77:                         end else begin
   78:                             // Cycles 3..N: Pure Ethernet Frame (MAC + IP + UDP + Payload + FCS)
   79:                             xgmii_txd <= mac_data;
   80:                             xgmii_txc <= 4'b0000;
   81:                         end
   82:                     end else begin
   83:                         // End of Packet: Inject XGMII Terminate /T/ (0xFD) in Lane 0 + 3 Idles
   84:                         xgmii_txd <= 32'h0707_07FD;
   85:                         xgmii_txc <= 4'b1111;
   86:                         state     <= IPG_WAIT;
   87:                         count     <= 16'd0;
   88:                     end
   89:                 end
   90: 
   91:                 IPG_WAIT: begin
   92:                     // Enforce minimum 12-Byte (3-cycle) Inter-Packet Gap (IPG)
   93:                     xgmii_txd <= 32'h0707_0707;
   94:                     xgmii_txc <= 4'b1111;
   95:                     if (count == 16'd2) begin
   96:                         state <= IDLE;
   97:                         count <= 16'd0;
   98:                     end else begin
   99:                         count <= count + 16'd1;
  100:                     end
  101:                 end
  102: 
  103:                 default: state <= IDLE;
  104:             endcase
  105:         end
  106:     end
  107: 
  108: endmodule
